jobs.description:
Shape Reward Programs That Help People Thrive
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place to Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate growth, and create value through technology and human ingenuity. Joining Accenture means becoming part of a global community that champions innovation, continuous learning, inclusion, and meaningful impact.
Are you passionate about creating fair, competitive, and data-driven reward experiences? Do you enjoy turning insights into action and collaborating with others to solve complex challenges? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for a Total Rewards Senior Analyst to join our Nordics & Netherlands Market Unit , supporting Denmark. In this role, you'll help deliver compensation and benefits programs that support our people and business strategy while working closely with colleagues across HR, payroll, and leadership teams. You'll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, your expertise is trusted, and your development is supported.

About the Team
Our Total Rewards team plays an important role in helping Accenture attract, retain, and develop exceptional talent. We partner with stakeholders across the business to design and deliver reward programs that are equitable, competitive, and aligned with our people priorities.
Working as part of the Nordics & Netherlands team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate across countries, share ideas, learn from experienced colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that make a meaningful difference to the employee experience.

What You'll Do
As a Total Rewards Senior Analyst, you'll combine analytical thinking, stakeholder collaboration, and operational excellence to support compensation and benefits activities across Denmark:
- Support the delivery of compensation and benefits programs, helping ensure a consistent and positive employee experience.

- Partner with HR, payroll, and business stakeholders to provide guidance, insights, and support on reward-related matters.

- Contribute to annual salary review cycles, compensation benchmarking, and off-cycle reward processes.

- Collaborate with payroll and HR operations teams to ensure reward-related inputs are accurate and completed on time.

- Support benefits and reward inquiries by gathering information, analyzing data, and helping identify practical solutions.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance reporting, and simplify ways of working.

- Share best practices and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Nordics & Netherlands Total Rewards team.

- Maintain strong governance, documentation, and attention to detail across recurring and ad hoc activities.

What You'll Bring
We're interested in talented individuals who bring a combination of experience, curiosity, and a passion for helping people succeed:
- Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, Benefits, HR Analytics, Finance, HR Operations, or a related field.

- Knowledge of Danish labor legislation, reward practices, and regulatory requirements, or the ability and enthusiasm to quickly develop expertise in these areas.

- Experience working in a multinational or complex organization.

- Experience using Workday or similar HR information systems.

- A Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

- Readiness to work with AI-enabled tools and an interest in using emerging technology to improve insights, efficiency, and ways of working.

- Flexibility and comfort working in an evolving role whose responsibilities may change dynamically as the company, team, and business needs develop.

- Professional fluency in both Danish and English.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights.

- Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large data sets.

- Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is an advantage.

- Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple priorities.

- A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from and support others.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a clear and practical way.

- A continuous improvement mindset and interest in finding better ways of working.

At Accenture, you'll be part of a workplace where learning, wellbeing, and career growth are encouraged every day:
- Opportunities to work with talented colleagues across the Nordics, the Netherlands, and our global network.

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to the employee experience and business success.

- Access to world-class learning, development, and career opportunities.

- A collaborative and inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued.

- Flexible ways of working that support wellbeing and work-life balance.

- A supportive environment where you can grow professionally while being yourself.

Inclusion & Belonging
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to succeed. We believe that diversity of thought, background, experience, and perspective makes us stronger.
If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. We're interested in your potential, your experiences, and what you can bring to our team.

Join us and help shape reward programs that support our people, strengthen our culture, and drive business success across Denmark.

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Senior Manager / Director
jobs.description:
Role: Risk & Compliance Senior Manager / Director

Accenture Risk & Compliance Services help our clients focus on three key challenges - increasing profitability, reducing complexity and managing regulations. We primarily work with leading financial services institutions, government, utilities and telecommunication providers. These clients look to our Risk & Compliance consultants to recommend the best solutions, based on their unique insights and industry expertise across Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Risk Analytics, Regulatory, Compliance and Fraud & Financial Crime functions.

As a trusted advisor, you will play a central role in helping organisations achieve their strategic and derived operational, reporting and compliance goals. Our experienced professionals and cutting-edge solutions enable organisations to cost-effectively manage risks Initiatives and controls to create substantial shareholder and economic value.

THE WORK:
- Bring local and global risk expertise to clients

- Lead high performing teams to support the CRO agenda

- Leverage and support our breadth of experience, global resources and superior assets

- Contribute to Accenture’s go to market, strategy, methodology and assets

- Form deep relationships with Accenture's clients and propose appropriate risk solutions and propositions

Key responsibilities
- Shape and lead project teams, including risk and compliance operating models, process re-engineering, regulatory compliance, internal controls review, risk policies and procedures, governance and reporting

- Bring thought leadership and perspectives to client's business units, including Enterprise Risk Management, Technology Risk, AI in Risk Management, Operational Risk, Fraud and Financial Crime and Risk Analytics

- Lead the development of new intellectual capital for Accenture's Risk & Compliance service line, support development of thought leadership, and assist in publishing articles in industry periodicals

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:
- Experience within a Management Consulting firm (big 4 or assurance) is essential

- Minimum 12 + years of work experience in consulting and advisory services to Financial Services, Government or utilities on Risk Management in one or several of the areas below:
- Financial Crime Management

- Fraud operating model and detailed knowledge of modern fraud and scams monitoring tools

- Operational Risk Management

- Regulatory Change Management

- Financial Risk Management

- Credit Risk

- Technology risk

- AI in Risk Management

- Strong track record of risk / compliance process design and/or risk transformation

- Understanding of relevant regulatory requirements including AUS/NZ regulations and global directives

- People management skills, with proven experience leading teams

- Successful track record, offering impeccable service delivery

- Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, ideally using MS suite - particularly PowerPoint

- Bachelor's Degree

Job Description – Risk Manager (Norway)
Due to continued growth and increasing demand across Norway and the Nordic region , we are seeking Risk Managers to join our expanding and collaborative team. You will play a key role in supporting major capital projects across sectors such as infrastructure, energy, data centres, and complex construction programmes .
We are looking for individuals with strong risk management experience who are comfortable working in dynamic, client-facing environments and contributing to the successful delivery of high-value projects.

Main Purpose of the Role
As a Risk Manager, you will support project teams and senior risk leads across programmes of varying size and complexity. You will be responsible for the accurate capture and management of risk data, facilitating the identification, assessment, and prioritisation of threats, opportunities, and issues.
You will help maintain visibility of key risk trigger points, enabling effective cost and schedule risk management, including budget utilisation and mitigation strategies. Your contribution will be critical in ensuring projects are delivered to time, cost, and quality objectives in line with client expectations.

Key Accountabilities
- Design, implement, and adapt risk management processes aligned to client requirements and industry best practice
- Facilitate risk workshops with project teams and subject matter experts
- Develop and maintain risk registers and supporting risk documentation
- Challenge and validate risk data to ensure accuracy, robustness, and transparency
- Drive the implementation of mitigation strategies and track associated actions across projects and programmes
- Support the development of measurable and effective risk responses aligned with project objectives
- Perform Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) for cost and schedule to assess overall project risk exposure
- Utilise risk tools such as Safran, @Risk, PRA , or similar platforms
- Produce clear, timely risk reports using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
- Collaborate with wider Project Controls teams to ensure alignment across cost, schedule, and risk functions
- Engage with supply chain partners to assess and incorporate third-party risks into project planning

About You
- Proven experience in risk management across the full project lifecycle , ideally within infrastructure, energy, or construction sectors
- Experience in complex capital projects within Norway or the Nordic region is advantageous
- Ability to adapt risk strategies and processes in response to changing project needs
- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to assess and communicate complex risk scenarios clearly
- Familiarity with risk management tools such as Safran, @Risk, PRA , or equivalent
- Understanding of recognised risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, APM, Orange Book, IPA )
- Professional membership (e.g., IRM, APM) is desirable
- Relevant risk qualifications (e.g., APM Risk Certificate, MoR ) are advantageous
- Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and influencing skills
- Experience working within integrated Project Controls environments
- Fluent in English; Norwegian language skills are advantageous

Job Description
Due to increased opportunities and demand we are recruiting for Risk Managers to join a diverse and supportive team during a period of significant growth. Our nuclear client is at the forefront of industry leading change, and we are keen to speak to like-minded individuals with risk management experience.
MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE:

A Risk Manager will be required to support the team and their senior risk managers for work packages and projects of varying size and complexity. Due to the nature of the programme of works, work packages may vary in size with risk managers working across smaller projects or one which could be significantly larger in value. A Risk Manager will be responsible for the accurate capture of risk data, facilitating identification, assessment and prioritisation of threats, opportunities and issues. They will maintain visibility of threat/opportunity trigger points to facilitate risk cost profiling, timely drawdown of risk budget or retirement of threats/opportunities. They play a key role in ensuring that client objectives are met and that projects are delivered to time and cost targets and the appropriate quality standards.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
As a Risk Manager, you have a passion to provide services as required by our clients, which may include:
- Planning, designing and implementing risk management processes tailoring to the client’s needs and aligning with best practice.
- Facilitation of risk workshops with subject matter experts.
- Creation and maintenance of risk registers and other risk information.
- Challenging risk information to enhance the quality of risk data so that it is robust.
- Drive the implementation of mitigation actions against associated risks across projects and programmes.
- Assist the project team with the identification and development of management responses which are measurable and specific, that support the post mitigated positions.
- Conduct Quantitative Risk Assessment and analysis (QRA) for cost and schedule impacts to support the understanding of the project’s remaining risk exposure.
- Demonstrate basic to practitioner competency with tools such as Safran, @risk, PRA or similar.
- The production of timely and efficient risk reporting using tools such as Microsoft (PowerPoint, Word and excel) and Power BI. Familiarity with web-based database/reporting tools – ARM, Xactium, Predict, Tableau.
- Collaborating with other Project Controls disciplines to maintain alignment of project information.
- Working with the supply chain to understand and incorporate the risks they present to clients.

You have professional Risk Management experience in one or more sectors across the whole Project lifecycle. While nuclear experience is desirable it is not an absolute requirement. You have the ability to adjust risk strategies and process in response to change and have excellent communication skills to convey complex risk information to all stakeholders. You are conversant with risk management systems such as Safran, @risk, PRA. Strategic awareness and critical thinking are key, with the ability to confidently assess the implications of various risk scenarios.
You also:
- Will be able to obtain BPSS level security clearance.
- Are a member of a relevant professional body e.g., Institute of Risk Management (IRM), Association for Project Management
- Familiarity with at least one risk standard or approach (ISO31000, APM, Orange Book, IPA)
- A risk qualification such as APM Risk Certificate Level 2 or Management of Risk (MoR) is desirable
- Have good verbal and written communication skills.
- Have good research and analytical skills.
- Have stakeholder management experience.
- Have experience of working within a Project Controls team.
- Have a desire to work within the nuclear sector.

jobs.title: Data Engineering, Management & Governance Manager
jobs.description:
We Are

The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.
With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture’s Data & AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem automation.

The Work

We are seeking a Data Engineering, Management & Governance Manager to own the technical integrity and delivery of strategic AI insights platforms that translate enterprise data into measurable business value. This role sits at the intersection of data architecture, AI platform engineering, and business value realization. It combines the rigor of a data fabric architect with the commercial instincts of a strategic AI platform builder.

You will design and maintain intelligent data platforms that ingest, model, and govern enterprise data across distributed environments — integrating AI capabilities, connecting to systems like Salesforce and Palantir Foundry, and enabling coverage and conversion metrics that drive sales and operational decisions. You will serve as the technical authority on data quality, ontology design, platform versioning, and integration engineering and ensure the platforms your team builds remain trustworthy, scalable, and impactful over time.

You Are

An Enterprise AI Value Engineer who combines data architecture depth with AI platform engineering capability. You bring:
- Credentials — a proven track record of delivering enterprise data and AI platforms — from strategic architecture through production deployment — in complex client or enterprise environments.
- Capability — hands-on proficiency across data fabric design, cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, BigQuery), pipeline engineering, and AI-integrated analytics solutions.
- Commercial Acumen — the ability to connect the tool, the data, and the business — designing platforms that power whitespace identification, KPI measurement, and revenue growth insights.
- Connections — trusted advisor presence with client architects and leaders — able to shape reference architectures, facilitate design sessions, and communicate technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
- Content — a systems-builder mindset — able to instrument, version, govern, and maintain platforms so they deliver durable value without accumulating technical debt.

In This Role You Will:
- Architect & Deliver Enterprise Data Fabric Solutions - Design enterprise data fabric solutions that deliver unified, intelligent, automated access to distributed data across on-premises and multi-cloud environments.
- Integrate data virtualization, active metadata, knowledge graphs, cataloging, and automated data integration into a connected data layer that powers analytics and AI.
- Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and governance frameworks that scale across the enterprise and remain maintainable over time.
- Apply data mesh and data product operating models to support self-service consumption, real-time data delivery, and decentralized data ownership.

- Build & Maintain Strategic AI Insights Platforms - Own the technical build, versioning, and ongoing maintenance of strategic AI insights platforms, managing releases, schema evolution, and platform integrity over time.
- Find, ingest, and clean new data sources, expanding platform coverage as new whitespace opportunities, accounts, or market segments are identified.
- Design data models and ontologies that structure whitespace and pipeline data so it is queryable, consistent, and ready to feed downstream AI and analytics workflows.
- Instrument platforms to enable automated coverage and conversion metric extraction, moving from manual survey-based measurement to reliable, system-generated KPIs.

- Integrate AI & Enterprise Systems - Connect AI insights platforms to enterprise systems including Salesforce CRM, Palantir Foundry, and other source systems — enabling automated cohort tagging, pipeline tracking, and KPI measurement to flow end-to-end.
- Integrate cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, BigQuery) with AI/ML pipelines and analytics workflows to power intelligent automation and decision support.
- Design and implement API and streaming architectures that support real-time data delivery and event-driven AI platform workflows.
- Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines and metadata lineage solutions that keep data flowing reliably and traceably across the enterprise data estate.

- Govern Data Quality, Security & Access - Own data quality governance and establish data validation, monitoring, and remediation practices that keep platform inputs trustworthy over time.
- Handle account and client data responsibly, implementing security, access controls, and data governance practices appropriate for sensitive pipeline and market penetration data.
- Maintain metadata lineage and cataloging so data provenance is auditable and platform outputs are explainable to business and technical stakeholders alike.
- Proactively identify and address data quality risks that could degrade platform reliability or undermine the business value case over time.

- Enable Business Value & Client Advisory - Engage client data architects and business leaders as a trusted technical advisor — facilitating design thinking sessions, shaping solution architectures, and aligning platform capabilities to business outcomes.
- Translate business requirements, such as whitespace identification, account penetration measurement, and revenue growth targeting, into platform data models and AI-powered workflows.
- Partner with pursuit teams and business stakeholders to shape architectures and delivery models for major data modernization and AI value programs.
- Build reusable data assets, pipeline templates, and reference architectures that accelerate delivery across future client engagements.

- Drive Continuous Platform Innovation - Research and evaluate emerging cloud data platforms, data fabric technologies, and AI integration patterns to continuously advancing the technical quality of delivered solutions.
- Apply modern streaming, API, and event-driven architecture patterns to expand platform capabilities and reduce latency in data delivery.
- Contribute thought leadership on enterprise data fabric, AI-integrated data platforms, and whitespace value engineering to internal communities and client engagements.

Travel may be required for this role. 0 to 100% depending on client and business needs.

Here's what you need

Minimum of 5 years of experience in the following:
- Data architecture, enterprise data engineering, or AI platform delivery.
- Architecting data fabric solutions — including data virtualization, active metadata management, knowledge graphs, and automated data integration.
- With cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, BigQuery, or equivalent.
- With data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and metadata and lineage tooling.
- Designing API and streaming architectures for real-time data delivery.
- With enterprise CRM or operational platform integration (Salesforce preferred) in the context of data engineering or AI platform delivery

Professional Skills Requirements:
- Cloud Data Platforms: Snowflake (including Cortex AI, Snowpark), Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Google BigQuery.
- Data Fabric & Integration: Data virtualization, active metadata management, knowledge graphs, automated data integration, and data cataloging (e.g., Informatica, Alation, Collibra, or equivalent).
- Pipeline Engineering: ETL/ELT design and delivery using tools such as dbt, Apache Spark, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or equivalent.
- Data Modeling & Ontology: Dimensional modeling, graph data modeling, ontology design, and schema evolution for AI-ready data platforms.
- Streaming & API Architecture: Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis, REST/GraphQL API design, and event-driven integration patterns.
- Enterprise System Integration: Salesforce (data integration and pipeline tagging), Palantir Foundry, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
- AI/ML Platform Integration: Connecting data platforms to AI/ML workflows, vector databases, RAG pipelines, and analytical AI models.
- Data Governance & Quality: Metadata lineage, data quality monitoring, access control frameworks, and audit logging for sensitive enterprise data.
- Analytics Enablement: Instrumentation of platforms for automated KPI extraction, coverage metrics, and conversion measurement.
- Security & Access Management: Data security best practices, role-based access control, and governance in regulated or sensitive data environments.
- Programming: Python and/or SQL proficiency for pipeline development, data transformation, and platform automation.

Bonus Points If You Have:
- Hands-on experience applying data mesh and data product operating models in enterprise delivery contexts.
- Cloud or data platform architecture certifications: Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud (data engineering or AI/ML specializations preferred).
- Direct experience in Oil & Gas, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors — particularly with OT data environments, time-series data, or sector-specific AI use cases.
- Experience with Palantir Foundry data modeling, ontology design, or pipeline development.
- Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or enterprise delivery frameworks at scale.
- Experience contributing to open-source data platform or AI engineering projects, or published thought leadership in enterprise data architecture.
- MBA or advanced graduate degree in a technical or business discipline.

The Dependency Management Consultant is responsible for identifying, managing, and resolving delivery dependencies across complex, multi‑stream programs. Governance & Reporting
- Provide regular dependency status reporting to program leadership and governance forums.
- Produce clear, concise insights to support executive decision‑making.
- Ensure dependency management activities align with PMO standards, governance frameworks, and delivery controls.

Stakeholder Engagement
- Build strong working relationships with internal teams, vendors, and client stakeholders.
- Act as a trusted coordination point to facilitate collaboration and alignment across delivery teams.

Essential

jobs.description:
Role: Management Consultant - Banking
Location: Dublin

We are looking for an experienced management consultant with experienced gained within either commercial or retail banking. You should have gained exposure to major transformation projects using leading technology.

As a team:
In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Strategy & Consulting comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialised skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention.

You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformations and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.

Management Consultants design and implement business changes that drive industry-specific, function and digital operating model transformation, focusing on tasks relating to people and processes. We help banks challenge their conventions; capitalize on the full potential of technology, their people and emerging opportunities; and become better at change.

In our team you will learn:
- The latest industry innovations across both Retail and Commercial Banking, from organisation design through to GenAI

- Skills in the latest technologies that support successful banks such as cloud & advanced analytics

- How macroeconomic factors flow through to shaping the UK banking industry of the future

- How to deliver innovative solution to tight timelines working as part of a team in a project delivery capacity

- How to build and develop your own brand and career working in the Accenture Banking team

- How to manage some of the most complex and large-scale transformational projects at this inflection point in the industry.

In this role you will support one or several of the following areas:
- Solution Design and Planning: Ability to work in a client-facing role that translates client requirements and business objectives into engineering solutions that shape large scale programmes to deliver the technology strategy for an organisation.

- Project and Programme Management: Experience in creating, implementing and operating within appropriate governance framework, leading multi-disciplinary teams to implement cutting edge technology at an enterprise level.

- Develop business cases to identify, measure and realise enterprise value with an emphasis on modern software engineering

- Contribute to business development activities including opportunity identification/qualification, proposal development/presentation, and commercial contract negotiation.

- Contribute to developing the Accenture Strategy and Consulting Banking practice and building Accenture’s banking offerings, assets, capabilities, and thought leadership

We are looking for experience in the following:
- Experience working within Retail or Commercial Banking either in an advisory, operational or leadership capacity; ideally within a bank or professional services firm

- Strong client-facing experience with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.

- Excellent leadership, communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

- Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to approach a problem in a structured manner and propose workable solutions.

- Ability to absorb and process information quickly.

- Consulting experience or ability to work in a consulting environment indispensable.

Academic Requirements:
- An excellent University Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

Set yourself apart:
- A drive for personal development and curiosity to learn new concepts and skills.

- Ability to understand complex issues, quickly absorb information, and work creatively in a problem-solving environment.

- Comfort with the quantitative skills required to develop financial/operational models and supervise data analysis.

- An appreciation of how technology and digital can contribute to solving clients’ complex business problems; comfort operating at the intersection of business and technology.

- Experience working with relevant FinTech providers

- Natural leadership and the ability to quickly build effective teams, establish trust-based relationships and gain valuable insights through collaboration and communication.

- Experience with staff development and ability to mentor junior practitioners.

- Proven presentation skills, personal impact and charisma to lead meetings, presentations and workshops.

- Confidence to articulate complex problems and solutions in a simple, logical and impactful manner with groups ranging from board rooms to business unit leads, and to constructively challenge team members and leadership to ensure the right client outcomes and value is delivered.

- Some exposure and/or involvement in sales origination, coupled with an entrepreneurial mind-set.

- Strong project management skills, including experience working on a project using Agile delivery methodology

Our Commitment to You
Accenture is an incredible place to work - and keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re really proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow - whatever it is you're phenomenal at. So you will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.

Does this appeal to you? If so, we would love to hear from you!
Please advise if you have any particular requirements, so we can look into arranging reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process. You can contact us at accessIErecruitment@accenture.com .

What’s in for you:
At Accenture Ireland, in addition to a competitive base salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes pension, private health insurance, discounts through our employee discount scheme, 20 days of holidays and 2 days’ leave per year for charitable work of your choice! jobs.title: Document Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Would you like to actively contribute to the energy transition while ensuring structure and transparency in complex infrastructure projects? As a Document Management Consultant , you will support energy suppliers and grid operators in the professional management of their project documentation – from planning through to commissioning. You will work on forward-looking projects related to grid expansion and renewable energy, ensuring that information is traceable, quality-assured and available whenever needed.

Explore our projects and meet the ICP team, watch a recording from our professional meetups:
https://fb.watch/DJqNKn30Au/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b5B_yjsPZjs

Your Mission
You will support our clients in implementing, optimising and managing document management processes in complex infrastructure and energy projects. You will ensure that documents are managed in a compliant, structured and efficient manner throughout the entire project lifecycle.
As a key interface between project teams, business functions and external partners, you will ensure smooth processes, high data quality and compliance with relevant standards and requirements.
At Accenture, you can create the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You remain flexible and become part of a team of unique individuals who work together to make an impact.

What you can expect
Take control of documents
You will manage project documents throughout their entire lifecycle – from creation, approvals and version control through to archiving. You will ensure that documents are complete, up to date and stored in a transparent and traceable manner at all times.
Processes that work
You will develop and further improve document management processes, guidelines and standards and support their implementation in day-to-day project work. You will also support the administration and continuous optimisation of the systems and tools used.
Ensure quality and minimize risks
You will carry out quality and completeness checks, ensure compliance with documentation and regulatory requirements, and prepare relevant documentation for audits, reviews and project approvals.
Strengthen consulting and collaboration
You will support project teams with questions relating to document management and Document Control, deliver training sessions and work closely with business functions as well as planning and permitting teams to successfully implement documentation requirements.

We are looking for
- You have at least 2–4 years of professional experience in document management or Document Control , ideally in construction, infrastructure or large-scale plant projects
- You have practical experience with common Document Management and CDE systems and very good knowledge of MS Office
- You work in a structured, independent and detail-oriented manner and are able to maintain an overview even in dynamic project environments
- You have strong communication and teamwork skills and enjoy working with different stakeholders
- You have fluent German and very good English skills and are willing to travel depending on project requirements
- This position is available on a full-time or part-time basis

jobs.title: Management Consultant - Mining
jobs.description:
We Are
Accenture's Canada Natural Resources (CNR) practice works where strategy meets the working face. We help the world's largest mining companies close the gap between investment and outcomes, across planning, operations, maintenance, processing, and the commercial decisions that tie it all together. Our work spans the full Mine-to-Market chain: from resource to revenue, from site-level performance to boardroom strategy.
We are a team of practitioners. Most of us have spent years inside mining companies before joining Accenture. That operational credibility is how we earn trust with clients, and how we deliver work that actually holds up once we leave the site.

About Accenture's Mining Practice
Accenture's global mining practice works with leading mining companies to apply innovation, transformational strategies, and digital enablement to improve operations, drive growth, and reduce risk. With decades of experience, we bring an unmatched combination of industry knowledge, technology expertise, and strategic vision to deliver comprehensive, integrated solutions at speed and scale.
Our skilled consulting professionals engage with mining executives to reach new levels of performance and sustainability across the full mining value chain — from pit to port, and from sensor to boardroom.
Canada's Natural Resources practice is Accenture's mining centre of gravity in North America. Our differentiating position is Mine-to-Market transformation: integrating across the value chain to close the gap between digital investment and balance sheet outcomes. We work at the operational core of our clients' businesses, not from the outside looking in.
Learn more: www.accenture.com/naturalresources

You Are
You understand the industry, how value is created, and how to connect the dots. You are equally comfortable exploring the big questions with senior leaders and working alongside teams to make change real. You listen, connect ideas across the organization, and bring together the right people to move from ambition to action. You know that the best strategies are shaped with, and delivered by, the people closest to the work
Now you want to use that experience at greater scale. Not because you want to escape the industry. Because you want to shape it.
You move comfortably between a technical conversation with an engineer and a business case in front of a sponsor. You can identify where value is leaking before anyone has told you to look. And you're comfortable to function in an imperfect and fast paced environment

The Work
- Assess client functions and performance across the mining value chain -from exploration, mine design and planning, extraction, maintenance, processing, and logistics - and identify where performance, cost, capital efficiency, and enterprise value can be improved across both corporate and operating assets

- Structure opportunities in business terms, including cost per tonne, throughput, asset utilisation, capital recovery, and broader enterprise impact across metrics such as EBITDA, AISC, cash flow, and return on invested capital

- Develop and pressure-test strategic recommendations for senior client stakeholders - including business cases, investment rationale, portfolio prioritization, and growth or cost strategy - translating operational insight into boardroom-ready positions

- Design solutions that span process, people, and technology, with sound judgment on when each lever will create the greatest value

- Support technology-enabled transformation work - including platform reinvention, intelligent enterprise programs, and digital initiatives - by grounding solutions in operational reality and ensuring they deliver measurable business outcomes

- Lead and deliver implementation workstreams alongside client teams, moving beyond recommendation into execution and sustained value delivery

- Build credibility with operational and technical counterparts at site level while creating executive-ready communications and engaging confidently with project sponsors and senior corporate stakeholders

- Contribute to CNR practice development through proposals, thought leadership, and internal knowledge building

- Support the development of junior team members through active coaching, collaboration, and apprenticeship

What You Bring
- A working knowledge of the mining value chain and how decisions at each stage affect the bottom line

- The ability to diagnose operational problems with structure, and not just describe symptoms

- Comfort at every interface: site technical teams, project offices, corporate leadership

- Quantitative grounding to build and stress-test a business case

- Pragmatism: you know what can be realistically implemented, not just what looks good on a PowerPoint slide

- Willingness to be on-site with clients, as and when the project requires

What Makes This Role Different
- This is not a performance strategy or process improvement rotation. We are building a practice with deep industry roots and a distinctive point of view on how mining companies generate value across the full chain from resource to revenue. The work is integrative by design — spanning strategy, operations, technology, and commercial outcomes.

- You will work with clients on problems that matter. Mine design decisions ahead of major capital investment. Operational performance programs at scale. Maintenance transformations that change the cost structure of a site. Digital programs that need operational context to deliver business results — not just data.

- If you want to go deep in an industry you already know, and build a body of work that compounds over time, this is that role

What We Are Looking For
- 4 to 8 years of direct industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Mine design, planning, and scheduling across open pit or underground environments, including exploration through feasibility stages of ore body development

- Mine or plant operations and maintenance, including work management and process safety supervision

- In-house business improvement or continuous improvement programs, including CI teams, BI functions, and internally led transformation initiatives

- Sustaining or growth projects, capital programs, or portfolio-related work, particularly focused on investment optimisation, value assurance, or performance improvement rather than engineering delivery

- Digital or data programs embedded within mining operations

- Domain experience in any of the following is valuable:
- Open pit operations & underground mining, hard or soft rock

- Mills, concentration plants and other processing facilities

- Operational data and digital transformation

- Continuous improvement and Lean programs

- Business intelligence and performance management

- Strategy development and execution

- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Consulting experience, in conjunction with industry knowledge and experience

- Exposure to cross-functional or enterprise-level transformation programs is a plus, particularly where operational excellence was linked to broader business performance and enterprise outcomes

- Strong preference for degrees in one of the following areas:
- Engineering: Mining, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Metallurgical, Chemical, or Civil

- Metallurgy or Process Engineering

- Geology or other science-based disciplines

- Business, Commerce, or Strategy

- Additional qualifications that could strengthen a profile:
- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent)

- Project Management Professional (PMP)

- Continuous improvement or operational excellence credentials

jobs.description:
Role: Management Consultant – Public Sector Defence
Location: London, Manchester
Mobility: Up to 100%
Career Level:  Consultant

Accenture is a global professional services company, providing a broad range of market-leading services to our clients.

We are looking for an ambitious Consultant to join our Public Sector Defence practice.
In this role you will have an opportunity to perform work that is hugely important – often critical to national security - across the breadth of the UK Ministry of Defence client and connected government departments.

Accenture’s approach combines market-leading thought-leadership, deep industry knowledge and creativity blended with technology; you can be excited to join a team of experts driven by helping clients navigate present and future challenges.

Inclusion and diversity are woven into the fabric of our business, and our core values of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, Integrity and Respect for the Individual have enabled us to create One Global Network for clients all over the World.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” –  Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

Our Team

The UK and its allies are facing stern challenges in today’s geopolitical landscape. The nature of warfare is evolving and transforming at an unprecedented pace, catalysed by the conflict in Ukraine and the capability of emerging technology.

Accenture is at the forefront of this change. A global leader in AI, digital advisory and delivery, we have been working at the top table of the MoD and Government to prepare and enable the Digital Warfighter. We draw from our international experience, expertise and client connections across NATO, AUKUS and FVEYs to bring the best of our global organisation to sovereign UK military capability.

As budgets roll out from the Defence Investment Plan, we are operating in a fascinating environment that creates exciting opportunities for consultants who wish to work at the intersection of technology, defence, and largescale transformation. You will learn, grow, and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking, and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. You will have the opportunity to make an impact on operations, programmes and strategies, the success of which are crucial to the security, stability and growth of the UK and its citizens.

We help our clients deliver lasting impact by driving excellence from strategy development through to implementation. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity.

In our team, you will gain exposure to:
- The most strategic challenges and opportunities that occupy the minds of military and government leaders
- Cutting edge research and thought leadership that is defining the future of warfighting, defence and broader government
- Government defence clients as well as a broad range of industry Aerospace & Defence (A&D) clients, long established within our ‘One Defence’ model
- Structured problem-solving techniques to enable our clients to transform their businesses
- A global Defence and Technology network of highly skilled, geographically and culturally diverse people
- A world-class training curriculum that helps you continuously upskill yourself as the world changes
- A culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, enterprise, and a lot of fun!

As an Aerospace and Defence Consultant you will:
- Work as part of focused project teams across a range of Defence clients & problems
- Lead an independent workstream as part of a broader project
- Gather, synthesise and analyse data from a variety of sources to draw insights and develop recommendations
- Structure and communicate outcomes to client management teams
- Work alongside client teams to help them implement the recommendations to deliver value
- Help develop and refine offerings and generate collateral to support sales and origination activities.
- Facilitate client innovation and requirements workshops and use a human-centred approach to solve problems, frame opportunities and achieve innovation through collaboration and co-creation.

This is the ideal opportunity for you if you can demonstrate:

- Demonstrable client facing management consulting experience Defence clients (or closely related government clients), gained within a leading consulting organisation
- Alternatively, substantial industry experience driving transformational business change in Defence
- Bachelor’s degree with a strong academic record, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or MBA is a plus but not essential
- Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following areas is key – Supply Chain, Operational Improvement, Quality Management, Sourcing and Procurement, Digital Transformation & Engineering, Complex Programme Delivery, Data & Analytics, Intelligence & Operations
- Exceptional creative problem solving and analytical skills
- Effective communication skills, both written and oral. Fluency in English
- A passion for technology and innovation.

To apply for this role, you must hold or be eligible for UK security clearance. As such, you must have lived in the UK for the past five years without an absence from the country of greater than 30 days at a time. More information about the requirements can be found  here :  United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant - GOV.UK

What’s in it for you

At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days of vacation per year, access to app-based fitness classes and discounts on range of gyms, private medical insurance and three days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!
We strive to help our people create the right work-life balance that allows them to realise their full potential. Please speak to your recruiter about the working pattern that works best for you.

Your home office can be in London, Bristol or Manchester. This role is client-facing and will therefore involve travel, working in other parts of the UK.

Role: Automotive Management Consultant
Location: London
Career Level: Consultant (CL9)

Accenture is a global professional services company providing a broad range of market-leading services to our clients. We are looking for an ambitious Consultant to join our Industry & Enterprise Automotive Consulting practice. In this role you will have an enviable opportunity to work with some of the world's most iconic Automotive clients — from National Sales Companies (NSCs) and leading retailers, to OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and new mobility players — on cutting-edge and complex transformation programmes.

Our approach combines deep industry knowledge, market-leading thought leadership, and human ingenuity — blended with the power of AI and technology. As Accenture's reinvention partner of choice for its clients, everything we do is shaped by a simple belief: that in an industry designed for mobility, data and intelligence should be equally free to move. You will help clients harness the power of agentic AI and connected data to drive agility, growth, and lasting impact.

Inclusion and diversity are woven into the fabric of our business, and our core values of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, Integrity and Respect for the Individual have enabled us to create One Global Network for clients all over the world.

"Today, our clients need more value faster, and Accenture is their reinvention partner of choice. We are writing the playbook for how to be the most AI-enabled, client-focused professional services company in the world and a great place to work for our people — our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Accenture Chair & CEO

Our Team
The Automotive industry is undergoing one of the most profound transformations in its history. The shift to electric and software-defined vehicles, the disruption of traditional mobility and retail models, and the increasing pressure to decarbonise supply chains are reshaping the competitive landscape for every player in the value chain — from design and engineering, through manufacturing and distribution, to sales, aftersales, and service.

Accenture's UKI Automotive practice works with the full breadth of that value chain. A significant and growing part of our client portfolio is National Sales Companies — the organisations responsible for bringing vehicle brands to market in the UK, and for managing the relationships between manufacturers, their retailer networks, and end customers. NSCs face a distinctive set of challenges: unlocking siloed data assets, modernising customer engagement, optimising retailer performance, and building the commercial agility to compete in a fast-moving market. We believe that data freedom — the ability to connect customer, vehicle, finance, supply chain, and retailer data — is the founding enabler of their reinvention.

Accenture is at the forefront of this change — helping the world's leading Automotive companies achieve sustainable and profitable growth. As our clients' reinvention partner of choice, we bring together Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Operations, and Industry X capabilities through our integrated Reinvention Services to help them deliver lasting impact — from strategy through to implementation.

We are experiencing significant growth in our Automotive practice and are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team. As well as working with world-class industry clients, you will learn, grow, and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking, and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting directions.

In our team, you will gain exposure to:
- The most strategic challenges and opportunities occupying the minds of Automotive industry leaders — from Electric Vehicles (EV) and Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) transition strategy, to agentic AI-enabled operations, new mobility business models, and retail network transformation

- A diverse portfolio of Automotive clients across the full value chain — including National Sales Companies, OEMs, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, mobility providers, and captive finance businesses

- Accenture's Automotive Reinvention Suite of offerings, spanning Engineering Reinvention, Software-Defined Vehicle, Resilient Supply Chain, Manufacturing Reinvention, Intelligent Servitization & Aftersales, Omni-Channel Experience, and B2B2C Customer Engagement

- Cutting-edge research and thought leadership that is defining the future of Automotive — including how agentic AI and connected data are unlocking new value across the vehicle lifecycle

- Structured problem-solving and human-centred design techniques to enable our clients to reinvent their businesses with speed and confidence

- A global Automotive network of highly skilled, geographically and culturally diverse practitioners

- A world-class training curriculum that helps you continuously upskill as the industry — and the technology underpinning it — rapidly evolves

- A culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, enterprise, and a genuine passion for the Automotive sector

Job Qualifications
This is the ideal opportunity for you if you can demonstrate:

- Demonstrable client-facing management consulting experience, gained within a leading consulting organisation — with a track record of structured problem-solving, analytics, and client communication

- A genuine passion for the Automotive industry and its reinvention — whether through EV and SDV transition, digital transformation, agentic AI, new mobility models, retail network modernisation, or supply chain resilience

- Some direct experience of, or meaningful exposure to, the Automotive sector — whether through consulting engagements, industry roles, or sustained personal interest and self-directed learning. Experience working with or within National Sales Companies, captive finance businesses, or retail networks is particularly welcome

- Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or MBA is a plus but not essential

- Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Customer & Retailer Engagement, Commercial Strategy & Growth, Data & AI / Agentic Tooling, Supply Chain & Procurement, Manufacturing & Operations, Product Development & Engineering, Mobility Strategy, or Sustainability & Decarbonisation

- Exceptional creative problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous and complex challenges

- Effective communication skills, both written and oral — with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders. Fluency in English is essential

- A passion for technology, AI and innovation, and how these are reshaping the future of mobility and transportation. Able to both use and recommend agentic and AI solutions that are safe, responsible and impactful.

What's in it for you
At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days of vacation per year, access to app-based fitness classes and discounts on a range of gyms, private medical insurance, and three days leave per year for charitable work of your choice.

We strive to help our people create the right work-life balance that allows them to realise their full potential. Please speak to your recruiter about the working pattern that works best for you.

Location: Your home office will be in London. This role is client-facing and will involve travel across the UK and, on occasion, internationally.

Data Management Consultant
Location: London / Manchester / Bristol
Salary : Competitive salary package depending on experience
Career Level:    Accenture will be recruiting at the following levels:  Associate Manager & Specialist

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.
We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Management & Governance Consultant to join our AI&Data Practice.

We provide the trusted data foundations and AI ready data to deliver scalable, business critical solutions for our clients to harness the value of data and AI. We advise across Data Governance, Strategy, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality & Observability, Metadata Management and Data Products as well as supporting organisations adoption of AI including Agentic Data Management, AI Observability, Semantic Layers and Ontologies.

We are looking for candidates that have deep experience in one or more core capabilities below and wants to be a trail blazer in reinventing Data Management & Governance for the AI era.

- AI Data Management: awareness or experience of areas such as Agentic Data Management, AI Observability, semantic layers, knowledge graphs and ontologies.
- Data Governance & Strategy: experience supporting the design or implementation of governance frameworks, policies, standards, controls, ownership and stewardship models.
- Data Quality & Observability: working knowledge of profiling, rule definition, controls, monitoring, issue management, remediation and root-cause analysis.
- Metadata Management: experience with business glossaries, data catalogues, lineage, classification, metadata standards or data discovery processes and tools.
- Master & Reference Data Management: understanding of relevant principles, data models, matching, survivorship, workflows, stewardship, technology and common solution components.

You will learn, grow and advance amongst an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways.

If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to our global training and network of experts, this is the role for you.

In our team you will learn:
- How to grow your skills working on challenging and innovative solutions in the Data Management and Governance space
- Work on new technologies with demanding clients and grow your Data expertise and consulting skillset
- Work in highly skilled teams advising and supporting our clients through some of the most complex data challenges ever faced.

As a Data Management Consultant, you will need to:

- Be the subject matter expert in one of the key capabilities.
- Support the design and delivery of Data Management and Governance solutions aligned to client priorities, regulatory needs and business outcomes.
- Assess current data capabilities, identify gaps and translate findings into clear recommendations, delivery plans and measurable improvements.
- Work across business, data and technology teams to gather requirements, facilitate workshops and convert complex needs into deliverable solutions.
- Produce high-quality deliverables and support implementation using Agile, product-led or traditional delivery methods.
- Build trusted client relationships, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and contribute to proposals, practice development and the coaching of junior colleagues.

We are looking for experience in the following skills:
- Typically 3 years minimum hands-on experience in one or more capabilities
- Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, structure ambiguous problems and communicate practical recommendations.
- Experience creating clear client-ready deliverables, facilitating workshops and working effectively with business, data and technology stakeholders.
- Experience contributing to delivery in multidisciplinary and multi-location teams using Agile, product-led or traditional methods.
- Strong written and verbal communication, collaborative working, attention to detail and a commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

Set yourself apart:
- Relevant experience in areas such as Agentic Data Management, AI Observability, semantic layers, knowledge graphs and ontologies
- Relevant certifications e.g. DAMA CDMP, DCAM, technology or cloud accreditations
- Implementation experience with leading technologies in data governance, catalogue, Data Quality, observability, MDM or cloud data platforms.
- Knowledge of regulatory, privacy, risk or compliance requirements and how they translate into proportionate data controls.

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes up to 25 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

Accenture reserves the right to close the role prior to this date should a suitable applicant be found.

Accentures Utilities Industry Group i Norge er i sterk vekst, og vi styrker nå teamet betydelig. - Gi strategiske råd til kraft- og energiselskaper om forretningsutvikling, markedsposisjonering og omstilling.

Consultant or Manager | Oslo, Norway

Are you a finance transformation professional who wants to drive real reinvention for some of Norway’s most complex organizations? Are you highly motivated to shape the AI-driven future of finance - and build a practice around it?

Accenture's Finance Strategy & Consulting practice is looking for Consultants and Managers to join our growing team in Oslo.

You will work with clients to improve and reinvent their finance functions, combining finance expertise, consulting skills and technology to deliver practical, sustainable outcomes. Depending on your experience, you will contribute to or lead workstreams across finance transformation, operating model design, process improvement, performance management, digitalisation, data and AI.

We are looking for finance consulting profiles, with experience in navigating a range of transformation challenges. You should enjoy solving business problems, working collaboratively, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Finance practice in Norway.

What you will do

Delivery experience
You do not need experience in every area listed below. If you have relevant skills in one or more of these areas, we encourage you to apply.

• Finance transformation and operating models : Support the design and implementation of target operating models, governance structures, service delivery models, transformation roadmaps and Global Business Services or shared service organisations.
• Finance process improvemen t: Assess and improve end-to-end finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, planning, reporting and performance management.
• Enterprise performance managemen t: Help clients strengthen planning, forecasting, reporting, scenario modelling, decision support and finance business partnering.
• Finance technology and digitalisation : Support finance platform and application transformation, including ERP, SAP and other finance technologies, with a focus on standardised processes and effective data models.

Consulting and practice-building skills
• Data, analytics, automation and AI : Identify and shape practical opportunities to use data, analytics, automation and AI responsibly across the finance function.
• Value creation and efficiency : Help identify and realise measurable value through cost optimisation, organisation effectiveness and operational improvement.

Level and typical responsibilities

Manager Lead workstreams or projects, manage client relationships, guide teams, assure delivery quality, contribute to sales and proposals, and coach junior colleagues.

·         Experience with ERP systems would be advantageous

·         Competitive salary, bonus arrangements, pension, health insurance and employee share purchase opportunities.

·         Formal and informal learning opportunities to build consulting, finance, leadership and technology skills.

As part of Accenture ’s Finance practice you will help organizations reinvent their finance functions and unlock new value – making Reinvention part of your career and your clients’ future.

We are looking for a Strategy and/or Management Consulting Manager or Senior Manager for our Finance practice in Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö).

To succeed in the role you are a driven, ambitious, and proactive leader who thrives on both drawing the bigger picture and owning the outcome. You bring deep finance expertise , a hands-on delivery mindset, and the ability to build trusted relationships at CFO and senior finance executive level. You will own client relationships, drive business development and originate new opportunities, lead teams and workstreams, and ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction. As a Manager or Senior Manager you will also help shape our Swedish F inance practice, coach and develop junior colleagues, and contribute to growing the team.

What you will do

- Finance operating model design and GBS/shared service center establishment – defining target operating models, governance frameworks, and transformation roadmaps that move finance from scorekeeper to strategic value architect

- Finance platform transformation – leading ERP and finance application modernization programmes ( e.g. SAP, Oracle, Workday, OneStream, Anaplan) that build an AI-ready digital core and streamline data models

- Strategic finance operations – redesigning end-to-end finance processes, driving standardization, and building high-performance Finance & Accounting capabilities through GBS and intelligent operations

- AI and automation reinvention – designing and implementing GenAI and agentic automation in finance operations, building Human + Machine finance teams, and embedding AI across the finance function in a responsible and audit-compliant way

- Enterprise performance management and connected planning – replacing static budgets with AI-driven forecasting, scenario modelling, and decision intelligence that gives CFOs and business leaders a true forward-looking view

- Business development and client leadership – originating and leading proposals, building and owning relationships at CFO and Controller level, and actively shaping our Finance practice in Sweden

- Strategic cost reduction, operational efficiency, and enterprise value creation – identifying and realizing measurable financial outcomes through transformation programmes

What´s in it for you

- Truly competitive salary terms, bonus schemes, pension, health insurance, employee stock purchase program etc.

- Work-life balance is important to us. Volunteer roles and events through our internal networks

- Access to several social activities through active corporate sports community

- A variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

- A Master’s degree in a relevant field, e.g. Accounting, Finance or Industrial Engineering with excellent academic performance

- 5+ years (Manager) or 8+ years (Senior Manager) of strategy and/or management consulting experience related to the CFO Agenda – e.g. finance transformation, GBS design and establishment, enterprise performance management, finance operating model or platform transformation – ideally gained at a Big Four or comparable strategy/management consultancy

- A proven track record of leading teams and workstreams, managing senior client stakeholders, and contributing to business development, proposals and sales – with greater commercial ownership expected at Senior Manager level

- Experience working with AI and digital tools in a finance or consulting context – including an understanding of how GenAI, agentic automation and data analytics are reshaping the finance function

- Experience from diverse projects and cross-functional teams, with the ability to work across industries and client contexts

- Fluent in English (incl. experience with written and oral presentations in English) and Swedish, with experience conducting interviews and facilitating workshops

The position will report to the Finance Practice Lead and the workplace is Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö). Some travel should be expected.

Apply online by attaching your CV, application letter and educational diplomas as soon as possible.  We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, Sweden · Hybrid · Fluent Swedish and English

The role
You'll help large organisations get identity and access right as they transform, and increasingly as they adopt AI. Deciding who, and what, can reach which systems is some of the most consequential work in security: organisations that get it wrong don't just face a technical gap, they face a governance one. You'll work close to delivery, alongside the client teams who own the processes and systems you're helping to change, across organisations and sectors where the stakes are real. Regulation and the pace of AI adoption are raising the bar on what good identity looks like, and clients turn to us to help them meet it. It's a role where you build depth from strength on one side of identity — the functional or the technical — into confidence across both.

About Accenture Cybersecurity
At Accenture Cybersecurity, we help organisations protect what matters most by combining deep security expertise with leading technology. We support our clients across the entire security journey, from strategy and advisory to implementation and managed security services, helping them navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape with confidence.

What you'll do
- Help clients work out how identity and access should function across their organisation, and shape designs that stand up in the real world.
- Create and evolve the processes and architectures that help clients adopt modern concepts and technologies at the frontier of identity.
- See those designs through into something clients can depend on, whether building greenfield or re-engineering legacy processes and systems into efficient, trustworthy identity capabilities.
- Work shoulder to shoulder with client teams, trusted to deliver and to explain the trade-offs along the way.
- Contribute to assessments and roadmap conversations that help clients understand where they stand on identity and what it will take to get where they need to go.

What we're looking for
- A feel for how identity and access should work — in IAM directly, or in closely adjacent transformation work — and the judgement to reason about it, not just operate a tool.
- Strength on either the functional or the technical side of identity: process and access design, or building on a platform such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Ping or Microsoft Entra ID, and the ambition to grow across both.
- Around 3+ years of experience in IAM or a closely related field.
- Fluent Swedish and English.
- Based in Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, on a hybrid pattern.
- Comfortable working across sectors and adapting to each client's context.

Many strong people in this field didn't start in IAM. If you're moving in from adjacent transformation work — business analysis, solution design, cloud and infrastructure, software engineering, or running directory and access services — and you want to build a career in identity and security, we'd like to hear from you.

Nice to have
- A relevant degree.
- Exposure to software architecture, automation, or application onboarding.
- Relevant security certifications, or the drive to earn them.
- A genuine curiosity about where identity is heading: the shift toward continuous verification, policy-based access, and how AI is reshaping what organisations need to govern.

Location & working
Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö · Hybrid.

What we offer
A place to grow and learn, on work that genuinely matters to the organisations you help. As clients transform and adopt AI, the surface they need to govern only expands, and the demand for people who can think clearly about who and what should reach which systems is growing rather than shrinking. You'll do it with the scale of a global firm behind a long career and the scope to move across industries and geographies as your career develops.

Apply via the link on this page.
