jobs.title: Process Excellence Manager/Consultant
jobs.description:
En Accenture buscamos incorporar perfiles de Consultant y Manager para participar en proyectos de transformación y excelencia de procesos enfocados en Ventas B2B .

Ambas posiciones trabajarán en el análisis y rediseño de procesos comerciales end-to-end, incorporando IA, automatización y nuevas tecnologías para transformar la manera en que las organizaciones gestionan sus operaciones de ventas.

Consultant – Process Excellence
Buscamos perfiles con una fuerte orientación analítica, capaces de comprender procesos comerciales, identificar oportunidades de mejora y contribuir al diseño de soluciones de transformación.

Principales responsabilidades
- Analizar y mapear procesos actuales de ventas B2B, considerando etapas, actividades, roles, sistemas, datos, controles y puntos de dolor.
- Identificar oportunidades de mejora relacionadas con tiempos de ciclo, esfuerzo manual, retrabajo, excepciones y duplicidades.
- Elaborar análisis de tendencias, benchmarking y evaluaciones de impacto del cambio.
- Colaborar en el diseño de procesos futuros, incorporando IA, automatización y nuevas formas de interacción entre personas y agentes.
- Analizar cómo plataformas como CRM, CPQ, CLM, forecasting, planificación comercial y compensación variable habilitan el ciclo de ventas.
- Construir análisis y recomendaciones basadas en datos mediante herramientas de visualización y soluciones asistidas por IA.
- Participar en workshops y entrevistas con stakeholders.
- Preparar presentaciones, diagramas de procesos y entregables para audiencias ejecutivas.
- Apoyar proyectos de RPA, automatización inteligente y transformación de operaciones comerciales.
- Colaborar en propuestas, respuestas a RFP/RFI y actividades de desarrollo de negocio.

Requisitos
- Formación universitaria o equivalente.
- Entre 1 y 4 años de experiencia en excelencia o rediseño de procesos, consultoría, operaciones de ventas, Revenue Operations, Business Analysis o mejora continua.
- Experiencia desarrollando análisis de tendencias, benchmarking o evaluaciones de impacto.
- Conocimiento práctico sobre la incorporación de IA y automatización en procesos de negocio.
- Manejo de herramientas de analítica, visualización o benchmarking, como Power BI, Tableau o soluciones basadas en GenAI.
- Capacidad para analizar datos y traducir resultados en recomendaciones estructuradas.

Se valorará
- Conocimiento de procesos de ventas B2B, incluyendo gestión de leads, oportunidades, pipeline, forecasting, cuentas, CPQ, contratación y operaciones comerciales.
- Exposición a Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics y plataformas de CPQ, CLM, forecasting o compensación variable.
- Conocimientos de AX Design, RPA y automatización inteligente.
- Manejo de herramientas de mapeo y modelado de procesos, como Microsoft Visio.
- Conocimientos de SQL, Python o herramientas equivalentes.
- Experiencia en consultoría o interacción con clientes.

Manager – Process Excellence
Buscamos perfiles con experiencia sólida en transformación de procesos de ventas B2B, capaces de liderar proyectos, equipos y conversaciones estratégicas con clientes.

Principales responsabilidades
- Liderar el diseño integral de procesos futuros de ventas B2B, desde el diagnóstico hasta la planificación de la adopción.
- Evaluar procesos actuales para identificar puntos de dolor, brechas de control, esfuerzo manual, duplicidades y oportunidades de estandarización.
- Diseñar integraciones de IA, cambios en modelos operativos y nuevas formas de interacción entre personas y agentes.
- Liderar análisis de benchmarking y evaluaciones de impacto del cambio.
- Evaluar cómo las plataformas de CRM, CPQ, CLM, forecasting, planificación comercial, compensación variable y gestión de pedidos habilitan los procesos.
- Traducir necesidades de procesos en requisitos funcionales, tecnológicos y de solución.
- Identificar oportunidades de aplicación de RPA, automatización inteligente y agentes de IA.
- Liderar workshops, entrevistas y sesiones de design thinking con clientes.
- Presentar y defender recomendaciones ante stakeholders senior.
- Desarrollar hojas de ruta, especificaciones, requisitos de negocio y business cases.
- Gestionar la relación con el cliente, los riesgos y la resolución de incidencias.
- Liderar equipos de consultoría y formar a profesionales junior.
- Contribuir al desarrollo de negocio, propuestas y respuestas a RFP/RFI.

Requisitos
- Formación universitaria o equivalente.
- Entre 3 y 7 años de experiencia en excelencia de procesos, rediseño de procesos o consultoría de gestión.
- Experiencia sólida en procesos de ventas B2B a lo largo de distintas etapas del ciclo comercial.
- Experiencia diseñando procesos futuros con integración de IA, cambios en el modelo operativo y estrategias de adopción.
- Capacidad demostrada para liderar workshops y presentar recomendaciones ante la dirección senior.
- Experiencia desarrollando análisis de benchmarking y evaluaciones de impacto del cambio.
- Manejo de herramientas asistidas por IA aplicadas a benchmarking, analítica o facilitación de workshops.

Se valorará
- Conocimiento aplicado de AX Design.
- Comunicación ejecutiva y capacidad para presentar decisiones complejas en términos de negocio.
- Dominio de plataformas como Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Conga, SAP, Icertis, Anaplan, Xactly, Clari, Aviso o Varicent.
- Experiencia implementando RPA y automatización inteligente mediante UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism o herramientas equivalentes.
- Conocimiento de process mining, digital twins y modelado de procesos.
- Experiencia en desarrollo de negocio, propuestas o respuestas a RFP.
- Experiencia en proyectos de consultoría para diferentes industrias o especialización profunda en un sector.

El perfil de Consultant tendrá mayor foco en el análisis, mapeo de procesos, preparación de entregables y soporte en el diseño de soluciones.
El perfil de Manager será responsable de liderar el diseño de la transformación, gestionar equipos y stakeholders senior, presentar recomendaciones ejecutivas y contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio

jobs.title: Management Consultant - Utilities Industry
jobs.description:
About the Role

Accenture is seeking an experienced Utilities Retail Consultant to help utility organizations modernize customer operations, improve service delivery, and accelerate business transformation. In this role, you will lead large-scale transformation initiatives across Utilities Retail, Customer Information Systems (CIS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), billing, customer service, and operating model modernization.

You will work closely with client executives and cross-functional teams to define transformation strategies, lead implementation programs, optimize business processes, and deliver measurable business outcomes across electricity, gas, water, and broader utilities sectors.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead Utilities Retail and customer transformation programs from strategy through implementation and deployment.
• Advise client stakeholders on customer operations, billing, metering, collections, customer service, and digital transformation initiatives.
• Lead functional workstreams across CIS and CRM transformation programs, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable solutions.
• Facilitate business process assessments, requirements workshops, and stakeholder discussions to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Manage large-scale business transformation initiatives, including business readiness, deployment planning, risk management, and change adoption activities.
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to develop functional solutions that align with client objectives and industry best practices.
• Support proposal development, solution shaping, client presentations, and strategic business development activities.
• Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, reusable assets, capability development, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
• Communicate complex business and technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Support delivery governance and ensure successful execution across multiple project workstreams.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Utilities Management, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 5–11 years of experience within Utilities Retail, customer operations, business transformation, consulting, or related fields.
• Demonstrated experience delivering or supporting CIS and CRM transformation initiatives within the utilities sector.
• Strong understanding of utility retail business processes, including customer management, billing, payments, meter-to-cash, collections, and customer service operations.
• Experience leading client workshops, requirements gathering, process design, and solution definition activities.
• Proven ability to manage stakeholders and work effectively across business and technology teams.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
• Experience managing multiple priorities and delivering results in complex client environments.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in electricity, gas, water, or multi-utility organizations.
• Experience supporting large-scale CIS, CRM, digital customer service, or enterprise transformation programs.
• Knowledge of regulated and competitive utility market environments.
• Experience in business readiness, deployment, organizational change, or operating model transformation initiatives.
• MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.
• Utilities industry certifications or professional accreditations.

jobs.title: Management Consulting Analyst (Junior+)
jobs.description:
About Accenture
At Accenture Management Consulting, we work with leading companies on some of their most important challenges – from shaping strategy, improving performance to driving transformation. Our projects are cross industries and typically focus on delivering tangible, long-term impact for our clients.

The Role
As a Management Consulting Analyst , you will be part of small project teams (usually 3–8 people) working closely with experienced consultants and client teams.
From early on, you will get your own responsibilities and contribute directly to client deliverables - whether it is analyzing data, structuring problems, or helping shape recommendations. You will also have the opportunity to join client discussions and presentations, including senior stakeholders.
Projects usually last 2–6 months , and usually you will be fully dedicated to one project at a time.

What you’ll be doing
- Break down and structure key business problems
- Work with data (quantitative & qualitative) to support analysis
- Form hypotheses and test them
- Turn insights into clear, practical recommendations
- Support implementation and change initiatives
- Contribute to presentations and client discussions

What we’re looking for
We’re looking for someone at an early stage of their career who already has some exposure to analytical or business-focused work and is ready to take the next step in consulting.

Qualification :
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
- Around 0–2 years of experience (consulting, analytics, corporate environment, etc.)
- Fluent Czech or Slovak and English (German is a plus)
- Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem solving
- Good communication skills and confidence working with others
- Team player with a proactive mindset
- Willingness to travel when needed

What Will Help You Stand Out
- Strong academic track record
- Experience working with data, analysis, or presentations
- Demonstrated initiative or leadership (e.g. projects, extracurriculars, work experience)

What you can expect
Our recruitment process includes online assessments (DRT & NRT) and typically three rounds of interviews. It can take a bit of time, but it helps us get to know you properly – we are looking for exceptional people, and we believe that’s worth the extra step.

And
- Work on high-impact projects for leading local and global clients
- Structured training and continuous learning opportunities
- Clear career progression and performance-based growth
- Exposure to an international consulting environment
- Supportive and collaborative team culture

What We Offer
We know that performance goes hand in hand with well-being and flexibility, and so we try to keep our benefits practical and relevant.

Health & well-being
- Multisport card to support an active lifestyle
- Employee Assistance Program (confidential psychological, financial and legal support)
- Well-being Hub and telehealth services for easy access to care
- Paid sick days

Financial & lifestyle
- Flexible cafeteria system – tailor your benefits to what matters most to you
- Pension contribution and life & disability insurance
- Employee Share Purchase Plan
- Referral bonuses for bringing great people on board
- Employee discounts (e.g. Sphere VIP card)
- Recognition through service anniversary awards
- Extra compensation for work on public holidays

Flexibility & life events
- Flexible working arrangements (both in terms of time and location)
- Opportunity for international remote work
- Maternity bonus
- Support during difficult life situations

Time off & work–life balance
- Additional personal leave beyond statutory vacation
- Time off for key life moments (wedding, childbirth, bereavement)

If you’re looking for a role where you can learn fast, take on responsibility early, and work on meaningful projects, we’d be happy to connect.

jobs.description:
Job Description

YOUR ROLE
Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as a CFO & EV Consulting Manager a typical day might include:

- Analyzing, reviewing and reporting on the financial opportunities and challenges our clients face in the areas of strategy, processes, operations, and enterprise resource planning and enterprise performance management

- Evaluating an organization’s financial performance and profitability from end-to-end

- Supporting the CFO in defining and modeling the key drivers of current and future enterprise value

- Advising clients on the use of tools such as Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EPM Cloud, SAP BPC and emerging technologies (OneStream, Anaplan etc) to transform their organisation’s finance function through the application of modern technology solutions

- Translating financial strategies into tactics and plans, delivering and monitoring their execution across the organization

- Designing and deploying leading-edge EPM methodologies: ZBB, Scenario Based Planning, High-Frequency and Rolling Forecasting

- Supporting clients’ ERP and EPM transformations by educating and training their Finance workforce

- Transforming client’s finance & accounting functions, removing human middleware with such capabilities as EPM Cloud, On Premise/In-Memory & Mobile technologies

- Working across a dynamic, international team where English is the common language

jobs.title: Management Consultant – Comms, Media, Technology
jobs.description:
Management Consultant, - Communications & Media
Career Level 9
Location London

As a team
We work with leading organisations in telecoms, TV and broadcast, gaming and betting, sport, business media and publishing. Their networks, services and content reach millions of people and businesses every day, and almost everything about how they operate is being rethought.
Audiences now move freely between screens, services and devices. Customers expect digital experiences that simply work. AI is changing how products are built, how content is made and how businesses run. For the organisations we serve, this is a moment to reinvent rather than tweak.

We help them work out what to build, and then we help them build it. Our work spans network and telecoms reinvention, customer experience, the way content is produced, managed and monetised, and the creation of new digital products and services.

As a Consultant, you will sit where consulting meets product delivery. You will help clients get clear on the problem and their ambition, and then stay involved as that thinking becomes a product, platform or service that real customers use. You don't need to be an engineer, but you will enjoy working alongside engineers, designers and data specialists. You will get into the detail and make the practical trade-offs that turn a good idea into something that ships.

Challenges you could work on
- Simplifying a telecoms operator's products and the systems behind them, so new services launch in weeks rather than years.

- Redesigning how consumers and businesses buy, set up and get help with their broadband, mobile and connectivity services.

- Modernising the platforms that bring programmes and live sport to audiences across apps, TVs and devices.

- Using AI to speed up how content is tagged, edited, localised and discovered.

- Creating new products, commercial models and revenue streams from content, audiences, advertising and intellectual property.

- Helping a betting or gaming operator improve how its products are designed, built and released.

- Changing the people, processes, technology and data behind a core part of a client's business, rather than simply replacing its systems.

In our team you will learn
- How Communications and Media businesses really work, from network to content to customer, by working with leading organisations in the sector.

- How to take an idea from discovery through to launch, drawing on Accenture's engineering, design, data and AI specialists.

- How to apply AI and data to real problems, and how to tell a promising use case from a distraction.

In this role you will
- Help clients turn business problems and customer needs into clear product visions, roadmaps and plans that teams can deliver.

- Take responsibility for a defined product area or workstream, helping to move it from discovery and design through build, launch and improvement.

- Work day to day with client and Accenture teams across product, engineering, design and data, helping them prioritise, resolve delivery challenges and make practical trade-offs.

- Build business cases and success measures that link what gets built to the outcomes it should deliver, and use data to show whether it is working.

- Find practical ways to use AI in products, customer experiences and operations.

- Run interviews and workshops, present to clients, and help business and technology teams reach a shared view.

- Contribute to proposals and new opportunities, and play an active part in the life of the team.

Job qualifications

We are looking for people who enjoy both shaping ideas and making them happen. You will be able to point to products, services or business capabilities that you have helped design, build, launch or transform.
With around four years' relevant experience, you may have built your career in consulting, a Communications or Media business, a digital agency, a product studio or a technology company. Your experience might include consulting, business analysis, product ownership or product management. We welcome different paths, and we don't expect you to bring everything below.

Product and delivery
- You have helped design and deliver digital products, platforms or services, and contributed to a roadmap, backlog or workstream along the way.

- You can turn strategy into clear priorities and requirements, and make sensible trade-offs between customer value, cost, speed and technical feasibility.

- You can point to outcomes you helped deliver for customers, operations or revenue.

Technology and data
- You understand how digital products are built and run, and can work confidently with engineering and technology leaders.

- You know what AI, cloud and modern data platforms make possible, and can spot where they would add real value.

- You use data to inform decisions, and can build a business case that stands up to senior scrutiny.

Industry knowledge
- You have experience in, or a strong and growing understanding of, telecoms, media or both. Depth in one area, such as networks, broadcast, betting or publishing, matters more than breadth across all of them.

- You have a point of view on how changing customer expectations, AI and new commercial models are reshaping these industries.

Working with clients and teams
- You are comfortable leading workshops and client conversations, and can explain complex ideas simply.

- You bring structure to ambiguous situations and work well in mixed teams, in both agile and more traditional delivery settings.

- You support colleagues and want to grow your commercial skills by contributing to proposals.

Set yourself apart
- Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Delivery Lead, ideally taking a product from discovery to launch and beyond.

- Experience working inside a major telecoms or media business, or consulting to one.

- Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering valuable uses of AI or automation within a product, customer journey or operation.

- Familiarity with telecoms industry models such as TM Forum's eTOM and SID, or with content production and distribution workflows.

- Experience helping an established organisation adopt product-led ways of working.

- Relevant training or certifications in product management, agile delivery, cloud, data or AI, such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.

What's in it for you?
You will work on problems that reach millions of viewers, players, customers and businesses, at organisations going through some of the biggest changes in their history. You will build a rare combination of consulting, product and industry skills, working alongside strategy, engineering, data, AI and design specialists from across Accenture. You will also join a team that values clear thinking, collaboration and getting things done.

jobs.description:
Role:  Aerospace and Defence Management Consultant
Location:  London or Manchester
Mobility:  Up to 100%
Career Level:  Consultant

Accenture is a global professional services company, providing a broad range of market-leading services to our clients. We are looking for an ambitious Consultant to join our Aerospace & Defence (A&D) Consulting practice. In this role you will have an enviable opportunity to work with some leading A&D clients, on cutting-edge and complex projects.

Our approach combines market-leading thought-leadership, deep industry knowledge and creativity blended with technology; you can be excited to join a team of experts driven by helping clients navigate both present and future A&D challenges.

Inclusion and diversity are woven into the fabric of our business, and our core values of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, Integrity and Respect for the Individual have enabled us to create One Global Network for clients all over the World.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” –  Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

Our Team
The Aerospace and Defence industry is being hit by disruption on multiple fronts. To compete and win in this environment, companies are beginning to strategically transform components of their business to successfully address disruptive forces and capture new growth. Government is also increasing defence spending, to rearm and modernise. This environment creates exciting opportunities for consultants who want to work at the intersection of technology, defence capability, and largescale transformation.

Accenture is at the forefront of this change, helping the world’s largest A&D companies achieve sustainable and profitable growth by transforming their businesses to become more agile, innovative, operationally efficient, data and AI enabled while being secure.

We help our clients deliver lasting impact by driving excellence from strategy development through to implementation.

At Accenture, our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity.

We are experiencing unprecedented growth, and we are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team of passionate A&D consulting practitioners. As well as working with world class industry clients you will learn, grow, and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking, and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. You will have the opportunity to make an impact on operations, programmes and strategies, the success of which are crucial to both UK security and its A&D industry.

In our team, you will gain exposure to:
- The most strategic challenges and opportunities that occupy the minds of industry leaders
- Cutting edge research and thought leadership that is defining the future of the A&D industry
- Industry A&D clients as well as government defence clients as part of our ‘One Defence’ model
- Structured problem-solving techniques to enable our clients to transform their businesses
- A global A&D network of highly skilled, geographically and culturally diverse people
- A world-class training curriculum that helps you continuously upskill yourself as the world changes
- A culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, enterprise, and a lot of fun!

As an Aerospace and Defence Consultant you will:
- Work as part of focused project teams across a range of A&D clients & problems
- Lead an independent workstream as part of a broader project
- Gather, synthesise and analyse data from a variety of sources to draw insights and develop recommendations
- Structure and communicate outcomes to client management teams
- Work alongside client teams to help them implement the recommendations to deliver value
- Help develop and refine offerings and generate collateral to support sales and origination activities.
- Facilitate client innovation and requirements workshops and use a human-centred approach to solve problems, frame opportunities and achieve innovation through collaboration and co-creation.

This is the ideal opportunity for you if you can demonstrate:
- Demonstrable depth of client facing management consulting experience in Aerospace and Defence clients, gained within a leading consulting organisation
- Alternatively, substantial industry experience driving transformational business change in Aerospace and Defence
- Bachelor’s degree with a strong academic record, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or MBA is a plus but not essential
- Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following areas is key – Supply Chain, Operational Improvement, Manufacturing, Quality Management, Sourcing and Procurement, Digital Engineering, Complex Programme Delivery, Services.
- Exceptional creative problem solving and analytical skills
- Effective communication skills, both written and oral. Fluency in English
- A passion for technology and innovation.

To apply for this role, you must hold or be eligible for UK security clearance. As such, you must have lived in the UK for the past five years without an absence from the country of greater than 30 days at a time. More information about the requirements can be found  here : United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant - GOV.UK

What’s in it for you
At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days of vacation per year, access to app-based fitness classes and discounts on range of gyms, private medical insurance and three days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!
We strive to help our people create the right work-life balance that allows them to realise their full potential. Please speak to your recruiter about the working pattern that works best for you.

Location:
Your home office can be in London or Manchester. This role is client-facing and will therefore involve travel, working in other parts of the UK.

- A minimum of 2-5 years’ people consulting experience in a National Security environment

- Strategic thinking skills and the ability to bring insight to complex problems

- Change management

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

jobs.title: Learning & Workforce Reinvention - Management Consulting Manager
jobs.description:
Learning & Workforce Reinvention Manager
Location: London, Manchester, Edinburgh
Career Level: CL7 — Management Consulting Manager

Workforce capability is now a C-Suite priority. AI is compressing skill half-lives, rewriting job architectures and creating an urgent capability gap that traditional learning organisations are not built to close. CHROs and CLOs are under pressure to move from costly, fragmented training to personalised, AI-powered capability building that delivers measurable business performance — not just course completions.
Accenture's Learning practice is at the forefront of this reinvention. Powered by LearnVantage — our AI-native enterprise learning business and platform — we help the world's largest organisations redesign how they build and sustain workforce capability at scale. We are growing fast, building a distinct market presence within Accenture's Talent Reinvention practice, and we are looking for a learning consulting leader who wants to shape this space — not just deliver in it.
As a team
You will join the Learning offering within Accenture's Talent Reinvention practice — a growth-oriented team that operates at the intersection of consulting, AI and enterprise transformation. We are not a traditional L&D function. We work with CHROs, CLOs and business leaders to redesign learning operating models, deploy AI-enabled platforms, build enterprise AI skilling programmes, and deliver end-to-end learning transformation.
The Learning offering is part of a broader Talent Reinvention practice that works across the full talent and transformation agenda — spanning workforce strategy, organisation design, change and adoption, talent operating model, and skills-based organisation design. You will be expected to operate comfortably across this breadth, connecting learning and skilling to the wider talent reinvention work our clients need.
We operate as one team with our LearnVantage product colleagues — joint pipeline, joint delivery, joint ambition.
In this role you will
- Act as engagement lead on client programmes — taking overall responsibility for delivery, client relationships, team coordination and outcomes across complex, multi-workstream learning and workforce transformation engagements.
- Be the person who can run the whole programme: overseeing learning experience design, content and learning development, platform implementation, delivery management and stakeholder engagement end-to-end.
- Help architect enterprise-scale skilling solutions: advising clients on how to structure content ecosystems, integrate learning platforms and skills data, deploy AI tools, and/or build the operating model to sustain capability at scale.
- Work fluidly across the talent and transformation agenda: connecting learning and skilling work to organisation design, change management, workforce strategy and talent operating model projects as client needs require.
- Serve as a credible advisor on modern learning technology ecosystems: guiding clients through product or platform strategy and selection, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across learning, talent and business functions.
- Design and lead enterprise AI skilling programmes — moving beyond awareness training to build role-specific capability that changes how people work.
- Drive business development: identifying and shaping new opportunities, contributing to proposals and bid processes, and helping grow client accounts as part of a market-building team.
- Coach and develop junior team members; create the conditions for analysts and consultants to perform at their best.
- Contribute to practice development: building reusable assets, developing propositions and strengthening the team's market position.

We are looking for
- A track record of leading end-to-end client engagements in learning, workforce transformation, talent or adjacent consulting — not just contributing to workstreams, but owning delivery and client outcomes.
- Consulting or projects-based background: we are looking for consultants who understand the need for outcomes, value, delivery as well as an understanding of  learning as a specialism
- Comfort and credibility across the broader talent and transformation agenda: you have worked across or alongside organisation design, change and adoption, workforce strategy or talent operating model work — and can connect the learning thread to the wider transformation story a client is living through.
- Experience with modern learning technology ecosystems: you can advise clients on content products, platform strategy and have worked with AI-enabled learning platforms or LXPs in a client or advisory context.
- Commercial capability: you have contributed to business development, understand how consulting opportunities are shaped and won, and are motivated by market growth as well as delivery excellence.
- Experience engaging senior stakeholders across learning, talent and business functions — with the confidence to influence and challenge at a senior level.
- The ability to think at enterprise scale: how do you design a skilling solution that works for 50,000 people, not just a cohort?
- Leadership capability: you can build and lead a delivery team, develop talent and maintain quality across complex engagements.
- Preferred experience
- Demonstrated experience applying AI, automation or emerging technology to learning, talent or workforce transformation challenges — evidenced through specific client examples.
- Experience with AI-enabled learning platforms or modern learning technology ecosystems; exposure to LXPs and skills intelligence tools.
- Background from management consulting (human capital, people & organisation, workforce transformation practices), learning and skills consultancies, or workforce and HR technology companies in an advisory or solutions capacity.
- Experience contributing to winning proposals or business development processes.

What's in it for you
At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days' vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice.
Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners.

jobs.title: Life Sciences R&D Consultant/Manager
jobs.description:
Join Our Global Consulting Network and Expand Your Horizons!
Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At the Global Network, we are more than just a team; we are a thriving community of over 10,000 professionals operating from key locations around the world. We specialize in providing top-tier consulting expertise across various industries and functional areas, including life sciences, energy, supply chain operations, finance, and talent management.

Why Choose Us?
- Global Exposure: Work on international projects and gain invaluable insights into diverse cultures and business practices.

- Specialized Development: We don’t just work across broad spectrums; we ensure you develop deep expertise in specific areas of management consulting, enhancing both your professional value and expertise.

- Dynamic Work Environment: Our work is fast-paced and challenging, pushing you to grow quickly and continuously improve. It’s not just about meeting expectations; it’s about exceeding them and making a significant impact.

- Innovation at the Core: At the Global Network, innovation isn't just a buzzword—it's a fundamental part of how we operate. We leverage cutting-edge technologies and innovative strategies to solve complex problems and deliver novel solutions that keep our clients ahead in a rapidly changing world.

We are driven by a commitment to excellence and a passion for delivering results that matter. If you are ambitious, talented, and ready for a challenge, we want to hear from you. Reach out, join our network, and start a conversation that could lead to your next big opportunity.

Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
- Deep understanding of Life Sciences/BioPharma R&D processes.

- Familiarity with clinical trial systems, regulatory submission tech, patient safety reporting platform, and any modern tech solutions to accelerate drug development.

- Strong stakeholder engagement and team leadership capabilities.

- Ability to develop strategic perspectives and thought leadership on industry trends, digital transformation, and innovation in R&D.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and analytical problem-solving skills

Key Responsibilities:
- Requirements gathering and defining acceptance criteria, to align with the organization's specific needs and business processes.

- Ensuring data integrity and efficient workflows.

- Ability to provide insightful, deal-relevant points of view and recommendations based on robust analysis.

- System documentation as per GxP-compliant SDLC process

- Deliver end-user support, training, and change management to ensure successful technology adoption.

- Monitor platform updates and manage system upgrades or enhancements as needed.

- Ensure alignment with industry best practices and regulatory expectations for technology enablement in R&D.

Read more about us:
- Recent Blogs

Job Location: Mexico City or Monterrey

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree mandatory. Desirable MBA or equivalent Masters degree in science, or a postgraduate degree with rich and relevant industry experience.

- 4+ years of progressive experience in the Life Sciences industry or consulting, ideally in roles involving business strategy systems implementation or technology transformation.

- Proven experience leading initiatives around Clinical trial systems, Regulatory submission tech, Patient safety reporting platform, and any modern tech solutions to accelerate Drug development space.

- In-depth understanding of Life Sciences R&D functions including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Safety, and related compliance requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11).

- Extensive knowledge and experience in agile methodology-based technology transformation projects.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders.

- Proven ability to effectively plan, manage, and coordinate multiple projects in a dynamic environment with numerous and complex stakeholder groups.

- Excellent documentation skills and exposure to work within GxP-validated systems.

- Advanced English is mandatory.

- Availability to travel may be required.

Good to have:
Experience in at least 4-5 of the following areas:
- Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS)

- Regulatory Information Management (RIM)

- Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) or Clinical Document Management

- Clinical Data Management / EDC

- Biostatistics or Clinical Data AnalyticsLaboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)

- Quality Management Systems (QMS)

- Pharmacovigilance or Safety Systems

Additional Information:
Relocation Options:  Candidates based in cities other than Mexico City or Monterrey can be considered, but Accenture regrets it does not cover relocation expenses for this position.
International Considerations : Foreign candidates can be considered but Accenture regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas for this position.

- Experience with IP telephony, intelligent routing, workflow automation, self-service, workforce optimization, outbound engagement, social engagement, digital channels, unified communications, and analytics.
- Experience using Sprinklr products to automate customer service processes and improve interaction service, agent experience, and reporting.

- Opportunity to work on transformative projects with key clients.

- Opportunity to collaborate across the organization in a culture committed to accelerating equality for all.

jobs.title: Service Management Consultant / ITSM Process Specialist
jobs.description:
- Design and uplift enterprise IT Service Management (ITSM) processes across complex client environments.

- Act as a trusted advisor , embedding practical ITIL 4-aligned service management practices that enable reliable operations.

- Work across multi-supplier, cloud, and modern engineering environments (DevOps/SRE).

- Location: Melbourne (primary); Canberra or Sydney (secondary).

- Eligibility: Must have full Australian working rights . Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Job Description

The Service Management Consultant / Process Specialist is part of Accenture’s Service Management team, responsible for designing, uplifting, and embedding IT Service Management practices across diverse client environments.

This role combines process design, advisory, and hands-on delivery , supporting both transformation initiatives and ongoing operational improvement. The role works closely with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and service providers to establish fit-for-purpose ITSM processes that enable reliable, efficient, and scalable service operations.

The role operates within complex enterprise environments , including multi-supplier, cloud, and platform-based delivery models, ensuring service management practices align with modern engineering approaches such as DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) .

Key Responsibilities
- Design, document, and pragmatically embed ITSM processes (e.g. Incident, Problem, Change, Event, Request, Knowledge, Configuration) aligned to ITIL 4 principles and client needs.

- Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagements to gather requirements, align on process design, and drive agreed outcomes.

- Assess current-state service management maturity and define practical, achievable improvement roadmaps.

- Support the implementation and uplift of service management capabilities across both project delivery and BAU environments.

- Ensure ITSM processes integrate effectively with infrastructure, cloud, and platform engineering practices, including DevOps and SRE .

- Collaborate with tooling teams (e.g. ServiceNow or equivalent ) to align workflows, data models, and automation with process design.

- Work across complex enterprise and/or multi-supplier environments to ensure consistency, integration, and clear accountability.

- Define and implement governance frameworks, including SLAs, KPIs, and reporting , to support service performance and continual improvement.

- Identify process gaps and operational issues, driving pragmatic resolutions in live environments.

- Develop process documentation, training materials, and knowledge artefacts to support adoption and operational readiness.

- Support service transition, stabilisation, and ongoing optimisation activities.

- Contribute to the development of the broader Service Management capability , including reusable assets, standards, and practices.

Qualifications (Required)
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.

- ITIL 4 Foundation certification (higher-level certifications preferred).

- Minimum 5 years’ experience in IT Service Management, including process design, uplift, and/or operational improvement in enterprise environments.

- Strong understanding of ITIL 4 principles, process governance, and ITSM practices.

- Experience working in complex, multi-supplier and/or large-scale enterprise environments .

- Proven ability to facilitate workshops and translate business needs into practical process outcomes.

- Experience with ITSM tooling platforms (e.g. ServiceNow or equivalent ).

- Working knowledge of service management integration with DevOps, SRE, and modern infrastructure or cloud operations .

- Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to operate effectively across both project delivery and BAU environments.

Qualifications (Preferred)
- ITIL 4 Specialist, Managing Professional, Strategic Leader, or Practice Manager certifications.

- SIAM Foundation or Professional certification, or experience in multi-vendor environments.

- ServiceNow certification (CSA and/or implementation) or hands-on design/configuration experience.

- Experience in service management transformation, maturity uplift, or large-scale operational improvement.

- Exposure to cloud platforms ( AWS, Azure, Google ) and their service management considerations.

- Experience in automation, service optimisation, or AIOps .

- Experience working in regulated or government environments .

- This role is open to Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents only. Candidates must already hold valid Australian work rights .

jobs.title: Consulting Finance Director | CFO Advisory & Transformation
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Consulting Finance Director to lead large-scale Finance Transformation and CFO Advisory programs across multiple industries. This is a high-impact leadership role focused on helping CFOs redefine their finance organizations, improve business performance, optimize operating models, and accelerate transformation initiatives.

The successful candidate will bring a strong consulting background, extensive experience working with senior finance executives, a proven ability to drive business growth, and a track record of leading high-performing teams. This individual will act as a trusted advisor to CFOs while helping organizations navigate complex transformation programs and achieve measurable business outcomes.

The position can be based in Madrid or Barcelona in a hybrid working model, combining work from home with in-office collaboration opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead Finance Transformation and CFO Advisory engagements for large organizations across different industries.
- Advise CFOs and senior finance leaders on operating model transformation, financial performance, organizational effectiveness, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and governance.
- Drive business development activities, including opportunity identification, proposal development, consulting sales, and account growth.
- Build, mentor, and lead high-performing consulting teams while expanding Accenture's Finance Transformation capabilities.

Responsibilities
- Define and execute finance transformation roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy and business objectives.
- Lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across finance functions and shared services organizations.
- Manage executive-level relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, and C-suite stakeholders.
- Support the adoption of data-driven decision-making capabilities within finance organizations.
- Contribute to market positioning, thought leadership, and practice growth initiatives.

Mandatory Requirements
- Experience in Management Consulting, Business Consulting, Finance Transformation Consulting, or CFO Advisory.
- Experience leading Finance Transformation programs for large organizations.
- Experience working directly with CFOs, Finance Directors, and senior executive stakeholders.
- Experience in business development, consulting sales, and account growth activities.
- Experience leading and developing consulting teams.
- Strong expertise in corporate finance, FP&A, performance management, financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and finance operating models.
- High level of English (C1 or above).

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in Data & Analytics initiatives within Finance organizations.
- Experience supporting Finance Digital Transformation programs.
- Understanding of AI, Advanced Analytics, or emerging technologies applied to Finance.
- Previous experience in Big Four, Strategy Consulting, or Global Consulting firms.
- Strong executive network and client development capabilities.
- International project experience.

Knowledge of generative AI and AI tools applied to the workplace will be considered a plus, aligned with Accenture's commitment to the responsible and effective use of AI.

Global Exposure
Work with multinational clients on large-scale manufacturing, operations, and industrial transformation programs spanning multiple industries and regions.
Specialized Development
Build expertise across Manufacturing Strategy, Smart Factories, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Systems (MES/MOM), Industrial IoT, AI-driven Operations, Digital Twins, Robotics, and Intelligent Automation.

We are seeking motivated and proactive professionals with experience in manufacturing, engineering, operations, industrial technology, automation, data & AI, and digital transformation to help clients accelerate industrial reinvention and operational excellence initiatives.
Whether your background is in Manufacturing Consulting, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Automation, Robotics, Operations Management, Data Science, Industrial AI, Supply Chain, or Smart Manufacturing, we want to hear from you.

Manufacturing Strategy & Transformation - Support clients in: Manufacturing Transformation Programs, Smart Factory Strategy & Roadmaps, Network Optimization, Operational Excellence, Cost Optimization, Industrial Sustainability, Supply Chain Integration
Manufacturing Systems, Automation & Industrial Infrastructure - Design and deliver solutions across: MES / MOM, SCADA, Industrial IoT, OT/IT Integration, Manufacturing Platforms, Smart Factory Infrastructure, Connected Factory Ecosystems
Manufacturing AI & Digital Twin - Help organizations unlock value through: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, Digital Twin Solutions, Predictive Maintenance, Process Optimization, Industrial Data Platforms, Generative AI in Manufacturing
Physical AI & Robotics - Drive innovation in: Robotics & Intelligent Automation, Autonomous Manufacturing Systems, Collaborative Robotics (Cobots), Computer Vision, AMRs & AGVs, Adaptive Automation, Next-Generation Physical AI Technologies

- Support Manufacturing and Operations Transformation initiatives across global clients.
- Define and execute Smart Manufacturing and Industry 4.0 roadmaps.
- Assess manufacturing performance, operational maturity, and organizational readiness.
- Design and implement MES, MOM, and shop-floor digitalization solutions.
- Integrate enterprise platforms with manufacturing operations.
- Develop AI, Advanced Analytics, and Digital Twin use cases to improve operational performance.
- Support Industrial IoT and Connected Factory deployments.
- Contribute to the development of reusable assets, accelerators, methodologies, and client offerings.
- Translate business requirements into scalable operational and technology solutions.
- Collaborate with business and technology teams to shape innovative industrial solutions.
- Support business case development, investment strategies, and transformation planning.
- Partner with Managers and Senior Managers to drive client value and grow Accenture's Manufacturing capabilities.

Preferred Technologies
Manufacturing Systems & Industrial Platforms: Siemens Opcenter , SAP Digital Manufacturing , Rockwell FactoryTalk , AVEVA , Ignition , Kepware.
Cloud & Industrial Data Platforms: Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Databricks, Snowflake, Python, Azure AI
Robotics & Automation: ABB, KUKA, FANUC, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, NVIDIA Robotics Platforms

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Operations, or a related field.
- Experience in manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, technology consulting, automation, or digital transformation environments.
- Experience supporting or leading transformation initiatives.
- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
- Advanced English proficiency.
- Ability to work effectively within global and multicultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in industries such as Automotive, Consumer Goods, Food & Beverage, Life Sciences, Energy & Utilities, Chemicals, Mining, Aerospace, Semiconductor, Electronics, High Tech, or Industrial Equipment.
- Certifications such as PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Scrum/Agile, or Industry 4.0 certifications.

Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com .

We Are:
Accenture's Life Sciences MedTech practice sits at the intersection of science, technology, and human impact. We partner with the world's leading MedTech companies to reinvent how they discover, develop, and deliver innovations that improve patient outcomes. From strategy through execution, we help clients navigate regulatory complexity, accelerate product development timelines, and build the AI-enabled operating models that will define the next era of medical technology.

Our R&D practice is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business — and we're looking for the leaders who will own a significant piece of it.

You Are
- A proven business builder. You have led an organization — a consulting practice, a business development function, or a commercial team — and you know what it takes to grow revenue, build talent, and set a market strategy from the top.

- A major account originator. You have a track record of personally sourcing and closing large, complex engagements with senior R&D and innovation leaders at MedTech OEMs. You don't need a warm intro or institutional support to open a door.

- An AI leader with substance. You understand how AI and data are reshaping R&D operations and you can set a credible vision for AI-enabled transformation in front of a skeptical board or C-suite.

- A MedTech authority. You are recognized in the industry — through your network, your thought leadership, or your track record — as someone who understands the product development lifecycle, the regulatory environment, and the strategic pressures facing R&D organizations.

- A talent multiplier. You build organizations, not just teams. You attract strong people, develop them deliberately, and create the kind of culture where high performers want to stay and grow.

Job Description:
This is a business leadership role, not a senior delivery role. We are looking for a Principal Director who has already built and run something meaningful — a practice, a business unit, a market — and is ready to do it again at Accenture scale.

You will own a defined segment of our MedTech R&D growth agenda: setting the strategy, building the team, originating and closing major client engagements, and being accountable for the P&L. You have the credibility to walk into a boardroom conversation with a Chief R&D Officer and be seen as a peer. AI fluency is not a nice-to-have — it is central to how you lead and what you sell.

The Work (Role Responsibility)
- Responsibility for a defined segment of Accenture's MedTech R&D practice — including revenue targets, headcount, and margin.

- Market strategy for your segment: where to play, how to win, which clients to prioritize, and how to differentiate Accenture's offering against competitors.

- A major client origination agenda — personally sourcing and closing transformational engagements with C-suite and VP-level R&D leaders across top MedTech OEMs and emerging digital health companies.

- Design and deployment of AI-enabled solutions that help clients accelerate product development, improve clinical operations, and build data-driven R&D organizations.

- Executive-level client relationships that position Accenture as the long-term strategic partner of choice for R&D transformation.

- Thought leadership and market positioning — setting Accenture's point of view in your segment through publications, keynotes, and industry presence.

- Practice development — recruiting, developing, and retaining the next generation of Accenture's MedTech R&D leaders.

Travel - candidate should be willing to travel up to 75% to client locations.

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum of 15 years working in or advising the MedTech R&D industry, with deep expertise in the product development and regulatory lifecycle with deep segment expertise in at least one area: cardiovascular, neuromodulation, surgical robotics, diagnostics, digital health, or adjacent fields.
- Minimum of 10 years experience in management consulting or with a MedTech firm, with a demonstrated track record of business development, client origination, and practice leadership.
- Minimum of 10 years of experience owning or leading an organization — a consulting practice, a business unit, or a commercial function — with accountability for people, revenue, and strategy.
- A Bachelor's degree (science, engineering, or health-related field preferred); advanced degree a strong plus.

Bonus Points If You Have:
- A proven ability to originate and close major engagements independently — large, complex deals with senior buyers at MedTech OEMs.
- Hands-on experience leading or selling AI-enabled R&D transformation — not just recommending AI, but designing and implementing it.
- An established, senior network of C-suite and VP-level R&D, innovation, and commercial leaders at MedTech OEMs who see you as a trusted strategic advisor.
- Experience building and scaling a consulting practice or business development organization — not just contributing to one.
- A visible market presence: publications, keynote appearances, board or advisory roles, or a professional reputation that precedes you in the MedTech R&D space.
- A disciplined approach to pipeline management at scale — portfolio-level thinking about where to invest the team's time, not just your own.
- Experience operating at the intersection of R&D, commercial, and technology strategy — able to connect Accenture's full capability set to a client's enterprise agenda.

jobs.description:
Overview
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale.

Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at  www.accenture.com .

Our Laboratory Reinvention practice is where scientific and laboratory innovation meets leading-edge technology.  We help our clients envision and achieve Digital and AI Laboratory Transformation through co-creation and application of digital technologies, revolutionizing scientific and laboratory processes.  Our people have a combination of scientific and laboratory informatics expertise, tied with strategic and business consulting experience, and industry platforms knowledge.  We provide an innovative approach and global scale across a variety of industries.

We leverage digital technologies such as GenAI and Agentic SI solutions, automation, Internet of Things, analytics, and cloud, in combination with a fundamental redesign of the scientific user experience to help our clients better capture, manage, integrate, and analyze complex scientific data. We help improve the research, development, and manufacturing of new products, improve quality, ensure compliance, reduce time to market and improve operational efficiency.

As a member of our team, you will be exposed to the cutting-edge technologies and processes that many leading companies and government agencies utilize.

What would you do?
Deliver exceptional, differentiated solutions for our clients that advance their ambitions for digital laboratory operations and scientific intelligence. As a Forward Deployed Scientific   Informatics Consultant, you can expect to:
- Utilize AI tools to effectively elicit, demonstrate, develop, and scale solutions that meet the needs of laboratory scientists across the value chain

- Conduct stakeholder interviews and working sessions to gather insights and clarify needs

- Analyze and translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration of custom and off-the-shelf solutions

- Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, use cases, user stories, and design documents

- Operate in and perform project management activities for both waterfall and agile methodologies

- Support the design and implementation of solutions that comply with regulatory standards in GxP and non-GxP environments

- Support the accurate and timely design, creation, and migration of scientific master data and transactional data

- Provide training and ongoing support to end-users on new systems and processes

- Prepare SDLC documents (Process Maps, Workflows, Specs, Test Scripts, etc.)

- Provide point-of-view on laboratory and scientific informatics solutions and strengths and weaknesses of various technology solutions

jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture’s Life Sciences MedTech Practice sits at the forefront of commercial innovation. In the face of increasing external macrodynamic and customer cost pressures, we partner with leading MedTech organizations to evolve their commercial engines to drive both topline growth and better execution. From commercial strategy and growth acceleration to sales transformation, channel optimization, AI-enabled customer engagement, and commercial operations, we help leading MedTech organizations reinvent how they bring products and services to market. Our work spans commercial operating model transformation, commercial excellence, omnichannel engagement, commercialization of data and digital solutions, and next-generation revenue growth strategies powered by AI. We are looking for leaders who share our passion for commercial innovation and want to help us grow this foundational pillar of our MedTech business.

You Are:
- A natural connector. You build relationships with senior commercial and marketing leaders at MedTech companies, identify where the real pain is, and turn those conversations into scoped, signed engagements.
- An AI enthusiast with substance. You understand how AI and data are reshaping MedTech commercial and marketing organizations and you can speak credibly about it in front of a skeptical business leader.
- A MedTech insider. You understand the commercial process across different MedTech segments, from commercial strategy to marketing to field sales to commercial enablement. You have the segment depth to be seen as a peer, not just a consultant.
- A commercial transformation leader. You understand how commercial strategy, sales, marketing, pricing, contracting, customer success, field service, and commercial operations work together to drive growth. You can connect strategic vision with the operational changes required to deliver measurable business outcomes.
- A builder. You thrive in white space. You're energized by creating something — a new client relationship, a new capability, a new team — rather than maintaining what already exists.
- A leader worth following. Your teams deliver quality work on time because they want to, not because they have to. You invest in developing people and leave every engagement with talent that's grown.

- An industry thought leader. You have a recognized point of view on the future of MedTech commercial models, AI-enabled growth, customer engagement, and revenue transformation. Clients, partners, and colleagues seek out your perspective, and you actively shape industry conversations through publications, conference participation, executive forums, and C-suite advisory work.

The Work:
- This role is focused on growing and shaping Accenture's MedTech Commercial business. Beyond leading client engagements, you will define market strategy, create industry-leading points of view, cultivate C-suite relationships, and help establish Accenture as the preferred partner for commercial reinvention across the MedTech ecosystem.
- You will be a key driver of our MedTech Commercial growth agenda: building client relationships from scratch, shaping compelling propositions, closing engagements, and developing the next generation of Accenture consultants. AI fluency is central to how we work and what we sell.
- You will help MedTech clients rethink growth in a rapidly changing environment, helping them deploy AI, redesign commercial operating models, optimize go-to-market strategies, improve productivity, and unlock new sources of revenue.

Key Responsibilities:
- Establish and manage business development pipeline of new client engagements across the MedTech industry — including top OEMs and digital health companies
- Develop C-suite and VP-level client relationships, positioning Accenture as a long-term strategic partner in commercial reinvention.
- Lead commercial transformation programs including commercial operating model redesign, sales excellence, omnichannel engagement, commercial enablement, and go-to-market optimization.
- Partner with clients to evaluate, design and scale AI and advanced analytics to improve commercial decision-making, territory design, lead generation, customer segmentation, channel effectiveness, and field productivity, improving both efficiency and topline metrics
- Develop business cases and value realization roadmaps that quantify revenue growth, productivity improvements, and customer experience outcomes.
- Shape and pitch compelling propositions that connect Accenture’s capabilities – strategy, technology, AI, and operations – to our clients’ most urgent commercial challenges
- Develop and advance Accenture's market position in MedTech Commercial Transformation through industry thought leadership, executive forums, publications, conference speaking engagements, analyst engagement, and strategic client discussions. Shape Accenture's MedTech commercial growth agenda by identifying emerging industry trends, defining differentiated market offerings, and building distinctive intellectual property that supports business development and client impact.
- Build and activate relationships across clients, technology partners, industry associations, venture ecosystems, and academic institutions to support business growth and innovation.

- undefined

- Lead global, high-performing consulting teams delivering commercial and marketing engagements across MedTech segments
- Build and scale Accenture offerings, assets, and thought leadership across AI-enabled commercial transformation and MedTech growth strategy.
- Mentor and develop junior talent, building the next generation of Accenture's MedTech Commercial practice.
- Travel - candidate should be willing to travel up to 75% to client locations.

Here's What You Need:
- Minimum of 12 years of MedTech commercial experience and expertise, including sales, marketing, commercial operations, commercial excellence, market access, customer engagement, or business unit leadership.
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in commercial and marketing continuums from strategy to execution.
- Minimum of 8 years in at least one area: cardiovascular, surgery, diabetes, diagnostics, digital health, or adjacent fields.
- Minimum of 5 years of consulting experience, with a strong track record of delivery, business development, and client origination.
- Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated ability to build senior client relationships independently and convert them into revenue — a proven hunter, not just a relationship manager.
- Minimum of 5 years hands-on experience applying or selling AI, data, or digital solutions within a commercial or marketing context.
- Demonstrated thought leadership in MedTech commercial strategy, customer engagement, AI, digital health, commercialization, or revenue transformation.
- Experience developing market propositions, industry offerings, intellectual property, or commercial growth platforms.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Bonus Points If:
- Experience with leading commercial technology platforms including Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft, Adobe, ServiceNow, or AI-enabled commercial platforms.
- Experience commercializing connected devices, software, services, data products, or digital health solutions.
- An existing network of senior commercial, marketing, or business leaders at MedTech companies who see you as a trusted advisor
- A track record of building and managing a pipeline with discipline: staged opportunities, conversion metrics, and a clear point of view on where to invest your time.
- Experience helping clients build AI-enabled commercial and marketing organizations — not just recommending AI, but designing and implementing it.

- Recognized market presence demonstrated through published thought leadership, conference speaking, analyst engagement, industry board participation, executive roundtables, podcast appearances, media contributions, or a well-established professional reputation within the MedTech ecosystem.

jobs.title: Consulting Associate Director – Health & Public Services (Ministerie van Financiën)
jobs.description:
Wij zijn Accenture Strategy & Consulting – Health & Public Services (H&PS). Onze ambitie is om dé vertrouwde strategische partner te zijn voor organisaties binnen het Rijk die voor grote maatschappelijke, financiële en digitale opgaven staan. Als Associate Director Strategy & Consulting werk je in high performance teams aan strategische vraagstukken op het hoogste niveau, specifiek voor het Ministerie van Financiën, de Belastingdienst en aanpalende uitvoeringsorganisaties. Je ondersteunt DG’s, directeuren FEZ, CIO’s en andere C-level leiders bij het maken van keuzes die politiek-bestuurlijk gevoelig, financieel impactvol en maatschappelijk relevant zijn.

Samen met je team help je klanten toekomstbestendig te blijven in een omgeving waarin ambitie, uitvoerbaarheid, digitalisering en publieke verantwoording continu met elkaar botsen. Je doorgrondt de kern van hun belangrijkste uitdagingen, analyseert strategische opties en begeleidt besluitvorming. Niet door oplossingen te pushen, maar door richting te geven: je helpt klanten kiezen welke koers strategisch houdbaar, uitvoerbaar en verantwoord is.

In één zin: Een Strategy & Consulting leader die waardegedreven blik, Rijkskennis en bestuurlijke sensitiviteit combineert om het Ministerie van Financien te helpen duurzame keuzes te maken in een soevereine, weerbare digitale overheid.

Het team en klanten
- Je opereert binnen Strategy & Consulting – Health & Public Services en fungeert als trusted advisor voor grote publieke accounts, met een duidelijke focus op het Ministerie van Financiën (incl. Belastingdienst/Toeslagen) en gerelateerde rijksbrede dossiers. Je combineert diepgaande Rijkskennis met strategisch en financieel inzicht en bent een inhoudelijk geweten richting klant én Accenture-accountteam.
- Je werkt intensief samen met DG’s, directeuren FEZ, CIO, programma-directeuren, uitvoeringsverantwoordelijken en senior IT- en financeleiders, vaak rondom Kamergevoelige dossiers en grote transformaties.

Activiteiten
- Je krijgt energie van het oplossen van complexe strategische vraagstukken en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams. Onze H&PS‑consultants binnen Strategy & Consulting helpen organisaties dagelijks bij het vormgeven van hun strategische agenda. Jij past data‑gedreven en analytische methoden toe om strategische dilemma’s inzichtelijk te maken, scenario’s af te wegen en bestuurders te ondersteunen bij prioritering en besluitvorming.
- Ontwikkelen van integrale strategieën (cloud, sourcing, finance, governance, soevereiniteit) en afwegingskaders voor publieke waarde, risico, autonomie en weerbaarheid. Niet: “welke oplossing?” Wel: “welke richting is bestuurlijk houdbaar en uitvoerbaar?”
- Sparringpartner voor DG’s, directeuren FEZ en CIO-raden; inhoudelijk klankbord bij Kamergevoelige dossiers, hersteloperaties en grote transformaties (o.a. Belastingdienst/Toeslagen). Cruciaal: klanten vertrouwen je met vraagstukken voordat ze politiek worden.
- Van strategie naar portfoliokeuzes, prioritering, governance-inrichting en sourcing/partnerstrategie, met expliciete aandacht voor financiële consequenties, uitvoeringscapaciteit en bestuurlijke risico’s. Finance is hierbij een strategisch stuurinstrument.
- Richting geven aan accountstrategie, proposities en thought leadership; bewaken van strategische consistentie en geloofwaardigheid richting klant. Je voorkomt solution push en borgt dat Accenture strategisch relevant blijft.
- Naast klantwerk draag je actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de practice. Je helpt het team groeien door thought leadership te ontwikkelen, point‑of‑views te creëren, kennis te delen en events te initiëren. Je bent een inhoudelijk ankerpunt voor collega’s en bewaakt de strategische scherpte in onze proposities en accounts.

Technologie & Data
- Je hebt een diepgaand begrip van de rol van technologie binnen het Rijk en weet dit te vertalen naar strategische keuzes voor MinFin en uitvoeringsorganisaties. Je adviseert over cloud- en sourcingstrategieën met expliciete aandacht voor soevereiniteit, weerbaarheid, compliance en governance (o.a. rijksbrede kaders en parlementaire verantwoording). Je helpt klanten hun technologische landschap herontwerpen vanuit strategisch perspectief, met oog voor langetermijnwaarde en publieke verantwoordelijkheid.
- Je ontwikkelt samen met klanten datastrategieën, innovatie‑agenda’s en operating models voor zorg‑ en publieke organisaties. Je begrijpt het strategisch belang van data voor bestuurlijke besluitvorming en helpt organisaties daadwerkelijk data‑ en inzichtgedreven te worden.
- Je ondersteunt klanten bij het identificeren van meetbare publieke en financiële waarde uit data & analytics, het ontwikkelen van de benodigde capabilities en het verankeren van data in besluitvorming, processen en dagelijkse operatie. Daarnaast begeleid je teams in het helder en overtuigend communiceren van inzichten via data‑gedreven storytelling.

People & Organization
- Je ontwerpt implementatie‑ en transformatieplannen met expliciete aandacht voor mens, organisatie en change. Je helpt klanten operating models te ontwikkelen die aansluiten bij hun strategische ambities en bestuurlijke realiteit.
- Als Associate Director breng je structuur en overzicht in complexe discussies en help je bestuurders kiezen in trade-offs. Je ziet wat gezegd wordt én wat niet gezegd kan worden, kent politieke timing en gevoeligheden, en zegt met inhoud “nee” wanneer dat nodig is. Je bouwt teams om je heen, ontwikkelt jong talent en verbindt strategie, technologie en uitvoering zonder ze te vermengen.

Binnen al onze rollen is er ruimte voor fysieke samenwerking met klanten, collega’s en leiders, gecombineerd met flexibiliteit om werk en privé goed te balanceren. Accenture ondersteunt maatwerk in werkvormen en stimuleert duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Wie wij zijn
Bij Accenture Strategy & Consulting veranderen we bedrijven elke dag met onze inzichten, kennis en innovatieve ideeën. Samen met ’s werelds toonaangevende bedrijven en onze ongeëvenaarde branche- en functie experts gaan we de uitdaging aan om samen transformatieve bedrijfsoplossingen te creëren, te innoveren en ze te implementeren. Door de nieuwste technologie te gebruiken, helpen we onze klanten om beter contact te maken met hun klanten, de veerkracht te verbeteren en duurzame groei te stimuleren.

Strategy & Consulting is een van de vijf services als onderdeel van Accenture – de andere zijn Operations, Technology, Song en Industry X.

Samen met circa 50 collega’s bevind je je in het hart van complexe transformaties in de Health & Public Services Industrie. Je werkt aan korte tot middellange strategische trajecten waarin waardecreatie, governance en uitvoerbaarheid centraal staan. Als Associate Director bevind je je op het cruciale snijvlak van strategie, finance, technologie en publieke context. Alles wat je doet is gericht op één doel: het ontsluiten van publieke waarde en het realiseren van tastbare, duurzame impact.

#LI-EU

Wat je meebrengt
- Een afgeronde masteropleiding.
- 12–15+ jaar relevante strategie- en/of managementconsultingervaring, bij voorkeur binnen de Rijksoverheid.
- Aantoonbare ervaring als trusted advisor voor DG-, CIO- en directeur FEZ-niveau; comfortabel aan tafel zonder hiërarchische macht.
- Diepe ervaring met het Ministerie van Financiën en/of ketenorganisaties (Belastingdienst, Toeslagen, Douane) en begrip van Haagse besluitvorming, FEZ-logica en parlementaire verantwoording.
- Sterke finance/control/governance-basis: je kunt financiële vraagstukken strategisch framen, consequenties doorrekenen en risico’s bestuurlijk duiden.
- Bewezen vermogen om integrale strategieën en afwegingskaders te ontwikkelen (publieke waarde, risico, autonomie, weerbaarheid) en deze te vertalen naar portfoliokeuzes, prioritering en governance.
- Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, stakeholdermanagement en datagedreven storytelling; vloeiende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Wat we jou bieden
Accenture is een geweldige plek om te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Kies je voor Accenture, dan word je een schakel in een bedrijf op wereldniveau. Door de vele samenwerkingsverbanden en relaties met klanten zijn wij trots op onze levendige en diverse bedrijfscultuur. Wij staan voor een agile aanpak, end-to-end services en een realistische mindset. Wij willen de echte jij leren kennen en je verder helpen met je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Je doorloopt gedurende je carrière bij ons meerdere leertrajecten (formeel en informeel) om je vaardigheden en expertise binnen je rol uit te breiden. Wij beloven:
- Flexibel werken in een cultuur gebaseerd op vertrouwen
- Een mindset van duurzame groei
- Een door mensen geleidde cultuur van inclusie en diversiteit door diep om al onze mensen te geven
- Leid en transformeer onze klanten met technologie
- Maak verbinding met ons wereldwijde netwerk van 800.000 collega's

Naast onze uitdagende projecten, bieden wij jou ook nog het volgende:
- Een fijne en open werkomgeving waarbij de focus op jouw (persoonlijke) ontwikkeling ligt en waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt
