- Korting op Accenture aandelen
- Goede benefits zoals laptop, mobiele telefoon, maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding, mobiliteitsbudget en meer

Wat wij geloven
Accenture is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Onze leiders zijn toegewijd aan het bouwen van een beter, sterker en rechtvaardiger bedrijf voor toekomstige generaties om positieve, langdurige verandering te creëren. Inclusie en diversiteit zijn fundamenteel voor onze cultuur en kernwaarden. We zetten ons in voor het creëren van een inclusieve omgeving voor al onze medewerkers. Onze rijke diversiteit maakt ons innovatiever en creatiever, waardoor we onze klanten en onze gemeenschappen beter van dienst kunnen zijn.

Onze positie als partner van veel van 's werelds toonaangevende bedrijven, organisaties en overheden biedt ons zowel een buitengewone kans als een enorme verantwoordelijkheid om een verschil te maken. jobs.title: SAP Finance Transformation Associate Director
jobs.description:
SAP Finance Transformation Associate Director
Career level: Associate Director (CL5) · Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh · Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (SAP)

Why this role
SAP is where most of our finance transformation pipeline sits, and this role exists to convert it. You'll spend your time in front of clients, finding the finance problem worth solving, turning it into a pursuit, shaping the deal, and leading the early discovery that sets the programme up before our delivery teams take it on. It's a senior, market-facing seat with a clear brief: build relationships with finance and technology leadership, grow the accounts you work on, and bring work into the practice.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
Originating and winning SAP finance work. This is the core of the role. You build and hold senior relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, CIOs and transformation leads, and you use them to spot where an SAP finance problem is costing a client real money, open the conversation, and turn it into a qualified pursuit. You own the qualification call. You decide what we chase and what we walk away from, and you own the commercial shape we take to the client: the scope, the solution, the team, the construct and the value case that makes it fundable. You lead bids and orals, you know how to position against the firms you'll be up against, and you're comfortable owning a pipeline rather than a plan. You grow the accounts you're on, and you make sure the next piece of work is in view before the current one lands.

Credibility on SAP finance programmes. Configuration isn't part of this role. What matters is that you can hold your own in a serious conversation about SAP-enabled finance transformation with a CFO or a CIO and come out of it with a shaped deal. You know what an S/4HANA finance programme involves: how the finance design fits with the wider programme, what it takes to move a finance function off a legacy landscape, what realistic sequencing and timelines look like, and what drives the cost. You also know what goes wrong: where finance design decisions get deferred and come back as rework, where data and master data sink a timeline, where the business case quietly stops adding up, and where a client's own readiness is the real constraint. That pattern recognition, earned on real programmes, is what makes a client trust the recommendation you put in front of them.
Talking to the CFO agenda, not the system. You connect SAP capability to what a finance leadership team actually cares about: a faster and more reliable close, reporting the business trusts, stronger control, better insight, and a finance function that costs less to run. You're grounded in the finance process spine an SAP programme touches: Record-to-Report first, and the wider processes around it. You know it well enough to diagnose a client's problem in their language rather than the platform's, and to build a value case a CFO will sign off. The platform matters less here than the judgement you bring: you can talk credibly about SAP and about comparable finance platforms, and give advice a client believes because it is rooted in their business and not in a product.

Leading early discovery. Once the work is won, you lead the front end: the discovery, the diagnostic, the visioning and the early design where the decisions that shape everything downstream get made. You run those phases in front of the client, setting the agenda, chairing the senior sessions, and standing as the finance design authority. You make the calls that hold the shape of the solution together, and you take the client's leadership to a decision they'll stand behind. You hand over to delivery with a defined scope, an agreed design direction and a client that knows what it has signed up to. You stay close enough to protect the relationship and the commercial position as the programme runs.

SAP Business AI in the conversation. AI is now part of every serious SAP finance discussion, and you need to hold that part of it in front of a client's finance leadership. You can talk about SAP Business AI and Joule: what is shipping today, what is still roadmap, and what that difference means for a client putting a programme behind it. You can hold the same conversation on agentic AI in and around finance processes: where an agent can credibly run a close task or a reconciliation, what that does to controls and evidence, and where a person still has to own the judgement. You can speak to how frontier AI capability outside the SAP stack interacts with an SAP landscape, and give a client a straight read on what that combination is good for today. In a pursuit, that shows up in what AI changes about the scope, the design and the value case, and in what it leaves untouched. It shows up in the room too, because a CFO or a CIO will test you on it and you need to come through that with your credibility intact. You won't be asked to build any of it yourself; the bar here is judgement and fluency, not engineering. We're also increasingly an AI-first firm in how we work ourselves, with agentic tooling and orchestration in diagnostics, value-case modelling and pursuit shaping, and our people owning the judgement and the outcome. If you already sell and shape that way, that's a real plus.

Building the capability behind the work. You also build the capability that has to be ready when the deals land. You attract senior people into the SAP finance team and grow the bench behind the work you win, you pull colleagues into the pursuits you shape so the capability deepens across the team, and you coach the managers and senior managers coming up behind you. You treat market eminence as a commercial instrument. A clear, public point of view on where SAP finance transformation is heading, voiced at events, in writing and in front of clients, generates the inbound conversations a pipeline like this is built from.

Who you are
You are at your best in front of a client. You open doors, building senior relationships from a standing start and turning them into business. You decide with incomplete information and carry the consequences. You can look at an opportunity, judge honestly whether it is real, and say no to a client and to your own organisation when the answer is no. You hold a position under pressure from a client executive who would rather hear something else, because being trusted is worth more to you than being agreeable. You carry commercial risk calmly, and you're candid upstream early when something you own isn't going to land. You communicate without ego. You can chair a room of a client's finance and technology leadership, explain a design trade-off to a CFO and to a CIO in the terms each of them cares about, and disagree without losing the relationship. And you build around yourself: you back the people you bring through, and you measure yourself on having grown a team that can win work without you in the room.

Things that set strong candidates apart: the years you have spent originating, shaping and closing SAP-enabled finance work at deal level, within a broader track record (typically 12+ years) in enterprise finance transformation; senior client relationships you have built and can build again; experience leading discovery and early design phases on large finance transformation programmes; breadth across more than one finance platform, so your advice isn't tied to one product; the ability to hold a credible conversation with a client's finance leadership about SAP Business AI, Joule and agentic AI in finance, covering what is real today, what is roadmap, and what it means for a programme; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you. Tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP
Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd help lead our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team taking SAP finance transformation to market, and building AI into how we deliver. SAP is where most of the demand in front of us sits, which is why this role sits at the front of the engagement, close to the clients, the market and the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package for an Associate Director (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

We Are:
Accenture’s Supply Chain & Operations practice, and we move at the speed of transformation. Our clients—Fortune 500 leaders in retail, e-commerce, consumer goods, grocery, and industrial manufacturing—depend on us to design and deliver next-generation distribution networks that are faster, smarter, and more resilient. From greenfield DC launches and large-scale WMS implementations to complex, multi-vendor warehouse automation deployments, our Warehousing & Distribution Engineering team combines deep functional expertise, proven program leadership, and the full power of Accenture’s global ecosystem to fundamentally change how goods move from facility to customer. We deliver outcomes that last—and we are looking for leaders who do the same.

You Are:
A seasoned program leader who has built a career delivering the hardest distribution center transformations—on schedule, on budget, and with lasting operational impact. You bring deep, hands-on expertise in Warehouse Management Systems, with Manhattan Active® WM at the center of your experience, and you know how to architect, configure, integrate, and cut over complex WMS solutions in live, high-volume operating environments. You understand the full automation ecosystem—AS/RS, goods-to-person, conveyor and sortation, autonomous mobile robots, pick-to-light and voice, and the WES/WCS layer that ties it all together—and you have successfully integrated these systems into large programs involving multiple vendors, contractors, and client teams. You are a trusted advisor to COOs and senior supply chain executives: a clear and confident communicator who keeps complex programs moving through ambiguity, and a leader who raises the bar for everyone around you. The work energizes you—and you are ready to be where it happens, 60 to 80 percent of the time.

The Work:
- Lead end-to-end distribution center transformation programs—new DC launches, WMS implementations, and warehouse automation deployments—from strategy and business case development through design, build, testing, go-live, and hypercare stabilization.
- Serve as the delivery executive and senior program leader across one or more engagements and multiple concurrent workstreams (WMS, automation/MHE, facilities, IT integration, labor and operations readiness). Own client satisfaction, delivery quality, and overall program financial performance while orchestrating systems integrators, automation OEMs, general contractors, IT vendors, and client operational teams throughout the program lifecycle.
- Own the full WMS solution lifecycle for Manhattan Active® WM engagements—requirements definition, solution design, configuration, integration architecture, testing strategy, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization—applying equivalent depth across Blue Yonder Luminate, SAP EWM, or other platforms where required.
- Direct the integration of automation solutions (AS/RS, goods-to-person, conveyor/sortation, autonomous mobile robots, pick-to-light/voice) with WMS and warehouse control/execution systems (WCS/WES), ensuring solution designs reflect realistic throughput targets, labor models, and facility constraints.
- Build and govern integrated program plans, risk registers, budgets, and RAID logs across design, build, test, and deployment phases; lead issue resolution, change control, and executive escalation management across client and partner organizations.
- Lead new distribution center launch readiness—operational design, slotting, labor standards, SOPs, training programs, and cutover/hypercare execution—in close partnership with client operations leadership and frontline management.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with client CSCO, VP-level supply chain and distribution leaders, and project sponsors; deliver program status, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations at the executive level with clarity and confidence.
- Develop and mentor project managers, functional leads, and solution architects, building WMS delivery and large-program management capability within the Supply Chain & Operations practice.
- Contribute to Accenture’s business development efforts—proposal writing, RFP responses, client presentations, and account expansion—and to practice-building initiatives including methodology development, delivery accelerators, and thought leadership.
- Champion client commitments around sustainability, workforce development, and community impact as an integrated dimension of program delivery.

Travel Requirements:
This role requires 60–80% travel, primarily to client distribution center and project sites across the United States and potentially internationally. Travel is aligned with active project needs and current health and safety guidelines.

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in supply chain, distribution center operations, or technology delivery, including at least 8 years leading large-scale WMS implementations, distribution center automation programs, or major facility transformations.
- Minimum 8 years' experience hands-on WMS solution expertise—Manhattan Active® WM strongly preferred—spanning solution design, configuration, integration, testing, and cutover, together with demonstrated experience integrating automation and material handling solutions such as AS/RS, goods-to-person systems, conveyor/sortation, AMRs, and robotic picking with WMS, WES, and WCS platforms.
- Proven ability to serve as the accountable program leader for large, multi-workstream distribution center programs involving multiple vendors, contractors, and client stakeholders, with ownership of budget, schedule, scope, risk, operational readiness, labor ramp, process documentation, and cutover execution.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points If:
- You hold Manhattan Active® WM certification or formal platform training credentials from Manhattan Associates.
- You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or comparable program management certification.
- Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of advising C-suite and VP-level client leaders on program status, risk, strategic direction, and critical delivery decisions.
- You have led simultaneous programs involving multiple automation OEMs or robotics providers across a single facility or DC network.
- You have hands-on experience with Blue Yonder Luminate Warehouse Management, SAP EWM, or other enterprise WMS/WES platforms in addition to Manhattan Active® WM.
- You bring Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt or Green Belt) or other operational excellence certifications.
- You have consulting experience delivering supply chain technology transformations for Fortune 500 clients across retail, e-commerce, grocery, consumer goods, or industrial/manufacturing.
- You have earned an MBA or an advanced degree in a related discipline.
- You have experience with AI-enabled warehouse operations, labor management systems (LMS), or intelligent slotting and demand-sensing tools.

jobs.title: Utilities Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
We Are:
We are a diverse team of driven individuals, sharing a common passion for driving the net zero agenda across our wide-ranging portfolio of clients. Our mission is to expedite the energy transition, reducing emissions whilst ensuring a stable and affordable energy supply enabling robust future economic development. From strategy development and delivering innovative new technologies through to enabling organizational and operational excellence, we are committed to a global sustainable future for our clients.

Our team thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and boundaryless opportunities that drive each of our careers in new and exciting ways. Innovation is at the heart of our team, and we bring cutting edge technology to our clients, helping them on our collective journey to a more sustainable future. From capital infrastructure projects building new energy generation plants through to power trading and energy retail, our team is at the forefront of utility excellence across the value chain.

You Are:
A Strategy Consulting Professional with experience in the renewables and utilities that understands the technical and regulatory nuances, while having a clear sense of the commercial dynamics that matter for our clients to succeed. You excel in using quantitative and qualitative analysis to support clients' business, commercial, and/or technology strategies. Energetic, resilient, and passionate about serving clients, you love continuous learning. You break down complex processes into logical parts, offering clear reasoning and analysis. With strong communication and people skills, you thrive in team settings and appreciate diverse perspectives.

The Work:
Accenture is the reinvention partner of choice for the world’s leading Utilities. We work with clients across Utilities value chain in generation, transmission & distribution, retail, and trading. As a Utilities Strategy Manager, you will:
•    Help clients navigate the energy transition with new business models, sustainability strategies, and market outlooks.
•    Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to help clients enter new markets and drive growth.
•    Apply Generative and Agentic AI to achieve meaningful results at scale
•    Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders on strategy, transformation, and performance topics
•    Structure and solve complex problems; manage projects end-to-end and ensure high-quality delivery
•    Design and facilitate executive-level workshops; synthesize insights into clear, compelling recommendations
•    Identify new value creation opportunities for clients and help convert insight into follow-on work
•    Support and mentor junior team members, fostering continuous learning and innovation.

Qualifications
- Minimum 5 of years of professional experience within top-tier management consulting and/or industry experience within the utilities sector
- You have a flair for breaking down problems into logical parts and constructing clear reasoning and analyses, using quantitative analysis methods, statistics & data-driven thinking.
- Knowledge of how power markets work and grasp of market trends, incl. a deep understanding of the Danish/Nordic regulatory environment,
- You have energy and drive, a passion for continuous learning and mastering new topics, and an understanding of how forces like digital and the energy transition will shape the future business landscape.
- You are an effective communicator and a natural at appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in people
- You have a natural ability for building relationships, as well as the ability to communicate well with different stakeholders both internally and externally in English and in one Nordic language.
- You have a Master’s degree from a top-tier university in a relevant discipline, such as engineering, economics or business administration

Bonus points if:
- You have experience in a commercial or technical function in the industry or from a top-tier consultancy.
- You have strong quantitative skills, including familiarity with Excel/VBA , R, and/or Python and their respective data manipulation, statistical modelling, and visualization packages.

What’s in it for you:
- You’ll be doing work in the forefront of the Utilities industry, working hand-in-hand with executives on strategy and solving their biggest challenges
- You’ll work across the globe, collecting experiences and developing skills that will render you successful in business regardless of geography
- We offer a transparent, fast paced career progression, with a focus on your strengths and continuous coaching from senior colleagues
- Flexible work arrangements and a range of benefits including competitive rewards

Interested?
Apply online by attaching your CV and cover letter as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application. Thank you for your interest in joining Accenture.

A Strategy expert with deep professional experience working across the High Tech industry — and a genuine obsession with what AI makes possible. You see around corners. jobs.description:

You define enterprise, industry-specific and function-specific   AI   and data strategy, develop value cases and roadmaps, shape AI and data operating models and platform   strategy, embed Responsible AI, and lead tech-driven transformations. Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- Engineering problem-solver mindset — ability to apply technology creatively to complex business problems

MBA/Masters

jobs.description:
#DigitalStrategy, #DigitalTransformation, #TechnologyStrategy: Begleite Top Unternehmen in ihre digitale Zukunft – mit Technologie- und Industrie- Know-how, strategischem Weitblick und Umsetzungsgeschick.

Deine Mission
Nutze Deine umfassende Führungserfahrung und strategische Expertise, um unser Technology Strategy & Advisory Team massgeblich voranzubringen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle arbeitest Du eng mit Entscheidungsträgern auf höchster Führungsebene zusammen, um wegweisende Strategien zu entwickeln und die Implementierung innovativer Technologien zu leiten. Du gestaltest die digitale Transformation in verschiedenen Branchen aktiv mit und erschliesst neue Wachstumschancen für unsere Kunden.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du Dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem Du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu Dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Entwickle Strategien für eine smartere, digitale Zukunft:
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den  Führungskräften unserer Kunden und unseren interdisziplinären Teams entwickelst Du umfangreiche Technologiestrategien, entwirfst agile Zusammenarbeits- und Organisationsmodelle, analysierst Werthebel für ein digitales Transformationvorhaben oder identifizierst IT-Kostenoptimierungspotentiale, erstellst Integrations- und Carve-out-Strategien im Rahmen von M&A-Prozessen und planst den Aufbau und die Steuerung eines strategischen Transformations Offices.

- Bringe neue Ideen und neue Technologien zusammen:
Du berücksichtigst disruptive Trends wie Cloud, generative AI und IoT, um massgeschneiderte Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.

- Projekt- und Führungsverantwortung:
Du übernimmst mit deinem Erfahrungshintergrund schnell Projekt- und Führungsverantwortung und prägst die Zukunft unserer Kunden und Teams.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein IT-Universitätsabschluss, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Zusatzqualifikation wie einen MBA oder eine Promotion.

- Fundierte Berufserfahrung (mind. fünf Jahre) im strategischen IT-Management, CIO oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb eines Industrie- oder Beratungsunternehmens.

- Du verfügst über eine erfolgreiche Bilanz in der Projektakquise und baust neue Geschäftsbeziehungen eigenständig und mit hoher Motivation auf.

- Erfahrung in Projektleitung sowie fachlicher Teamführung und tiefes Know-how in Bereichen wie digitale und IT Strategie, Agile IT Operating Model, IT Wert- & Kostenoptimierung, strategisches Transformationsmanagement, Cloud-Technologien, Künstliche Intelligenz, IT-Security oder Tech M&A.

- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und überzeugst durch analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke sowie exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Was wir dir bieten
- Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert

- Umfangreiche Angebote für Fort- und Weiterbildung

- Persönliches Mentoring und Einarbeitung

- Arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst – an einem der Accenture-Standorte, remote oder beim Kunden vor Ort

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Grossartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Noch Fragen offen? Dann wende dich an unser Recruiting Team per E-Mail an  recruiting.ch@accenture.com .

jobs.title: Finance AI Data Strategy Manager
jobs.location: Dallas, 5205 N OConnor Las Colinas, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:

Our Finance AI and Data Strategy practitioners work to create and execute an organization’s business strategy for Finance AI and Data transformation including: defining a compelling industry & Finance function vision, creating value & ROI models, architecting a client’s Finance AI talent strategy, ecosystem partnership approaches, creating scalable operating capabilities, and envisioning best-in-class business/technology architecture & roadmaps. Use scaled agile disciplines to transform a client’s business and Finance function by sequencing the delivery of critical data elements, data products and feature functionality.

Why This Role:

This isn't a role where you maintain the status quo. You'll work at the cutting edge of Finance transformation — helping the world's largest organizations reimagine what's possible when AI and data are built into the core of how Finance operates. You'll shape strategy at the C-suite level, build lasting client relationships, and leave engagements knowing you moved something that mattered. If you want scope, influence, and the chance to define what AI-led Finance looks like for an entire industry, this is it.

Who You Are:

You're a seasoned strategist who lives at the intersection of AI, data, and business transformation. You've spent at least five years turning ambiguous enterprise problems into clear-eyed strategies — and then seeing those strategies through to impact. Consulting sharpened you: you know how to read an organization, earn trust fast, and deliver under pressure on a global stage.

What You'll Do:

Our Finance AI and Data Strategy practitioners build and execute transformational strategies for how organizations reinvent their Finance function through AI and data. You'll own the full arc — from vision to roadmap to delivery — working across some of the most complex Finance environments in the world.

- Shape the vision.  Define compelling Finance AI strategies that connect to real business outcomes — revenue upside, cost takeout, and competitive advantage.

- Earn the room.  Build trusted advisor relationships with CFOs and senior Finance leaders, becoming their go-to thought partner on AI and data transformation.

- Architect the path forward.  Design AI and data strategies that cover technology platforms, data foundations, operating models, and talent — not just the technology layer.

- Make the case.  Develop the business case, investment profile, and ROI models that turn a bold vision into a funded, sequenced roadmap.

- Assess and diagnose.  Evaluate an organization's AI and data maturity across strategy, talent, operating model, and data infrastructure — and know exactly what needs to change.

- Build for scale.  Use scaled agile disciplines to sequence delivery of critical data elements, data products, and feature functionality that compound over time.

- Embed Responsible AI.  Infuse ethical AI principles from the start — building client trust and making responsibility a competitive differentiator, not a compliance checkbox.

- Drive commercialization.  Identify and develop AI-first product strategies and ecosystem partnerships that open new revenue streams for clients.

Ability to travel up to 80%; travel as needed based on client expectations.

Here’s What You Need:
- 5+ years of deep fluency in AI & Data Strategy — from enterprise-wide data architecture to function-specific plays across Finance, HR, and Operations. You've shaped the thinking, not just executed it.
- 5+ years of focused Finance AI and Data work — you understand how CFO organizations operate, what keeps Finance leaders up at night, and how AI and data can change that calculus.
- 5+ years developing value cases and ROI models — you can translate a bold vision into a business case that gets funded and a roadmap that gets built.
- 5+ years of hands-on data management and analysis , paired with the strategic instinct to know which insights actually matter to the C-suite.
- 5+ years conducting client assessments and requirements gathering — you know the right questions to ask, and you listen for what's not being said.
- 2+ years applying Responsible AI principles in live engagements — you build trust into your work, not as an afterthought, but as a differentiator.
- 5+ years of leading workstreams end-to-end across complex, multi-stakeholder environments — you're the person others look to when deadlines matter and the pressure is real.
- 5+ years of large-scale global delivery — you've navigated time zones, cultures, and matrix organizations, and you know what it takes to keep distributed teams aligned.
- 5+ years working directly with corporate and/or business unit Finance processes, functions, and systems — you can speak the language fluently, not just translate it.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

WHAT SETS YOU APART
- You've led.  You build effective teams, foster inclusive environments, and are known for strong client relationships that outlast the engagement.
- You've originated.  You're entrepreneurial — you know how to spot an opportunity, shape a deal, and bring it across the finish line.
- You're a clear communicator.  Strong written and verbal communication; you can adapt your message for a CFO, a data engineer, and a board room in the same week.
- You keep learning.  You bring innovative thinking to every project and actively seek out new ideas, tools, and approaches.
- You have a Master's degree  in a relevant field

jobs.description:
About Accenture Song:
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology, and intelligence. Visit us at:  www.accenture.com/song .

Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced professional with deep growth strategy and front office transformation experience with focus within one or more of insurance, banking, wealth management, retail, consumer goods, hospitality, travel industry.
Key areas you focus on may include sales (advisor) effectiveness / enablement, go-to-market strategies, B2B / B2C direct to customer growth, channel strategy, lead management, and sales operating model design.  Additional experience across marketing and service strategy and other industries is a plus.
You are a problem solver with strong project delivery within industry or consulting experience who is comfortable working in fast-paced, agile environments. You have experience managing executive-level client relationships as a trusted advisor, facilitating workshops, developing business recommendations, and building business cases for new innovative solutions (e.g. AI / Gen-AI enabled capabilities). You know how to balance project delivery responsibilities of your team as well as managing project progress up to account leadership.

You also are:
•    Passionate about helping clients solve complex growth and customer experience challenges, as well as supporting them through strategic transformations.
•    Knowledgeable about the nuances of the one or more of the insurance, banking, wealth management, retail, consumer goods, travel industry broadly as well as front-line sales and commerce organizations and are ready to apply your knowledge to help clients optimize and transform their sales and service solutions.
•    Experienced with managing executive level client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor, while managing junior team members to deliver high-quality solutions.
•    Ready to dive deep into problem solving using creative and analytical thinking to transform challenges into opportunities.
•    Energized by working in an agile, fast-paced environment and are at your best when collaborating with a team.
•    Familiar with the selling processes and have pitched proposals and solutions to help solve client challenges.

As a Customer Strategy Manager, you will apply your expertise in sales & commerce to define and enable growth strategies and approaches to help clients achieve top line growth objectives with a focus on sales and channel / distribution. You will deliver on engagements in the following areas:

Thought Leadership
- Able to understand client needs, support the development of proposed solutions, and deliver high-impact projects by partnering with clients to help them support and transform their sales organizations and advance their position in the Financial Services market.
- Build client relationships to sustain Accenture’s profile as a long-term trusted advisor and partner.
- Manage and coach junior team members while continuing to grow your own expertise to help Accenture maintain its thought leadership position.

Delivery Execution
- Design and execute large scale and complex transformation programs and strategy engagements including current state assessments, target state design, and operating model transformations.
- Implement business changes that drive industry-specific, functional, and digital operating model transformation.
- Synthesize overall technology needs by analyzing a wide variety of solutions, selecting the most relevant tools & techniques to meet specific client requirements.

About the role:
We are seeking a Manager or to play a critical role within our growing R&D strategy team to focus on R&D reinvention across the value chain: helping clients move beyond incremental improvement to AI-enabled transformation of how they discover, develop, and deliver medicines.   This high-impact role sits at the intersection of biopharma R&D, digital innovation, and enterprise transformation — advising R&D leaders at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies.

You will own end-to-end strategy workstreams and engagements, engage with clients across R&D functions, support business development, and contribute to practice growth through thought leadership and capability building.

We Are:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at   www.accenture.com .

Accenture's Life Sciences R&D practice helps biopharma organizations transform discovery, early development, and development operations through scientific strategy, data and AI integration, and operational reinvention. We work with R&D leaders — Chief Scientific and Medical Officers, Heads of R&D Functions, SVP and VP-level capability owners — to shape R&D strategy, accelerate pipeline decisions, and build the capabilities needed to compete in the age of AI-driven drug discovery and development.

This is a growth-focused practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

You Are:
An R&D expert with proven work experience in the Life Sciences R&D industry. You are a strategic problem solver with extensive consulting and industry experience. You are a clear and effective communicator, and you have an open, relatable manner with clients and colleagues. You perform well in an agile, fast-paced working environment. You know how to balance being a leader with contributing to the collective efforts of the team. You have supported business development to provide transformative programs and targeted consulting engagements.

You have energy and drive in abundance, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. You have a flair for breaking down challenges and processes into logical parts and constructing crystal-clear reasoning and analyses—an aptitude you use to decimate problems.

The Work (Role Responsibility)
- Lead complex R&D strategy workstreams and small engagements from problem framing through delivery, ensuring measurable client impact.
- Advise clients on R&D transformation priorities including strategy, pipeline portfolio management, scientific data and AI integration, R&D operational excellence, R&D operating model, etc.
- Develop and present strategic recommendations, transformation roadmaps, and reinvention narratives to Heads of R&D functions, and other senior stakeholders.
- Serve as a guiding presence throughout the workstream lifecycle — shaping critical deliverables, driving quality assurance, and ensuring delivery excellence.
- Buildand grow client relationships across biopharma R&D functions.
- Partner with the broader Accenture team to bring the tailored expertise needed for an individual R&D engagement in support of our clients (e.g., Data & AI, Technology Strategy & Advisory, Talent & Organization)
- Support originate and shape new opportunities, support proposals and commercial pursuits, and contribute to Accenture's pipeline growth in the Life Sciences R&D space.
- Identify adjacent opportunities and expand existing client relationships across the R&D value chain.
- Contribute to thought leadership on R&D transformation and scientific innovation — supporting the development of assets that establish Accenture's differentiated perspective in the market.
- Support the build of reusable offerings, frameworks, and assets that accelerate future client engagements.
- Mentor and develop junior colleagues; actively contribute to performance management and recruiting.
- Partner with Accenture’s global industry leads, capability leads, and cross-functional teams to evolve the R&D Strategy practice and go-to-market strategy.

Here’s What You Need (Basic Qualifications)

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:
- Deep expertise in Life Sciences R&D with experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a leading biopharma company in an R&D strategy or transformation function.
- A proven track record leading strategy work with measurable outcomes for biopharma clients.
- Experience supporting the development of strategic recommendations and transformation roadmaps to C-suite, SVP, and VP-level R&D stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of how AI, data, digital technologies, and scientific informatics are reshaping biopharma R&D — and the ability to translate that understanding into client strategy.
- Demonstrated success in supporting business development: identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, and building client relationships.
- Experience teams and managing junior professionals.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

Bachelor's Degree

Bonus Points (Preferred Skills)
- MBA, advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD), or equivalent combination of education and experience in a relevant discipline.
- Experience building a new strategy offering, or capability from the ground up.
- Track record supporting the development of thought leadership — whitepapers, conference presentations, or published perspectives — in the life sciences or R&D space.
- Experience operating across multiple biopharma sub-sectors (large pharma, emerging biotech, CROs, or medtech) and geographies

A retail merchandising and planning professional who combines solid functional expertise with strong project leadership. jobs.description:
Role: Technology Strategy Manager
Location: London, Manchester, Edinburgh
Mobility : Up to 100%
Career Level: Manager (ML7)

Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture (ITSA)

About ITSA

Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture leads at the intersection of business and technology, driving maximum client value through the exploitation of AI, technology and data. We serve as the primary architect of our clients' industry-relevant technology estate, defining future-state visions, building the business case for change, and designing the enterprise architecture that turns ambition into an executable roadmap.
Our work spans four solution areas: Business Technology Strategy, Technology Visioning / Future Tech & Innovation, Enterprise & Technology AI & Data Strategy, and Industry Enterprise Architecture. Across all of them we deliver measurable outcomes: full traceability between business priorities and technology investment, stronger investment alignment and prioritization, reduced architectural complexity and duplication, and faster identification of AI, data and digital opportunities.

Your responsibilities

- Own workstreams and delivery within technology strategy engagements, shaping scope, mobilising teams, managing plans, risks, issues, client expectations and project commercials, and delivering to agreed time, budget and quality.

- Assess the current technology footprint and market to identify and prioritise value creation opportunities, including where emerging technologies such as agentic AI reshape workflows and competitive positioning.

- Define and co-create a compelling technology vision, shaping the role of data, AI, GenAI and agentic AI in business strategies.

- Design technology operating models and roadmaps that integrate AI capabilities and sequence investments across planning horizons.

- Build value and business cases aligned to client planning cycles, and pressure-test leadership assumptions, including AI-generated insights.

- Facilitate and drive consensus for action across business and technology stakeholders.

- Ensure traceability between business priorities, technology investments and roadmaps.

- Help shape enterprise AI and data strategies, including roadmaps for scaling enterprise AI and foundation data.

- Build and sustain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, contribute relevant points of view, and identify opportunities to extend or create new work.

- Support senior leadership in sales and origination by identifying and qualifying opportunities, shaping proposals and statements of work, and matching client needs to relevant Accenture offerings.

- Lead medium-to-large teams or work efforts, setting clear objectives and standards, coordinating and delegating work, and building an effective, positive team environment.

- Coach, mentor and develop team members through regular feedback and formal performance responsibilities, addressing development needs and contributing to hiring, staffing and resourcing decisions.

- Own the quality of documents, presentations, analyses and other deliverables produced by the team, ensuring they are rigorous, coherent and ready to be presented to C-suite and executive-level audiences.

- Contribute to the growth and effective operation of the Accenture practice and ITSA by leading capability-building and community initiatives, supporting recruitment, sharing knowledge, developing reusable assets and thought leadership, and meeting internal business obligations.

We are looking for the following skills and experience:

Core capabilities
- High-level thinking: pursue innovative approaches, synthesise complex information to surface trends and root causes, and stay effective amid ambiguity while keeping the bigger picture and client value in view.

- Execution: plan and prioritise to high standards, apply structured processes and quality reviews, and manage scope, cost and risk while working ethically and protecting data.

- Collaboration: build trusted, inclusive relationships and share knowledge across teams and clients, drawing on diverse perspectives to reach aligned outcomes.

- Communication: make complex ideas clear and audience-appropriate, surface risks constructively, and develop and deliver a compelling vision of the value created.

- Learning and development: model continuous learning and curiosity, coach and develop others through honest feedback, and evaluate outcomes to drive improvement.

Technology strategy skills
- Deep expertise across business technology strategy, IT strategy, and roadmap and business-case definition.

- Strong command of AI, data and emerging technology and how they generate business value.

- Deep capability in technology strategy, business model strategy, technology assessment, competitor analysis, market intelligence, partner ecosystem strategy and application strategy.

- A track record of linking technology investment to measurable business outcomes and reduced duplication.

Set yourself apart
We're very interested in hearing from you if you have some or all of the following.
- A track record of designing and running enterprise technology strategy programmes.

- Strong understanding of industry operations, dynamics and trends, developed through experience in one or more sectors such as financial services, telecommunications, technology, resources and utilities, retail or consumer goods.

- Expert knowledge of technology trends and concepts, with a keen interest in innovations such as digital customer and commerce, connected platforms, digital enterprise and data-driven business models.

- Strong C-suite presence, stakeholder management skills and a proven track record of developing client relationships.

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

jobs.description:
Technology Strategy Manager / Senior Manager - Financial Services Industry

We Are:
Technology Strategy, and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry and utilize technology to capture market share.

Technology strategy leverages deep business expertise combined with technology know-how, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that unlock value and drive growth. We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help our clients disrupt their markets through creating strategies that capabilities in operating model, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, rethinking business models for growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:
An expert at advising Financial Services clients on technology strategies to achieve their vision and operational goals. You have an abundance of energy and drive, resilience, and a passion for collaborating with senior executives. You love continual learning and are intrigued by new challenges. You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:
- Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business​.

- Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise​.

- Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

- Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

- Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

- Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

- Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

- Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

- Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

- Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:
- Lead team, project, and program as well as corresponding deliverables​ while supervising and mentoring full teams.

- Build strong relationships with senior clients that go beyond the workplace, including beginning to develop C-suite relationships; drive a spirit of collaboration and teaming with client while serving as a true trusted advisor

- Drive thought leadership, asset development, and intellectual capital efforts with targeted input from more senior resources; identify and advance ideas for new opportunities

- Support Business Development, building understanding of how to architect and position proposals and SOWs

- Facilitate to drive results and gain consensus for action; able to address difficult client conversations and engage senior client stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes

- Travel as needed

Here’s What You Need:

- Minimum 1 year of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm
- Minimum 5 years of proven experience in at least one of the following: operating model strategy, M&A, tech value and cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.
- Minimum 5 years of experience writing business cases.

- Bachelor’s degree

- Minimum 6 years of experience writing business cases.
- Minimum 5 years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.
- Bachelor’s degree

- Comfortable using AI tools for research, synthesis, and analysis.
- Ability to evaluate AI outputs critically.
- Understanding of data limitations, bias, and model risk
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- You have shown critical thinking, ability to question decisions and provide creative solutions.
- You can manage junior members of the team and can develop them for more responsibility.
- You have effective communication and people skills to manage relationships with clients.
- You have strong presentation skills: ability to synthesize information and the ability to bring a message forward.
- You lead in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools, demonstrated advanced research skills.
- You can develop practical roadmaps that support the enabling of technology transformation.
- You can manage a variety of projects with increased complexity.
- You have developed project management abilities and have reported and escalated on time to managerial level.

jobs.title: Strategy Manager for our Finance Reinvention Partner
jobs.description:
Are you a true team player who wants to be part of an organization that strives to make a difference by innovating with a purpose? Are you highly motivated to shape the AI-driven future of finance for the Nordic banking,   insurance   and pension industry together with our clients?

Accenture’s Finance Reinvention Partner would like to hear from you!

As part of   Accenture’s   Finance Reinvention Partner   team   you will help Financial Services organizations – banks,   insurers   and pension providers – unlock their potential and make Reinvention part of your career. The world of Financial Services finance is being   redrawn:   AI and agentic automation are turning the finance function from a scorekeeper into the architect of enterprise value, while a relentless wave of regulation and reporting change keeps complexity high. CFOs in banking, insurance and pensions are responding by breaking down data silos, automating the core, and shifting talent from historical reporting to forward-looking, predictive insight.

We are looking for a   Manager   or Senior Manager   for our   Finance Reinvention Partner   team in Stockholm   and Helsinki , with a dedicated focus on Financial Services clients across banking,   insurance   and pensions.

To succeed in the role you are a driven, ambitious, and proactive leader who enjoys drawing and explaining the bigger picture, while still having a practical, hands-on approach and deep finance   expertise . You will own client relationships at CFO and Controller level, drive business development and   originate   new opportunities, and ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction. As a   Manager   or Senior   Manager   you will also help shape our Financial Services finance proposition, coach and develop junior colleagues, and help grow the practice.

What   you   will   do

- Finance operating model and shared service / GBS design for banks,   insurers   and pension providers – moving finance from scorekeeper to strategic value architect

- Finance platform and data transformation ( e.g.   SAP, Oracle, Workday, OneStream, Anaplan) to build an AI-ready digital core and   modernise   fragmented FS finance and risk data landscapes

- Regulatory, controls and reporting transformation across FS-specific frameworks (IFRS 17, IFRS 9, Solvency II, Basel/CRR, DORA, the EU AI Act) and faster, more reliable financial,   actuarial   and regulatory close

- Reinvention of core finance operations through AI, GenAI and agentic automation – designing autonomous, audit-compliant processes and Human + Machine finance teams

- Connected planning, forecasting and enterprise performance management – replacing static budgets with scenario modelling, predictive   insight   and decision intelligence for FS clients

- Enterprise value creation and resilience – capital allocation, balance sheet and liquidity   optimization, treasury, and post-M&A finance integration in banking,   insurance   and pensions

- Strategic cost reduction and operational efficiency, combined with originating and leading business development and proposals across our Financial Services accounts

- A   Master’s   degree in a relevant field,   e.g.   Accounting, Finance, Economics, Actuarial Science, Engineering or Business, with strong academic performance

- 5 + years (Manager) or   8 + years (Senior Manager) of strategy, management consulting and/or industry experience related to the CFO Agenda – e.g. finance transformation, finance operating model, enterprise performance management, finance platform and data transformation – ideally within or serving Financial Services (banking, insurance and/or pensions).

- A background from Big Four or a comparable strategy / management consultancy is a strong advantage, particularly within a finance,   risk   or Financial Services practice

- Understanding of Financial Services finance and the regulatory and reporting landscape that shapes it – for example IFRS 17, IFRS 9, Solvency II, Basel/CRR, DORA or the EU AI Act – and how AI and data are reshaping the finance function

- A proven   track record   of leading teams and workstreams, managing senior client stakeholders, and contributing to business development,   sales   and proposals (with greater ownership expected at Senior Manager level)

- Experience from diverse projects and teams

- Fluent in English (incl. experience with written and oral presentations in English) and Swedish, conducting interviews and workshops facilitation

What´s in it for you

- Truly competitive salary terms, bonus schemes, pension, health insurance, employee stock purchase   program   etc.

- Work-life balance is important to us. Volunteer roles and events through our internal networks

- Access to several social activities through active corporate sports community

- Monthly community meetings with a focus on personal and professional development

- A variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you   acquire   and build specialized skills faster

The position will report to the Finance Reinvention Partner   FS   Lead   and the workplace is Stockholm   and/or Helsinki . Some travel should be expected.

Interested ?

Apply online by attaching your CV, application   letter   and educational diplomas as soon as possible.  We look forward to receiving your application.   Due to the summer holiday season, our response time might be a bit longer than usual. Please note that we will review your application in August and get back to you shortly after.

About the Finance Reinvention Partner team in Accenture

As the Finance Reinvention Partner for the CFO, we help Financial Services   organizations   reinvent finance with AI at the core. We provide end-to-end services – from strategy through to delivery and managed operations – that address the unique challenges faced by Finance executives in banking, insurance and pensions, helping them lead a more efficient, resilient and value-creating Finance function powered by data, automation and a strong ecosystem of technology partners.

Our work is   organized   around four AI-powered Finance Reinvention offerings, which we are looking to strengthen for our Financial Services clients:

Value Creation & Resilience   – Position the CFO as the architect of enterprise value – improving ROE and capital efficiency,   optimizing   the balance sheet and liquidity, and accelerating value capture in M&A and divestitures, with treasury,   tax   and ESG under one accountable model.

Reinvented Finance Core   – Rebuild the core of finance on AI – record-to-insight, regulatory, controls & compliance, source-to-pay and order-to-cash – for   a faster   close, smarter controls, lower   cost   and proactively mitigated risk.

Planning & Performance Analysis   – Turn financial data into forward-looking conviction through connected planning, AI-driven forecasting, scenario   modelling   and decision intelligence that   helps   Financial Services leaders navigate volatility and move boldly.

Finance Platform Transformation   – Build the AI-native, regulatory-ready technology and data foundation –   modernizing   ERP, finance   applications   and connected data – so every finance capability compounds in value over time.

jobs.title: Strategy Manager for Technology & AI-Native Companies
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
TLDR: You would advise the world's most important technology and AI companies on their most transformational questions. You would be joining a team / community where you can build a career as a true industry strategist and make a lasting impact on yourself & the market.

We Are:
Technology companies - Software, AI, Advertising Platforms, Dual-Sided Marketplaces, and Hyperscalers - are rewriting every industry, and we advise the companies doing the rewriting & have an inside look every day in this massive transformation. We are the industry strategists and advisors supporting the world's most consequential technology companies: hyperscalers building the infrastructure that powers the global economy, software platforms reinventing how they grow and compete, and AI-native companies building an entirely new category.

We work on the problems that don't have answers yet. How do you monetize an AI-native product at scale? How do you build and operate data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand? How do you transform a $50B enterprise without losing the speed that made it great? Our work generally focuses on four domains:
- Product & Go to Market | inclusive of building, launching, and scaling products; driving forward deployed engagements to infuse the customer in the product; reinventing product lifecycles to accelerate growth; improving monetization; and driving more profitable innovation

- Platform Services | shifting platforms from manual operations to Data & AI-powered services that maximize trust, growth, and efficiency at billion-user scale

- AI Compute Capabilities | inclusive of helping companies design, build, and operate AI infrastructure efficiently; improving data center delivery, utilization, and ROI across the full lifecycle while concurrently identifying cost takeout opportunities across the business

- Transformation + Value | inclusive of driving reinvention for companies and the industry — transforming companies end-to-end across their mega-processes; leading the value/ROI identification for AI; and orchestrating the industry focus around customer zero

You Are:
A strategy advisor with professional experience working in the tech industry (Software, Hyperscalers, and AI-native companies). You are passionate about the industry and excited to tackle new problems without a playbook each day. You are energized by working in fast-moving, complex environment that is changing constantly. You are easily able to harness that complexity and define actionable strategies that your clients can execute at scale. You keep up with the market trends but also actively shape how your clients stay ahead. You thrive in ambiguity, support + grow the teams around you, and build the kind of trusted client relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.

The Work:
- Define strategies and roadmaps that help technology companies stay ahead; spanning product strategy, AI adoption, data center strategy and implementation, total cost of ownership for AI, and go-to-market planning.

- Shape the strategic choices defining the next generation of technology companies; where to play, how to win, how AI changes the business, and what capabilities and operating model are required to lead.

- Conduct market analysis and competitive research to identify where the industry is moving, where clients have exposure, and where the real opportunities are; then turn that into a clear point of view.

- Size markets, model financial scenarios, and build the business cases that support major client decisions; from new product investments to large-scale infrastructure builds to operating model changes.

- Identify cost reduction and efficiency opportunities across the business including AI-related spend, infrastructure utilization, and operational overhead.

- Build the analytical foundation for client decisions; synthesizing market dynamics, competitive signals, financial data, and operational inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Develop client-ready materials that communicate complex ideas simply and drive decisions at the executive level.

- Structure and lead workstreams from start to finish; framing the problem, designing the approach, managing the analysis, and delivering work that is ready for the client without a second pass.

- Own quality across everything the team produces. Coherence, rigor, and client-readiness are the standard.

- Support business development; contributing to proposals, shaping the point of view on new opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships.

- Lead the client relationship day-to-day; managing communication, setting expectations, and building trust over time.

- Keep internal delivery on track; coordinating across workstreams and making sure the right people are focused on the right things.

- Develop junior team members; give honest feedback, create real ownership opportunities, and invest in their growth.

- Travel: Average 40 to 50% (up to 80% as needed).

Here's What You Need:
- A bachelor's degree.
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the tech industry or consulting.

Bonus Points If:
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
- A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
- Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems.
- Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
- Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
Meet our Technology Strategy and Transformation Team

Our Technology Strategy and Transformation services help organizations reinvent how technology enables business value. We define resilient, industry-specific   technology and digital strategie s, AI-powered transformation agendas and create future-ready digital foundations.

Working directly with senior client stakeholders, we solve complex, often ambiguous business and technology challenges across industries. No two clients are the same, so we combine structured thinking, flexibility, and creativity to shape future-ready strategies, define actionable roadmaps, and unlock growth, resilience, and measurable business value at scale.

We deliver consulting assignments across industries and geographies. We work with some of the   biggest organizations worldwide ,   your impact will be   truly   global   and you will collaborate with experts in the industry.

Join Accenture and help leading organizations shape and execute enterprise-wide   technology strategies and digital agendas   that turn IT investment and organizational change into measurable business value. We work at the intersection of business, technology and innovation, helping organizations reinvent how they operate and compete. Our teams advise   C-suite executives   ( CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and CAIOs )   on how to set a winning tech agenda, design future-ready operating models, and build the capabilities to execute transformation at scale. You will be part of a global community of strategists, working with international experts and top-tier clients across industries, shaping the future of technology-powered organizations.

YOUR IMPACT:

Leadership & Client Engagement

- Lead and manage project teams  on client engagements.

- Act as a  trusted advisor  to senior executives, shaping strategic decisions at   C-suite and senior leadership level .

- Own end-to-end client relationships , accountable for     d elivery quality, and outcomes across multi-stream engagements.

Digital Strategy & Vision

- Capture and articulate the   digital strategy and vision   – connecting business ambition, market opportunities, customer needs and technology trends into a clear,   AI-ready transformation agenda , and helping clients   make confident strategic choices   on the path forward.

- Shape the   digital product   and   service portfolio   – defining value propositions and mapping   end-to-end customer and employee journeys   to identify where digital products and   experiences   can create the most value.

- Define the   technology core   that makes it happen – translating the digital strategy into the underlying technology direction, enterprise architecture,   AI and platform choices   needed to deliver it at scale.

- Translate strategy into   product visions   and   prioritized roadmaps   – functional requirements,   experience principles   and phased plans aligned with the broader   transformation objectives .

- Build the   business case   and   validate strategic hypotheses   – defining   success measures ,   ROI logic   and   executive narratives   that   align stakeholders   and accelerate investment decisions.

Operating Model ,   Organization & Governance

Define future-ready   operating models   spanning organizational design, sourcing strategies, tech and digital service delivery and ways of working.

- Design and implement   organizational structures that reflect new ways of   working   –   including roles, processes and capabilities   –   to support large-scale transformation.

- Design   governance frameworks and models   – covering risk management, regulatory compliance, decision rights, and portfolio oversight.

Enterprise Architecture

- Translate business strategy into   enterprise architecture blueprints   –   mapping business capabilities, applications, data, and infrastructure into a coherent end-to-end technology landscape.

- Assess architectural maturity and define   target-state architectures   that enable scalability, interoperability, and   AI-readiness .

- Bring structure to architecture assessments and investment decisions using   established EA frameworks   such as   TOGAF .

Transformation, Culture & Value

- Embed an   AI-first mindset   across the organization, supporting leadership engagement, behavioral change and the   cultural shift toward AI-ready , future-ready decision-making.

- Build   business cases, investment roadmaps and transformation plans   for strategic tech initiatives.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED :

- Higher degree   (preferred in IT, Computer Science, Business, Management, or related field with excellent academic performance).

- Minimum 5 years of experience   in strategy consulting, IT advisory, or related roles.

- Proven ability to   own key client relationships   -   acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders ( C- level), driving agenda independently and building long-term client partnerships.

- Proven track record of   delivering client engagements with full ownership   - leading stakeholder relationship s , managing project teams, coaching junior consultants and ensuring high-quality delivery.

- Ability to define   future state visions and strategic roadmaps   that translate business ambition into technology direction and investment decisions.

- Strategic technology fluency   –   no deep technical expertise required, but a confident command across   at least one of the followin g:

- Digital product and experience strategy (product portfolios, value propositions, customer and employee journeys, product roadmaps and prototyping) using tools such as Figma, Miro and Jira/Azure DevOps

- Business-technology strategy and enterprise architecture (understanding of how architectural choices drive business outcomes, supported by knowledge of related frameworks e.g. TOGAF),

- AI and emerging technology landscape (agentic AI, Digital Core, platform models, AI-ready digital foundations),

- Cloud and platform strategy (e.g. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) from a strategic/business perspective,

- Technology operating models, governance and IT economics (FinOps, tech value realization, ITOM),

- Tech investment prioritization, business case development and portfolio management (TCO, ROI analysis)

- Strong  analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

- Ability to craft   executive-level narratives   on complex technology topics - turning ambiguity into clear strategic direction for CIO, CTO, CDO and CAIO audiences.

- Excellent communication skills in  English.  Additional foreign language (e.g. German, French, Arabic) is a strong asset.

- Collaborative working style and comfort operating in  fast-evolving environments .

- Growth mindset, curiosity and strong motivation to solve client challenges.
