jobs.title: Technology Strategy Manager/Sr Manager, Resources (Energy, Utilities)
jobs.description:
Technology Strategy Manager / Senior Manager - Resources Industry (Utilities or Energy)

We Are:
Technology Strategy, and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry and utilize technology to capture market share.

Technology strategy leverages deep business expertise combined with technology know-how, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that unlock value and drive growth. We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help our clients disrupt their markets through creating strategies that capabilities in operating model, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, rethinking business models for growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:
An expert at advising clients in the Resources industry on technology strategies to achieve their vision and operational goals. You have an abundance of energy and drive, resilience, and a passion for collaborating with senior executives. You love continual learning and are intrigued by new challenges. You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:
- Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business​.

- Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise​.

- Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

- Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

- Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

- Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

- Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

- Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

- Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

- Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:
- Lead team, project, and program as well as corresponding deliverables​ while supervising and mentoring full teams.

- Build strong relationships with senior clients that go beyond the workplace, including beginning to develop C-suite relationships; drive a spirit of collaboration and teaming with client while serving as a true trusted advisor

- Drive thought leadership, asset development, and intellectual capital efforts with targeted input from more senior resources; identify and advance ideas for new opportunities

- Support Business Development, building understanding of how to architect and position proposals and SOWs

- Facilitate to drive results and gain consensus for action; able to address difficult client conversations and engage senior client stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes

- Travel as needed

Here’s What You Need:

As a Manager:
- Minimum 1 year of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm
- Minimum 5 years of proven experience in at least one of the following: operating model strategy, M&A, tech value and cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.
- Minimum 5 years of experience writing business cases.
- Minimum 2 years of experience leading or managing small teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.
- Bachelor’s degree

As a Senior Manager:
- Minimum 3 years of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm
- Minimum 6 years of experience in at least two of the following: operating model strategy, technology in M&A, tech value cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.
- Minimum 6 years of experience writing business cases.
- Minimum 5 years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.
- Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points if:
- Comfortable using AI tools for research, synthesis, and analysis.
- Ability to evaluate AI outputs critically.
- Understanding of data limitations, bias, and model risk
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- You have shown critical thinking, ability to question decisions and provide creative solutions.
- You can manage junior members of the team and can develop them for more responsibility.
- You have effective communication and people skills to manage relationships with clients.
- You have strong presentation skills: ability to synthesize information and the ability to bring a message forward.
- You lead in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools, demonstrated advanced research skills.
- You can develop practical roadmaps that support the enabling of technology transformation.
- You can manage a variety of projects with increased complexity.
- You have developed project management abilities and have reported and escalated on time to managerial level.

jobs.description:

About the role:
The Value Architect is the analytical engine of the Reinvention Force. This role builds and owns the financial models, value cases, and AI impact quantification that underpin every transformation engagement.  Value Architects are embedded in each engagement — focused on identifying and sizing value opportunities and tracking and reporting value realization. Together they ensure every reinvention decision is grounded in data and every milestone connects back to measurable business impact.

The work:
- Define value KPIs for each transformation program and ensure teams apply business process standards from the Process Blueprint Lead
- Build the value identification framework mapping each reinvention initiative to specific, quantified business outcomes (FTE capacity, cost, revenue, cycle time)
- Develop and maintain financial models covering investment, value, timeline, and risk — keeping them current as engagements evolve
- Produce value realization reports tracking actual outcomes against the business case and surfacing early signals of delivery success or risk
- Support preparation of C-suite and Board-level materials translating quantitative analysis into clear executive narrative
- Apply the Wharton economic value model and Accenture's Reinvention Roadmap to size opportunity across speed to market, capacity, decision quality, and experience dimensions

jobs.title: Innovation Lead – Business, Product & Commercial Strategy (Manager Level)
jobs.description:
The Dock is Accenture’s flagship R&D and Global Innovation Center, based in Dublin’s Grand Canal Dock. As an incubation hub for the next generation of AI and GenAI agentic solutions, The Dock brings together a global community of business strategists, designers, engineers, data scientists, and entrepreneurs.
Our mission is to solve some of the world’s hardest problems and create transformational products and services that help industries thrive in the face of unprecedented change. From shaping the future of work with intelligent systems to building breakthrough digital platforms, our team operates across the entire innovation spectrum, from exploration to real-world deployment. At The Dock, we experiment boldly, collaborate openly, and build the future in real time.

We are looking for an Innovation Lead – Business, Product & Commercial Strategy (Manager Level) to join the Business, Product & Commercial Strategy team.

Why This Role
Enterprise AI is moving from experimentation to execution — and the organisations that succeed will not be the ones with the best models. They will be the ones with the strongest leadership, governance, and organisational adaptation. That gap between AI capability and enterprise reality is where this role operates.
This is a rare opportunity to build expertise at the intersection of enterprise transformation, emerging AI technologies, and commercial strategy — during one of the largest platform shifts in decades. You will work on frontier AI challenges before they become mainstream, alongside the ecosystem partners shaping those capabilities, and with the enterprise clients who must operationalise them at scale.

We are not looking for someone who has already done all of this. We are looking for someone who is ready to. The right candidate will have strong foundations — in strategy, commercial thinking, or complex delivery — and the instinct, curiosity, and drive to apply them in genuinely new territory. In return, this role builds a profile that is difficult to develop anywhere else: AI commercialisation, enterprise transformation leadership, and ecosystem influence, gained in an environment where the work is real and the stakes are high.

The Role:
The Innovation Lead – Business, Product & Commercial Strategy (Manager Level) provides strategic delivery leadership across AI-enabled innovation and strategy engagements.

You will develop relationships, scope, own and steer complex projects while developing the capability of your team and acting as a credible, trusted voice with senior client stakeholders, account teams, and ecosystem partners.

Your work will span shaping AI-enabled business strategy across large-scale enterprise programmes and clients, collaborating with frontier AI ecosystem partners, and identifying how advanced AI technologies — including agentic AI systems — can reshape and redefine the future of our clients’ businesses. You will work closely with senior client stakeholders,  account leadership and industry partners to understand the disruption to their businesses, and help them to define the strategic pivots that follow.

What You Will Do:
- Lead and own innovation and strategy projects and programs — from initial scoping through incubation, transition, and launch — with accountability for quality and outcomes.

- Work closely with senior client stakeholders, account leadership and industry partners to understand, scope and ideate on profitable, industry-aligned business changes that help clients grow and thrive in the changing technical and economic environment.

- Shape and communicate commercially viable AI strategies — accelerating enterprise modernisation, identifying new growth opportunities, and translating emerging technology into actionable client propositions.

- Develop business cases, commercial models, and go-to-market strategies grounded in evidence, delivery reality, and a clear-eyed view of market economics.

- Collaborate with frontier AI ecosystem partners to understand where capability is heading and bring those insights into client strategy and project direction.

- Guide and coach your team to self-organise, make informed decisions, and deliver strong outcomes; create the conditions for high performance and remove the barriers in the way.

- Build and manage relationships with senior client stakeholders, CAL teams, and ecosystem partners; contribute actively to sales conversations, RFPs, and commercial discussions.

Experience You Will Build:
This role provides direct exposure to frontier AI developments, complex enterprise transformation programmes, and the evolving economics of AI-driven business.

For the right person, it is a path to a profile that is genuinely difficult to build elsewhere. Over time, you will develop expertise across:
- AI commercialisation and go-to-market strategy

- Enterprise transformation leadership at scale

- Ecosystem and strategic partnership management

- Innovation portfolio development and stage-gate governance

- AI operating model design and organisational adaptation

- Executive stakeholder engagement

- Business model transformation in response to AI-driven market disruption

- Strategic identification of new revenue opportunities in fast-changing environments

What We Are Looking For:
Background is less important than mindset. We are open to candidates from consulting, industry, or commercial strategy roles. What matters is how you think and how you work.

You are likely to demonstrate most of the following:
- Strong strategic and commercial thinking — you can structure ambiguous problems, identify what matters, and build a credible case for a course of action.

- Commercial instinct and an ability to translate ideas into propositions with real market logic — who pays, why, and at what value.

- Genuine curiosity about AI and its enterprise implications — not just awareness, but active engagement with what is changing and what it means for how organisations operate and compete.

- Credibility and presence with senior stakeholders — you can hold a room, ask the hard question, and be trusted with complex, high-visibility work.

- Experience shaping and facilitating stakeholder-led discovery — you know how to engage senior leaders, frame the right questions, challenge assumptions and surface insights that inform strategic direction.

- Leadership instinct — you develop others naturally, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and take accountability for outcomes rather than just activities.

- Comfort with ambiguity — you do not need a fully formed brief to get started, and you bring structure rather than waiting for it.

- A well-developed perspective on AI-driven industry disruption — grounded in commercial realities, business strategy, and a practical understanding of the technologies shaping the market.

- Ability to frame and answer complex strategic questions — you can identify emerging signals, develop hypotheses, and help senior leaders understand how technological disruption may reshape their industry, business model, and competitive position.

We are looking for someone with the curiosity of a researcher, the commercial instincts of a strategist, and the confidence to engage senior leaders on some of the most important questions facing their industry. You do not need all the answers, but you should be excited by the challenge of helping organisations find them.

Extras We’d Love to See:
- Exposure to AI-enabled transformation — whether shaping strategy, defining operating models, or contributing to delivery.

- Delivery experience in complex, matrixed environments — you have managed workstreams, navigated competing priorities, and brought people with you.

- Familiarity with ecosystem-based business models, platform strategy, or partnership-driven value creation .

- An MBA or equivalent advanced degree in a related field.

- Contribution to thought leadership, community engagement, or industry-facing initiatives.

You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:
- Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business​.

- Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise​.

- Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

- Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

- Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

- Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

- Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

- Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

- Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

- Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:
- Lead team, project, and program as well as corresponding deliverables​ while supervising and mentoring full teams.

- Build strong relationships with senior clients that go beyond the workplace, including beginning to develop C-suite relationships; drive a spirit of collaboration and teaming with client while serving as a true trusted advisor

- Drive thought leadership, asset development, and intellectual capital efforts with targeted input from more senior resources; identify and advance ideas for new opportunities

- Support Business Development, building understanding of how to architect and position proposals and SOWs

- Facilitate to drive results and gain consensus for action; able to address difficult client conversations and engage senior client stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes

- Travel as needed

Here’s What You Need:

As a Manager:
- Minimum 1 year of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm
- Minimum 5 years of proven experience in at least one of the following: operating model strategy, M&A, tech value and cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.
- Minimum 5 years of experience writing business cases.
- Minimum 2 years of experience leading or managing small teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.
- Bachelor’s degree

As a Senior Manager:
- Minimum 3 years of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm
- Minimum 6 years of experience in at least two of the following: operating model strategy, technology in M&A, tech value cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.
- Minimum 6 years of experience writing business cases.
- Minimum 5 years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.
- Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points if:
- You have experience in the Software & Platforms or Communications & Media industry
- You are comfortable using AI tools for research, synthesis, and analysis.
- You have the ability to evaluate AI outputs critically.
- You have an understanding of data limitations, bias, and model risk
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- You have shown critical thinking, ability to question decisions and provide creative solutions.
- You can manage junior members of the team and can develop them for more responsibility.
- You have effective communication and people skills to manage relationships with clients.
- You have strong presentation skills: ability to synthesize information and the ability to bring a message forward.
- You lead in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools, demonstrated advanced research skills.
- You can develop practical roadmaps that support the enabling of technology transformation.
- You can manage a variety of projects with increased complexity.
- You have developed project management abilities and have reported and escalated on time to managerial level.

jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture Strategy — where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We sit at the intersection of business strategy and technological transformation, helping the world's most ambitious companies not just adapt to change, but define it. In an era where AI is rewriting every industry playbook, we equip C-suite leaders with the clarity, confidence, and competitive edge to move fast and win. We don't just advise — we co-create the future alongside our clients, embedding AI-driven insights into the strategies that shape markets, disrupt incumbents, and unlock new growth engines. If you want to work where strategy is anything but theoretical, you're in the right place.

You Are:
A Strategy expert with deep professional experience working across the High Tech industry — and a genuine obsession with what AI makes possible. You see around corners. You translate complex, fast-moving dynamics into sharp, actionable strategies that clients can execute at scale. You are not just keeping up with the AI revolution — you are actively shaping how your clients lead it. You thrive in ambiguity, energize the teams around you, and build the kind of trusted client relationship that last well beyond a single engagement. Whether advising a semiconductor leader on manufacturing, capacity, and ecosystem strategy, optimizing global supply‑chain resilience and cost structures, or helping downstream technology providers align product and go‑to‑market decisions with operational realities, you bring you bring the intellectual rigor, creative instinct, and human connection to make it real.

The Work:
- Leverage deep industry knowledge across enterprise HW, SW, consumer HW, semi-conductor, data center or network sectors to support clients in analyzing their growth and profitability strategies, E2E process transformation and optimization in sales, service, marketing, or enabling functions, define enterprise-wide cost take-out initiatives, define new business models and revenue streams.

- Lead engagements to help High Tech, semi, and data center companies deploy innovative operating models including product-led growth frameworks and AI-first development methodologies to deliver year-over-year performance improvement.

- Leverage core consulting skills and High-Tech industry expertise to structure complex challenges around strategic c-suite priorities; develop hypotheses and business cases to unlock value.

- Develop deep client relationships that are long lasting and result in strategic advisory insights and projects, manage client expectations and project scope and manage all stakeholders and client satisfaction for engagements.

- Lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams spanning product, technology, and strategy — mentoring future leaders, shaping culture, and cementing Accenture's reputation as the definitive thought leader in High Tech.

- Act as the single point of ownership for major engagements — responsible not just for delivery, but for making the work successful analytically, commercially, and relationally.

- Set the overall narrative, rewrite or reshape stories for executives, and ensure consistency across workstreams.

- Quickly grasp commercial excellence concepts and have familiarity with the sales cycle.

- Travel as needed, up to 80%.

Here's What You Need:
- A Bachelor's degree.
- Minimum of 8 years of professional experience consulting for or working at a High Tech company, or a start-up.

Bonus Points If:
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
- A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
- Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems — for clients or within your own organization.
- Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
- Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Leadership & Culture Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Role: Leadership & Culture Strategy Senior Manager
Career Level: Senior Manager
Location: London
Travel Requirement: Flexibility to travel approximately 30-35% of the time, depending on client needs. Travel predominantly within UK, Europe & Middle East.
Languages: Fluent in English. Other European languages beneficial.

Job Description:
Accenture’s purpose is to help our clients Deliver on the Promise of Technology and Human Ingenuity and within this sits Leadership & Culture (part of our Talent and Organisation Practice). We partner with clients in the intentional design of workplaces where effective leaders, dynamic teams, and workplace culture ensures that organisations thrive and achieve their business strategies.
About The Leadership & Culture Practice:
We are a global team that thrives on connection, collaboration, and tackling complex client challenges. We care deeply about having impact at the individual, team, and organisational level. We are committed to excellence, consistently delivering the highest quality results for our clients. Our team is a mix of curious and diverse individuals with varied professional backgrounds in psychology, organisational behaviour, management, adult learning, and related fields.
Desired Senior Manager candidate:
- Able to deliver leadership & culture services at all levels within an organisation, from emerging leaders to C-Suite/Board.
- Deeply committed to improving business outcomes for our clients through leveraging a broad set of solutions, from Leadership & Culture and wider Accenture.
- Self-motivated, personable, and highly commercial with significant experience in our the field, looking to join a high-growth, dynamic, and entrepreneurial culture.
- Adept at navigating complex, global, matrixed organisations to drive client solutions.
- Insightful, collaborative, and flexible, comfortable with ambiguity and continuous learning.
- Accomplished at developing large-scale business solutions and driving transformational growth with new and existing clients.
- Skilled at selling leadership & culture solutions through brilliant exceptional client service, and building, nurturing and sustaining long-term client relationships.

Responsibilities of a Senior Manager:
- Design & delivery: Design, deliver, and implement impactful, consulting programmes within large-scale transformation programmes. Create solutions that will likely incorporate Leadership Strategy, Leadership Development, Talent Management, Culture Change, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Executive Assessment, Advisory Coaching, Team Development, Board Effectiveness, and CEO Succession Planning.
- Client management: Manage a portfolio of clients with a focus on embedding solutions that will bring benefits for the client, as well as serve in the interest of the practice.
- Business development: Develop and maintain a high-calibre network of senior-level contacts to create business opportunities, leading large-scale RFPs, including integrated deals within Accenture. Proactively originating new opportunities to sell work and expand the L&C footprint within Accenture.
- Commercial Acumen: Highly commercial individual, with experience managing project profitability.
- One Accenture: Build deep relationships with internal Accenture stakeholders. Work across diverse functions and geographies. Demonstrate credibility within the wider Accenture ecosystem and credibly talk to the wider range of Accenture offerings (beyond L&C), co-creating solutions that incorporate Leadership & Culture offerings into large-scale transformational deals.
- Leadership: Manage and coordinate client teams, serve as a role model within the practice, and lead others through change.
- Empowering leaders to deliver business value by leading in new ways, building resilient organisations that thrive in complexity, and drive transformative, human centred change?

Experience & Skills Required:
- Significant client management and business development experience.
- Experience working with senior leaders and supporting top teams in major industries.
- Broad, deep consulting experience, ideally in a Big Four organisation demonstrating breadth of experience in leadership & culture services.
- Proven record of working within a global organisation, effectively engaging with challenging and complex stakeholders.
- Credible experience in some/all of the following Leadership & Culture service offerings: - Team effectiveness
- Culture change
- Leadership development
- Leadership/Executive Coaching and Advisory
- Talent transformation
- Workshop design and facilitation
- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion strategy, services, and/or training

- Confidence using data, analytics, and technology alongside experience-based intuition.
- Experience as a line manager and/or coach and mentor.
- Aptitude, or genuine desire to deepen AI expertise in a Leadership & Culture context.
- Master’s degree or above in psychology, behavioural science, or a related field or equivalent levels of skill and knowledge – preferred but not a requirement.

What is in it for you:
At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days of vacation per year, access to app-based fitness classes and discounts on range of gyms, private medical insurance and three days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

• Lead discovery workshops with business stakeholders to identify pain points, opportunities, and AI transformation use cases.

Role Purpose
Originate, sell, and deliver client programs that identify, validate, and scale new customer-led growth opportunities. Senior Managers are responsible for directing the strategic agenda, driving provocative and future-forward thinking, generating POV content, ensuring ideas are tested and refined with the right evidence, and guiding them to market launch and scale.

-

jobs.description:
AI & Data Strategy — Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from AI and Data.
Practice : Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work : AI & Data Strategy
Level : Manager
Location : Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
Years of Experience : 10 to 15 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.

The Practice — A Brief Sketch
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will be part of our global team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives faster.

Business Transformation: Assessment of AI & Data potential, identification of high-value AI use cases, and development of solutions that can transform business operations. Transforming Businesses: Envisioning and designing customised, next-generation data and AI products and services that help clients shift to new business models for today's connected landscape. Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components. Product and Frameworks: Evaluate existing AI & Data products and frameworks and develop options for proposed solutions.

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role
- AI Value Assessment & Opportunity Identification: Leverage your knowledge of technology trends across AI & Data and conduct structured AI opportunity assessments — including AI use case identification, value mapping, industry benchmarking, and AI value diagnostics — to identify where AI creates real, measurable value for clients.
- Data & AI Readiness Assessment: Interact with client stakeholders to conduct data maturity assessments and AI readiness reviews, including data infrastructure review, gap analysis, and current-state diagnosis to set the foundation for AI adoption.
- AI Foundation Architecture: Design & guide development of enterprise-wide AI & Data strategy for clients, covering AI architecture design, platform strategy, data architecture, PDLC, foundation design, and cloud architecture to enable AI at scale.
- Strategic Roadmap & Business Case: Develop AI roadmaps, build quantitative and qualitative business cases, lead executive stakeholder engagement, and define value frameworks and prioritisation approaches to establish a fundable, board-level AI strategy.
- Data Governance & Quality: Establish frameworks for effective Data Governance across multi-speed implementations. Define data ownership, standards, policies, and associated processes; drive Data Capability Maturity Assessments and Data Operating Model design.
- Data Platform Strategy: Demonstrate a fair understanding of data platform strategy for cloud migrations, big data technologies, large-scale data lakes, and DW-on-cloud solutions leveraging platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks.
- Stakeholder & Client Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & Data opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.
- Benchmarking & Industry Expertise: Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers to understand current state and recommend AI & Data solutions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry — Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, or equivalent.
- Responsible AI: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI frameworks and tools to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations, including regulatory compliance and ethical AI considerations.
- Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI & Data transformation engagements.

Read more about us.
- The rise of forerunners
- Recent Blogs

Your Experience Counts!
- MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred.
- 5 – 7 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.
- 3+ years of experience on projects showcasing skills across: AI use case identification, AI value diagnostic, data maturity assessment, AI readiness, AI opportunity assessment, data infrastructure review, gap analysis, AI foundation architecture, AI roadmap, business case development, and executive stakeholder engagement.
- 3+ years of experience in designing end-to-end Enterprise AI & Data Strategic Solutions leveraging cloud and non-cloud platforms such as GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery), Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir.
- Excellent understanding of Traditional AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Advanced Cognitive methods to derive insights and actions.
- Deep understanding of data supply chain and building value realization frameworks for AI & Data transformations.
- 3+ years of experience leading or managing teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing Data & AI strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs.
- Experience in one or more technologies in the data governance space: Collibra, Talend, Informatica, SAP MDG, Alteryx, Alation, etc.
- Mandatory knowledge of IT & Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Cloud, API-first, Data Mesh, Digital Core.
- Foundational understanding of data privacy and Responsible AI frameworks is desired.
- CDMP Certification from DAMA preferred. Cloud AI/Data Practitioner Certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) desirable but not essential.

What's in It for You?

- An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

jobs.title: Life Sciences R&D Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Manager or Principal Director to play a critical leadership role within our growing R&D strategy team to focus on R&D reinvention across the value chain: helping clients move beyond incremental improvement to AI-enabled transformation of how they discover, develop, and deliver medicines.   This high-impact role sits at the intersection of biopharma R&D, digital innovation, and enterprise transformation — advising R&D leaders at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies.

You will lead end-to-end strategy engagements, build lasting client relationships across R&D functions, drive business development, and contribute to practice growth through thought leadership and capability building. This is a balanced role: part trusted advisor, part business builder, part practice champion.  You will be expected to partner across the various Accenture businesses to be successful in this role.

We Are:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at   www.accenture.com .

Accenture's Life Sciences R&D practice helps biopharma organizations transform discovery, early development, and development operations through scientific strategy, data and AI integration, and operational reinvention. We work with R&D leaders — Chief Scientific and Medical Officers, Heads of R&D Functions, SVP and VP-level capability owners — to shape R&D strategy, accelerate pipeline decisions, and build the capabilities needed to compete in the age of AI-driven drug discovery and development.

This is a growth-focused practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

You Are:
An R&D expert with proven work experience in the Life Sciences R&D industry. You are a strategic problem solver with extensive consulting and industry experience. You are a clear and effective communicator, and you have an open, relatable manner with clients and colleagues. You perform well in an agile, fast-paced working environment. You know how to balance being a leader with contributing to the collective efforts of the team. You have led business development and sales origination efforts to provide transformative programs and targeted consulting engagements.
You have energy and drive in abundance, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. You have a flair for breaking down challenges and processes into logical parts and constructing crystal-clear reasoning and analyses—an aptitude you use to decimate problems.
The Work (Role Responsibility)
- Lead complex R&D strategy engagements from problem framing through delivery, ensuring measurable client impact.
- Advise clients on R&D transformation priorities including strategy, pipeline portfolio management, scientific data and AI integration, R&D operational excellence, R&D operating model, etc.
- Develop and present strategic recommendations, transformation roadmaps, and reinvention narratives to Heads of R&D functions, and other senior stakeholders.
- Serve as a guiding presence throughout the program lifecycle — shaping critical program stages, driving quality assurance, and ensuring delivery excellence on large-scale engagements.
- Build, manage, and grow senior client relationships across biopharma R&D functions.
- Partner with the broader Accenture team to bring the tailored expertise needed for an individual R&D Strategy engagement in support of our clients (e.g., Data & AI, Technology Strategy & Advisory, Talent & Organization)
- Originate and shape new opportunities, lead proposals and commercial pursuits, and contribute to Accenture's pipeline growth in the Life Sciences R&D space.
- Identify adjacent opportunities and expand existing client relationships across the R&D value chain.
- Represent Accenture's R&D Strategy point of view in client briefings, industry forums, and executive conversations
- Develop and contribute to thought leadership on R&D transformation, AI-driven discovery and development, and scientific innovation — publishing assets that establish Accenture's differentiated perspective in the market.
- Build reusable offerings, frameworks, and assets that accelerate future client engagements.
- Mentor and develop junior colleagues; actively contribute to performance management and recruiting.
- Partner with Accenture’s global industry leads, capability leads, and cross-functional teams to evolve the R&D Strategy practice and go-to-market strategy.

Here’s What You Need (Basic Qualifications)

Candidates must have at least 8 years of combined experience in the following areas:
- Deep expertise in Life Sciences R&D with experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a leading biopharma company in an R&D strategy or transformation function.
- A proven track record leading strategy engagements with measurable outcomes for biopharma clients.
- Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations and transformation roadmaps to C-suite, SVP, and VP-level R&D stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of how AI, data, digital technologies, and scientific informatics are reshaping biopharma R&D — and the ability to translate that understanding into client strategy.
- Demonstrated success in business development: identifying opportunities, shaping proposals, and building senior client relationships.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing junior professionals.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

Bachelor's degree

Bonus Points (Preferred Skills)
- MBA, advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD), or equivalent combination of education and experience in a relevant discipline.
- Experience building or scaling a new strategy offering, practice area, or capability from the ground up.
- Track record developing thought leadership — whitepapers, conference presentations, or published perspectives — in the life sciences or R&D space.
- Exercise operating across multiple biopharma sub-sectors (large pharma, emerging biotech, CROs, or medtech) and geographies

Retail Merchandising and Planning – Strategy Senior Manager

We Are
Accenture's Retail Merchandising and Planning practice helps the world's leading retailers reinvent how they buy, plan, allocate, and manage product across the value chain. We work at the intersection of merchandising strategy, planning process design, and AI-enabled decision making, helping clients across apparel, hardlines, grocery, and specialty retail modernize their operating models and improve performance in demand forecasting, assortment planning, and inventory productivity.

You Are
A retail merchandising and planning professional who combines deep functional expertise with strong program leadership. You've spent your career close to the buy, whether in category management, merchandise financial planning, assortment, allocation, replenishment, or demand/supply planning, and you understand how these functions connect end-to-end. You translate that expertise into operating model redesign, process reinvention, and capability roadmaps clients can execute against. You are accountable to realizing value, and you have experience rolling up your sleeves to ensure high adoption of new processes and systems. You're equally comfortable leading a workstream, coaching a team, and standing in front of a client steering committee.

The Work
As a Senior Manager, you will lead transformation engagements for retail clients, working directly with client executives and Accenture leadership to shape strategy, drive execution, and activate results.
Engagement Leadership
- Lead large, transformational programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholder groups
- Orchestrate delivery across cross-functional teams spanning strategy, process, data / technology, and change management
- Own client relationships, including executive sponsors, and manage alignment across disparate points of view, escalations and ambiguity as they arise
- Ensure engagement quality, timeliness, and profitability

Merchandising & Planning Transformation
- Lead assessments of current-state merchandising, planning, and inventory management capabilities against industry-leading practices
- Design future-state operating models spanning category management, merchandise financial planning, assortment planning, allocation, replenishment, demand planning, and supply planning
- Develop capability strategies, transformation roadmaps, and value cases that quantify the impact of change
- Apply sub-industry nuance across apparel, hardlines, and/or grocery to tailor recommendations to client-specific dynamics

AI & Technology Enablement
- Bring current knowledge of AI, analytics, and emerging planning technologies to identify where they can solve merchandising and planning business problems
- Help clients evaluate and adopt planning platforms and AI-enabled decision-making tools as part of broader transformation
- Support the design and delivery of GenAI- and agentic-enabled planning capabilities where applicable to client roadmaps

Business Development & Practice Growth
- Contribute to proposal development, solutioning, and the broader business development cycle for consulting engagements
- Support the growth of the Retail Merchandising and Planning practice through asset development, thought leadership, and recruiting
- Coach, mentor, and develop junior team members; contribute to staffing and performance management

Basic Qualifications:
- Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience with demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following domains: Category Management, Merchandise Financial Planning (MFP), Assortment Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Demand Planning, or Supply Planning
- Minimum of 2 years in professional services at a consulting firm (or equivalent internal consulting experience)
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications:
- Ability to lead large, transformational programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholders
- Strong client management skills, including with senior stakeholders
- Ability to coach, mentor, and develop junior team members
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong problem-solving ability and sound business judgment
- Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving situations
- Ability to resolve issues and manage risk proactively
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment
- Familiarity with the operational nuances of one or more retail sub-industries, including apparel, hardlines, or grocery
- Experience designing or supporting operating model design, process reinvention, capability assessments, roadmaps, and value case development
- Experience solutioning approaches to client problems and supporting the business development/proposal cycle
- Working knowledge of current trends in technology, analytics, and AI, and how they apply to merchandising and planning business problems
- Prior industry experience in Buying, Planning, or Product Development
- Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini in a professional environment
- Familiarity with leading planning platforms such as o9, Blue Yonder, Anaplan, Oracle, or RELEX
- MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Data & AI Team Overview

Our Data & AI team within Accenture Song focuses on helping clients drive performance optimisation through deep customer insights and the implementation of leading Data & AI capabilities across the Marketing and Service value chain.
The team collaborates with clients to accelerate experimentation, deepen their understanding of key customer value drivers, improve business outcomes and drive innovation across industries.

Through deep industry understanding, analysis and insights, we help our clients identify new opportunities for growth in a world increasingly powered by Data and AI. Our work spans strategy through to implementation , with Data and AI at the centre of how we help organisations transform customer and marketing outcomes.

By joining Accenture Song’s Data & AI team, you will be part of a global, dynamic and innovative environment where you can make a meaningful impact on the customer experiences of the future.

As a Customer & Marketing Data & AI Associate Manager, you will:
- Lead and deliver defined workstreams across customer and marketing Data & AI engagements, from problem definition and analysis through to recommendations and implementation.

- Develop modern marketing strategies that enable organisations to make better decisions across customers, channels, geographies, routes to market and products.

- Explore how digital and technology innovation is reshaping business models and identify opportunities to create new routes to growth, including through Generative AI.

- Help transform and optimise how clients understand, engage and service their customers.

- Deliver sustained business value through the implementation of next-generation technology, Data & AI and customer experience capabilities across the value chain.

- Develop your consulting, client leadership and delivery capabilities while working alongside experienced Data & AI practitioners.

- Demonstrated experience in a consulting, data, analytics or business environment , with experience delivering customer, marketing or Data & AI initiatives.

- Strong analytical capability with experience translating complex data and business problems into actionable insights and recommendations.

- Hands-on experience with programming and analytical languages such as SQL, Python and/or R , and/or data visualisation tools such as Tableau and Power BI .

- Experience delivering customer-focused initiatives such as customer analytics, segmentation, personalisation, predictive modelling, marketing analytics or related Data & AI solutions.

Are you ready to transform your business with the power of Data & AI? jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
TLDR: You would advise the world's most important technology and AI companies on their most transformational questions. You would be joining a team / community where you can build a career as a true industry strategist and make a lasting impact on yourself & the market.

We Are:
Technology companies - Software, AI, Advertising Platforms, Dual-Sided Marketplaces, and Hyperscalers - are rewriting every industry and we advise the companies doing the rewriting & have an inside look every day in this massive transformation. We are the industry strategists and advisors supporting the world's most consequential technology companies: hyperscalers building the infrastructure that powers the global economy, software platforms reinventing how they grow and compete, and AI-native companies building an entirely new category.
We work on the problems that don't have answers yet. How do you monetize an AI-native product at scale? How do you build and operate data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand? How do you transform a $50B enterprise without losing the speed that made it great? Our work generally focuses on four domains:
- Product & Go to Market | inclusive of building, launching, and scaling products; driving forward deployed engagements to infuse the customer in the product; reinventing product lifecycles to accelerate growth; improving monetization; and driving more profitable innovation

- Platform Services | shifting platforms from manual operations to Data & AI-powered services that maximize trust, growth, and efficiency at billion-user scale

- AI Compute Capabilities | inclusive of helping companies design, build, and operate AI infrastructure efficiently; improving data center delivery, utilization, and ROI across the full lifecycle while concurrently identifying cost takeout opportunities across the business

- Transformation + Value | inclusive of driving reinvention for companies and the industry — transforming companies end-to-end across their mega-processes; leading the value/ROI identification for AI; and orchestrating the industry focus around customer zero

You Are:
A strategy advisor with professional experience working in the tech industry (Software, Hyperscalers, and AI-native companies). You are passionate about the industry and excited to tackle new problems without a playbook each day. You are energized by working in fast-moving, complex environment that is changing constantly. You are easily able to harness that complexity and define actionable strategies that your clients can execute at scale. You keep up with the market trends but also actively shape how your clients stay ahead. You thrive in ambiguity, support + grow the teams around you, and build the kind of trusted client relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.

The Work:
- Define strategies and roadmaps that help technology companies stay ahead; spanning product strategy, AI adoption, data center strategy and implementation, total cost of ownership for AI, and go-to-market planning.

- Shape the strategic choices defining the next generation of technology companies; where to play, how to win, how AI changes the business, and what capabilities and operating model are required to lead.

- Conduct market analysis and competitive research to identify where the industry is moving, where clients have exposure, and where the real opportunities are; then turn that into a clear point of view.

- Size markets, model financial scenarios, and build the business cases that support major client decisions; from new product investments to large-scale infrastructure builds to operating model changes.

- Identify cost reduction and efficiency opportunities across the business including AI-related spend, infrastructure utilization, and operational overhead.

- Build the analytical foundation for client decisions; synthesizing market dynamics, competitive signals, financial data, and operational inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Develop client-ready materials that communicate complex ideas simply and drive decisions at the executive level.

- Structure and lead workstreams from start to finish; framing the problem, designing the approach, managing the analysis, and delivering work that is ready for the client without a second pass.

- Own quality across everything the team produces. Coherence, rigor, and client-readiness are the standard.

- Support business development; contributing to proposals, shaping the point of view on new opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships.

- Lead the client relationship day-to-day; managing communication, setting expectations, and building trust over time.

- Lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams spanning product, technology, and strategy — mentoring future leaders, shaping culture, and cementing Accenture's reputation as the definitive thought leader in Software and Platforms.

- Act as the single point of ownership for major engagements — responsible not just for delivery, but for making the work successful analytically, commercially, and relationally.

- Keep internal delivery on track; coordinating across workstreams and making sure the right people are focused on the right things.

- Develop junior team members; give honest feedback, create real ownership opportunities, and invest in their growth.

- Travel: Average 40 to 50% (up to 80% as needed).

Here's What You Need:
- A Bachelor's degree.
- Minimum of 8 years of professional experience working in strategy in the tech industry or at a consulting firm.

Bonus Points If:
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
- A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
- Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems.
- Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
- Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital and AI capabilities across all services.

We are looking for a Transaction Advisory Manager with experience leading pre and post deal engagements in a consulting environment, and we’re particularly interested in candidates who have worked on technology-led or technology-intensive transactions.

Inclusion and diversity are woven into the fabric of our business, and our core values of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, Integrity and Respect for the Individual have enabled us to create One Global Network for clients all over the World.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO.

As a team

You’ll join Accenture’s Transaction Advisory team, which is a network of M&A and Private Equity professionals across Europe, Asia and North America. Our practitioners provide dedicated support from M&A strategy, target screening and due diligence to transaction management, merger & synergy planning, as well as carve-outs and divestitures, increasingly where technology sits at the centre of the deal thesis.

We use scaled agile disciplines to transform around iterative approach sequencing use cases focused on critical data elements aligned to data product and platform feature development.

As an AI & Data Strategy Senior Manager, you will:
- Shape vision and create opportunities for AI, GenAI and data led business reinvention.

- Build client relationships and credibility as a trusted advisor on how to infuse AI, GenAI and data into the business processes or functions

- Define building blocks required to convert to an AI-first organization, including technology and AI platform blueprint, data strategy and future-ready operating model.

- Create the business case, investment profile and roadmap to deliver on the strategy (including revenue upside as well as cost-takeout opportunities).

- Infuse Responsible AI in vision and roadmap, develop plan for leveraging ecosystem partners, and define operating model to foster a culture of innovation and experimentation.

- Identify people, processes, and technologies to develop and operationalize AI solutions.

- Create strategy for AI-first products and develop commercialization opportunities.

Ability to travel up to 80%; travel as needed based on client expectations.

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum of 7 years of experience and demonstrated skills within the AI and Data Strategy space including (but not limited to): Enterprise & Function-Specific Data Strategy, Talent Strategy, Value Case Development, Data Management, Data Analysis, Data Management, Client Assessments, Roadmap, Requirements Gathering, Responsible AI, and/or leading tech driven transformations
- Minimum of 7 years of high value consulting experience or equivalent internal consulting experience
- Minimum of 7 years of experience leading workstreams and meeting deadlines
- Minimum of 7 years of large-scale delivery experience
- Minimum of 1 year of experience serving utilities clients (electric, gas, or water) or in a utilities finance, controllership, or regulatory function.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

jobs.title: Manager IT M&A F/H
jobs.description:
Imaginez, transformez et impactez le monde positivement : venez vivre au cœur du changement en tant que Consultant(e) to Senior Manager IT M&A.

Vos principales missions :
En tant que Consultant IT M&A , vous serez amenés à traiter les problématiques technologiques et de IT à travers toutes les étapes des transactions (e.g., due diligence, intégration, séparation). Vous interviendrez pour évaluer la maturité technologique et le potentiel de développement des cibles, mais également pour définir et accompagner la mise en place du nouveau Target operating model IT issu de la transaction, sous tous les angles (e.g., people & organisation, IT applications, data, infrastructure).
- Target Screening :  Vous serez amené à identifier des cibles potentielles et définirez les critères de sélection pertinents pour des cibles à forte dominante technologique. Vous évaluerez la complémentarité de ces cibles avec le portefeuille de nos clients et formulerez des recommandations.
- IT / Due-Diligence & Transaction Management :  Vous interviendrez sur des due-diligences opérationnelles en adressant en particulier le volet IT et technologie. Vous travaillerez au besoin avec le réseau d’experts en stratégie et en technologie d’Accenture.
- IT / Merger Integration :  Vous contribuerez à la planification et à la définition d’un plan d’intégration IT (e.g., IT blueprint, Day-1 readiness plan, D-1 target operating model). Vous vous assurez de l’identification des risques relatifs à l’intégration et de la réalisation des synergies.
- IT / Carve-Out & Divestiture :  Vous contribuerez à la planification et à la définition d’un plan de séparation/cession IT: évaluation des dépendances liées au détourage du système d’information, analyse des différents scénarios standalone de la cible, identification des activités de cutover, et évaluation des coûts de séparation et de di-synergie liés à la transaction.
- Vous assisterez également nos clients à la définition, la mise en œuvre et le suivi des TSAs.
- IT / Joint-Venture & Alliances :  Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans le choix des modèles d’alliance et l’identification des partenaires potentiels dont l’asset IT présente une valeur forte pour l’entreprise. Vous contribuerez à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de ces JV ou de ces partenariats.

L’équipe – Accenture M&A Strategy :
L’équipe Accenture Strategy – Mergers and Acquisitions accompagne les investisseurs financiers et stratégiques sur l’ensemble du processus de transaction, en s’appuyant sur la forte expertise sectorielle et fonctionnelle d’Accenture Strategy & Consulting.
Nous proposons à nos clients une offre complète de services incluant Target Screening, Due-Diligence, Post-merger Integration et Carve-out / Divestiture, s’appuyant sur des accélérateurs et outils technologiques uniques.
Nous rejoindre, c’est l’opportunité d’intégrer une practice globale organisée autour de 16 hubs, avec des équipes expérimentées ayant participé à plus de 850 transactions au cours des 5 dernières années. C’est aussi bénéficier de la force de frappe d’un groupe à la pointe de la technologie et de l’innovation pour réinventer le conseil M&A.

Vous construisez une carrière agile, grâce à la formation, aux certifications et aux feedbacks reçus pour chacune de vos réalisations. Nos équipes apprennent chaque jour avec les meilleurs experts en France et à l’international.
Vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail flexible qui vise à favoriser l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle : le télétravail donne la possibilité d’adapter son rythme professionnel en fonction des actualités de l’équipe et du projet.
Nous vous proposons de vivre l’expérience du changement auprès de nos équipes, rejoignez Accenture.

- - Formation Bac +5 en école d’Ingénieur, de Commerce.
- Expérience d’au moins 6 ans en matière de Strategy et d'IT Strategy acquise au sein d’un cabinet de conseil idéalement dans le cadre d’opérations de M&A
- Vous avez la capacité à intervenir lors d’opérations de fusions acquisitions en France ou à l’étranger
- Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

A propos de nous :
Accenture, c'est une communauté de plus de 730 000 talents et une mission commune : réaliser la promesse technologique alliée à l’ingéniosité humaine.

Dans un monde en perpétuel changement, nous accélérons la transformation des plus grandes entreprises, de la stratégie à la réalisation des projets, à l’aide des technologies de demain et dynamisons leur croissance grâce à l'expertise multi-sectorielle de nos experts.

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, ou de genre et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Manager — Commercial Strategy
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
Overview ​

Join our Life Sciences Industry & Enterprise practice to help leading pharma, biotech, and medtech clients define commercial strategy and reinvent how commercial work gets done. This role focuses on leading strategy work across asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, market access, patient services, functional transformation, operating model, process redesign, and AI/data-enabled reinvention. ​

​

What would you do? ​

As a Manager, you will lead client workstreams that help life sciences organizations make critical commercial decisions — from how to launch and grow assets to how to redesign functions and enterprise ways of working. ​

Your work could include: ​

- Leading asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, market access, patient services, and broader commercial strategy workstreams ​

- Assessing market dynamics, customer needs, competitive landscapes, access considerations, and commercial growth opportunities ​

- Translating strategic recommendations into functional or enterprise implications across operating model, process, governance, capability, talent, and technology ​

- Identifying where AI, analytics, automation, copilots, or agentic workflows can improve commercial decision-making, execution, or ways of working ​

- Facilitating client discussions and synthesizing research, interviews, benchmarks, and data inputs into executive-ready recommendations ​

​

In this role you will be expected to: ​

- Anticipate risks, dependencies, and shifting client priorities; prepare teams to pivot as programs evolve while keeping delivery focused on outcomes ​

- Shape client objectives into clear workplans, hypotheses, analyses, and deliverables ​

- Lead workstreams and manage analysts/consultants to produce high-quality, client-ready outputs ​

- Manage day-to-day client relationships, including working sessions, feedback, and next steps ​

- Apply life sciences commercial knowledge to connect asset, customer, access, functional, and enterprise implications ​

- Bring a robust point of view on the “right answer” and shift from executor to advisor ​

- Use structured problem solving and storytelling to communicate recommendations clearly and persuasively ​

- Define value unlock opportunities by identifying where commercial strategy can drive growth, efficiency, differentiation, or better customer / patient outcomes; shape the value story, KPIs, and implications for leadership decisions ​

- Support AI/data-enabled strategy and reinvention work by shaping use cases, workflow fit, required inputs, risks, governance, and human-in-the-loop considerations ​

- Support proactive commercial strategy / reinvention opportunities and proposals by shaping the client problem, workplan, solution approach, and value story ​

- Contribute to thought capital by developing reusable perspectives, frameworks, case examples, and market-facing points of view on priority commercial topics

Growth Opportunities ​

You will continue to grow through: ​

- Leading high-priority commercial strategy and reinvention work for senior life sciences leaders ​

- Building breadth across asset, function, and enterprise commercial strategy topics ​

- Developing expertise in AI/data-enabled commercial strategy and future ways of working ​

- Partnering across Accenture teams to bring together strategy, technology, analytics, operations, and industry expertise ​

- Coaching analysts and consultants into future life sciences strategy practitioners

Who do we need? ​
We would love to hear from you if you have:​

Basic Qualifications
- Minimum of 6 years of life sciences commercial experience across asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, marketing, medical, market access, patient services, field, or commercial ops / transformation topics
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, professional services, or an equivalent internal corporate-strategy role.
- Bachelor's Degree

​
Preferrred Qualifications
- ​Ability to lead work across both asset-level strategy and functional / enterprise-level reinvention questions​
- Demonstrated ability to lead a workstream, manage clients, and coach junior team members​
- Strong client management skills, including ability to build trusted relationships, facilitate working sessions, manage feedback, align stakeholders, and communicate risks / tradeoffs clearly​
- Strong understanding of commercial strategy fundamentals such as market dynamics, customer behavior, access considerations, competitive positioning, value drivers, and launch / growth levers​
- Experience with operating model, process redesign, governance, capability building, transformation roadmap, or implementation planning work​
- Proactive mindset around innovative ways of working, including how AI, automation, copilots, and agentic workflows can improve productivity, quality, collaboration, and speed of execution​
- Working knowledge of AI/data concepts, including predictive analytics, GenAI, copilots, workflow automation, and agentic solutions​
- Practical understanding of how AI/data can be applied responsibly in commercial workflows, including where it creates value, what risks or dependencies must be managed, and how to support adoption with appropriate human oversight​
- Comfort partnering with technology, analytics, AI, and platform teams while staying anchored in the business problem​
- Proactive mindset around innovative ways of working, including how AI, automation, copilots, and agentic workflows can improve productivity, quality, collaboration, and speed of execution for external project & internal Accenture work​
- Strong PowerPoint, Excel, written communication, storytelling, facilitation, and executive communication skills​​

jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture Strategy. We empower clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now, and the unknown through deep industry expertise , analytics, and insights. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously driving the total reinvention of its business. Accenture Strategy enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:
A strategy consulting professional with significant experience setting growth and transformation agendas within the Banking Industry. Your expertise includes working with management teams and senior leadership to advise clients on strategies to transform their business operations, client experience, product propositions, and business models so they can achieve their strategic, financial, and operational goals. You bring an understanding of the commercial banking landscape, including areas such as business banking, corporate and middle-market banking, lending, deposits, treasury management, payments, relationship management, client segmentation, pricing, risk, and digital transformation.

As a manager, you're a natural at building and bringing out the best in teams. You thrive in solving complex problems, thanks to your strong analytical skills and structured approach to complex problems. You have excellent communication and people skills along with a strong desire to work in a fast-paced environment.

The Work:

- Lead delivery of commercial banking strategy engagements, covering areas such as growth strategy, operating model design, client experience, pricing, and digital transformation, with a clear focus on practical, executable outcomes

- Lead teams to deliver world-class business, operations, and technology strategy solutions that meet the needs of banking clients, including commercial banking growth, operating model, client experience, product, pricing, and digital transformation initiatives

- Build relationships with senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions that sustain Accenture’s profile as a long-term trusted advisor and partner

- Advise clients on commercial banking strategy topics such as market growth, client segmentation, relationship management effectiveness, lending and deposit strategy, treasury management, payments, channel strategy, cost transformation, and modernization of core business capabilities

- Integrate AI tools into engagement delivery and advise clients on where AI can unlock value across commercial banking operations, client coverage, and back-office processes

- Provide overall guidance on quantitative analysis and research to generate recommendations, insights, and outcomes, including analysis of client profitability, portfolio performance, operating efficiency, market opportunities, and competitive positioning

- Contribute to Accenture’s Banking practice through thought leadership, client-facing content, and participation in internal and external industry forums

- Mentor junior members of the Strategy team

- Travel may be required based on client demand. Accenture promotes a client-centric, flexible work environment

- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. - Minimum 3 years of experience delivering analytics or digital technology projects for commercial banking or financial services clients

- Minimum 4 years of experience leading large-scale transformation programs, including at least one in banking or financial services

- Minimum 4 years of experience managing consulting or project teams

- Bachelor’s degree
