In End-to-End Supply Chain & Engineering we work with C-suite executives, leaders and boards of the world’s leading organizations, helping them reinvent every part of their enterprise to drive greater growth, enhance competitiveness, implement operational improvements, reduce cost, deliver sustainable 360° stakeholder value, and set a new performance frontier for themselves and the industry in which they operate. Our deep industry and functional expertise are supported by proprietary assets and solutions that help organizations transform faster and become more resilient. Underpinned by technology, data, analytics, AI, change management, talent and sustainability capabilities, our End-to-End Supply Chain & Engineering services help architect and accelerate all aspects of an organization’s total enterprise reinvention.

End-to-End Supply Chain & Engineering Strategy.  We embed innovation, intelligence, and sustainability in the way the world makes and moves things while optimizing resources, keeping people safe, and ensuring a sustainable future for all.

We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot their supply chain to the future.  We believe that smart, sustainable, connected digital products and assets are revolutionizing industrial experiences with new levels of operational efficiency, transparency & traceability, tangible impact on sustainability, and more sources of revenue.

You are:
A skillful advisor. You know how to make the supply chain work for clients, society, and our planet – ensuring input products and services are received responsibly without interruption. And, what’s more - you’ve got the real-life experience and analytical know-how to reduce complexity, optimize risk exposure/resiliency, and increase long-term profitability. You have energy and drive, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. You have a flair for breaking down challenges into logical issues and constructing clear reasoning and root-cause analysis — an aptitude you use to solve problems. You have both communication and people skills, and as a team leader, you’re a natural at appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

The work:
- Work directly with business leaders to deliver actionable supply chain insights for top organizations.
- Help address priority enterprise-wide issues with strategies that can be executed with speed and at scale.
- You will spot, define, and solve Supply Chain problems using your skills in one or more of the following:
- Operating model architecture – people, process, and technology.
- Business analytics – network optimization, business case modeling.
- Supply Chain processes – planning/scheduling, routing optimization, capital projects.
- Give clients insights that help make their operations work better, faster, and more efficiently.
- Challenge legacy ways of working using constructive techniques that fuel client growth.
- Leverage tech to find new ways to make client organizations more effective and efficient.
- Manage small to medium-sized teams with diverse backgrounds, skills, and knowledge.
- Effectively mentor and coach others, collaborating with internal and external parties.
- Support client sales origination, business development, and external thought leadership.
- Drive a positive impact in the communities where we work and live with volunteerism initiatives.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary from 10-75%.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum of 5 years of experience working on relevant Supply Chain transformation initiatives.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience at a consulting firm or 7 years of internal consulting experience or equivalent role in non-consulting companies.
- Experience working with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI platforms
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus points if:
- You have a deep specialization in strategies for one or more of the following: procurement or third-party / vendor cost takeout initiatives; supply chain forecasting, planning and inventory optimization; manufacturing production in either continuous or discrete manufacturing environments
- You excel in building and developing relationships, overseeing complex programs, and demonstrating team leadership
- You’ve earned an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- You have a functional-level understanding of technology solutions such as Oracle and SAP.
- Lean or Six Sigma qualifications.
- You can use the latest data analytics tools to spot opportunities for improvements with prior experience in visualization tools (i.e., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (i.e., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).

Bij Accenture Strategy & Consulting transformeren we onze klanten met inzicht, kennis en innovatieve ideeën. Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture works at the intersection of business and technology, helping clients realise value from AI, technology and data. We define industry-relevant technology visions, build the case for change and design the enterprise architecture and roadmaps required for delivery.
Our work spans four solution areas: Business Technology Strategy; Technology Visioning, Future Technology and Innovation; Enterprise Technology, AI and Data Strategy; and Industry Enterprise Architecture. We deliver measurable outcomes by linking business priorities to technology investment, improving decision-making, reducing architectural complexity and identifying AI, data and digital opportunities.

Your responsibilities

As a Senior Manager, you will set technology strategy for Financial Services clients, lead delivery, originate work and build the practice.

Technology strategy and transformation
- Lead technology strategies that align business goals, investment, market change and regulation.

- Prioritise value opportunities and present board-level options and trade-offs.

- Design operating models, investment cases and multi-year roadmaps with measurable outcomes.

- Link business priorities to technology investment, challenging assumptions with independent judgement.

AI, data and technology leadership
- Define how AI, data and cloud-native technology enable reinvention and competitive advantage.

- Lead scalable AI and data strategies, operating models and governance roadmaps.

- Address model risk, data governance, resilience and regulatory requirements.

- Use AI to accelerate analysis while independently validating outputs.

Delivery and client leadership
- Lead complex, concurrent engagements, accountable for outcomes, quality and coherence.

- Own engagement scope, mobilisation, commercials and financial performance.

- Build trusted C-suite relationships and deliver clear, challenging advice.

- Align senior stakeholders on direction, investment, expectations and delivery risk.

People development and practice building
- Lead, coach and develop teams, including recruitment and performance management.

- Shape practice strategy, targets, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

- Champion Accenture's values and recognise others' contributions.

- Meet the chargeability target [align to current practice target], with remaining time focused on sales and practice building.

Business development and thought leadership
- Lead business development from opportunity identification to close.

- Shape propositions, RFP responses, proposals and statements of work.

- Drive cross-Accenture sales through client relationships and internal collaboration.

- Publish thought leadership and represent the practice at industry events.

We are looking for the following skills and experience

Core consulting skills

- Proven leadership of large, complex technology strategy engagements, with accountability for delivery, quality and business outcomes.

- Strong command of strategy methods, including research, quantitative analysis, structured problem solving and executive communication.

- Strong financial and commercial fluency, including modelling, valuation, business cases and key Financial Services value drivers.

- Excellent board-level communication, influencing, negotiation and C-suite workshop facilitation skills.

- Proven team leadership, coaching, people management and capability development.

- Commercial acumen and a strong record of originating and closing work.

- Ability to structure ambiguous problems, assure complex deliverables and challenge conventional approaches.

Technology strategy skills

- Deep expertise in business and technology strategy, roadmaps and business cases.

- Strong command of AI, data and emerging technology, including GenAI, agentic AI, cloud-native architectures and AI-ready data.

- Ability to assess the feasibility, scalability, value and risks of technology choices in regulated environments.

- Experience designing technology and business operating models and translating them into implementable change.

- Broader capability in technology assessment, market and competitor analysis, ecosystem strategy and application strategy.

- Track record of linking technology investment to measurable business outcomes.

Financial Services industry expertise

- Strong understanding of the Financial Services landscape, market trends and participants across banking, capital markets, payments and insurance.

- Familiarity with key sub-sector ecosystems, including banks, regulators, fintechs, payment providers, insurers and London Markets.

- Depth in one or more areas such as products and channels, digital strategy, operating models or strategic cost reduction.

- Understanding of regulation affecting technology investment, including operational resilience, AI governance and model risk.

Experience

- Proven leadership experience of significant technology strategy engagements or programmes.

- A strong Financial Services delivery record in consulting, industry or a comparable advisory setting.

- Formal people management experience, including performance and career development.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent; an MBA or relevant MSc is advantageous.

Set yourself apart
We're very interested in hearing from you if you have some or all of the following.

- - Recognised expertise in a Financial Services sub-sector or functional area, supported by a distinctive viewpoint on investment themes and client challenges.

- Technology due diligence experience in a Financial Services M&A or private equity context.

jobs.title: IT Service Management Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management Transformation Lead to design, establish, and continuously improve an enterprise-wide IT Service Management function supporting applications, infrastructure, cloud, security, and digital services.

In this role, you will develop transformation frameworks, strengthen ITIL-aligned processes, and establish effective operational governance across multiple service teams. You will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to ensure service stability, achieve service-level commitments, manage operational risks, and deliver sustainable improvements.

This is a senior, customer-facing position requiring strong ITSM leadership, transformation experience, and the ability to influence multiple teams and service providers.

Key Responsibilities
ITSM Transformation and Strategy
- Develop and implement an IT Service Management transformation roadmap aligned with organizational priorities.
- Design and mature an ITIL-aligned service management operating model.
- Define service management policies, processes, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.
- Assess current capabilities, identify improvement opportunities, and translate recommendations into practical initiatives.
- Align business objectives with technology and service-management solutions.

Service Management Leadership
- Lead end-to-end service management across multiple technology service areas.
- Oversee Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, Service Level, Knowledge, Capacity, Availability, and Continual Improvement practices.
- Establish clear accountability, escalation paths, and cross-functional ways of working.
- Provide guidance and mentorship to service delivery and process management teams.

Operational Governance
- Lead operational governance forums, including service reviews, incident reviews, problem reviews, and Change Advisory Board meetings.
- Monitor service performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
- Present service performance, risks, issues, and improvement plans to senior stakeholders.
- Coordinate service delivery across internal teams, external providers, and geographically distributed teams.
- Manage service risks and escalations proactively.

Major Incident and Problem Management
- Lead the response to critical service incidents and support timely service restoration.
- Coordinate executive and stakeholder communications during major service disruptions.
- Drive post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and permanent remediation.
- Identify recurring service issues and implement preventive improvement initiatives.
- Improve service resilience, operational stability, and recovery performance.

Change and Service Improvement
- Govern change enablement and release activities across application and infrastructure environments.
- Ensure appropriate impact assessment, risk evaluation, implementation planning, and stakeholder alignment.
- Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and operational efficiency.
- Strengthen knowledge management and promote effective shift-left practices.
- Support the use of intelligent automation and AI-enabled service operations.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- At least 10 years of experience in IT Service Management .
- At least 5 years of experience leading ITSM functions within a large enterprise environment.
- Strong experience in managed services, application support, infrastructure support, shared services, or IT outsourcing.
- Demonstrated experience designing, establishing, or improving an ITSM operating model.
- Strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, Service Level, Knowledge, Capacity, Availability, and Continual Improvement practices.
- Experience managing major incidents, customer escalations, and senior stakeholder communications.
- Experience managing enterprise-scale operations, multiple service providers, or geographically distributed teams.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, influencing, and decision-making skills.
- Professional proficiency in Thai and English.

Preferred Qualifications
- ITIL Managing Professional or ITIL Strategic Leader certification
- PMP or PRINCE2 certification
- ServiceNow certification
- Lean Six Sigma certification
- Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, CMDB platforms, monitoring and observability tools, and reporting solutions
- Experience supporting automation or AI-enabled service operations
- Experience working within a complex, multi-vendor technology ecosystem

What We Are Looking For
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Strong operational and transformation leadership
- Confidence leading through critical incidents and complex service challenges
- The ability to translate strategic objectives into practical service-management solutions
- Strong customer and senior stakeholder engagement
- The ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
- A continuous improvement and data-driven mindset
- High accountability and ownership
- The ability to lead and develop high-performing teams

jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
Leadership Acceleration Consulting – part of Accenture, is the world’s pre-eminent provider of leadership strategy services. Leadership strategy is the intentional design of the individual leadership styles, the team dynamics and interactions, and the workplace culture that are most likely to enable successful achievement of an organization’s desired future state.

We Are:

An inclusive and interconnected global team made up of appreciative and constructive individuals who start with what works, build from successes, and are future focused. Our people are eclectic and curious by nature, making us uniquely Leadership Acceleration.

Our consultants have varied professional backgrounds, advanced degrees, and industry credentials in psychology, organizational behavior, management, adult learning, and related fields, including education, social work, counseling, and more.

Our team is grounded in the rigor of the behavioral sciences and practical realities of commercial and organizational demands.

You Are:
- Able to deliver at the C-suite and Board levels in our client systems. You provide dynamic support and leadership advisory to leaders and their teams.

- Skilled at pulling from a wide variety of experiences and expertise to support clients, provide content expertise and leadership, and are deeply committed to improving leadership outcomes through the lens of talent optimization and support.

- A self-motivated, personable, business-savvy individual with significant and diverse experience in our field, looking to join a high-growth, dynamic, and entrepreneurial culture.

- As a Senior Manager, you are responsible for managing and driving growth with existing clients; able to demonstrate proof of growing the practice. You have relevant and extensive experience in working with C-suite leaders, Boards, and are well-versed in leadership strategy, assessment, and development, and demonstrate deep insights and fluency regarding industry context and needs.

- You are accomplished at developing business, bringing great insights to clients, collaborating, building relationships, and thinking flexibly. You are comfortable with ambiguity, have an inquiring, innovative mind, and a strong learning orientation.

- You demonstrate curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI ‑ powered tools to improve productivity and are able to apply AI tools to real business problems with strong quality and risk awareness.

The Work:
- Design, deliver, and implement impactful, large-scale, and strategic consulting programs, at the highest levels, across the suite of Leadership Acceleration’s Leadership Strategy Services: Board Effectiveness, CEO Succession Planning, Culture Change, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Executive Assessment, Advisory Coaching, Identifying and Developing Potential, and Team Development.

- Consistently model and deliver senior-most leadership consulting offerings to CEOs, C-Suite leadership teams, boards, chairs, and other senior-level leaders, credibly and at differentiated margin.

- Develop and maintain a high-caliber network of senior-level contacts throughout the region/market to enable the creation of significant business opportunities.

- Be a trusted and confidential advisor to leaders; build deep, insightful relationships with C-suite leaders and their teams; support their success and help them create impactful cultures.

- Deliver high-quality work to support the client’s business strategy and improve commercial outcomes, and demonstrate mastery of the commercial, contextual, and behavioral levers of value creation.

- Contextualize leadership insights into cultural and commercial drivers for client stakeholders to build their understanding of how leadership impacts outcomes and attainment of business strategy.

- Manage and coordinate client team and/or portfolios: upskill teams, set up and cultivate local client relationships, create operational structures to service clients with a high level of professionalism.

- Pilot new intellectual property within client systems to support our Content Team and ensure we are keeping up with best practices.

- Manage a portfolio of clients, leading typically one to two large clients, including but not limited to: growing the client account by drafting strategic client growth plans, driving active and intentional growth within the client, selling across all of Leadership Acceleration's offerings, focusing on the top-of-house.

- Serve as a role model for others to build a positive and inclusive culture.

- Flexibility to travel up approximately 30-35%, dependent on client needs.

Basic Qualifications:
- A minimum of 8 years’ experience in one or more of the following areas: - Extensive experience working with C-suite leaders and Board; supporting top teams in major industries.
- Leadership/Executive Coaching and Advisory; developing leaders and high-performing teams.
- Deep psychological assessment of senior leaders and executives.
- Organizational consulting, effectiveness, and design expertise.
- Workshop design and facilitation - both in-person and virtual.
- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion strategy, services, and/or training.

- Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree or above in psychology, behavioral science or a related field, or equivalent levels of skill and knowledge.

Professional Skills Requirements:
- Significant client management and/or business development experience. A track record of developing new business, building networks, and forming strategic, lasting relationships with the C-suite executives and Board members.
- A consulting mindset: able to develop insights and spot opportunities to add value for clients, generate innovative solutions and drive outcomes in response to client needs.
- Confidence using data, analytics, and technology alongside experience-based intuition; Comfortable using both quantitative and qualitative data to develop insights and drive demonstrable results for clients.
- Experienced as a line manager: inspiring others to create seamless, high-touch client experiences and developing your team’s confidence, capabilities and credibility.
- Able to build trust and understanding; maintain strict confidential support across all stakeholders.
- Comfortable working with ambiguity; must be able to operate in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with tight turnaround times when necessary.
- A desire to be a part of, and contribute to, collaborative and inclusive teams; having a global mindset to operate as part of a truly global team

jobs.description:
We are:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.
Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.  We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human + AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

About the Role:
The Portfolio Strategy & Value Lead is the most senior Accenture leader on a Reinventive Enterprise engagement. This role owns the end-to-end value thesis, governs the portfolio of transformation workstreams, and serves as the primary C-suite relationship owner on behalf of Accenture. Part trusted advisor, part business builder, part value architect — this is a balanced leadership role at the center of enterprise reinvention.

The Work:
- Chair the portfolio governance forum and facilitate investment sequencing and prioritization across multiple transformation programs
- Own the end-to-end reinvention value case from initial business case through value realization tracking, maintaining CEO/CFO-level narrative around ROI
- Serve as primary Accenture senior relationship owner with client executive team, managing C-suite relationships and driving alignment across leadership
- Surface trade-offs, escalate delivery risks and resourcing gaps, and drive the reinvention roadmap including sequencing of transformation waves
- Lead cross-functional Reinvention Force teams across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators
- Drive business development: originate, shape, and close new reinvention engagements; lead proposals and commercial pursuits
- Contribute to thought leadership and practice development for the Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice

You are:
A strategic leader and trusted advisor with deep Life Sciences expertise. You are a structured problem solver with extensive consulting and industry experience. You communicate clearly and credibly with C-suite executives. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and know how to lead a team while staying close to the work. You have driven business development and built lasting client relationships. You bring energy, resilience, and a genuine passion for building something new.

Candidates must have at least 8 years of combined experience in the following areas:

- Enterprise transformation or strategy consulting at a top-tier firm or leading Life Sciences organization, with experience leading multi-workstream programs from problem framing through delivery.
- A proven track record leading engagements with measurable client impact — including owning the value case, governing delivery, and maintaining C-suite relationships throughout.
- Experience developing and presenting transformation roadmaps, reinvention narratives, and investment cases to C-suite, SVP, and VP-level stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of how AI, data, and digital technologies are reshaping enterprise operating models — and the ability to translate that into client strategy and roadmap.
- Demonstrated success in business development: identifying opportunities, shaping proposals, and building senior client relationships.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing junior professionals.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

Preferred Skills

- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
- Experience building or scaling a new practice, offering, or capability from the ground up in a consulting context.
- Track record developing thought leadership — whitepapers, conference presentations, or published perspectives — on enterprise transformation or AI-driven reinvention.
- Experience operating across multiple Life Sciences sub-sectors (large pharma, emerging biotech, CROs, or medtech) and geographies.
- Familiarity with value quantification frameworks for AI investments (e.g., Wharton economic model or equivalent).

jobs.title: Consultant Sourcing & Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Internationalen Kunden ganzheitlich entlang der Dimensionen Strategie, Organisation, People, Prozesse, Inhalte und Technologie zu helfen, klingt für dich nach einer spannenden Aufgabe? Du möchtest Verantwortung in Implementierungsprojekten übernehmen und echte Veränderungen vorantreiben? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Deine Mission
Als Consultant im Bereich Sourcing & Procurement unterstützt Du internationale Unternehmen dabei, die Beschaffung als strategischen Hebel für Effizienz und Innovation zu nutzen. Du bringst Deine Expertise ein, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Kosten zu reduzieren, Organisationen weiterzuentwickeln und die Einkaufsfunktion ganzheitlich zu transformieren. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf Integration von zukunftsweisenden Technologien wie Generative AI (GenAI) und Agentic AI und Nachhaltigkeit, um unseren Kunden eine Führungsposition in ihrer Branche zu sichern.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Procurement Strategy : Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden eine zukunftsfähige Vision und Mission für die Einkaufsfunktion. Dabei gestaltest du nachhaltige Target Operating Models, definierst Prozesse, Rollen und Fähigkeiten, die den Einkauf strategisch neu ausrichten. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung von Category-Management-Strategien, die eine optimale Warengruppensteuerung ermöglichen.
- Digital Procurement Transformation : Du analysierst bestehende Einkaufsorganisationen und Systemlandschaften, berätst bei der Auswahl passender digitaler Lösungen und begleitest deren Implementierung. Mit innovativen und standardisierten Prozessen machst Du den Einkauf unserer Kunden effizienter und effektiver. Dabei nutzt Du modernste Technologien wie Generative AI und Agentic AI, um datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen und die Automatisierung von Prozessen voranzutreiben.
- Strategic Cost Optimization : Du hast Erfahrung im Warengruppenmanagement für direktes und/oder indirektes Material. Mit Deinem Wissen über Preis-, Spezifikations- und Bedarfshebel trägst Du dazu bei, die Kosten unserer Kunden nachhaltig zu senken und ihre Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu steigern.
- Responsible Procurement und Sustainable Value Chain : Du hast Interesse daran, im Einkauf zu arbeiten und dabei eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen innerhalb eines Unternehmens zusammenzuarbeiten, wie beispielsweise Logistik, Qualitätsmanagement, Corporate Sustainability und der Geschäftsführungsebene. Darauf freuen wir uns

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams sowie in globalen Projektumgebungen

jobs.title: #ACN S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - AI Op Model & Governance - Manager
jobs.description:
AI Op Model & Governance — Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from Data Management, Governance, and AI Operating Model design.
Practice : Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work : AI & Data Operating Model & Governance
Level : Manager
Location : Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
Years of Experience : 10 to 15 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.

The Practice — A Brief Sketch
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling Data & Analytics — and the governance that makes it trustworthy — to power every single person and every single process. You will be part of our global team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services to help clients achieve their business objectives faster.
AI Operating Model Design: Define structural and process changes required to move from AI pilots to enterprise-scale AI operating models, including AI Centre of Excellence design, org design, and ways of working. AI Governance & Risk Management: Design pragmatic AI governance frameworks that define policy and guardrail structures across Responsible AI, model risk, privacy, security, compliance, human oversight, and third-party AI usage. Data Operating Model & Data Management:
Design governance structures, policies, data stewardship frameworks, and accountability models for enterprise data at scale, including regulatory compliance (GDPR, DPDP, CCPA) and data ownership frameworks.
Define MDM architecture, golden record strategy, entity resolution, and data domain ownership across the enterprise using leading MDM platforms.
Establish data quality frameworks including data profiling, data cleansing, data validation, DQ monitoring, and remediation processes to ensure trusted data at scale.
Design and implement metadata management, data lineage, data discovery, business glossary, and enterprise data catalog capabilities using platforms such as Collibra and Alation.

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role
- AI Operating Model Design: Define the structural, governance, and process changes required to move from AI pilots to enterprise-scale adoption. - Shape AI target operating models covering AI Centre of Excellence design, federated vs. centralized ownership, talent and capability model, operating cadence, and cross-functional ways of working across business, data, technology, risk, and legal teams.
- Establish pilot-to-scale frameworks including use-case intake and prioritization, value tracking, lifecycle management, model ownership, MLOps/LLMOps handoffs, business adoption, and change enablement.
- Drive role clarity, process integration, and service management models to embed AI into enterprise delivery and business operations at scale.

- AI Governance & Risk Frameworks: - Design pragmatic AI governance frameworks that balance innovation, control, and regulatory readiness.
- Define policy and guardrail structures across Responsible AI, model risk, privacy, security, compliance, human oversight, and third-party AI usage.
- Establish governance processes for use-case triage, risk classification, approval workflows, documentation standards, testing and validation, monitoring, incident response, and periodic review.
- Advise clients on controls for GenAI and traditional AI across data access, prompt and output risk, explainability, transparency, bias and fairness, traceability, and model lifecycle accountability.
- Translate emerging regulatory expectations and enterprise risk requirements into actionable governance operating mechanisms, roles, forums, and reporting.

- Data Operating Model & Data Management: - Define a Data & Analytics Operating Model to manage data across organizations, with working exposure to core data management disciplines including data governance, stewardship, accountability, master data concepts, and data quality practices.
- Support the design of data ownership models, governance forums, policy structures, quality controls, and domain-based roles.
- Bring a practical understanding of concepts such as golden record, reference data, entity resolution, profiling, monitoring, remediation, and trust enablement as good-to-have capabilities in broader AI and data transformation engagements.
- Establish frameworks for effective data governance across multi-speed implementations. Define data ownership, data policy, data stewardship roles, accountability frameworks, regulatory compliance (GDPR, DPDP), and associated processes. Drive Data Capability Maturity Assessments for clients.
- Design and implement metadata management capabilities, data lineage, data discovery, business glossary, and enterprise data catalog solutions. Demonstrate expertise in tools such as Collibra, Alation, and data observability platforms.

- Data Platform & Cloud Strategy: - Demonstrate a fair understanding of data platform strategy for data-on-cloud migrations, big data technologies, large-scale data lake, and DW-on-cloud solutions. Utilize strong expertise in cloud data platforms — Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, AWS Redshift — or equivalent.

- Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement:

- Lead discovery workshops and executive design sessions to identify Data & AI opportunities, clarify business pain points, and align stakeholders on strategic priorities.
- Demonstrate consulting-led problem structuring, hypothesis-driven thinking, and the ability to translate ambiguity into actionable recommendations, roadmaps, and investment cases.
- Engage confidently with CIO, CTO, CDAO, and business leadership on target state architecture, AI governance, operating model decisions, transformation sequencing, and value realization.
- Use strong presentation, storytelling, and facilitation skills to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across business and technology teams.

Budgeting & Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and own proposals response for AI Op Model engagements.

- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

jobs.title: I&P GN - SC&E – Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
jobs.description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.

You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.

THE WORK

Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:

Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development

- Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.

- Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.

- Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.

- Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

Client Engagement & Advisory Support

- Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.

- Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.

- Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.

- Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

Data & AI Foundations

- Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.

- Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.

- Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.

- Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS

- 9-13 years of experience (including internships, co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field.

- Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics.

- Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level.

- Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting.

- Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations.

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

- Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations).

- Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations.

- Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context.

- Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes.

- Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context.

- Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. Our practice partners with CPOs, CFOs, COOs and CSCOs at the world's leading organizations to transform procurement functions into insight-driven engines for growth, efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. Our two flagship offerings — Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention — combine strategic advisory, managed services, and cutting-edge agentic AI to generate measurable ROI for our clients.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Sourcing & Procurement practice. This is a senior client-facing role that combines deep functional procurement expertise with a strong business development mindset. The successful candidate will lead complex client engagements across Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention, develop relationships at C-level, and actively contribute to the growth of the practice — ideally bringing an existing network in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil & Gas).

As an Application Developer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and configuring applications to meet business process and application requirements. -Strong experience in StarLIMS configuration, customization, and administration.

-Experience in workflow development, forms customization, and report development.

-Experience with JavaScript, .NET, or related development technologies.

-Understanding of Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) solutions.

In Consulting, we work with C-suite executives, leaders and boards of the world's leading organizations, helping them reinvent every part of their enterprise to drive greater growth, enhance competitiveness, implement operational improvements, reduce cost, deliver sustainable 360° stakeholder value, and set a new performance frontier for themselves and the industry in which they operate.

Our AI and Data Strategy practitioners focused on Finance Transformation sit at the intersection of Finance functional expertise and applied AI. We are looking for practitioners who don't just advise on AI and data in the abstract — we need people who deeply understand how Finance functions operate, where the friction lives, and how to engineer smarter solutions using AI and data to fundamentally transform Finance processes. This is not a generalist role. Our clients need advisors who can credibly engage with a CFO, understand their FP&A cycle or Controllership challenges, and translate that into a concrete AI-enabled transformation roadmap.

As an AI & Data Strategy Senior Manager focused on CFO & Enterprise Value, you will:
- Lead Finance-specific AI strategy engagements  — define a compelling vision for how data and AI can reinvent core Finance functions including FP&A, Controllership, Financial Close, Treasury, and Tax.

- Apply an engineering problem-solving mindset  — creatively identify where AI, automation, and data solutions can eliminate friction, reduce manual effort, and generate new insight within Finance processes.

- Conduct Finance AI and Data Assessments  — evaluate the maturity of a client's Finance data assets, technology stack, and AI readiness to identify highest-value transformation opportunities.

- Design Finance Process Reinvention  — map current Finance processes, identify AI intervention points, and develop future-state process designs that embed intelligence at their core.

- Develop Finance AI Functional Designs  — translate Finance process requirements into AI solution designs, working closely with technology and data engineering teams to ensure buildability and fit.

- Build the business case and roadmap  — create investment profiles, value models, and sequenced roadmaps to deliver Finance AI transformations with measurable ROI.

- Shape AI Operating Model design  — define the people, processes, governance, and technology structures needed to sustain AI-enabled Finance operations.

- Infuse Responsible AI  — embed ethical AI principles into Finance AI strategy and solution design, ensuring auditability, explainability, and compliance with Finance regulatory requirements.

- Bachelor's Degree

- 7+ years of experience in Finance functional roles or Finance transformation consulting — you have direct, hands-on experience working within or transforming Finance functions (FP&A, Controllership, Financial Close, Treasury, or Tax)

- 7+ years of AI & Data experience — including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI & Data projects, with demonstrated application to Finance use cases

- 7+ years of high-value consulting experience, including large-scale delivery with minimal oversight and proven ability to lead workstreams and meet deadlines

- Finance AI Strategy & Business Case development

- Finance Data Assessment

- Finance AI Technology Assessment

- Finance Process Reinvention

- Finance Process AI Functional Design

- AI Operating Model Design for Finance functions

- Experience leading senior-level (C-suite or C-level minus 1) conversations, including with CFOs and Finance leadership

jobs.title: Growth Tech & Agentic Commerce Advisory Senior Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Shape the future of commerce by helping global organizations unlock growth through AI‑driven, autonomous customer experiences. In this role, you work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and creativity—turning emerging agentic capabilities into measurable business impact.

Your Mission
As a Growth Tech & Agentic Commerce Advisory Senior Manager, you enable clients to design and operationalize next‑generation, AI‑driven commerce ecosystems. You connect business ambition with intelligent, autonomous systems that orchestrate customer journeys, decisions, and transactions in real time.
By bridging marketing, data, AI, and IT, you guide organizations from traditional Growth Tech stacks toward agentic, decision‑centric architectures—transforming AI and automation into sustainable value.
At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.

Your Daily Work
- You develop Agentic Commerce strategies and blueprints that align business, marketing, and data objectives with AI‑driven, composable architectures.

- You assess existing Growth Tech and commerce ecosystems, identify gaps in automation, decisioning, and AI enablement, and define future‑state agentic architectures.

- You design AI‑powered decisioning frameworks such as next‑best‑action models, recommendation engines, and autonomous journey orchestration.

- You define operating and governance models covering AI agents, data ownership, model governance, privacy, and consent management.

- You facilitate cross‑functional workshops that translate business intent into agentic use cases and technical enablers.

- You support platform and capability selection across CDP, DXP, commerce platforms, AI/ML, decisioning engines, and orchestration layers.

- You define business cases and KPI frameworks linking agentic capabilities to revenue uplift, conversion optimization, and customer lifetime value.

- You collaborate closely with architects and delivery teams to ensure end‑to‑end alignment from strategy to AI‑enabled execution.

- You mentor junior colleagues and actively contribute to capability building within Song.

Who You Are
- You bring 5–8 years of experience in digital strategy, marketing technology, commerce, or customer experience consulting.

- You have a strong understanding of Growth Tech stacks and emerging Agentic Commerce paradigms.

- You are experienced in AI‑ and ML‑driven use cases such as personalization, recommendations, predictive analytics, and automation.

- You understand identity resolution, consent management, and real‑time data activation.

- You are able to translate between business strategy, AI capabilities, and technical architecture.

- You manage senior stakeholders confidently across CMO, CIO, CTO, and Chief Data / AI roles.

- You are comfortable working in agile, cross‑functional, product‑oriented environments.

What We Offer
- The opportunity to shape one of the most forward‑looking commerce and growth topics at the intersection of AI, data, and experience.

- Access to global clients, large‑scale transformation programs, and cutting‑edge technologies.

- A collaborative Song environment that combines strategy, creativity, and technology.

- Flexible working models that support your individual lifestyle and priorities.

- Continuous learning, certifications, and clear career development paths at Accenture.

Life at Accenture
At Accenture Song, creativity, technology, and strategy come together to help the world’s leading brands grow in new and meaningful ways. You work in diverse, interdisciplinary teams and benefit from a culture that values individuality, trust, and continuous learning.

The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change
At Accenture, we believe that innovation starts with people. You’ll work in diverse teams, bring your authentic self to work, and grow in an environment that values individuality, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com .
We look forward to your application.

jobs.title: Technology M&A Consultant
jobs.description:
Meet our Technology Strategy and Transformation Team

Technology Strategy & Transformation is the advisory pillar of Accenture’s Technology practice, alongside AI & Data Services, Software & Platform Engineering, Intelligent Infrastructure Services and Managed Reinvention Services. We help Clients set technology strategy, assess platforms and vendors, and build the roadmap for a resilient, AI-ready digital core .

We work directly with Clients to solve their specific challenges. No two Clients are alike, so we stay flexible and pragmatic in finding solutions to non-standard problems.

We deliver consulting assignments across industries and geographies, working with some of the world’s largest organizations .

As a Technology M&A Consultant focused on Tech Due Diligence & IT Assessment, you bring sharp analytical skills and some experience contributing to Tech DD or IT Assessment engagements. You understand technology architecture, IT operating models and current technology trends, and turn that into clear, actionable findings under tight deal timelines.

What’s in it for you:

- Run Tech Due Diligence and IT Assessments for M&A deals, covering application landscape, infrastructure, security and IT organization

- Assess a target company’s “as-is” technology state and flag key risks, gaps and integration costs for the deal team

- Evaluate vendors and technology options against client requirements, and document the rationale behind recommendations

- Feed Tech DD findings into post-deal planning: transition service agreements, carve-out or integration roadmaps and day-one readiness

- Prepare clear, concise findings and recommendations for client and deal-team stakeholders

- Contribute to proposals and business development by researching industries, companies and technology markets

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- Charismatic, confident communicator – able to build credibility quickly with senior client and deal-team stakeholders

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , able to structure ambiguous client challenges and work independently

- Some experience in technology strategy, enterprise architecture or Tech Due Diligence / IT Assessment work

- Comfortable working directly with clients on time-pressured, complex assignments

- Working knowledge of a broad range of technologies and how they apply to real business problems

- Practical experience evaluating vendors or technology options against business requirements

Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.

Working Conditions:

- Headquartered in   Warsaw with offices in Kraków, Wrocław, Łódź and Gdańsk.

- Work is mostly remote, but the model is advisory-led and client-facing, so willingness and ability to travel to Client sites – mostly across Europe, occasionally beyond – for short or longer periods is required.

What we offer:

- Employment contract

- Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach

- A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification)

- Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.

- Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares

- Paid employee referral program

- Private medical care, life insurance

- Access to the MyBenefit platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card)

WHAT WE BELIEVE:

Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. Beyond that, what matters to us is what you can do: we’re looking for people who are sharp, hands-on, and want to keep learning and getting better.

jobs.title: I&P GN - SC&E – Senior Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
jobs.description:
Job Description
The ideal candidate for a Senior Manager in the Supply Chain team shall be,
- A subject matter expert in application of data science methodologies in one or more areas of supply chain analytics: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower

- Create new innovative offerings and lead workstreams in their area of expertise; demonstrate thought leadership which helps the growth of the Practice via new client work and more trained team members.

- Support business development and communicate with leaders in client teams to understand business challenges, be the solution architect, design and get buy-in for the analytics solution and serve as delivery lead of one or more Manager-led teams during project execution

Job Qualifications
Experience and Education:
- Ideal candidates should have a Ph.D. or a Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline like Statistics/ Economics/ Operations Research/Computer Science, etc.

- Work experience in data science applications should be 11+ years after Master’s degree or 8+ years after Ph.D., with at least 7 years in advanced analytics solutions design and delivery experience in supply chain/logistics/manufacturing/ production. Global client experience is a plus.

- Certifications in any one or two of the areas will be an added advantage: Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Optimization, Simulation, data science application on any of the cloud platforms (Azure/ GCP/ AWS).

Mandatory Skills:
- Deep experience in creating innovative solutions and delivering projects using data science in at least one of the supply chain functional areas: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower

- Expertise in use of data science for supply chain planning and operations of any of the major industries: Consumer Goods, Retail, Life sciences, Industrial, and Resources

- Expert in creating solutions using one or more data science areas like Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, Operations Research

- Experience in leading work delivered via large project teams across multiple workstreams

- Strong skills in presentation of complex concepts and large-scale project work to senior stakeholders

- Hands-on programming experience with any of the analytics tools, data bases and visualization tools and platforms (e.g., Python, PySpark, SQL)

En Accenture, dentro del equipo de Strategy & Consulting – Technology Advisory , acompañamos a nuestros clientes globales en sus prioridades más estratégicas. Impulsamos crecimiento, eficiencia e innovación mediante la transformación tecnológica y la redefinición de modelos de negocio.
Como Enterprise Architect , trabajarás con líderes de negocio y tecnología para conectar estrategia y ejecución, definir modelos operativos modernos y habilitar transformaciones digitales de gran escala.
Colaborarás con equipos multifuncionales para diseñar arquitecturas empresariales, identificar oportunidades, guiar decisiones clave y asegurar que las soluciones tecnológicas permitan alcanzar los resultados de negocio esperados.

📌  Un lugar de trabajo único, descubrí los beneficios que tenemos para vos:
🍔 Pedidos Ya
👩‍⚕️ Prepaga Swiss Medical
💻 Reintegro de Conectividad & Servicios
💪 Gimnasio 100% Bonificado
📆 Accenture Days
📚 Certificaciones bonificadas
🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre
🏆 Bonos
👨‍👩‍👦‍👦 Licencias de Paternidad & Maternidad Extendida
💰 Ayuda económica de Guardería
y muchos ➕!
🏢 Tenemos a disposición oficinas en CABA, Córdoba, Mar del Plata, Rosario, Salta y Mendoza !  Y si estás en otras provincias nuestras posiciones son remotas, para que puedas trabajar desde tu casa! 🌎

Qué desafíos te esperan
- Alinear estrategia de negocio y de IT, actuando como puente entre líderes técnicos y de negocio.
- Analizar modelos operativos, tendencias de mercado y tecnologías emergentes para evaluar su impacto en los objetivos estratégicos.
- Diseñar y evolucionar la arquitectura empresarial, identificando brechas y oportunidades de mejora.
- Construir casos de uso, escenarios futuros y roadmaps de transformación.
- Liderar conversaciones con stakeholders clave, facilitando decisiones sobre inversiones tecnológicas y priorización.
- Acompañar equipos de delivery (product y project centric) asegurando consistencia con la arquitectura y acelerando time‑to‑value.
- Desarrollar estándares, patrones y principios de arquitectura para garantizar gobernanza y escalabilidad.

Lo que te hará exitoso (Requisitos):
Formación & Experiencia
- Título universitario en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Administración, o carreras afines.
- +8 años de experiencia en consultoría, planificación estratégica, business analysis o arquitectura empresarial.
- Experiencia en al menos 3 áreas: Business, Information, Solution o Technical Architecture.
- Experiencia liderando transformaciones en la industria CPG y conocimiento del end‑to‑end de capacidades (Marketing, Ventas, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Development, etc.).

Conocimientos Técnicos
- Plataformas clave: SAP S/4, MS Dynamics, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Siemens Teamcenter, Shopify (deseable hands‑on).
- Expertise en SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, APIs, microservicios, SOA, analytics, integración y sistemas event‑driven.
- Conocimientos de modelos operativos, cost‑benefit, budgeting, risk management.
- Familiaridad con herramientas de EA, frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman), Agile at scale y ITIL.

Habilidades & Competencias
- Consultoría estratégica, storytelling, toma de decisiones y gestión de stakeholders.
- Capacidad de análisis, pensamiento sistémico y visión estratégica.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita (técnica y no técnica).
- Liderazgo colaborativo y capacidad de influenciar sin autoridad formal.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you an outcome-oriented problem solver? Do you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clients? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then, Accenture Strategy and Consulting is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.

As a part of the Insurance practice , you will leverage our industry experience, domain expertise and transformative technologies, to help Insurance companies thrive in a dynamic future.

Some of your key responsibilities will include:
- Independently drive Insurance projects spanning areas such as claims transformation, distribution and marketing transformation, cost reduction, digital transformation, tech/ ops transformation, applied intelligence, analytics, automation and so on.

jobs.title: Digital Payments Consultant / Manager
jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs mitzugestalten?
Der Zahlungsverkehr befindet sich im größten Wandel seit Jahrzehnten. Neue regulatorische Anforderungen, digitale Ökosysteme und innovative Technologien verändern die Art, wie Menschen und Unternehmen bezahlen.
Genau hier setzt unser Team an.
Gemeinsam mit Zentralbanken, Geschäftsbanken und weiteren Finanzinstituten entwickeln wir Strategien und begleiten die Transformation moderner Payment-Landschaften – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Ob Digitaler Euro, Instant Payments, Embedded Finance, Wallet-Lösungen oder KI-gestützte Innovationen: Wir helfen unseren Kunden dabei, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs aktiv zu gestalten.

Deine Mission
Als Digital Payments Consultant / Manager gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung des europäischen Payments-Marktes aktiv mit. Gemeinsam mit einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Team aus Strategie-, Fach- und Technologie-Experten entwickelst du zukunftsweisende Lösungen für unsere Kunden und begleitest ihre Transformation.
Du analysierst Markt- und Technologietrends, entwickelst innovative Geschäfts- und Operating-Modelle und berätst unsere Kunden bei strategischen Fragestellungen rund um den Zahlungsverkehr sowie während der Umsetzung ihrer Transformation – immer mit dem Ziel, messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.
Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du Verantwortung für einzelne Projektmodule oder leitest Projektteams, entwickelst Kollegen weiter und unterstützt den Ausbau unseres Payment-Geschäfts.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dein Arbeitsumfeld aktiv mit. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, individuellen Weiterbildungsangeboten und einem inspirierenden Team, das Vielfalt und Innovation lebt.

Das erwartet dich

- Gestalte den Zahlungsverkehr von morgen. Du entwickelst innovative Strategien und Geschäftsmodelle für Zentralbanken, Geschäftsbanken und weitere Finanzinstitute und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Payment-Landschaften zukunftssicher auszurichten.

- Führe unsere Kunden durch anspruchsvolle Transformationen.
Du begleitest unsere Kunden von der Strategieentwicklung über die fachliche und technische Konzeption bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Transformationsprogramme.

- Treibe Innovationen voran.
Du analysierst Markttrends, identifizierst neue Potenziale und entwickelst daraus innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden sowie neue Beratungsangebote für Accenture.

- Präge die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs.
Du arbeitest an Themen wie Digitaler Euro, Instant Payments, Embedded Finance, Open Finance oder Wallet-Lösungen wie EPI/ Wero und bringst technologische Innovationen wie KI, Cloud und Blockchain gezielt in Kundenprojekte ein.

- Verbinde Strategie und Technologie.
Du arbeitest eng mit Expert:innen für Strategie, Business und Technologie zusammen und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachliche Exzellenz mit erfolgreicher Umsetzung verbinden.

- Übernimm Verantwortung und entwickle Menschen weiter.
Als Manager führst und entwickelst du Projektteams, förderst Kolleg:innen und gestaltest den weiteren Ausbau unserer Payments Community aktiv mit.

Das ist genau dein Ding? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der Accenture Payments Community. Übernimm eine zentrale Rolle in einem internationalen Team aus Strategie-, Fach- und Technologieexperten und vertiefe gleichzeitig deine eigene Expertise. Arbeite an der Gestaltung innovativer Technologien, Geschäftsmodelle und maßgeschneiderter Payment-Strategien und trage dadurch dazu bei, die Finanzwelt nachhaltig zu prägen und zu verändern.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich.

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Beratung, einer Bank, einem Zahlungsdienstleister oder im Bereich Payments und Digital Currency.

- Selbstständiges Arbeiten, Eigenverantwortung und Proaktivität zeichnen dich aus.

- Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an innovativen Payments-Lösungen zu Digitaler Euro, Wallet-Lösungen, Instant Payments , Embedded Finance und Technologien wie KI, Blockchain & Cloud sowie die Fähigkeit, diese gezielt in der Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung einzusetzen.

- Eine aufgeschlossene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit, die analytisch denkt und innovative Lösungen entwickelt.

- Deine Teamfähigkeit und kooperative Arbeitsweise.

- Deine Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän zu überzeugen.

Was wir dir bieten
- Spannende Strategie- und Transformationsprojekte bei führenden Finanzinstituten sowie Zentralbanken.

- Die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs aktiv mitzugestalten und an den wichtigsten Innovationen der Branche zu arbeiten.

- Früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und – je nach Erfahrung – Teams, Kundenbeziehungen und neue Marktangebote weiterzuentwickeln.

- Individuelle Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie ein umfassendes Mentoring-, Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsangebot.

- Individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell in Voll- oder Teilzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, dort zu arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst – sei es an einem Accenture-Standort, remote oder direkt beim Kunden vor Ort.

- Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und persönliches Wachstum fördert.

- Events, die Erfolge feiern.

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Grossartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Dein Kontakt
Noch Fragen offen? Schreib uns an  recruiting_germany@accenture.com .

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Life Sciences MedTech Strategy Principal Director
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture's Life Sciences MedTech Practice helps leading medical technology companies define and activate growth strategies in markets being reshaped by changing clinical workflows, economic pressure, digital innovation, artificial intelligence, and evolving customer expectations. Our work spans enterprise and business unit strategy, portfolio and growth strategy, commercial model transformation, customer experience, AI-enabled engagement, and new business building.
We are seeking a senior MedTech strategy leader with deep understanding of physician and allied medical staff customers across MedTech segments. This leader will bring an outside-in clinical customer perspective to our clients and play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy, vision, offerings, and activation agenda for our segment-focused Centers of Excellence, including surgery, diabetes, diagnostics, and other priority MedTech markets.

You Are:
- A deep MedTech strategist. You translate market shifts, clinical practice patterns, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and technology disruption into clear choices for growth, portfolio direction, customer strategy, and operating model activation.
- A clinical customer expert. You understand how physicians, nurses, technicians, administrators, and other allied medical staff evaluate, adopt, use, and advocate for medical technologies across care settings.
- A segment authority. You bring meaningful depth in one or more MedTech segments and can connect segment-specific clinical and economic realities with enterprise-wide strategic implications.
- A recognized thought leader. You develop distinctive, evidence-based points of view and represent them credibly with C-suite, business unit, clinical, and commercial leaders through executive forums, publications, conferences, and client advisory work.
- A strategy-to-activation leader. You do not stop at the answer. You convert strategic choices into practical roadmaps, capability priorities, operating models, investment cases, and mobilized workstreams.
- A natural connector. You integrate clinical, commercial, technology, data, AI, product, and operating model perspectives and build trusted relationships across clients, partners, and the broader MedTech ecosystem.
- A leader worth following. You set a high bar for strategic rigor, develop people, and create inclusive teams that deliver high-quality outcomes.

The Work:
- This role is focused on growing and shaping Accenture's MedTech Strategy business. Beyond leading client engagements, you will define market strategy, create industry-leading points of view, cultivate C-suite relationships, and help establish Accenture as the preferred strategy partner within the MedTech ecosystem.
- You will be a key driver of our MedTech Strategy and Growth agenda: building client relationships, shaping compelling propositions, closing engagements, and developing the next generation of Accenture consultants. AI fluency is central to how we work and what we sell.
- You will help MedTech clients rethink growth in a rapidly changing environment, helping them deploy AI, unlock new sources of revenue, optimize investment and portfolio decisions, and drive activation in market.
- In this role, you will bring  a deep and market-relevant understanding of MedTech customers across segments. You will use this to shape and activate Accenture MedTech’s COEs across priority segments, including surgery, diagnostics, diabetes, and other key segments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Advise MedTech C-suite and business unit leaders on enterprise, portfolio, growth, customer, and segment strategy, with particular emphasis on the needs of physicians and allied medical staff.
- Lead client engagements from insight through activation, including market and customer assessment, strategic option development, business case creation, roadmap design, and implementation mobilization.
- Connect clinical customer insight with commercial and enterprise decisions across innovation, portfolio strategy, go-to-market, customer experience, education and training, service, digital solutions, and AI-enabled engagement.
- Develop differentiated points of view on the future of MedTech segments, care pathways, clinical workflows, customer expectations, and the role of data, digital, and AI in improving customer and patient outcomes.
- Shape the strategy and vision for Accenture's MedTech Centers of Excellence, defining where each COE will differentiate, the priority client problems it will solve, and the assets, partnerships, and capabilities required to win.
- Translate COE strategy into activation plans, including market-facing propositions, lighthouse pursuits, executive engagement, research agendas, reusable assets, alliance plays, and talent communities.
- Build senior relationships across strategy, business unit, medical, clinical, R&D, marketing, commercial, and operations leadership, positioning Accenture as a trusted partner for high-value strategic decisions.
- Originate and shape major strategy-led opportunities, working across Accenture Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Song, Industry X, Data & AI, and Operations to bring the best of Accenture to clients.
- Build strategy frameworks, playbooks, benchmarks, and reusable intellectual property that improve the quality and speed of client work and pursuit shaping.
- Identify and incubate high-potential offerings at the intersection of segment expertise, clinical customer needs, data, digital, AI, and new commercial models.
- Mentor senior and emerging talent, strengthening MedTech segment knowledge, clinical customer fluency, and strategy capabilities across the practice.
- Travel based on client and business needs, potentially up to 75%.

Here's What You Need:
- Minimum of 12 years of experience in MedTech strategy, healthcare strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, business unit leadership, clinical/commercial strategy, or an equivalent field.
- Minimum of 8 years of deep experience in at least one MedTech segment such as surgery, diabetes, diagnostics, cardiovascular, orthopedics, imaging, patient monitoring, or digital health.
- Demonstrated expertise in physician and allied medical staff customers, including clinical workflows, decision drivers, adoption barriers, evidence needs, training requirements, and stakeholder dynamics across care settings.
- Minimum of 5 years of consulting or strategy leadership experience, with a strong record of structuring ambiguous problems, developing executive-level recommendations, and leading strategy through activation.
- Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise, business unit, portfolio, growth, customer, innovation, or go-to-market strategy in MedTech.
- Demonstrated thought leadership through research, publications, conference participation, executive forums, industry engagement, or C-suite advisory work.
- Ability to originate and shape client opportunities and build trusted senior relationships, while bringing a strategy-led and collaborative approach to business development.
- Working fluency in the implications of AI, data, digital health, connected products, and ecosystem models for MedTech strategy and clinical customer engagement.
- Bachelor's degree.

Bonus Points If:
- Advanced degree in business, public health, health policy, medicine, nursing, biomedical engineering, or a related field.
- Direct experience working with or alongside physicians, nurses, technicians, or other allied medical staff in clinical, research, product, education, or advisory settings.
- Experience across multiple MedTech segments or care settings, with the ability to identify transferable patterns while respecting segment-specific differences.
- Experience creating and activating a Center of Excellence, industry platform, strategic capability, market offering, or comparable cross-functional initiative.
- Experience with clinical workflow redesign, customer journey research, human-centered design, professional education, medical affairs, evidence strategy, market development, or new category creation.
- A strong network across MedTech executives, clinicians, professional societies, health systems, academic institutions, technology partners, and innovation ecosystems.
- Recognized market presence within the MedTech ecosystem and a track record of turning thought leadership into client dialogue, differentiated offerings, and business growth.
