jobs.title: Utilities Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Utilities Strategy Consultant , you will support and lead workstreams across utilities strategy engagements. You will help clients define investment priorities, develop transformation business cases, design operating models, build capability roadmaps, and translate complex industry challenges into practical recommendations.

You will work across topics such as grid modernization, intelligent asset management, energy retail, smart metering, enterprise asset management, digital utility platforms, renewables, storage, and broader energy transition initiatives .

Key Responsibilities
- Develop business cases, investment narratives, value cases, and benefits-realization models for utilities transformation initiatives.
- Conduct structured analysis, market research, competitor benchmarking, and financial modeling to support client recommendations.
- Apply hypothesis-led problem solving to ambiguous client challenges, breaking complex topics into clear workplans, analyses, and decision points.
- Develop executive-ready presentations, reports, and storylines for senior client stakeholders.
- Support strategy engagements across grid modernization, Network of the Future, asset management transformation, retail & customer transformation, smart metering & Advance Metering Infrastructure (AMI), energy transition initiatives, and operating model and capability design.
- Translate industry trends, technology developments, and regulatory considerations into practical client implications.
- Facilitate client workshops, capture requirements, synthesize stakeholder input, and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
- Contribute to proposals, credentials, points of view, and internal practice-building initiatives.

Core Skills and Experience Required:
We are looking for candidates who bring strong consulting fundamentals and the ability to operate effectively in complex client environments.

You should have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Business case development, including investment logic, cost-benefit analysis, value driver definition, and benefits tracking.
- Quantitative analysis and financial modeling, with strong Excel capability.
- Structured problem solving, including issue trees, hypothesis development, workplanning, synthesis, and recommendation formulation.
- Market, competitor, and sector research, with the ability to translate findings into clear strategic insights.
- Executive-ready written and visual communication, including PowerPoint storylining and concise report writing.
- Stakeholder management, workshop support, and collaboration with consulting teams and client counterparts.
- Strong attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple workstreams or deliverables concurrently.
- Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in consulting, strategy, corporate development, energy, infrastructure, transformation, or a related field.

jobs.title: Junior Strategy Consultant Chemicals & Natural Resources ( all genders)
jobs.description:
Nur zukunftsfähige Unternehmen bestehen auch in disruptiven Zeiten. Unterstütze unsere Kunden mit passgenauen Strategien und gestalte die chemische Industrie von morgen.

Deine Mission
Als Junior Strategy Consultant – Chemicals & Natural Resources hilfst du Unternehmen dabei, ihre Zukunftsfähigkeit zu sichern und neue Geschäftsfelder zu erschließen. CO2-Neutralität, steigende Energiekosten, Digitalisierung und Fachkräftemangel: Du begegnest den Jahrhundertanforderungen der Chemieindustrie. Mit transformativen Ideen, digitalen Technologien und deinem tiefen Branchenwissen. So bringst du innovative Strategien und praxisnahe Lösungen auf den Weg und prägst die Zukunft einer der zentralen Industrien Europas maßgeblich – in Voll- oder Teilzeit.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Bereite die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden vor.
Du begleitest unsere Kunden aus der Chemie- und Prozessindustrie, ihre Geschäftsmodelle und -prozesse zu erneuern. Dabei bist du immer auf dem neuesten Stand in Sachen Trends und Nachhaltigkeitsaspekte.

- Wandle die Herausforderungen der Industrie zu ihrem Vorteil.
Du verstehst unsere Kunden und ihre Bedürfnisse, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast ein Gespür für zeitgemäße Technologien. Darauf aufbauend formulierst du Wachstumsstrategien und initiierst M&A-Aktivitäten inklusive Due Diligence, Carve-out und Post-Merger-Integration.

- Stärke die Leistungsfähigkeit von Chemieunternehmen.
Durch den gezielten Einsatz von Spitzentechnologie und Analytics-Tools befähigst du unsere Kunden, ihre Performance zu erhöhen und ihre Marktposition zu festigen. Und du trägst gleichzeitig dazu bei, unser eigenes Beratungsportfolio weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf freuen wir uns

jobs.title: Strategy Consultant (Macro Foresight)
jobs.description:
About the Role

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations navigate complexity, drive reinvention, and create sustainable value.

The Role will be part of Macro Foresight - an Accenture's CEO Advisory business. We work with CEOs and boards on enterprise-wide strategy and reinvention, helping them perform, protect, and grow. Within that, we are the team that anticipates disruption and volatility: we help clients read the external environment - economic, geopolitical, and financial - and build long-term strategies for competitiveness and resilience. Our footprint is global, with hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia.

In the past two years we've helped leaders respond to the highest US tariffs in a century, energy and supply shocks around the Strait of Hormuz, two-speed economies, and the reordering of global trade around industrial policy and AI.

What we do

The work we deliver for client’s centers on a set of CEO- and board-level offerings:
- Economic and geopolitical impact assessments. AI-accelerated analysis of how macro and geopolitical shifts affect a business, a market, or a major investment.

- Scenario planning and wargaming. AI-enabled planning and table-top wargaming that test a strategy against a range of possible futures.

- Decision intelligence. Enterprise-wide decision support that reaches beyond macro and geopolitics into portfolio strategy, competition, consumer trends, and business performance.

- Strategic foresight and long-range planning. Structured futures assessments and long-range portfolio planning.

- Enterprise resilience assessments. CEO- and board-level diagnostics that measure and strengthen an organization's resilience to shocks.

- Foresight capability enablement. Helping clients build their own capability across people, process, and technology.

The people we hire

We hire for a few different profiles, and many people here bring more than one:
- Economists and geopolitical experts who read the real economy, financial and commodity markets, and the interplay of policy, trade, and security, and apply it to a client's business context.

- Strategists who translate complex analysis into recommendations a leadership team can act on.

- Entrepreneurial people who grow teams and develop those who join after them.

- AI engineers who code, build models, and put large language models and AI agents to work. We're actively hiring for this.

- People who work well with ambiguity , set their own direction, and want to help build new offerings like scenario planning, wargaming, and foresight.

Based in our Singapore hub, you'll work on the questions reshaping the Asia Pacific region: supply-chain reconfiguration, China's changing role, geopolitical tensions, and the new industrial forces driving growth in the region. You'll help multinationals, regional companies, government-linked entities, and investors turn that uncertainty into practical strategy and stronger resilience.

What you'll be doing
- Deliver client engagements. Own a workstream from the first framing of the question through to the recommendation, and stay with it as the client acts on it.

- Work as part of a team. Deliver on small engagement teams, learn from senior colleagues, and help develop those who join after you.

- Build the analysis behind the advice. Create the models, scenarios, dashboards, and data pipelines that turn raw data into clear answers.

- Put AI to work. Use large language models and AI agents to accelerate monitoring, research, and scenario analysis on live projects.

- Help build our offerings and platform. Work with Accenture's AI engineering teams to turn scenario planning, wargaming, and decision intelligence into productized, AI-enabled services, and to develop our AI Foresight platform.

- Sharpen our thinking between engagements. Alongside the client work, contribute to our monthly Macro Briefs and points of view, with the chance over time to publish under your own name.

What we're looking for
- At least 2 years delivering strategy, economics, or advisory work in consulting, corporate development, investment, or research. Including:
- A track record of delivering on client work : running a workstream in a team, hitting deadlines, and holding your own with a client.

- The ability to turn analysis into a decision , drawing out what macro and company data mean for a client's business.

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to redesign and accelerate workflows, improve research and analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance project delivery.

- A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience .

What will make you stand out
- A graduate degree in economics, finance, public policy, international relations, or management (or an MBA), or an advanced quantitative, computational, data science, or engineering background.

- Curiosity about macro and geopolitics , with a strong grasp of how the real economy connects to markets, sectors, and regions

- Experience with our core offerings: scenario planning, wargaming, or foresight .

- AI and engineering depth , with priority given to developing AI-enabled analytical solutions: coding in Python and/or R, building models, dashboards, or data pipelines, and applying LLMs and AI agents to analytical workflows .

- Experience communicating with and advising C-suite or board audiences, or depth in a specific industry or region's political economy.

- Familiarity with tools like Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau , or econometrics packages such as Stata or EViews.

The practical details
- Fluency in English is required for this role.

- Proficiency in a regional language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, or Bahasa Indonesia ) is nice to have

jobs.title: AI Strategy & Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you ready to elevate your career at the frontier of applied artificial intelligence?

At Accenture Strategy & Consulting , we help the world's leading organisations move from AI ambition to AI in production. This is your chance to join a team that thrives on innovation — where you will not only advise C-suite executives on their AI agenda, but personally build the agentic and generative-AI solutions that bring it to life. We offer a culture that nurtures your talent and celebrates diversity, helping you achieve your professional and personal goals sooner than you ever imagined.

Work You'll Do
As an AI Strategy & Engineering Consultant, you will sit at the intersection of advisory and hands-on engineering. Working alongside industry specialists and fellow engineers, you will design, prototype, and scale AI capabilities that deliver measurable business value for our clients. Here is what you can expect in this role:
- Applied AI Delivery: Design and build agentic and generative-AI solutions — from multi-agent workflows and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — taking them from proof of concept towards enterprise-grade deployment.

- AI Advisory: Support C-level executives (CIO, CTO, CDO, CAIO) in shaping their AI strategy, prioritising use cases, and defining the operating model, governance, and platform choices needed to scale responsibly.

- Solution Architecture: Contribute to the design of secure, vendor-agnostic AI architectures — including model abstraction layers, RAG patterns across vector and graph data stores, observability, and LLM cost management.

- Client Engagement: Conduct interviews and working sessions with client stakeholders to uncover operational challenges, assess AI readiness, and identify high-value opportunities across their technology landscape.

- Rapid Prototyping: Translate business problems into working AI prototypes at pace — testing feasibility and demonstrating value before committing to full-scale build.

- Business Case Development: Help craft clear, actionable business cases and implementation roadmaps that align AI investments with industry best practice and measurable outcomes.

- Global Collaboration: Draw on Accenture's global network of AI assets, accelerators, and specialists to bring leading-edge solutions to your clients and drive competitive advantage.

Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking ambitious, curious individuals who are excited by generative AI and want to combine technical work with client advisory. If you enjoy solving problems with AI and explaining your thinking to non-technical audiences in equal measure, this could be the role for you. The ideal candidate will have:
- Academic Foundation: A BSc (distinction or honours preferred) from a top university in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. A relevant MSc is a plus.

- Foundation in Software or Data: A grounding in software engineering, data, or a related technical field — you are comfortable writing code (Python is useful for AI work) and understand the basics of APIs and cloud services.

- Interest in AI: A genuine curiosity about generative AI and how it creates value. You don't need to know everything on day one — some exposure to building with large language models (for example simple agents or RAG-based tools) is welcome, and familiarity with areas such as LangChain/LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), semantic layers, vector databases, or LLM Ops is a bonus rather than a requirement.

- Methodological Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, and Design Thinking, and how they enable rapid, iterative delivery.

- Business Acumen: The ability to connect technical solutions to business value and articulate a simple, compelling case for change.

- Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication in both Greek and English, including the ability to present technical concepts clearly to senior, non-technical stakeholders.

- Mindset: A strong appetite for learning, comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to excel in a fast-paced, hands-on consultancy environment. An interest in mentoring or coordinating small teams is a plus.

What's it in for you

jobs.title: Strategy Life Science Analyst (all genders)
jobs.description:
Du bist innovativ und brennst dafür die Welt der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen besser zu machen? Du möchtest mithilfe der aktuellsten Technologien, wie AI, Automatisierung oder Robotics das Leben von Patienten nachhaltig verbessern?

Dann wirst du bei Accenture Strategy ein Umfeld vorfinden, das dich inspiriert und dazu motiviert, Großes zu leisten. Dein Weg führt dich in ein Team, das die renommiertesten Pharma- und Medtech-Unternehmen berät und in dem du deine Fähigkeiten in der Strategieentwicklung und -Umsetzung entfalten kannst.

Deine Mission
Als Life Science Strategy Analyst arbeitest du in einem inspirierenden Team, in dem du Geschäftsmodelle, Organisationsstrukturen und Prozesse entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette gestaltest und optimierst und Pharma- und Medtech-Unternehmen dabei berätst modernste Technologien in ihre Geschäftsstrategie einzubinden.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Analysiere den Markt.
Du identifizierst die aktuellsten Markt- und Technologietrends, analysierst und strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen und entwickelst Handlungsoptionen, um Pharma- und Medtech-Unternehmen den entscheidenden Wettbewerbsvorsprung zu verschaffen.

- Gestalte die Life Science Strategie der Zukunft.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelst du Strategien, um die aktuellsten Innovationen in Technologie und Wissenschaft in Wachstumschancen und Effizienzsteigerungsmöglichkeiten zu übersetzen und tauchst hierbei tief in verschiedene Therapiegebiete und Unternehmensfunktionen ein.

- Entdecke Deine Möglichkeiten.
Mit deiner Erfahrung und deinem Interesse bringst du dich in eines unserer Fokusgebiete wie Commercial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing oder Digital Health ein und entwickelst neue und kreative Lösungen für die brennendsten Herausforderungen der Life Science Industrie.

- Leiste erstklassige Kundenbetreuung.
Du berätst das Top Management führender Life Science Unternehmen, präsentierst Ergebnisse und Handlungsempfehlungen und baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Überdurchschnittlich gut abgeschlossenes Master-Studium an einer Universität, vorzugsweise im Bereich Finance, Wirtschaft, Management, Medizin oder Naturwissenschaften
- Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
- Sehr gutes Know-How in betriebswirtschaftlichen Prozessen, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Strategie-/Geschäftsmodellentwicklung, Reorganisation, Marketing, Vertrieb oder Logistik
- Erste Erfahrungen in der Strategieberatung oder in einer strategischen Funktion eines renommierten Industrieunternehmens
- Kommunikationsstärke sowie fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten
- Homeoffice
- Attraktive Aufstiegschancen
- Umfangreiche Angebote für Fort-und Weiterbildung
- Versicherungen, Altersvorsorge und lohnenswerte Corporate Benefits, z.B. lokale und überregionale Sportangebote
- Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert

Du und Accenture
In dieser Rolle bist du Teil von Accenture Strategy & Consulting. Der aktuelle Wandel eröffnet Unternehmen zuvor nie dagewesene Chancen. Wir helfen unseren Kunden diese umfassend auszuschöpfen und sich neu zu erfinden.

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist diene Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Bitte füge deine Bewerbung deine aktuellen Zeugnisse hinzu.

jobs.title: Consultant Core Banking Transformation
jobs.description:
In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa per reinventare interi settori di mercato, lavorando con le aziende più importanti a livello mondiale. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.

Entra a far parte del Reinvention Partner Industry & Enterprise nel settore Banking e fai la differenza in un mercato sempre più dinamico, trasformando il modo di lavorare dei nostri Clienti grazie alle tecnologie più evolute.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

Valorizza sul campo le tue competenze per guidare i nostri Clienti del settore Banking verso l'innovazione e la trasformazione del loro business tramite soluzioni che rispondano in modo sempre più efficace ed efficiente alle loro esigenze.
Potrai metterti alla prova accrescendo la tua autonomia e managerialità facendo parte di importanti progetti di:
- Digital Transformation: implementazione di processi di onboarding digitale e miglioramento dell’app di Mobile Banking per un’esperienza utente più completa e intuitiva

- Core Banking and Process Optimization: migrazione a nuovi sistemi di Core Banking e implementazione di soluzioni di automazione robotica per migliorare i processi di back-office bancari

- Revisione e miglioramento end-to-end dei processi bancari tramite l’implementazione delle più evolute tecnologie, ripensando customer e employee journey

- Data Migration and Integration: gestione della migrazione e dell’integrazione dati tra sistemi legacy e nuove piattaforme digitali, assicurando qualità e consistenza dei dati

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B3 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico. La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 36.906,87€ e 46.700€.

Se condividi la nostra passione per la consulenza in ambito Banking e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
- hai maturato un’esperienza dai 2 ai 10 anni in società di consulenza su clienti del settore Bancario (Core Banking Retail and Corporate) e conosci le attuali tecnologie come l'AI, il Cloud Computing, le Application Programming Interfaces e l’Open Banking

- hai familiarità coi principali applicativi IT del settore bancario e con le principali piattaforme di Core Banking

- hai una Laurea Magistrale in discipline Economiche, Ingegneristiche o Scientifiche

jobs.title: S&C Finance Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
Strategy & Consulting Finance Transformation Consultant – CFO & Enterprise Value
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations define their future, create value, develop their digital core, optimize operations, and accelerate growth through strategy, technology, and innovation.
We are looking for Finance Strategy & Transformation Consultants to join our Finance Reinvention Partner practice within Strategy & Consulting , working at the intersection of finance strategy, value creation, operating model transformation, and digital enablement.
You will work with CFOs and executive leadership teams of leading organizations in Spain and internationally to address their most relevant priorities. These range from defining the future vision and operating model of the Finance function to identifying value creation opportunities, shaping transformation roadmaps, and supporting their implementation.
The role is suited for experienced consultants looking to deepen their expertise in the CFO agenda, combining strategic thinking, finance transformation, data, technology, and emerging AI capabilities .
What you will do:
- Support the definition of finance and enterprise value strategies aligned with overall corporate priorities.

- Conduct strategic and operational diagnostics of the Finance function, identifying opportunities across performance management, cost optimization, growth, working capital, and capital efficiency.

- Design end-to-end target finance operating models covering organization, governance, capabilities, processes, sourcing, data, and technology.

- Assess and redesign core finance processes, including R2R, P2P, O2C, FP&A, treasury, tax, and controlling, with a focus on simplification, standardization, and value creation.

- Identify opportunities to digitalize and automate the Finance function through ERP, EPM, Cloud, advanced analytics, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.

- Develop analytical models, insights, business cases, and clear strategic narratives to support decision making and investment prioritization.

- Define transformation roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives according to value, impact, feasibility, dependencies, and implementation requirements.

- Support the delivery of finance transformation programs that combine strategy, technology, data, processes, organization, and people.

- Collaborate with CFOs, executive teams, and multidisciplinary Accenture teams to translate strategic ambition into measurable outcomes.

- Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, and internal initiatives related to the future of finance, enterprise value, and AI-enabled transformation.

What we are looking for:
- 4+ years of experience in strategy consulting, management consulting, financial advisory, Big 4, corporate strategy, finance transformation, or similar environments.

- Experience in one or more of the following areas: finance strategy, operating model design, finance process transformation, performance management, value creation, or large-scale transformation programs.

- Exposure to finance platforms and technologies such as ERP, EPM, Cloud, Analytics, automation, or AI is highly valued.

- Experience or strong interest in Generative AI and Agentic AI applications within the finance domain.

- Ability to structure complex problems, perform rigorous analysis, develop business cases, and build clear, compelling narratives.

- Ability to engage with senior stakeholders and work effectively in multidisciplinary, fast-paced teams.

- Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and project delivery skills.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data, Technology, or a related discipline.

- Fluency in Spanish and English.

What this role offers
- Direct exposure to CFOs, CEOs, and executive leadership teams on strategic and transformation topics.

- Participation in high-impact finance strategy and digital transformation engagements with measurable business outcomes.

- The opportunity to work across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategy and operating model definition to implementation.

- Continuous learning in finance, strategy, Data, AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Cloud, and leading finance technologies.

- Career development within a growing, multidisciplinary team across Accenture Strategy, Consulting, and Technology.

- A hybrid working model, combining remote work and on-site collaboration in our Madrid office.

The role is based in Madrid, under a hybrid working model.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Strategy & Architecture Leader (Financial Services)
Join our Financial Services Technology Strategy & Architecture practice within Accenture Strategy & Consulting. This role sits within the Global Network and focuses on Strategy & Enterprise Architecture for leading Financial Services clients.
As a senior leader, you will drive enterprise-wide business strategy, architecture vision, execution governance, and measurable value realization. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to translate strategic ambition into architecture-enabled delivery and sustained business outcomes.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Capability Network I Areas of Work: Enterprise Strategy & Architecture | Level: Manager | Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Hyderabad/Pune | Years of Exp: 10 to 15 years
Explore An Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
Our Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Architecture Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in Business Strategy , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth.
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced Financial Services Architect / Strategy Leader to drive strategic initiatives across banking and financial services domains. The role will be responsible for shaping business and technology strategy, defining enterprise and domain architecture, and leading the design of future-state operating models and solution landscapes aligned with regulatory, operational, and customer objectives.
This role requires a strong combination of financial services domain expertise, strategic thinking, and hands-on architecture leadership to support complex programs spanning payments, core banking, channels, data, regulatory reporting, customer communication, and digital modernization.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy/Architecture
- Define enterprise architecture vision aligned to business and growth strategy.
- Identify capability gaps and opportunities for digitization, automation, and modernization.
- Design future-state business capability models and target architecture.
- Lead modernization of banking, capital markets and insurance platforms.
- Design overall architecture for modernization initiatives (core banking, wealth payments, lending, digitization underwriting, claims etc.).
- Define system interaction models across channels, middleware, core systems, and external ecosystems.
- Provide recommendation for build versus buy and aid the client in product evaluation if the recommendation is purchase a solution
- Establish architecture governance, principles, standards, and minimal viable guardrails.
- Embed regulatory compliance within architecture with modernization strategy
- Ensure data governance, risk management, and cybersecurity alignment.

Solution Execution
- Translate target architecture into multi‑year, phased roadmap
- Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Security teams to ensure secure‑by‑design architectures.
- Define migration waves and sequencing to minimize business and operational risk.
- Identify quick wins, foundational enablers, and long‑term modernization initiatives.
- Establish clear transition architectures between current and target states.
- Align roadmap with planning & funding cycles, regulatory milestones, business priorities & customer impact
- Align business, product, and technology teams to enterprise vision.
- Drive integration between finance, business, and IT delivery teams.
- Maintain architectural coherence across programs and product portfolios.
- Partner with CIO/CTO leadership to evolve technology operating models.
- Manage and track initiative adoption across front, middle, and back-office functions to ensure sustained benefits realization

Value Realization
- Lead change at pace within a regulatory framework through data-driven decision-making, disciplined risk management, and operational resilience
- Ensure alignment between architecture decisions and value targets.
- Define KPIs, baselines, and benchmarking mechanisms to track benefits realization.
- Prioritize investments using financial impact and cost-benefit analysis.
- Provide executive-level reporting on value delivery, risk, and strategic alignment across multiple workstreams and vendors

- Recent Blogs

Your experience counts!

Master’s or bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, system analysis or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

Technical & Functional Expertise

Architecture & Technology Depth
- Experience in any one of the Banking, Cap Markets and insurance platforms/suites (e.g., Temenos, Avaloq, Mambu, Finastra Suite, Guidewire Suite, Duck Creek, etc.). - Core Banking – Transact, Flexcube, Finacle, BaNCS, etc.
- Payments – GPP, TPH, etc.
- Insurance – Policy Center, Claim Center, Contact Manager, Agency Portal etc.
- Capital Markets – Calypso, Avaloq, Murex, FIS Trading Suite etc.
- Ability to align technology architecture with business outcomes and regulatory obligations.

- Experience in defining current, target, and transition architectures.
- Proven ability to incorporate sequencing, and prioritization approach when defining roadmaps
- Know-how of - Cloud architectures, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and integration patterns.
- Enterprise integration patterns, data architecture, and predictive analytics.
- Security and resilience requirements
- AI, GenAI and Agentic AI uses cases

Industry Experience
- 10+ years of experience in banking (retail, corporate, wealth, investment)/insurance (Life/P&C)/capital markets industry in the strategy and consulting space.
- Proven track record of delivering modernization (digital, core banking, operating model, or regulatory) initiatives
- Exposure to global or multi-county modernization programs preferred
- Deep understanding of banking/insurance/capital markets products, processes, and regulatory landscape and industry standards
- Experience in any of the frameworks/industry standards (e.g., TOGAF, BIAN, Zachman, ISO 20022, SWIFT, Open Banking, etc.).

Leadership Competencies
- Executive presence with ability to influence C-suite stakeholders.
- Strong consulting acumen, stakeholder management, and business development capability.
- Ability to balance long-term architectural vision with short-term execution realities.
- Vendor and technology neutral mindset focused on business outcomes.

What’s in the for you?
- An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

- Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Gestalte die digitale Zukunft systemrelevanter Industrien – mit SAP S/4HANA und deinem Innovationsgeist!

Deine Mission
Mehr als Beratung – eine Transformation gestalten!
Als SAP Business Consultant Resources bist du mitten in digitalen Umbrüchen in der Chemie-, Rohstoff-, Energie- und Versorgungsbranche. Du führst Unternehmen in das Zeitalter von SAP S/4HANA, entwickelst wegweisende Lösungen und begleitest den gesamten Transformationsprozess – von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live. Dabei bist du nicht nur Berater:in: Du bist Vordenker:in, Kommunikator:in, Macher:in und Innovator:in. Du bringst Unternehmen auf das nächste Level und machst ihre Prozesse smarter, effizienter und nachhaltiger. Deine Rolle? Unverzichtbar. Dein Impact? Unermesslich.

Bei Accenture gestaltest Du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem Du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel und hast  auf Wunsch auch in Teilzeit  die Möglichkeit in deinem Team viel zu bewirken, indem die SAP-Systeme der Zukunft dieser Generation aufgebaut werden.

Das erwartet dich
- Erkenne Chancen, bevor sie andere wahrnehmen.
Du analysierst die individuellen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und zeigst, wie SAP S/4HANA völlig neue Potenziale freisetzt – intelligente Automatisierung, datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse und nachhaltige Geschäftsmodelle inklusive. Dein Wissen macht den Unterschied!

- Gestalte Geschäftsbereiche neu – digital, agil, zukunftssicher.
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du maßgeschneiderte Roadmaps für Geschäftsbereiche wie Produktionsplanung, Logistik, Qualitätsmanagement, Einkauf oder Finanzen und optimierst zentrale Unternehmensprozesse. Dein Ziel: Wirklich nachhaltige Transformationen, die über den Standard hinausgehen.

- Übernimm Verantwortung und werde zum Gamechanger.
Du koordinierst dein Projektteam, kommunizierst klar und führst Transformationsprojekte zum Erfolg. Dabei bist du die Brücke zwischen Kunde und Technologie, vermittelst zwischen Fachbereichen und IT – und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen Innovationen werden.

#LI-MP

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet

- Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Transformationsprojekten mit agilen Methoden

- Tiefe Kenntnisse in SAP ECC und SAP S/4HANA – du kennst Prozesse, Funktionen und Module (z. B. FI/CO, EAM, SD, MM, PP, QM, TM, EWM, LBN) wie deine Westentasche

- Branchenexpertise in den Bereichen Energie, Versorgung, Rohstoffe oder Chemie

- Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch und Englisch – du kannst souverän präsentieren und überzeugen

Was wir dir bieten
- Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt – an einem unserer Accenture-Standorte, remote oder direkt beim Kunden

- Flexibilität pur – individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell in Voll- oder Teilzeit

- Wissen, das dich weiterbringt – persönliche Mentoren, umfangreiche Weiterbildungsangebote und echte Karrieremöglichkeiten

- Culture of Celebration – Events, Erfolge und Meilensteine werden gefeiert

jobs.title: Transformation Consultant – IT-Projekte (all genders)
jobs.description:
Mache technologische Transformation greifbar und unterstütze unsere Kunden bei ihren Tech Transformations-Programmen, um neue Arbeitsweisen oder KI-gestütze Lösungen nachhaltig und datenbasierte Steuerungsmodelle langfristig zu verankern.

Deine Mission
Als Transformation Consultant – IT-Projekte bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Mensch, Organisation und technischer Transformation: Du stellst sicher, dass Nutzer:innen neue Technologien, KI-gestützte Prozesse, rollenbasierte Enablement Ansätze und veränderte Arbeitsweisen nicht nur verstehen, sondern aktiv annehmen und in ihren Arbeitsalltag integrieren. Dafür analysierst du ganzheitlich die Auswirkungen der Transformation und behältst die Bedürfnisse aller relevanten Stakeholder im Blick. Du schaffst die besten Voraussetzungen für die Tech Transformation deiner Kunden, indem du passende Transformations-Maßnahmen umsetzt und ihren Erfolg misst, um die nachhaltige Transformation sicherzustellen.

Dabei treibst du zum Beispiel die Agentifizierung des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) voran durch den gezielten Einsatz von Agentic AI, Copilots und intelligenten Automatisierungsansätzen sowie durch Human-in-the-loop Modelle, in denen Mensch und KI effektiv zusammenarbeiten. Du beeinflusst dadurch die Art und Weise, wie Software, insbesondere im Kontext von Custom Development und Plattformlösungen, entwickelt, getestet und ausgerollt und über Agentic Transformation Delivery nachhaltig in der Organisation verankert wird.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich

- Gestalte Transformation, die wirkt – bei den Menschen.
Du befähigst Menschen, Veränderungen nicht nur zu verstehen, sondern aktiv mitzugestalten und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen in ihrem Arbeitsalltag sicher und rollenbasiert umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Produkt-, Entwicklungs- und DevOps-Teams zusammen und verankerst Transformationsmaßnahmen direkt in agilen Delivery- und SDLC-Prozessen. Dafür entwickelst du wirkungsvolle Transformations-, Enablement- und Adoption-Konzepte, die unterschiedliche Rollenprofile berücksichtigen und den Einsatz von AI Tools im Arbeitsalltag greifbar machen. Mit deinem Gespür für Stakeholder identifizierst du die relevanten Akteur:innen im Projekt und gewinnst sie für den Wandel.

- Verankere technologische Innovationen bei unseren Kunden. Du bist bei uns direkt an der Quelle zu innovativen Tech Trends wie GenAI, Agentic AI,Cloud, DevOps und digitalen Plattformlösungen. Du hilfst unseren Kunden, diese Technologien von ersten Use Cases bis zur skalierbaren Umsetzung in Organisation und Prozessen zu verankern und dabei datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung zu ermöglichen.

- Gestalte Interaktion und Dialog.
Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops und steuerst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen, die Wirkung zeigen. So sorgst du dafür, dass Nutzer:innen Transformationen verstehen, annehmen und mit Überzeugung umsetzen.

- Mache Transformation messbar und nachhaltig.
Du trackst anhand ausgewählter Kennzahlen, ob deine Transformations-Maßnahmen erfolgreich waren und die Akzeptanz der Nutzer:innen steigt. Auf dieser Basis optimierst du deine Ansätze kontinuierlich: für echte Adoption, wertschaffende Delivery und messbaren Business Value.

Darauf freuen wir uns

- Du hast bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Transformations Management von komplexen IT-Programmen, insbesondere im Bereich Workshop und Experience Gestaltung, Kommunikation, Impact Analysen, rollenbasiertem Enablement und agile Ways of Working.
- Du hast dein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business/Transformation, IT Management, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, (Arbeits- oder Wirtschafts-)Psychologie, oder vergleichbare Studiengänge mit IT-Fokus abgeschlossen.
- Zukunftsweisenden Themen wie Agentic AI, Cybersecurity & Digital Trust, Data & Analytics, SAP, Cloud, DevOps etc. und alles rund um Künstliche Intelligenz interessieren dich brennend. Du hast auch schon die ein oder andere Zertifizierungen in einem der genannten Bereiche.
- Du bist erfahren in der Nutzung und dem Einsatz gängiger KI Tools wie Co-Pilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude oder AgenticAI insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Tech Transformation Management.
- Du hast ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Human in-the-loop-Ansätze, KI, Cloud, DevOps und Plattformorganisationen Arbeitsweisen, Rollen, Governance und Operating Models verändern.
- Du bist präsentationssicher in Deutsch und Englisch und kannst deine Stakeholder in beiden Sprachen gleichwertig managen.
- Du bringst erste Führungserfahrung in cross-funktionalen und internationalen Teams mit.
- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert mit einer starken Kundenorientierung.
- Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen (SDLC) sowie agilen Arbeitsweisen (z. B. Scrum, SAFe) und bist es gewohnt, mit Entwicklungs-, Produkt- und DevOps-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

- Individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell mit flexibel anpassbaren Arbeitszeiten

jobs.description:

Als SAP Consultant im Supply Chain Management bist du verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf der Lieferkettensysteme unserer Kunden.

Als SAP SCM Consultant unterstützt du unsere Kunden, die Vorteile von SAP-Lösungen im Lieferkettenmanagement optimal zu nutzen – und damit erfolgreich in die Zukunft zu gehen.

Mit deiner Expertise kennst du dich gleichermaßen in IT und Business aus und arbeitest Hands-On bei der Umsetzung und Implementierung unserer SAP-Projekte  mit.

Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, welche die heutigen als auch zukünftigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden erfüllen werden.

jobs.title: Tech GCC advisory manager
jobs.description:
Job Title - GCC Technology Advisory Manager
Management Level: 07 – Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
Must have skills: GCC (Global Capability Centers) Strategy, Digital & Technology Strategy, Technology Operating Model Design, Sourcing Strategy, Business Case Formulation, IT Processes & Governance
Good to have skills: Tech M&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture
Job Summary:
- Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
- Own and lead projects – guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
- Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
- Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks , and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
- Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI-enabled transformation
- Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
- Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- GCC Strategy and Setup : lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
- Cost Analysis and Value Realization : develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
- KPI Design and Performance Frameworks : design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
- Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
- GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
- IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
- RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third-party vendors
- Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
- AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts – covering AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management

Professional & Technical Skills:
- 7–10 years of total experience in strategy consulting , technology advisory, or in-house corporate strategy; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
- Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
- Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital & Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services,  Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
- Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
- Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures ; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
- Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or technology maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
- Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
- Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
- Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
- Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint ; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

What’s in it for you?
- Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
- Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
- Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
- Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

About Our Company | Accenture

Experience: 7–10 years
Educational Qualification: MBA from Tier-1 Institute

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. jobs.title: Junior Strategy Consultant Public Sector (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission
Als Public Sector Strategy Consultant gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft des öffentlichen Sektors. Im Fokus deiner Beratungstätigkeit stehen strategische Grundsatzfragen und organisatorische Richtungsentscheidungen für die Verwaltung von morgen. So treibst du nicht nur die Modernisierung öffentlicher Organisationen voran, sondern schaffst auch nachhaltigen gesellschaftlichen Impact.

Das erwartet dich
- Gestalte die Zukunft des öffentlichen Sektors
Du berätst öffentliche Institutionen wie Ministerien oder staatliche Unternehmen zu zentralen Zukunftsthemen: von der Strategieentwicklung über die Neuausrichtung von Organisationen in Zeiten von agentischer KI bis hin zur Gestaltung komplexer Transformationsvorhaben – du setzt dich mit den aktuell größten Herausforderungen des Public Sectors auseinander, analysierst Zukunftstrends, bringst Innovationsimpulse ein und leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

- Übernimm Verantwortung und bringe dich aktiv ein
Als Junior Consultant führst du zum Beispiel qualitative und quantitative Analysen durch, recherchierst relevante (politische) Rahmenbedingungen und entwickelst Lösungskonzepte sowie Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete – du wertest Informationen aus, bereitest Inhalte adressatengerecht auf, gestaltest innovative Workshops, und stellst die Qualität von Ergebnissen sicher.

- Arbeite und wachse in interdisziplinären Teams
Du arbeitest in interdisziplinär zusammengesetzten, diversen Teams – remote, im Office oder beim Kunden vor Ort. Dich erwartet ein leistungsorientiertes und analytisch geprägtes Umfeld, das Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist gleichermaßen fördert. Unser Team verbindet strategische Exzellenz mit dem Anspruch, echten gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Darauf freuen wir uns

- Du verfügst über einen überdurchschnittlichen universitären Masterabschluss (alle Fachrichtungen).

- Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Strategieberatung, dem öffentlichen Sektor oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.

- Du zeichnest dich durch analytische Schärfe, ein strukturiertes Denkvermögen sowie eine hohe Lernbereitschaft aus.

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig, mit einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick.

- Du hast Freude an einer teamorientierten Arbeitsweise und an der gemeinsamen Entwicklung innovativer Lösungsansätze.

- Du überzeugst durch ein souveränes und empathisches Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.

Was wir dir bieten
- Einen starken Teamspirit – geprägt von hoher Motivation, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und persönlicher Wertschätzung

- Eine steile Lernkurve durch den Einsatz auf vielfältigen Projekten, regelmäßiges Feedback sowie Mentorings und Coachings

- Ein breites Weiterbildungsangebot – u. a. mit zahlreichen Trainings zur Nutzung von KI

- Regelmäßige Team- und Firmenevents, die Austausch und Vernetzung in unserer Community fördern

- Zahlreiche Benefits, darunter Jobrad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle

Du und Accenture
In dieser Rolle bist du Teil von Accenture Strategy & Consulting . Der aktuelle Wandel eröffnet Unternehmen zuvor nie dagewesene Chancen. Mit ganzheitlichen Strategien helfen wir unseren Kunden, diese umfassend auszuschöpfen und sich neu zu erfinden.

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst

Du hast Fragen? Dann wende dich gerne an unser Recruiting Team per E-Mail an recruiting_germany@accenture.com .

jobs.description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.

You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.

THE WORK

Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:

Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development

- Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.

- Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.

- Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.

- Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

Client Engagement & Advisory Support

- Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.

- Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.

- Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.

- Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

Data & AI Foundations

- Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.

- Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.

- Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.

- Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS

- 1 .5 - 4 years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field.

- Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics.

- Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level.

- Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting.

- Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations.

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

- Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations).

- Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations.

- Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context.

- Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes.

- Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context.

- Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

jobs.title: Junior Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
The Work
We are Technology Strategy and Transformation. We help organizations reinvent technology by aligning business strategy, digital foundations, and AI-driven innovation to unlock measurable enterprise value.
As a Junior Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant, you will work alongside senior client stakeholders and C-suite leaders to solve complex business and technology challenges. You will help shape technology strategies, design future-ready digital architectures, accelerate AI adoption, and deliver transformation programs that create sustainable business outcomes. Working in high-performance teams, you will combine strategic thinking with analytical rigor to help clients make critical technology investment decisions, modernize their technology landscape, strengthen their digital core, and realize value from transformation initiatives. From technology strategy and enterprise architecture to AI-enabled operating models and transformation delivery, you will play a key role in helping clients stay ahead in an increasingly digital world.
- Team  you will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients: In Technology Strategy & Transformation, we articulate a compelling technology vision with industry expertise and context. You will work with C-level executives, digital marketers and/or IT managers. With your ~100 direct colleagues you are at the heart of the change, developing value case and operating model with disruptive technologies in short to medium engagements. As a TS&T junior consultant you will be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and the industry. We devise creative new digital strategies, implementation roadmaps and guide digital transformations based on trends, insights, data and our expertise. Our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts.
- Processes  you get energy from solving complex puzzles and working in teams: Our consultants in Digital Core are changing businesses every day using industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Applying data-driven methods to analyze our clients’ strategic challenges, solving complex problems and helping them realize their business strategy through the right use of new technologies. Beside the work for our clients you will also be contributing to our practice and help the team grow and develop by e.g. participating and organizing events, creating points-of-view, and sharing your knowledge.
- Technology  Convey deep understanding of technology platforms and architecture at intersection of client's industry to (re)define the client’s technology stack. Realize value, advise, and execute medium to longer term technology transformations such as multi-year Cloud journeys with a clear industry focus, leveraging cloud partners and platforms to drive innovation, flexibility and agility across enterprise and build new businesses.
- AI & Data:  You will help clients unlock business value through AI and data. From shaping AI and data strategies to designing operating models and digital foundations, you will support organizations in becoming truly AI-driven enterprises. You will identify high-impact AI opportunities, help scale Generative AI and advanced analytics solutions, and embed data-driven decision-making into business processes and operations. By combining technology, business insight, and storytelling, you will help clients turn data into actionable intelligence and measurable outcomes.

With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Who we are - Accenture Digital Core
In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Digital Core comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialized skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.
Digital Core is one of seven services that make up one Accenture – the others are Cybersecurity, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, Talent, AI & Data, Industry & Process and Technology

Here's what you'll need
Do you want to work with great people and be part of a diverse team? We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the below requirements. We are looking forward to meeting you, so don't hesitate to give us a call and discuss this!
- Completed Master’s degree, preferable with a technical and/or (business) economics focus
- Excellent WO and VWO results, especially on the beta courses
- Extra-curricular activities (e.g. board and/or international experience)
- Strong personality, presentation, and communicative skills
- Fluent in Dutch and English - spoken and written
- Proven affinity with Digital/IT and Technology (e.g., in your hobbies or work experience)

Bonus points if you have
- Analyzing current issues and building a fact-based approach to developing and implementing client visions, road maps and governance to address today's business needs and support future growth
- Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation and curiosity around opportunities and threats posed by innovation and industry convergence.
- Developing a deep understanding of emerging technologies to feed value creation opportunities that often disrupt traditional industry value chains and challenge orthodoxies
- Intellectual capacity to develop creative and breakthrough solutions
- Communicating complex technology concepts easily towards clients and build lasting trusted relationships
- Strong analytical skills, understanding of complex issues, the ability to quickly absorb information, conceptual and creative problem-solving excellence
- First class written and verbal communication skills; the ability to articulate complex problems and solutions in a simple, logical and impactful manner.
- Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment
- Leadership qualities; the ability to easily establish trust-based relationships and gain valuable insights through collaboration and communication
- Drive; enjoys a challenge, proven ability to adapt and remove obstacles to achieve results, determination and optimism
- Multiple years of external consulting experience
- 0-3 years of experience on a transformation program driving value realization, executive storytelling or managing measures of success
- Certifications e.g., Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), SAFe, TOGAF, DAMA, ML, Data Science, Finops, TBM

What's in it for you?
Accenture is a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:
- Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust
- Embrace a sustainable growth mindset
- Live a human-led culture of Inclusion & Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.
- Lead and transform our clients with technology
- Connect with our global network of 700.000 colleagues.

These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:
- Unlimited learning: access to thousands of free courses, classes and workshops.
- Flexible working hours (4x9) & work location
- ‘Do Good’ volunteering program
- 26 vacation days per year
- A laptop, iPhone, and home office setup allowance
- Accenture shares, annual bonus, collective health insurance scheme
- Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties.

What we believe
Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

jobs.title: Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
The Work
We are Technology Strategy and Transformation. We help organizations reinvent technology by aligning business strategy, digital foundations, and AI-driven innovation to unlock measurable enterprise value.
As a Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant, you will work alongside senior client stakeholders and C-suite leaders to solve complex business and technology challenges. You will help shape technology strategies, design future-ready digital architectures, accelerate AI adoption, and deliver transformation programs that create sustainable business outcomes. Working in high-performance teams, you will combine strategic thinking with analytical rigor to help clients make critical technology investment decisions, modernize their technology landscape, strengthen their digital core, and realize value from transformation initiatives. From technology strategy and enterprise architecture to AI-enabled operating models and transformation delivery, you will play a key role in helping clients stay ahead in an increasingly digital world.
- Team  you will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients: In Technology Strategy & Transformation, we articulate a compelling technology vision with industry expertise and context. You will work with C-level executives, digital marketers and/or IT managers. With your ~100 direct colleagues you are at the heart of the change, developing value case and operating model with disruptive technologies in short to medium engagements. As a TS&T consultant you will be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and the industry. We devise creative new digital strategies, implementation roadmaps and guide digital transformations based on trends, insights, data and our expertise. Our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts.
- Processes  you get energy from solving complex puzzles and working in teams: Our consultants in Digital Core are changing businesses every day using industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Applying data-driven methods to analyze our clients’ strategic challenges, solving complex problems and helping them realize their business strategy through the right use of new technologies. Beside the work for our clients you will also be contributing to our practice and help the team grow and develop by e.g. participating and organizing events, creating points-of-view, and sharing your knowledge.
- Technology  Convey deep understanding of technology platforms and architecture at intersection of client's industry to (re)define the client’s technology stack. Realize value, advise, and execute medium to longer term technology transformations such as multi-year Cloud journeys with a clear industry focus, leveraging cloud partners and platforms to drive innovation, flexibility and agility across enterprise and build new businesses.
- AI & Data  [PS1] You will help clients unlock business value through AI and data. From shaping AI and data strategies to designing operating models and digital foundations, you will support organizations in becoming truly AI-driven enterprises. You will identify high-impact AI opportunities, help scale Generative AI and advanced analytics solutions, and embed data-driven decision-making into business processes and operations. By combining technology, business insight, and storytelling, you will help clients turn data into actionable intelligence and measurable outcomes.

With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Who we are - Accenture Digital Core
In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Digital Core comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialized skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.
Digital Core is one of seven services that make up one Accenture – the others are Cybersecurity, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, Talent.

Here's what you'll need
Do you want to work with great people and be part of a diverse team? We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements below. We are looking forward to meeting you, so don't hesitate to give us a call and discuss this!
- Completed Master’s degree, preferable with a technical and/or (business) economics focus
- 3-5 years of experience in technology strategy and/or large scale digital and technology transformations
- Knowledge of the latest technology advancements (in a certain technology area and/or industry) based on previous experience and interest in the latest innovations
- Consulting skills, e.g., solid financial and business acumen, structured and abstract thinking, analytical and creative problem solving, project management, prioritizing, communication, and stakeholder management
- Strong personality, presentation, and communicative skills
- Fluent in Dutch and English - spoken and written
- Proven affinity with Digital/IT and Technology (e.g., in your hobbies or work experience)

Bonus points if you have

jobs.title: Health Strategy & Consulting Internship
jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you a master's student eager to contribute to strategic innovation and digital transformation in healthcare?
At Accenture Netherlands, you'll work on a wide variety of challenges in the health sector; from developing digitalization strategies and improving care processes and services, to analyzing emerging technologies and guiding organizational change. Experienced consultants will coach you in conducting analyses, structuring complex problems, and translating insights into concrete, actionable recommendations for our clients.
Your primary focus will be on healthcare, but as part of the broader Health & Public Services (HPS) team, you'll also gain exposure to public sector projects, broadening your perspective on strategic transformation across both domains.
Duration: 4 to 6 months, starting in February or March.
How to apply: Submit your CV and a cover letter (preferably in Dutch) explaining your interest in Accenture Netherlands and this internship. Please clearly indicate your preferred start date, the length of your internship, and whether you are applying for a work placement or a thesis internship.
What you'll do
As an intern, you'll work alongside consultants on projects for healthcare organizations such as (academic) hospitals, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, health insurers, and other care institutions. You'll explore how care delivery can be made faster and more accessible, how processes can be redesigned more efficiently, or how digital technology can be applied responsibly.
You'll learn to develop and substantiate strategies through structured analysis. Your contributions may lead to reduced costs, shorter throughput times, improved digital care services, or more efficient processes for our clients.
What to expect
Working internship: You'll have the opportunity to shape your own experience and explore your personal interests. You'll contribute to various projects including business analyses, stakeholder and market analyses, support in developing business proposals, and research into client systems and functionalities. You are encouraged to bring your own ideas and initiatives, so you can challenge yourself and get the most out of your internship.
Thesis internship: It is also possible — in consultation with your supervisor — to combine your internship with writing your thesis. You are encouraged to choose a topic that aligns with your studies and adds value to one of our clients. You'll receive all the guidance and resources needed to complete your thesis while continuing to contribute to the HPS team.
How we reinvent
This internship sits within our Industry & Enterprise Strategy practice, where we combine deep sector expertise with advanced technology to deliver 360° value for our clients. You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team working on the future of intelligent health services, leveraging our global network, platforms, and partnerships to bring ideas to life.

What we're looking for

Education: Currently enrolled in a master's program at a Dutch university for the full duration of the internship. Preferred fields of study include Healthcare/Life Sciences, Public or Business Administration, Health Policy & Management, or closely related disciplines.
Skills: Affinity with healthcare and/or the public sector; you actively follow the latest developments in technology and health policy.
Mindset: Ambitious and proactive, naturally critical and analytical, a strong communicator, and a team player.
Bonus points: Involvement in extracurricular activities such as student organizations, Defensity College, Society College, De Kleine Consultant, etc.
Location: Amsterdam
Languages: Fluent Dutch and English required

What we offer
Learning opportunities: Access to our Learning & Development Platform.
Guidance: Support from a dedicated internship supervisor (People Lead) and a buddy.
Culture & Community: You'll be part of an open culture that actively encourages you to get the most out of your internship. Through close guidance and support, you'll quickly find your footing within both HPS and Accenture NL. Your week will offer a balanced mix of personal development and informal interaction with colleagues at all levels. The more proactive and assertive you are, the more you'll take away from your internship.
Extras: Competitive internship allowance and travel expense reimbursement.
Inclusion, Diversity & Social Impact: Do Good Volunteer Program, I&D Networks, Refugee Talent Track.
