jobs.description:
This role is with our Partners in Performance  team, part of Accenture.

Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture is a global management consulting firm with a focus on human performance working alongside client partners to make change happen. We’ve got offices in Australia, New Zealand, South-East Asia, Africa, North and South America and Europe but prefer to spend as little time in them as possible. Instead, we work alongside our clients to unleash their potential and deliver lasting impact that you hardly ever achieve by sitting in a boardroom.

IF YOU THINK CONSULTING IS MAKING GREAT POWERPOINT DECKS, KEEP WALKING.

Don’t get us wrong. We admire a sharp PowerPoint™ presentation as much as the next global consulting company. Heck, we make plenty ourselves. And we respect the people who are good at making them. But give us the choice between a column of perfectly aligned bullet points and delivering a plan that helps turn a client’s business around and the decision is a no-brainer. At Partners in Performance, being a Senior Associate isn’t about writing reports, or standing up and presenting them. It’ about the results. We’re here to deliver big, rapid, sustainable results for our clients. Deliver. Not just recommend. So, our end product isn’t a report, it’s what happens once we work alongside the client to implement what’s in it. It’s why our clients around the world choose us, and why we choose a certain type of person to fill our key roles. Like this one: Senior Associate

Now that you’ve finished your MBA – and maybe even had a few years in a commercial role – you’ll be looking for the opportunity to turn your insights into business results. As a Partners in Performance Senior Associate those results could impact some of the world’s largest companies.

This role combines analysis with outcomes in a way that will challenge and develop you– all the time with the full support and mentoring of your fellow Partners in Performance colleagues. Once the recommendations built on your analysis are agreed to, you can expect to work alongside clients from the shop floor to the C-suite to help make them happen. Whether it’s process improvement, supply chain optimization or back office transformation, you’ll help turn your recommendations into results for your clients.

The nuts and bolts.
We’re looking for Senior Associates in our Americas business. You’ll also need a distinction average in a Master’s degree or MBA and up to 6 years’ commercial experience is desirable. Working with Analytics is like breathing to us, so Excel and general math ability are important. We love interesting people, so please include your community, sporting and volunteering experience in your CV. Our priority is to work along side our clients at the site, where the action is happening. Work travel and working on heavy industry, construction like sites, are a norm for us. Come work with the front lines, boots on the ground and be a part of the action.

This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 80% as part of the role.

Visit pip.global , Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture on LinkedIn, or @lifeatpip on Instagram to get to know us better.

You must submit a cover letter, resume and transcript as part of your application. Application deadline is October 23, 2026.

- Master's Degree or MBA with an anticipated graduation date of Winter 2026/2027 or Spring/Summer 2027

- English is required for this position as this role will be aligned to multi-national teams where English is the common language across our North America Market. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking multi-national teams, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

- Experience or academic exposure to the Natural Resources industry and/or operations consulting
- Exposure to or interest in working in field-based environments such as mining, heavy industry, or construction sites

- Willingness and ability to travel for client engagements as business needs require, including potential for frequent on-site client presence

jobs.title: Partners in Performance - Performance Strategy Senior Associate
jobs.description:
This role is with our Partners in Performance  team, part of Accenture.

Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture is a global management consulting firm with a focus on human performance working alongside client partners to make change happen. We’ve got offices in Australia, New Zealand, South-East Asia, Africa, North and South America and Europe but prefer to spend as little time in them as possible. Instead, we work alongside our clients to unleash their potential and deliver lasting impact that you hardly ever achieve by sitting in a boardroom.

IF YOU THINK CONSULTING IS MAKING GREAT POWERPOINT DECKS, KEEP WALKING.

Don’t get us wrong. We admire a sharp PowerPoint™ presentation as much as the next global consulting company. Heck, we make plenty ourselves. And we respect the people who are good at making them. But give us the choice between a column of perfectly aligned bullet points and delivering a plan that helps turn a client’s business around and the decision is a no-brainer. At Partners in Performance, being a Senior Associate isn’t about writing reports, or standing up and presenting them. It’ about the results. We’re here to deliver big, rapid, sustainable results for our clients. Deliver. Not just recommend. So, our end product isn’t a report, it’s what happens once we work alongside the client to implement what’s in it. It’s why our clients around the world choose us, and why we choose a certain type of person to fill our key roles. Like this one: Senior Associate

Now that you’ve finished your MBA – and maybe even had a few years in a commercial role – you’ll be looking for the opportunity to turn your insights into business results. As a Partners in Performance Senior Associate those results could impact some of the world’s largest companies.

This role combines analysis with outcomes in a way that will challenge and develop you– all the time with the full support and mentoring of your fellow Partners in Performance colleagues. Once the recommendations built on your analysis are agreed to, you can expect to work alongside clients from the shop floor to the C-suite to help make them happen. Whether it’s process improvement, supply chain optimization or back office transformation, you’ll help turn your recommendations into results for your clients.

The nuts and bolts
We’re looking for Senior Associates in our Americas business. You’ll also need a distinction average in a Master’s degree or MBA and up to 6 years’ commercial experience is desirable. Working with Analytics is like breathing to us, so Excel and general math ability are important. We love interesting people, so please include your community, sporting and volunteering experience in your CV. Our priority is to work along side our clients at the site, where the action is happening. Work travel and working on heavy industry, construction like sites, are a norm for us. Come work with the front lines, boots on the ground and be a part of the action.

This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 80% as part of the role.

Visit pip.global , Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture on LinkedIn, or @lifeatpip on Instagram to get to know us better.

Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of professional experience
- Bachelor Degree
- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's Degree or MBA
- Natural Resources Industry experience and/or operations consulting experience
- Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with on-site travel comprising approximately 80% of the role
- Experience on mining, heavy industry, or construction sites
- Analytics experience including excel and general math

jobs.title: Strategy Consultant – Capital Projects in Resources (Utilities, Energy/Oil & Gas, Chemicals, or Natural Resources)
jobs.description:
THE WORK:

- Join our Strategy practice as part of Industry Strategy – Resources team and play a key role in shaping the future of capital-intensive organizations across the energy transition.
- Work side by side with global, cross-functional teams to design and deliver strategies that guide major capital investments from early-stage feasibility and project development to commissioning and operations handover.
- Advise clients on the strategic and commercial dimensions of large-scale capital projects: new greenfield and brownfield plant construction, grid infrastructure expansions, energy storage deployments, data center grid connections, LNG terminals, refinery upgrades, and industrial decarbonization programs.
- Support clients in structuring capital project portfolios prioritizing investments, sequencing build-out phases, and aligning capital allocation with long-term strategic objectives.
- Conduct asset portfolio analysis for clients managing large infrastructure or production asset bases assessing reinvestment vs. divestment trade-offs and optimizing portfolios across geographies or business units.
- Lead strategic engagements from problem framing and analysis to solution design, covering project economics, permitting and regulatory strategy, technology selection, and go/no-go investment decisions.
- Advise senior executives and project sponsors, delivering insights that shape critical investment decisions at board and C-suite level.
- Analyze project economics and financial models including CAPEX/OPEX structuring, levelized cost benchmarking, and project finance considerations to turn data into actionable investment strategies.
- Help clients rethink how capital projects are governed and delivered design and optimize PMO structures, project delivery models, and owner-operator capabilities to improve schedule, cost, and quality outcomes.
- Apply data-driven insights, digital tools, and engineering simulation outputs to accelerate project decisions and de-risk capital programs.
- Create high-impact deliverables such as investment committee presentations, strategic roadmaps, feasibility assessments, and capital program playbooks

Required Qualifications:
- Master's degree in electrical engineering, power systems, civil/mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related technical discipline. An additional degree in economics, finance, or business administration is a plus.
- Minimum 4 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, project development, or capital project advisory within the Resources industry (Utilities, Energy/Oil & Gas, Chemicals, or Natural Resources).
- Hands-on exposure to one or more phases of a capital project lifecycle: feasibility, front-end engineering and design (FEED), permitting, EPC/construction management, commissioning, or operations ramp-up.
- Experience with contractor or vendor management in a capital project context including procurement strategy, tendering processes, contract negotiation, or construction contractor oversight.
- Experience in technical or commercial analysis supporting investment decisions including project economics, technology assessments, grid connection studies, or infrastructure planning.
- Experience working with senior stakeholders (C-suite, project sponsors, or regulators) in a consulting or advisory context.
- Fluency in English and German or French (spoken and written).
- Willingness to travel and work on client sites as required.

- Experience on cross-border infrastructure or energy transition projects (e.g., grid interconnections, data center power supply, offshore wind, green hydrogen, carbon capture).
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing grid access, permitting, and energy market participation in European markets.
- Familiarity with major EPC/EPCM contracting models and their risk allocation implications (lump sum, reimbursable, hybrid) across different project types and geographies.
- MBA or other advanced business degree complementing a technical background.
- Familiarity with digital tools, AI/ML solutions, or advanced analytics applied to capital project strategy and portfolio management.

- Join one of our Strategy Practice as part of Industry Strategy – Life Sciences (LS) and play a key role in shaping the future of leading organizations.
- Work side by side with global, cross-functional teams to design and deliver strategies that transform businesses and drive real impact for our clients from LS industry.
- Advise clients on a highly diversified set of strategic topics in R&D, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Operations etc., while working end-to-end from strategy development to implementation.
- Conduct both primary and secondary research to discover key insights and findings relevant to client projects.
- Lead qualitative (e.g. KOL interviews) and quantitative analysis (e.g. claims and patient data, financial data, financial modeling and sales projections, etc.) as required during client engagements.
- Synthesize the insights from the analyses, develop strategic recommendations based on the insights, and create action plans to implement the recommendations.
- Develop and produce quality client deliverables including presentations, reports, workshops and key findings summaries.
- Support senior team members with business development efforts including writing proposals.
- Develop commercial capability assets, including white papers, industry reports, POVs, and thought capital pieces for publication.
- Create high-impact deliverables such as C-suite presentations, strategic roadmaps, and action-oriented playbooks.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences, business, economics, engineering, or a related field.
- Minimum 4 years of professional experience in strategy consulting or relevant roles within the Life Sciences or Healthcare industry.
- Experience supporting strategy engagements across areas such as R&D, Commercial, Medical Affairs, or Operations.
- Experience conducting primary and secondary research and performing qualitative and quantitative analyses.
- Ability to synthesize data and insights into strategic recommendations and actionable plans.
- Experience developing client deliverables such as presentations, reports, and strategic roadmaps.
- English fluency (written and spoken).
- Willingness to travel and work on client sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA or other advanced degree.
- Experience managing project workstreams or supporting business development activities.
- Familiarity with digital tools, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled approaches in strategy.
- International or cross-border project experience.
- Fluency in German or other European languages.

What we offer:
- Employment contract.
- A flexible working model - mostly remote, but with opportunities to collaborate directly with clients across Europe.
- Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.
- A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification).
- Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.
- Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares.
- Paid employee referral program.
- Private medical care, life insurance.
- Access to the WorkSmile platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card)​

- Merger integrations to help our clients plan and successfully execute integration phases across all functions (IT, operations, finance, HR, supply chain, etc.)

Un lugar de trabajo único, descubrí los beneficios que tenemos para vos:
🍔 Pedidos Ya

🏆 Bonos

y muchos ➕!
🏢 Tenemos a disposición oficinas en CABA, Córdoba, Mar del Plata, Rosario, Salta y Mendoza !  Y si estás en otras provincias nuestras posiciones son remotas, para que puedas trabajar desde tu casa! 🌎

📌 Data & AI Consultant
Accenture – Technology Advisory

🎯 Descripción del rol
Buscamos un/a Data & AI Consultant con fuerte perfil técnico para sumarse al equipo de Technology Advisory. La persona participará en el diseño e implementación de soluciones de datos y AI en entornos cloud, trabajando junto a equipos multidisciplinarios para transformar datos en valor tangible para nuestros clientes. El foco estará puesto en la construcción de pipelines, procesamiento y modelado de datos, implementación de soluciones analíticas y de AI, y acompañamiento técnico en proyectos de transformación digital.

🚀 Responsabilidades
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT). Integrar y transformar datos provenientes de múltiples fuentes. Trabajar con grandes volúmenes de datos en entornos cloud. Desarrollar soluciones en Python (pandas, PySpark, etc.). Implementar procesos en Databricks / Spark. Participar en el desarrollo y puesta en producción de modelos de ML/AI. Optimizar procesos de datos para performance y escalabilidad. Colaborar con equipos de negocio y tecnología para entender requerimientos y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas. Aplicar buenas prácticas de versionado, testing y documentación. Contribuir a definiciones técnicas dentro de proyectos de transformación digital.

Lo que te hará exitoso (requisitos):
Formación y experiencia
- Título universitario en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Computer Science, Business o afines (MBA deseable).

- Inglés avanzado (C1).

- +5 años liderando programas tecnológicos o transformaciones digitales.

- +5 años trabajando con metodologías ágiles.

- +3 años de experiencia profunda en tecnologías data & AI.

- +1 año en proyectos de BI, AI o GenAI.

- Experiencia en consultoría (deseable).

jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
TLDR: You would advise the world's most important technology and AI companies on their most transformational questions. You would be joining a team / community where you can build a career as a true industry strategist and make a lasting impact on yourself & the market.

We Are:
Technology companies - Software, AI, Advertising Platforms, Dual-Sided Marketplaces, and Hyperscalers - are rewriting every industry and we advise the companies doing the rewriting & have an inside look every day in this massive transformation. We are the industry strategists and advisors supporting the world's most consequential technology companies: hyperscalers building the infrastructure that powers the global economy, software platforms reinventing how they grow and compete, and AI-native companies building an entirely new category.
We work on the problems that don't have answers yet. How do you monetize an AI-native product at scale? How do you build and operate data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand? How do you transform a $50B enterprise without losing the speed that made it great? Our work generally focuses on four domains:
- Product & Go to Market | inclusive of building, launching, and scaling products; driving forward deployed engagements to infuse the customer in the product; reinventing product lifecycles to accelerate growth; improving monetization; and driving more profitable innovation

- Platform Services | shifting platforms from manual operations to Data & AI-powered services that maximize trust, growth, and efficiency at billion-user scale

- AI Compute Capabilities | inclusive of helping companies design, build, and operate AI infrastructure efficiently; improving data center delivery, utilization, and ROI across the full lifecycle while concurrently identifying cost takeout opportunities across the business

- Transformation + Value | inclusive of driving reinvention for companies and the industry — transforming companies end-to-end across their mega-processes; leading the value/ROI identification for AI; and orchestrating the industry focus around customer zero

You Are:
A senior strategy advisor with professional experience working in the tech industry (Software, Hyperscalers, and AI-native companies). You are passionate about the industry and excited to tackle new problems without a playbook each day. You are energized by working in fast-moving, complex environment that is changing constantly. You are easily able to harness that complexity and define actionable strategies that your clients can execute at scale. You keep up with the market trends but also actively shape how your clients stay ahead. You thrive in ambiguity, support + grow the teams around you, and build the kind of trusted client relationships that last well beyond a single engagement. As a Principal Director you are a true Subject Matter Expert, bringing deep domain judgment that shapes direction and ambition.

The Work:
- Serve as the senior strategic advisor to our most important clients when the stakes are highest - defining strategies and roadmaps that help technology companies stay ahead; spanning product strategy, AI adoption, data center strategy and implementation, total cost of ownership for AI, and go-to-market planning.

- Shape the strategic choices defining the next generation of technology companies; where to play, how to win, how AI changes the business, and what capabilities and operating model are required to lead.

- Size markets, model financial scenarios, and build the business cases that support major client decisions; from new product investments to large-scale infrastructure builds to operating model changes.

- Identify cost reduction and efficiency opportunities across the business including AI-related spend, infrastructure utilization, and operational overhead.

- Build the analytical foundation for client decisions; synthesizing market dynamics, competitive signals, financial data, and operational inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Develop client-ready materials that communicate complex ideas simply and drive decisions at the executive level.

- Crack the industry's most complex challenges — platform scalability, ecosystem monetization, AI-driven developer enablement — by building ironclad business cases and delivering insights that inspire confident, decisive action.

- Build and sustain Accenture's most strategic client relationships at the executive level - becoming the trusted thought partner that C-suite leaders call before they call anyone else.

- Define the intellectual frontier of our practice — lead the creation of breakthrough thought leadership, represent Accenture at premier industry forums, and help shape the future of technology companies.

- Develop the next generation of senior strategists — invest in the talent pipeline, model what great looks like, and build a team that consistently punches above its weight.

- Meaningfully contribute to work products at critical moments (e.g., problem framing, key POVs, executive narratives).

- Distinguish your contribution as selective and high‑impact.

- Elevate thinking, challenge assumptions, and materially strengthen outcomes when stakes are highest.

- Travel: Average 40 to 50% (up to 80% as needed).

Here's What You Need:
- A Bachelor's degree.
- Minimum of 10 years of professional experience working in strategy in the tech industry or at a consulting firm.

Bonus Points If:
- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
- Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
- A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
- Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems.
- Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
- Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

In Accenture Operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Business Transformation Analyst to support clients in designing, implementing, scaling, and optimizing enterprise transformation initiatives across industries.
Part of the role will focus on helping clients design, set up, scale, and improve Global Capability Centers (GCCs). At the same time, the role remains broader, meaning that you will work on a broad range of topics related to business transformations. This covers operating model transformation, governance frameworks, service delivery improvements, talent strategies, technology enablement, and transformation roadmaps for our clients, where you will typically work as a business analyst, support in these changes.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, structured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and execution discipline, with an interest in how GCCs, Shared Services, Global Business Services, AI, automation, and analytics can help organizations build scalable capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Accenture Operations

As part of Accenture Operations, you focus on executing plans efficiently and achieving short-term objectives in line with the strategic goals. Within Operations, we also typically have longer engagements to ensure effective transformations, and the right capacity and capabilities are in place.
You will work together with our colleagues from different reinvention partners such as Talent, Digital Core and Industry & Enterprise. While their focus will be on setting up the operating model, our focus on Operations is to work together on implementing and executing the change and ensuring a smooth transformation for clients by achieving operational excellence. You typically work with mid-level management and department heads at the client and make a bridge to their operations through a hands-on approach.

Key Responsibilities

Transformation Delivery
- Support the planning and execution of business transformation, enterprise operating model, service delivery improvement, and capability-building initiatives across industries.
- Support clients in defining and executing GCC-related transformation initiatives, including setup, scale-up, optimization, transition planning, and value realization.
- Contribute to operating model design activities, including service scope, governance, talent considerations, process ownership, location considerations, and technology enablement.
- Help shape GCC operating models by supporting capability maps, service portfolios, governance forums, KPIs, SLAs, escalation paths, and decision-making structures.
- Support maturity assessments, benchmarking studies, business case development, transition planning, and value realization.
- Support transformation planning across business functions, retained organizations, operational teams, and third-party partners.
- Develop an understanding of how AI, automation, analytics, process excellence, and digital tools can improve productivity, operational performance, scalability, and business outcomes.
- Assist in developing transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, RAID logs, delivery trackers, and value realization updates.
- Support process documentation, process mapping, and process improvement activities.

Analysis & Insights
- Analyze operating models, organizational structures, service delivery models, governance frameworks, capability structures, and business processes.
- Develop insights and recommendations supported by qualitative and quantitative analysis.
- Create reports and presentation materials for client and internal discussions.

Stakeholder Management
- Collaborate with client stakeholders, internal teams, and subject matter experts across business, operations, technology, HR, finance, and transformation functions.
- Support workshops, meetings, and working sessions to gather requirements and structure discussions
- Change Management & PMO
- Support change management and adoption activities linked to new processes, tools, roles, service delivery models, and ways of working.
- Track progress against milestones, KPIs, value realization metrics, transition deliverables, and agreed transformation outcomes.
- Support project management activities including planning, reporting, dependency management, issue resolution, resource coordination, and status updates.

Qualifications

Required
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, Operations, or a related discipline.
- 1-2 years of experience in consulting, enterprise transformation, PMO, operations, change management, or business transformation.
- Fluency in Dutch and excellent command of English.
- Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and data storytelling skills.
- Excellent PowerPoint, Excel, and executive communication capabilities.
- Familiarity with Agile methodologies, project management, change management, PMO practices, and transformation delivery disciplines.
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau.
- Awareness of AI-enabled transformation, automation, analytics, digital productivity tools, or process excellence initiatives.
- Interest in Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), service delivery models, or enterprise operating model transformation.
- Exposure to process mapping, process documentation, and continuous improvement methodologies.
- Exposure to change management and adoption activities.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred
- Experience supporting or contributing to GCC, Shared Services, GBS, service delivery, operating model, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

- Understanding of GCC concepts, service transition, governance models, value realization, talent strategies, location strategy, and continuous improvement.

- Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification, training, or practical exposure; Green Belt exposure is a plus.

Key Competencies
- Structured problem solving
- Analytical thinking
- Communication & storytelling
- Collaboration & teamwork
- Adaptability & learning agility
- Results orientation

About Accenture

YOU ARE

You define how process transformation work gets done within your industry or function — setting the methodology, governing quality, and making sure every engagement reflects deep domain expertise as well as the right delivery standard. You manage and develop your team, coach senior specialists on what good looks like in your domain, and connect with technology and delivery partners to make sure the process and platform work fit together.
You've made AX Design, the intersection of human, agent, and process part of the team's methodology — you've worked out how to apply it in your domain context, and you coach your team on what human+AI agent experience design looks like in practice.

THE WORK

Embed AI into future state design for clients as well as in ways of working for your full workstream using the appropriate AI tools and creating agents strategically to aid in deliverable creation.

- Determine the client facilitation approach: discovery workshop methodology, recommendation presentation standards, and approval governance.

- Define the benchmarking and transformation roadmap methodology the team applies.

- Determine how domain expertise and functional playbook methodology are applied consistently across the team's portfolio of engagements.

- Manage client stakeholder facilitation activities — discovery workshops, recommendation presentations, and day-to-day relationship management.

- Approve final process designs before client delivery.

- Manage and develop direct reports; coach senior specialists on process redesign, domain application, and senior leadership presentation.

- Connect with technology and delivery partners to make sure process design and platform work fit together on joint deliverables.

You will bring together HR strategy, operating model, organisation design, workforce transformation, technology, data and AI to help clients reinvent how their organisations and people work, creating better experiences and driving stronger business outcomes.
You will also play a key leadership role in growing Accenture's HR Reinvention capability in Ireland – developing our market presence, shaping new opportunities and building the next generation of HR transformation talent.

Our Talent practice sits within Accenture's Consulting business and helps organisations reinvent how their people and organisations work.
We combine deep expertise in HR, organisation, talent, workforce transformation and change with Accenture's capabilities in technology, data and AI to help clients turn strategy into tangible business outcomes.
We partner with our clients to:
- Shape and deliver the future of HR, redesigning HR strategies, operating models, capabilities, processes and employee experiences.
- Harness technology, data and AI to create more intelligent, efficient and insight-led HR organisations.
- Design future-ready organisations and workforces , including organisation structures, skills, roles and workforce strategies.
- Transform how work gets done , helping organisations respond to changing business models, technology and workforce expectations.
- Embed sustainable organisational change across complex business and technology transformations.

We are continuing to grow our Talent practice in Ireland and are looking for a senior HR Transformation Leader who can help us build and scale our HR Reinvention capability.
In this role you will:
- Advise senior executives and HR leaders on their most important people and HR challenges, helping them define a compelling vision and roadmap for enterprise-wide people and workforce transformation.
- Lead HR strategy and transformation engagements , spanning HR strategy, HR operating model, organisation design, workforce strategy, service delivery, employee experience and HR function optimisation.
- Shape technology and AI-enabled HR transformation , helping clients understand how emerging technologies, automation, data and generative AI can transform HR services, roles and ways of working.
- Lead complex transformation programmes from strategy through execution , ensuring strategic ambitions translate into practical changes to organisation, process, technology, skills and ways of working.
- Develop evidence-based recommendations and business cases , using data, benchmarks, external insight and leading practices to identify opportunities and demonstrate value.
- Facilitate executive workshops and design sessions , challenging established thinking and helping leadership teams shape the future of their organisation, workforce and ways of working.
- Build trusted senior client relationships , acting as a strategic adviser and bringing together the right capabilities from across Accenture to address complex client challenges.
- Shape and grow new business , identifying opportunities, developing propositions and leading proposals, solution design, scoping, commercials and client pitches.
- Lead and develop high-performing teams , providing direction, coaching and support while creating opportunities for our people to grow.
- Help grow our HR Reinvention practice in Ireland , strengthening our capabilities, propositions, market presence and external profile.

What We're Looking For
We are looking for an experienced HR transformation leader who combines deep functional HR expertise with strong consulting, commercial and leadership capability.
You will ideally bring:
- Deep HR transformation expertise , with strong knowledge across areas such as HR strategy, HR operating models, organisation design, workforce strategy, HR service delivery, employee experience and HR technology.
- Significant experience leading complex HR transformation programmes , ideally spanning strategy through implementation and involving meaningful changes to organisation, process, technology and ways of working.
- A strong understanding of the future of HR , including the opportunities created by AI, automation, data and emerging technologies and their implications for HR functions and the workforce.

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills , with the ability to turn complex challenges, data and insights into clear strategic choices and practical recommendations.

- A passion for developing people , with a strong track record of coaching teams, building capability and creating an inclusive environment in which people can perform at their best.

jobs.description:
Role: HR Transformation Senior Manager
Talent Reinvention Partner - HR Transformation
Location : London

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge. We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” –

Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
About the team:
HR Transformation Consulting Services is a cross-industry capability, which is focused on developing and delivering market leading, innovative HR solutions to our clients. This practice is part of our UKI Talent and Organisation/Human Potential practice which leads on combining our HR Transformation and HR Technology consulting with programme leadership capabilities, change management, and leadership expertise, helping our clients to shape and deliver world-class colleague experience, HR services underpinned by digital enablement to unlock their human potential.
Accenture’s HR Transformation capability is a recognised market leader in HR Consulting. We have worked with our clients to create leading edge HR organizations, processes and practices that deliver measurable improvements in the performance of people and the organization. Our HR professionals provide knowledge and experience that help today's companies blueprint their HR strategy, operating model and support the planning, design, and deployment activities required to achieve broad HR transformational changes across the enterprise. Accenture provides strong methods, tools, and accelerators founded in best in class thought leadership to help our client’s structure, launch, and implement these large-scale transformation programs which drives productivity, effectiveness and improves workforce performance.
Following a period of sustained growth, we are expanding our practice with ambitions to scale at pace and are looking for enthusiastic professionals to further our HR capabilities and share our passion for innovative HR.  As a group of practitioners, we work very closely with the world’s largest organisations which gives us a strong understanding of the challenges they face and how our strong ties in the wider Accenture community can support them.
In our team you will:
You'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of HR experts, this could be the role for you. As part of our team, you'll be working with cutting-edge HR technologies and will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of new skills on the job.
In this role you will:
- Lead HR Strategy & Consulting projects for our clients, and help shape their People strategy, lead the HR function optimisation and drive the HR led enterprise transformation
- Leverage our HR Strategy & Consulting offerings to lead and client proposals and conversatoins
- Lead the organisation’s journey towards strategic goals and support them to build people capability and capacity in the organisation through HR function capability and maturity assessments, defining of the strategic vision, HR operating model & organisation design, and implementation
- Lead strategic decision making through collection and analysis and deliver data driven insights, recommendations, and innovation to solve our client’s challenges such as HR Benchmarks and POVs
- Lead the Identification of need for change in the organisation that is linked to strategy and working with senior client leaders to agree on approach and implementation plan.
- Lead strategic initiatives portfolio assessments, business and value case development, prioritisation, and execution of benefit realisation across all HR Transformation including technology
- Challenge our clients to think differently in how HR can support the workforce of the future and agile enterprise and leverage our point of views, where applicable to drive the discussions
- Facilitate workshops or meetings to gather requirements, present and validate solutions options and test interpretation of client needs in an interactive manner using design thinking methodologies as appropriate
- Act as an innovative solution architect for HR Transformation programmes across planning, scoping, resourcing, and commercials for the solutions in the space of People strategy, operating model, business case development and implementation
- Guide the team on delivery through excellent project management disciplines and agile methods, including development of detailed project plans, key quality deliverables and working and delivering to time constraints
- Develop innovative HR thought leadership and assets to help re-define the role of HR for our clients.
- Establish good working relationships and collaboration across Accenture, both multi-discipline Strategy & consulting capabilities and business lines such as Technology and Operations.
- Become a strategic advisor and establish trusted relationships with key client stakeholders

We are looking for experience in the following skills:
- A strategic thinker with an ability to balance between long-term strategic outcomes and day to day delivery
- Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to sell and deliver large programmes of work
- Excellent understanding of latest HR trends, strategy, and operational value levers, how the role of HR is changing, and the digital enablers required to add value to an organisation.
- Track record of delivering strategic projects including but not limited to complex operating model and organisation design & HR technology transformation, both globally across multiple geographies and variety of models (e.g. lean organisations, shared services/centres of excellence, talent led, and onshore/offshore).
- A sound understanding of end-to-end People function capabilities from Talent Acquisition to Talent Management and Service Operations
- Experience of working in an HR environment consisting of business partnering/relationship management with business leaders supported by an ecosystem of operations, technology and vendors
- Deep expertise in one or more of the following: HR Transformation and/or strategic programme management roles for operating model changes, restructures or ZBB/ZBO programmes
- Strong consulting acumen by demonstrating excellent communication, facilitation and data analysis skills to influence others
- Demonstrable experience in leading large, disparate teams across multiple geographies, with an ability to coach and support each colleague’s personal and professional development
- Demonstrating solid insights and good judgement when solving business problems with strategic outcomes
- Ability to build trusted relationships, and manage stakeholders, both internally and externally to your organisation with clear ability to influence others
- Demonstrating focus on continuous development through continuous learning and innovative problem solving
- Ability to confidently articulate human resources issues to clients and internal stakeholders alike

Set yourself apart:
As a Senior Manager, we expect that you:
- Are forward thinking with a strong business acumen and ability to navigate the wider business context within our client organisation.
- Are passionate for working in an entrepreneurial environment and working with constantly evolving technologies and agile methodologies.
- Prioritise continuous development and self-guided learning, for self and for your team.
- Have the drive and determination to lead, coach and develop others and continuously share your knowledge with others and serve as a guide to your teams and clients
- Are open to think and work independently, comfortable with operating in a global network & fast pace growth model and comfortable to set your own personal growth plan
- Are enthusiastic to extend and navigate networks in and outside of Accenture.
- Are comfortable travelling and working away from home, whilst managing your own schedule based on client and internal commitments
- Can take responsibility for own actions and make decisions with minimal direction
- Are able to think creatively to solve problems

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice! Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jobs.title: Marketing Transformation Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Accelerate your career in a dynamic and innovative digital marketing agency that’s redefining how organisations connect with stakeholders and deliver value.

Join Accenture Song , a fast-growing division dedicated to crafting transformative digital experiences at scale. As part of the Marketing Advisory team, you’ll support a portfolio of clients Helping leading organisations thrive by combining creativity, data-driven insights, and cutting-edge technology. Grow alongside our global network of talent and help drive impactful change for some of the world’s most mission-driven institutions.

About Marketing Advisory:
We are a consulting practice within Accenture Song; uniquely positioned to help clients on their Marketing Re-invention journey. We build close relationships with our clients to fully understand their growth objectives and work collaboratively with them to help shape their transformation and support them on all aspects of this journey.

This can encompass developing a strategic vision, brand strategy, operating model, new ways of working, embracing new technologies, driving a culture change or building people capabilities and skills. We bring strong client-centred, Marketing practitioner skills and partner across Accenture to help our clients create winning customer experiences and drive their Marketing performance.

As part of Marketing Advisory, you'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success and diverse ways of thinking.
If you’re looking for a stimulating career working in a vibrant environment, with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you.

In our team you will learn how to:
- Shape the future of marketing re-invention, working with our clients to develop a roadmap of change that helps them to drive growth, brand performance and new ways of working

- Combine human ingenuity with technology to make change happen in practice, supporting our client businesses to navigate and thrive through times of change

- Apply Generative AI and agentic technologies to marketing, from shaping a client’s strategic vision and operating model to practical implementation that creates tangible value.

- Support our clients to address today’s financial reality: optimising marketing investments, and identifying opportunity to fuel growth, using proprietary analytics tools and benchmarks.

- Accelerate your learning and development by working at the cutting edge of marketing and consulting

As a Consultant in Marketing Advisory, you will :
- Lead project workstreams, develop solutions, manage client communications and support business development initiatives.

- Engage with marketing leadership teams to explore their vision and purpose for the function in driving business objectives and strategies

- Develop project content to deliver solutions that exceed client expectations and drive real marketing re-invention

- Advise marketing leadership on how Generative AI and marketing tech platforms can strategically transform their function across people, processes and technology.

- Support business development activities including proposal development and delivery

- Build strong and trusted client relationships – building our business with existing clients and winning new clients

- Contribute to client projects to shape and co-create Capability Strategies, Operating Models, Transformational Roadmaps and Change Management programmes to drive organisational growth and performance improvement in teams to deliver tangible results

- Partner with other capability areas across Accenture to deliver end-to-end business transformation

- Assess organisation capability gaps in areas such as: Data and Analytics, Operating model, Insights, Segmentation & Portfolio Strategy, Strategy & Planning, Customer Engagement and Omnichannel campaign management

- Build strong internal networks and relationships, supporting our continued business growth agenda and contributing to our team spirit and unique company culture

We’re looking for you to have:
- Proven marketing experience in a blue-chip client role, marketing consultancy or agency
- Experience in designing and leading the delivery of complex projects including product innovation and marketing campaign development and delivery within a multi-national organisation
- Worked across a breadth of marketing disciplines including insight, strategy and planning, innovation, customer experience, e-commerce and GenAI
- A practical understanding of Generative AI and agentic technologies and their transformative impact on marketing
- The ability to make the complex simple; you can cut through the hype surrounding emerging technology to guide clients towards real-world, valuable solutions.
- Strong conceptual and analytical thinking skills with excellent attention to detail
- Excellent inter-personal skills and the ability to influence, collaborate, partner and build relationships
- A natural curiosity and passion for marketing, with a deep understanding of industry trends and the broader marketing technology landscape.
- Experience in any of the following sectors:  Life Sciences and Consumer Healthcare, Financial Services, Consumer Goods, Communications, Media and Technology (CMT)

What’s in it for you:
Our Total Rewards consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits. These include perks such as:
- Up to 30 days of leave to spend each year plus 3 extra volunteering days per year for charitable work of choice.

- Family-friendly and flexible work policies.

- Attractive pension plan with financial wellbeing support and resources.

- Private healthcare insurance plan and Mental Wellbeing support.

- Employee Assistance Programme, Career Development and Counselling.

- A range of generous Parental Leave offerings.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the outstanding services we are known for.

Please note that with all our roles, you should expect some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building rapport with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Advisory & Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and, Interactive, Technology, and Operations services, all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 800,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners, and communities. Visit us at  www.accenture.com .  .

We are seeking a Manager to join our Infrastructure Advisory & Transformation practice. In this role, you will help clients define and execute technology transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, modernize infrastructure environments, and enable business growth.
You will work closely with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams to assess current environments, develop transformation roadmaps, and drive execution of strategic infrastructure programs. This role offers the opportunity to work across cloud, data center, network, workplace, security, and operational transformation initiatives while building strong consulting and leadership skills. This aligns with the practice focus on infrastructure advisory, transformation services, innovation, and business value realization.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Advisory
- Conduct assessments of infrastructure environments, operating models, and technology capabilities.
- Analyze client challenges and develop practical recommendations aligned to business objectives.
- Support the creation of transformation strategies, roadmaps, business cases, and executive presentations.
- Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions to align on priorities and future-state vision.

Transformation Delivery
- Manage workstreams within large-scale infrastructure and cloud transformation programs.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver project milestones, manage dependencies, and mitigate risks.
- Track project progress, budgets, deliverables, and key performance indicators.
- Ensure delivery quality and alignment with client expectations.

Cloud & Modernization
- Support initiatives involving cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, automation, and operational transformation.
- Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, AI-enabled operations, and process optimization.

Client Relationship Management
- Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders across technology and business functions.
- Support account growth by identifying additional opportunities to deliver value.
- Contribute to proposals, solution development, and client presentations.

Team Leadership & Development
- Lead small to medium-sized consulting and delivery teams.
- Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance guidance to team members.
- Foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across engagements.
- Contribute to practice initiatives, knowledge sharing, recruiting, and capability development.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Required
- Minimum 8+ years of experience in infrastructure consulting, cloud transformation, technology strategy, or infrastructure operations.
- Minimum 8+ years experience delivering complex technology or infrastructure transformation projects.
- Minimum 8+ years knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), infrastructure technologies, and IT operations.
- Minimum 8+ years strong project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
- Minimum 8+ years experience working directly with clients and senior technology leaders.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 8 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 8 years work experience)

Preferred
- Experience with infrastructure assessments, cloud adoption frameworks, operating model transformation, or technology modernization.
- Knowledge of automation, observability, AIOps, and intelligent infrastructure services.
- Experience in Financial Services, Healthcare, Communications, Products, or other large enterprise environments.
- Relevant certifications such as Azure, AWS, ITIL, PMP, Agile, or equivalent.

What Success Looks Like
- Delivers high-quality transformation outcomes and measurable client value.
- Builds trusted relationships with client stakeholders and team members.
- Successfully manages multiple workstreams and project priorities.
- Identifies opportunities to improve client operations through innovation and modernization.
- Contributes to practice growth, thought leadership, and business development efforts.

Why Join Us?
- Work on strategic transformation programs for leading global organizations.
- Gain exposure to emerging technologies, cloud, AI-enabled operations, and infrastructure modernization.
- Collaborate with experienced advisors, architects, and technology leaders.
- Accelerate your career in a high-growth practice focused on shaping the future of infrastructure and operations.

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Intercompany Finance Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
Intercompany Finance Transformation Consultant
Career level: Associate Manager (CL8) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (SAP / BlackLine)

Why this role
Intercompany is one of the most intricate parts of a finance transformation, and this is where you build real expertise in it. You'll work on large-scale finance transformation programmes — across SAP, BlackLine or comparable platforms — helping design how intercompany accounting works and holds together through the close, sitting with the client's finance team and seeing the design through to go-live. You'll grow quickly, on real programmes, alongside people who architect this work for a living.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
Intercompany expertise. Genuine understanding of intercompany accounting — cross-company postings, intercompany AR/AP, invoicing, clearing, netting and settlement, and intercompany close and reconciliation. You can turn transfer-pricing policy into workable finance processes, and you understand how enterprise structure — company codes, controlling areas, profit centres — shapes intercompany design and reporting. This is the capability we're really looking for; the platform matters less than the intercompany judgement you bring.

Finance process knowledge. Solid Record-to-Report understanding around the close, and a clear view of how intercompany connects to group reporting and consolidation. You understand chart-of-accounts and enterprise structure well enough to see how intercompany flows land in the numbers.

Platform familiarity. Exposure to intercompany on one of the platforms we deliver on — SAP S/4HANA Finance, BlackLine (Intercompany, and close and controls automation), or comparable finance technology. Depth on one with the curiosity to work across others is exactly right at this level; we don't expect all of them.

Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and follow it through, and you support the workstream and the design authority around you — contributing to design decisions rather than owning them yet, and flagging risks within your scope early. You're comfortable running workshops and status discussions, managing client expectations and timelines, and building credible relationships with finance, tax and treasury stakeholders. You bring structured, analytical problem-solving and communicate clearly under pressure.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. If you already work this way, that's a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience.

Who you are
You take ownership and follow through. You work well in a team and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues, and you're comfortable coordinating finance, tax and treasury perspectives. You bring good judgement and critical thinking to ambiguous problems, and you're clear and considered in how you make and explain decisions. You're early in your trajectory and set on building the rest.
Things that set strong candidates apart: hands-on experience delivering intercompany and transfer-pricing work on complex, multi-entity or multi-country programmes; exposure across more than one platform (SAP, BlackLine or comparable); an awareness of how group reporting, consolidation and controls shape an intercompany design; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP
Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.
You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led finance transformations across SAP, BlackLine and comparable platforms, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on intercompany finance while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 25 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society.

Closing date: 28/02/2027. Accenture reserves the right to close the role earlier should a suitable applicant be found.

jobs.title: Digital Finance Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
Digital Finance Transformation Consultant
Career level: Consultant (CL9)  |  Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh  |  Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Platform Transformation)

Why this role
This is where a finance-transformation consultant builds the advisory credibility that gets you asked for by name. You'll sit with a client's finance team, work out what is wrong with how they run today, and help design what should replace it: the processes, the finance structure underneath them, and the technology that carries them. You're not tied to one ERP. This is advisory work across the finance-technology landscape, so you'll build a view of what different platforms are good for instead of going deep on one product. You'll grow quickly, on real programmes, alongside people who design this work for a living.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Every leader needs to think of themselves as a reinventor. … Being a reinventor is believing that every part of the enterprise and their product has to be reinvented using tech, data, AI—new ways of working, new ways of engaging." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
Workshops, requirements and problem definition. Much of this role happens in a room with the client. You'll take part in design and discovery workshops and run them yourself as you grow into it. That means preparing the material, getting the right questions asked, keeping a mixed group of finance and technology people to the point, and writing up what was agreed so it holds afterwards. You gather and structure business requirements, and you define a problem properly before jumping to a solution: what is happening, what it costs the finance function, and what would have to change. You produce clear analysis and options that inform the decisions the lead takes.

Finance process design and fit-to-standard. A working knowledge of the core finance processes (Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Purchase-to-Pay and Acquire-to-Retire) and real skill in designing and improving them, across general accounting, close and consolidation, external and management reporting, intercompany, finance master data and finance controls. You contribute to fit-to-standard and fit-gap work, comparing what a client does today against what the target platform and good practice support, then helping turn the result into a process design the business will run. That design closes faster, reports with more confidence, and strengthens control.

Enterprise structure and chart of accounts. A working grounding in the finance backbone: legal entities and company codes, ledgers, the controlling and profit-centre model, cost-centre and hierarchy design, and the chart of accounts across it. You're aware of why these decisions shape everything downstream and are expensive to revisit once a programme is moving. You'll gather the reporting and statutory requirements that drive the structure, document how it hangs together, and prepare the options and analysis behind the calls the design lead makes.

Platform breadth and conversational fluency. You'll have worked on an enterprise finance platform programme (SAP, Oracle, Workday or a comparable finance platform) and come away understanding how one runs: how a design gets agreed and built, what "standard" means in practice, and why a decision taken early is hard to unpick later. This is a technology-agnostic role, so the platform matters far less than the judgement and the breadth you bring. What we need is someone who can hold a sensible conversation with a client across a range of platform topics, not someone led by a single product. You'll contribute to technology selection and vendor assessment, comparing platforms against what the client needs, and supporting the value case and the return on a platform investment that helps a CFO back the decision.

AI in finance processes, and in how we deliver. We expect you to be fluent in this. You should be able to talk credibly with a client about what AI is doing to the finance function: where it is changing a process, in reconciliations, close tasks, intercompany matching, variance commentary, forecasting and controls monitoring, and where it is not there yet. You should understand why the answer usually turns on the state of the data, the controls and the process rather than the tool. You'll contribute to designing AI-enabled ways of working into a target process: what an agent runs, what a person approves, and where the human check sits. And you'll work that way yourself. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. This is advisory work, not engineering: at this level we're looking for genuine fluency and current awareness, not a delivery track record in AI.

Working with clients, and how the work gets done. You'll hold the day-to-day client relationships around your scope, with the people who trust you because you turn up prepared, do what you said, and tell them early when something is harder than it looked. You own your scope and follow it through, manage expectations and timelines, and hold realistic boundaries. You'll contribute to target operating model work: how the finance function, its shared-services or GBS arrangements and its process ownership need to work once the platform lands. You're comfortable working in a design-thinking, agile way, co-developing solutions with the client in the room, not through documents alone.

Who you are

You take ownership and follow through. You work well in a team and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues. You're comfortable with ambiguity inside a complex finance organisation, you bring good judgement and critical thinking to problems that aren't fully defined, and you're clear and considered in how you explain your reasoning. You're credible across all levels of a client's management and can explain a technical point to a mixed room without losing either half of it. You're closely engaged with what AI is changing in finance: you follow it, you've formed your own view, and you can talk about it with a client instead of repeating what a vendor told them. You're early in your trajectory and set on building the rest.

Things that set strong candidates apart: experience across more than one ERP or finance platform rather than a single one; running workshops and discovery sessions with client finance teams; contributing to a technology selection or vendor assessment on a live transformation; an understanding of enterprise structure and chart-of-accounts design and why it shapes everything downstream; hands-on exposure to AI or agentic tooling in a finance or delivery setting; fluency in design-thinking and agile delivery methods; an awareness of how controls, intercompany or tax considerations shape a finance design; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you. Tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team advising clients across the full finance-technology landscape — helping them choose the right platform, design the process, enterprise structure and operating model around it, and lead the change. Because the role is platform-agnostic, you build genuine breadth here early, while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience) for a Consultant (CL9) role, you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.
