jobs.title: Talent & Workforce Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Job Role: Talent & Workforce Transformation Manager
Location: Dublin
Salary: Competitive salary and benefits
Career Level:  Management Consulting Manager (CL7)

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge. We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:
Talent & Workforce leads how organisations reinvent work in the age of An extraordinary inflection point: for the first time in history, business leaders are managing a human+AI workforce — and the decisions they make now about skills, roles and capability will define competitive advantage for a generation. What began as an HR agenda has become the defining leadership challenge of our time, commanding the attention of every CEO and CHRO one; where is AI changing the work, what skills does that leave people to build, and how do we redeploy the capacity it frees rather than lose it. That's the conversation we own
We work at the task level, not the job-title level;understanding what people actually do, where AI and automation change it, and what that means for skills, roles, mobility and organisation design. We help clients build talent strategy that defines how to access, create and unlock the potential of their workforce; we help them become Skills-Driven Organisations, with skills as the connective tissue between roles, career paths and business strategy; and we build the Strategic Workforce Planning capability that keeps the workforce aligned to where the business is going, not where it's been.
This spans strategy through delivery,from diagnosing where AI is redistributing work across an enterprise, to designing the skills architecture and workforce plans that respond to it, to standing up the mobility, career and capability systems that make the change stick — and pairing workforce reinvention with the AI-powered learning that equips people with the skills and confidence to succeed in their transformed roles.
“We are uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology and talent to drive true reinvention and value for our clients.” – Karalee Close, Global Lead, Talent & Organisation
In our team you will:
Lead work across the full Talent & Workforce gamut: talent strategy, Skills-Driven Organisation transformation, Strategic Workforce Planning, skills architecture and talent mobility, for clients navigating the biggest shift in how work gets done in a generation. You will work at the highest level, advising CEOs and CHROs on decisions that will shape their organisations for years to come, and build a depth of expertise at the intersection of AI, workforce strategy and learning that very few consultants anywhere in the world can match.
In this role you will:
•  Advise senior client stakeholders on how AI is changing work at the task level, and translate the implications into clear choices on skills, roles, organisation design, capacity and investment
•  Lead the design and delivery of Talent & Workforce engagements across talent strategy, Skills-Driven Organisation transformation, Strategic Workforce Planning, skills architecture and talent mobility
•  Own key client relationships and act as a trusted adviser, challenging established thinking, aligning stakeholders and sustaining momentum from strategy through implementation
•  Shape talent strategies that define the skills clients have, the skills they need and the interventions required to close gaps at pace
•  Lead Skills-Driven Organisation transformation, setting the direction for skills architecture and integrating skills into roles, career paths, workforce planning and mobility
•  Lead Strategic Workforce Planning, translating business strategy and workforce supply-and-demand insight into prioritised, actionable workforce plans
•  Oversee the use of AI-powered diagnostics and modelling to identify how work is changing, assure the quality of analysis and turn findings into executive-level recommendations and delivery roadmaps
•  Mobilise and manage multidisciplinary delivery teams, setting direction, managing scope, quality, risks, dependencies and outcomes across complex programmes
•  Coach and develop Analysts and Consultants through day-to-day leadership, feedback, mentoring and meaningful development opportunities
•  Support clients to redesign ways of working, governance and leadership behaviours needed to realise value from human and AI collaboration
•  Advise clients on the technology ecosystem that underpins workforce transformation, including workforce planning platforms, skills infrastructure and AI-powered diagnostic tools
•  Identify and progress business development opportunities, shape propositions and solutions, and lead or contribute to bids, proposals, client presentations and commercial discussions
•  Contribute to the growth of the Talent & Workforce practice through capability building, recruitment, community leadership, thought leadership and market eminence
•  Create market-relevant Talent & Workforce points of view, articles and offerings that strengthen Accenture’s position in AI-led workforce transformation
Desirable experience:
•  Demonstrable experience leading client-facing work across one or more of: talent strategy, Skills-Driven Organisation design, Strategic Workforce Planning, or workforce/organisation transformation
•  Experience managing complex workstreams or programmes, including teams, senior stakeholders, scope, quality, risks and delivery outcomes
•  Experience using data-driven, AI-enabled diagnostics or workforce modelling to inform strategic recommendations and investment decisions
•  Ability to translate workforce insight into compelling executive narratives, practical roadmaps and client-ready delivery
•  Experience developing people through coaching and performance support, and contributing to proposals, business development or practice growth
Health & Public Service overlay (attach only when hiring against H&PS pipeline — not part of the core JD):
•  Experience leading talent, workforce or skills transformation for NHS, DHSC/ALBs, local government or blue-light services
•  Experience navigating public sector delivery constraints — procurement/commercial models, programme governance, benefits realisation, assurance and auditability
•  Understanding of clinical and non-clinical role structures, regulated professions, rota patterns and large-scale change adoption in healthcare/public service contexts
•  Understanding of public sector information governance and data protection expectations, including UK GDPR and secure-by-design working
•  Holds, or willing to obtain, UK government security clearance (BPSS; SC where required)

jobs.title: Aftersales & Service Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Entrando in Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering lavorerai al cuore della value chain, dal sourcing e procurement all'engineering e R&D, dalla manifattura e operations ai capital projects, per aiutare le aziende a reinventare l'intera catena del valore, alimentata da dati, AI e tecnologie di nuova generazione.

Per supportare la crescita della nostra practice Aftersales & Service Transformation , siamo alla ricerca di Consultant e Manager che desiderino contribuire alla trasformazione dei processi post-vendita, customer operations e service management, aiutando le organizzazioni a migliorare l'esperienza cliente, l'efficienza operativa e la creazione di valore lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Sedi: Milano, Roma.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

- Guidare programmi di trasformazione in ambito Aftersales, Service Operations, Customer Service e Customer Support, contribuendo all'evoluzione dei modelli operativi e organizzativi dei clienti
- Disegnare e ottimizzare processi di Order Management, Order-to-Cash, Warranty Management, Claims, Returns e Customer Operations per migliorare qualità del servizio ed efficienza operativa
- Supportare la definizione e l'implementazione di strategie e modelli operativi per Spare Parts Management, Service Parts, Field Service e Technical Support
- Collaborare all'adozione di piattaforme digitali e soluzioni innovative per la gestione dei servizi post-vendita, delle customer operations e delle interazioni con i clienti
- Applicare analytics, AI, automazione e tecnologie emergenti per reinventare processi di service management, customer support e operations
- Sviluppare business case, KPI ed executive presentation, supportando il management nella definizione di roadmap di trasformazione e miglioramento continuo

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è prevista l’applicazione del CCNL Metalmeccanico, con uno tra i seguenti livelli inquadramento e corrispondente fascia di retribuzione annua lorda:
B3: € 32.000 e € 50.500
A1. € 50.000 e € 65.100

#LI-EU
#LI-MP

Le tue caratteristiche

- Esperienza in progetti di Aftersales Transformation, Service Transformation, Customer Operations, Customer Service, Order-to-Cash o Process Improvement
- Competenze in uno o più ambiti tra Aftersales, Service Operations, Customer Support, Warranty Management, Claims & Returns, Spare Parts Management, Field Service o Technical Support
- Partecipazione ad iniziative di trasformazione dei processi, operating model redesign, process excellence o programmi di digital transformation
- Conoscenza di piattaforme CRM, Customer Service o Service Management (es. Salesforce, Service Cloud, ServiceNow o soluzioni analoghe) rappresenta un plus
- Interesse per l'applicazione di Data & AI, analytics, automazione e tecnologie digitali ai processi di customer operations e service management
- Laurea Magistrale in discipline Economiche, Ingegneristiche o Scientifiche

The work
Financial institutions are reinventing their Risk & Compliance functions—moving from manual, control-heavy processes to tech-enabled, data-led, AI-supported operating models . Accenture’s Dutch Compliance team helps leading banks, fintechs and payment service providers navigate regulatory change and turn it into sustainable advantage .

In this role, you will lead delivery workstreams at the intersection of regulatory change, RegTech, data/analytics, and Responsible AI . You’ll combine hands-on project leadership with client advisory, helping teams deliver tangible outcomes—from smarter controls to automated workflows and scalable target operating models.

What you will do
Regulatory change → actionable transformation
- Lead workstreams on Dutch & EU developments (e.g., AMLR, DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act ) and translate requirements into practical operating models, control frameworks and implementation roadmaps .
- Shape “what this means” for the business: from compliance impact assessments to future-ready compliance design.

RegTech & process reinvention
- Drive implementation of RegTech platforms and workflow automation to streamline compliance, improve operational resilience and reduce manual effort.
- Partner with Technology & Operations teams to embed solutions into real processes (not slideware).

AI-enabled compliance (done responsibly)
- Oversee initiatives that apply GenAI and analytics to improve compliance processes (e.g., triage, investigation support, documentation, control testing), while ensuring Responsible AI principles (ethical, transparent, explainable).
- Use Accenture assets and frameworks to help clients build AI governance aligned with regulatory expectations.

Delivery leadership & client partnership
- Manage multi-disciplinary teams, plan and steer delivery, and keep senior stakeholders aligned.
- Contribute to proposals, client development, and thought leadership in the Dutch market.

Who we are
In today’s world, leaders want to reinvent rapidly and confidently to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and create sustainable value. Accenture Strategy & Consulting brings together industry expertise, tech, data & AI, and change capabilities to co-create each client’s path to reinvention. You’ll work with a diverse team and leverage global assets and partnerships to bring innovation to life.

- Master’s degree (e.g., Financial Law, Business Administration, Economics or similar).

Visit us at  www.accenture.com .

Accenture Security

Join Accenture Security to pioneer security solutions that blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed services. Using the coolest next-gen tech, you’ll have every chance to stay one step ahead of cybercrime and out-hack the hackers.

Accenture Security provides comprehensive security services – from security strategy development to business transformation, to managed security services – on demand and at a global scale to help mitigate risks and take full advantage of advanced technologies and proven risk management models. Our experienced team of global security professionals helps businesses understand their risks and build resilience from the inside out, giving them the confidence to focus on what matters most: innovation and business growth.

As a Security Delivery Associate Manager, you will lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of security solutions across client engagements. You will own end-to-end accountability for defining security requirements, overseeing the build of security components, and ensuring rigorous testing standards are met. Operating as a subject matter expert, you will guide and manage your team's day-to-day performance while actively contributing to broader practice decisions and cross-team initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead the planning and execution of Security Operations Center (SOC) programmes, driving strategic direction and operational effectiveness across engagements
- Oversee the implementation and optimisation of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, ensuring alignment with client environments and evolving threat landscapes
- Define and translate security requirements into scalable, practical architecture and delivery approaches
- Drive team performance through clear direction, structured ways of working, and a culture of accountability — managing resource allocation, workload, and quality across concurrent workstreams
- Develop and champion innovative security strategies that align with organisational goals and client risk appetite
- Conduct and lead regular vulnerability assessments, translating findings into actionable remediation roadmaps
- Facilitate capability-building sessions and knowledge transfer to elevate team expertise on security protocols, tools, and emerging practices
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including infrastructure, application, and risk functions — to ensure security is embedded comprehensively across the delivery lifecycle
- Serve as a key point of escalation for complex security challenges, providing sound, timely solutions that balance risk, cost, and business impact
- Stay current on the latest security trends, threat intelligence, and emerging technologies, continuously evolving team practices in response

Qualifications & Experience
Education
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. A Master's degree is advantageous but not required.

Experience
- 6–9 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, with a meaningful portion in delivery or consulting environments
- Demonstrated experience managing or leading security teams, including responsibility for team performance, development, and workload management
- Proven track record delivering complex security programs across SOC, SIEM, threat detection, incident response, or related domains
- Experience working in or with large, matrixed organizations — ideally across multiple industries or client environments
- Exposure to security program governance, risk management frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements (e.g. NIST, ISO 27001, NCA ECC for KSA-based roles) is strongly preferred

Technical Proficiency
- Expert-level proficiency in SOC planning, operations, and maturity assessment — required
- Advanced proficiency in SIEM platforms (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or equivalent) — strongly preferred
- Working knowledge of endpoint detection and response (EDR), threat intelligence platforms, SOAR tools, and cloud security principles
- Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), network security architecture, and vulnerability management tools
- Comfort with data and analytics as applied to security operations — including log analysis, correlation rule development, and security metrics reporting

Certifications
- Professional security certifications are strongly valued. Preferred credentials include one or more of the following: CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC-200, or equivalent SIEM/SOC-specific certifications
- Cloud security certifications (e.g. AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer) are a plus, particularly for engagements with significant cloud footprint

Soft Skills & Leadership Attributes
- Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Proven ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and maintain delivery momentum in fast-moving environments
- A coaching mindset — invested in the growth of team members and capable of creating an environment where people perform at their best
- Collaborative by nature, with the ability to build trust and influence across functions, geographies, and seniority levels

jobs.description:
Senior Manager – Transformation Office – Transformation Coach
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Management, Transformation Coaching, Value Realization, Agentic AI
Level: Senior Manager (Level 6)
Location: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
Years of Experience: 12 to 17 years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Are you passionate about shaping the early direction of large-scale transformation programs and building organizational muscles to sustain them? Do you excel at guiding senior leaders and cross-functional teams to define ways of working, embed governance practices, and drive transformation with discipline and clarity?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation and take on a senior leadership role, guiding global clients on their most complex transformation journeys — working at the heart of our clients’ most ambitious programs to set the tone, build the foundation, and enable lasting transformation outcomes, now enhanced by the power of Agentic AI.
The Practice – A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, redefining business models and delivery approaches.
As a Senior Manager, you will be deployed at the critical early stages of transformation programs — shaping direction, enabling teams, and embedding the practices that make transformation stick. Here are some of the key initiatives you will drive:
•    Establishing Strategic Direction for Early-Stage Transformation: Partnering with senior client leadership to define transformation vision, governance frameworks, and ways of working at program inception.
•    Transformation Coaching & Team Enablement: Embedding alongside client teams to coach leaders and program workstreams on transformation management best practices, decision-making structures, and accountability models.
•    Agentic AI-Powered Transformation Management: Identifying and deploying Agentic AI solutions within transformation programs to automate tracking, analysis, and realization of business value.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Manager who brings deep expertise in Transformation Management and a hands-on track record as a Transformation Coach. The ideal candidate excels at working in the early, ambiguous stages of large transformation programs — helping clients shape direction, define how the program will be managed, establish ways of working, and build the governance structures needed to execute with confidence.
You will work closely with C-suite stakeholders, transformation leads, and program workstream owners to coach teams, embed best practices, and apply Agentic AI to accelerate program management maturity — ensuring measurable business outcomes are governed and realized throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Transformation Coaching & Early-Stage Strategy Formulation
•    Orchestrate Transformation Change– Guide and orchestrate enterprise-wide change across business units in close coordination with talent/HR teams, ensuring transformation approaches are shaped to client context, maturity, and archetype — enabling the organization to own and sustain the change rather than depending on externally imposed frameworks.
•    Steer Culture & Accountability – Embed transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring governance is actively practiced.
•    Coach Leadership Teams – Guide senior leaders and workstream heads on transformation management principles, enabling effective decision-making, alignment, and disciplined execution.
•    Build Capability – Build Transformation Management capability by enabling standard transformation orchestration guidelines, structured governance, change adoption, stakeholder alignment, and value realization to sustainably drive strategic change.
Lead Transformation & Value Management
•    Set up & Run TO – Set up and run Transformation Management Offices (TMO) / Value Realization Offices (VRO) for large-scale client engagements, owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end-to-end.
•    Value Discovery & KPIs – Conduct and facilitate value discovery workshops to identify business objectives, key value drivers, and measurable KPIs during the business blueprint phase. Build detailed business cases for transformation initiatives, working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance against targets.
•    Establish Program Governance – Design and embed program structures including decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working (meetings, reporting, RAID, decision registers).
Embedding Best Practices & Sustaining Transformation
•    Build Playbooks & Toolkits – Develop and institutionalize transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs tailored to client context and maturity.
•    Facilitate Health & Risk Reviews – Lead structured sessions to assess transformation health, identify risks, and co-create corrective actions.
Drive Agentic AI-Powered Transformation
•    Apply hands-on expertise in AI Agents and agentic architecture to automate and accelerate transformation management activities — including status tracking, risk identification, value analysis, and reporting.
•    Identify opportunities within client programs where Agentic AI can meaningfully improve program governance, decision-making, and value realization speed.

jobs.title: Gen AI Consultant / Work Transformation
jobs.description:
Kdo jsme:

Jsme Accenture AI & Data   Practice   - globální   tým, který pomáhá firmám využívat data a umělou inteligenci ve skutečném měřítku. Navrhujeme a realizujeme moderní datové platformy, pokročilou analytiku a generativní AI / Agentic AI, které mění klíčové byznysové procesy napříč odvětvími. Součástí našich projektů je i zavádění   GenAI   do každodenní práce   zaměstnanců - bezpečně , měřitelně a s důrazem na reálný dopad.

O pozici:

Tato role je   hybridní - spojuje   client-facing   AI   upskilling   (primárně) a AI   engineering   (sekundárně). Budeš navrhovat a realizovat vzdělávací programy,   facilitovat   workshopy a pomáhat týmům převádět   GenAI   do praxe. Zároveň budeš tvořit   PoC   a demo řešení, abys dokázal(a) rychle ukázat, jak   GenAI   funguje na konkrétních scénářích. Cílem je stát se partnerem pro klienty, který umí AI srozumitelně vysvětlit, nastavit bezpečné   guardrails   a posunout adopci i hodnotu.

Náplň práce:

- Navrhujete   a   vedete   AI upskilling   programy   ( workshopy ,   školení ,   promptathons , office hours) pro leadership, champions/ ambasadory ,   byznys   uživatele   i IT.   ​

- Facilitujete   identifikaci   a   prioritizaci   use   casů   s   byznysem   a   převádíte   je do   praktických   ukázek   a   tréninkových   scénářů .

- Nastavujete   a   vysvětlujete   Responsible AI a   bezpečné   zásady   používání   GenAI (do’s & don’ts,   práce   s   citlivými   daty ,   limity   modelů , cost awareness).

- Podporujete   adopci   a   engagement ( komunikace , community management v Teams/Viva Engage,   práce   s   ambasadory ,   sběr   zpětné   vazby ).

- Měříte   dopad   upskillingu   a   adopce :   návrh   KPI,   práce   s   metrikami   a   dashboardy ,   interpretace   dat   a   doporučení   pro   další   kroky   (value case).

- Budujete   PoC/demo   řešení   a   technické   akcelerátory   (RAG,   agentní   workflow,   integrace   LLM   přes   Python/API) a   ladíte   kvalitu   výstupů   ( prompty ,   evaluace , guardrails).

Hledáme právě Vás, pokud:

- Máte   zkušenost   s   vedením   školení ,   workshopů   nebo   enablement   aktivit   a   baví   vás   práce   s   lidmi   i   obsahová   příprava .

- Rozumíte   GenAI / LLM a   umíte   jednoduše   vysvětlit   principy ,   limity   a   zásady   bezpečného   používání .

- Dokážete   převést   byznysové   potřeby   do   praktických   use   casů   a ( kde   dává   smysl ) do   prototypu /PoC.

- Ovládáte   Python   na   úrovni   skriptování ,   práce   s   daty   a   integrací   pomocí   API.

- Znáte   alespoň   jeden   z GenAI   frameworků   ( LangChain ,   LlamaIndex ,   AutoGen ,   CrewAI ) a   principy   RAG ( embeddingy ,   vektorové   databáze ,   vyhledávání ).

- Máte   silné   komunikační   dovednosti ,   umíte   prezentovat   a   facilitovat   diskusi   se   stakeholdery .

- Plynulá   angličtina   a   čeština / slovenština   jsou   nezbytné ,   němčina   je   výhodou .

Výhodou:

- Zkušenost   s   programy   adopce   a change   managementu   (champion network,   komunikace , engagement,   interní   komunity ).

- Praktická   zkušenost   s Microsoft 365 Copilot / Copilot Chat a/ nebo   Copilot Studio (agents) a   jejich   využitím   v   organizaci .

- Zkušenost   se   Streamlit   /   Chainlit   / n8n   při   rychlém   prototypování   a   tvorbě   demo   aplikací .

- Základy   cloudových   platforem   a   AI   služeb   (Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks).

- Základy   Dockeru , CI/CD a   nasazování ;   zkušenost   se SQL/NoSQL   databázemi .

- Zkušenost   s   měřením   adopce   a   dopadu   (Power BI, Viva Insights)   a s   prostředím   regulovaných   odvětví   (GDPR,   bezpečnost   dat ).

Co nabízíme:

- Neomezený počet žetonů Claude, neomezený přístup k ChatGPT Pro, Copilot M365 nebo Google a dalším nástrojům potřebným pro vaši práci

- Hybridní   roli   kombinující   AI upskilling   a   engineering -od   workshopů   a   školení   až   po   prototypy   a   integrace .

- Práci   na   end-to-end   projektech : od AI & Data   strategie ,   přes   adopci   a   změnu   způsobu   práce ,   až   po   implementaci   GenAI   řešení   ( chatboti ,   asistenti , agentic AI).

Benefity a pracovní podmínky:

jobs.title: Process Transformation & AI Reinvention Consultant
jobs.description:
CHI SEI

Produci analisi solide e strutturate, valutando trend e dinamiche che influenzano il tuo settore o la tua funzione, progettando processi futuri e creando materiali di supporto che aiutano professionisti senior a definire raccomandazioni di trasformazione. Stai sviluppando una solida esperienza nel tuo ambito e una visione su come l'AI e l'automazione possano modificare il modo in cui opera.
Sei in grado di lavorare seguendo linee guida strutturate, assumendo progressivamente maggiori responsabilità nei diversi incarichi progettuali.
Comprendi che progettare il modo in cui gli agenti AI interagiscono all'interno dei processi - AX Design - è importante tanto quanto la progettazione del processo stesso, e stai iniziando ad applicare questi principi nel tuo lavoro.

IL LAVORO

Utilizzare strumenti di AI rilevanti nello svolgimento delle attività quotidiane e nella creazione dei deliverable, inclusa la creazione di agenti e altri strumenti a supporto delle attività del team:
- Produrre analisi di trend e dinamiche di mercato relative al settore o alla funzione assegnata, incluse analisi comparative (benchmark) che evidenzino il posizionamento del cliente rispetto ai competitor e individuino le opportunità di trasformazione.

- Progettare specifiche dei processi futuri, includendo i punti di integrazione dell'AI, le modifiche al modello operativo, i requisiti di interazione uomo-macchina e gli approcci per favorire l'adozione da parte della forza lavoro nell'ambito di riferimento.

- Condurre analisi dei processi e supportare la realizzazione di soluzioni digitali e basate su piattaforme nell'ambito delle operations.

- Costruire framework analitici e valutazioni basate sui dati utilizzando strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi supportati dall'AI.

- Condurre analisi di benchmark utilizzando strumenti di confronto tra settori e aziende comparabili accelerati dall'AI.

- Sviluppare valutazioni dell'impatto del cambiamento utilizzando strumenti di analisi organizzativa supportati dall'AI.

- Applicare la propria conoscenza del settore o della funzione per revisionare e migliorare i modelli di trasformazione specifici del dominio e i contenuti dei playbook funzionali.

- Contribuire alla libreria di riferimento e mantenere aggiornata la propria conoscenza del dominio attraverso attività di formazione continua.

- Applicare i principi di AX Design nella definizione o revisione dei modelli di integrazione AI, stabilendo come gli agenti AI debbano comportarsi all'interno di ciascuna fase del processo riprogettato, quali attività possano gestire autonomamente e quando debbano trasferire l'attività a una persona.

FORMAZIONE
- Laurea triennale o titolo equivalente.

QUALIFICHE DI BASE (REQUISITI)
- Esperienza in ambito process excellence, ridisegno dei processi o consulenza direzionale.

- Esperienza nella produzione di analisi di trend di settore o funzionali, output di benchmark o valutazioni dell'impatto del cambiamento.

- Esperienza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di analytics, visualizzazione o benchmarking supportati dall'AI (ad esempio funzionalità AI native delle piattaforme).

- Esperienza nell'integrazione dell'AI e nell'automazione della progettazione dei processi aziendali.

- Esperienza nella realizzazione di attività progettuali in un ambiente consulenziale oppure esperienza industriale in almeno un ambito specifico (ad esempio: Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities, Chemical and Natural Resources).

- Capacità di analizzare dati e tradurre i risultati in raccomandazioni strutturate.

QUALIFICHE PREFERENZIALI
- Familiarità con strumenti di mappatura o modellazione dei processi.

- Forti capacità analitiche e capacità di comunicare risultati complessi in modo chiaro, traducendoli in termini di business e raccomandazioni strutturate.

- Esperienza consulenziale o di advisory a diretto contatto con il cliente.

- Utilizza strumenti di AI in modo autonomo e avanzato, inclusa la creazione di agenti, per migliorare la qualità dei deliverable e risolvere problematiche di business.

- Integra i principi di AI Design nelle specifiche dei processi (comportamenti degli agenti, livelli di autonomia, passaggi di consegna tra agente e persona).

- Identifica dove l'AI agentica può trasformare specifiche fasi dei processi del cliente e definisce le implicazioni progettuali.

- Utilizza strumenti di analytics, visualizzazione e benchmark supportati dall'AI per guidare la progettazione dei processi futuri.

- Dimostra un approccio di apprendimento continuo rispetto agli strumenti e alle evoluzioni emergenti dell'AI.

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l'esperienza maturata. jobs.title: AI Transformation & Process Excellence Consultant
jobs.description:
You produce solid analytical work — assessing trends and forces shaping your industry or function, designing future-state processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in your domain and a point of view on how AI and automation can change the way it operates. You're comfortable working with structured guidance while taking on more with each engagement.

You understand that designing how AI agents interact within processes — AX Design — is just as important as the process design itself, and you're starting to apply those principles in your work.

THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
- Produce trend and forces assessments for your assigned industry or function, including benchmarking analyses that show where the client stands relative to peers and where the reinvention opportunity lies.

- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for your domain area.

- Conduct process analysis and support delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations.

- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools.

- Conduct benchmarking analysis with AI-accelerated industry and peer comparison tools.

- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.

- Apply your industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

- Contribute to the reference library and keep your domain expertise current through continuous learning.

- Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs — defining how AI agents should behave within each redesigned process step, what they handle autonomously, and when they hand off to a person.

#LI-EU

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION

- Experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting

- Experience producing industry or function trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, or change-impact assessments

- Previous usage of AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or benchmarking tools (e.g. Platform Native AI capabilities)

- Experience integrating AI and automating business process design

- You have previously delivered project work in consulting environment OR industry experience in at least one domain (e.g., Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities or Chemical and Natural Resources) OR worked within

- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

- Familiarity with process mapping or process modeling tools

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms/structured recommendations

- Client-facing consulting or advisory experience

jobs.title: AI Transformation & Process Excellence Consultant
jobs.description:
VOUS ÊTES

Vous produisez des analyses solides et structurées en évaluant les tendances et les facteurs qui façonnent votre secteur ou votre fonction, en concevant des processus cibles ( future state ) et en développant les supports qui permettent aux praticiens expérimentés de formuler des recommandations de transformation. Vous développez progressivement une véritable expertise dans votre domaine ainsi qu’un point de vue sur la manière dont l’intelligence artificielle et l’automatisation peuvent transformer son fonctionnement. Vous êtes à l’aise avec des orientations structurées tout en assumant davantage de responsabilités à chaque mission.

Vous comprenez que la conception de la manière dont les agents d’IA interagissent au sein des processus — AX Design (Agent Experience Design) — est tout aussi importante que la conception des processus eux-mêmes, et vous commencez à appliquer ces principes dans votre travail.

VOS MISSIONS

Utiliser les outils d’IA pertinents dans l’ensemble des tâches et des livrables, y compris la création d’agents et d’autres outils permettant de :
- Réaliser des analyses des tendances et des forces qui influencent votre secteur ou votre fonction, y compris des études comparatives ( benchmarking ) montrant la position du client par rapport à ses pairs et les opportunités de réinvention qui en découlent.

- Concevoir des spécifications de processus cibles intégrant les points d’intégration de l’IA, les évolutions du modèle opérationnel, les exigences d’interaction homme-machine et les approches d’adoption par les équipes dans votre domaine d’expertise.

- Mener des analyses de processus et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions numériques et de plateformes au sein des opérations.

- Développer des cadres d’analyse et des évaluations fondées sur les données à l’aide d’outils d’analyse et de visualisation assistés par l’IA.

- Réaliser des analyses comparatives grâce à des outils de benchmarking sectoriel et de comparaison entre pairs accélérés par l’IA.

- Élaborer des évaluations d’impact du changement à l’aide d’outils d’analyse organisationnelle assistés par l’IA.

- Mettre à profit votre connaissance du secteur ou de la fonction pour examiner et améliorer les conceptions de réinvention spécifiques à votre domaine ainsi que les contenus des guides méthodologiques fonctionnels.

- Contribuer à la bibliothèque de référence et maintenir votre expertise à jour grâce à un apprentissage continu.

- Appliquer les principes de l’AX Design lors de la définition ou de la revue des conceptions d’intégration de l’IA, en précisant comment les agents d’IA doivent se comporter à chaque étape du processus repensé, quelles activités ils gèrent de manière autonome et à quels moments ils doivent transférer la responsabilité à une personne.

FORMATION
- Diplôme de niveau Licence ( Bachelor's Degree ) ou qualification équivalente.

QUALIFICATIONS REQUISES
- Expérience dans l’excellence opérationnelle, la refonte des processus ou le conseil en management.

- Expérience dans la réalisation d’analyses de tendances sectorielles ou fonctionnelles, de benchmarks ou d’évaluations d’impact du changement.

- Expérience avec les outils d’analyse, de visualisation ou de benchmarking assistés par l’IA (par exemple, les capacités natives d’IA intégrées aux plateformes).

- Expérience dans l’intégration de l’IA et l’automatisation de la conception des processus métier.

- Expérience dans la réalisation de projets dans un environnement de conseil ou expérience sectorielle dans au moins un domaine (par exemple : Banque et marchés de capitaux, Assurance, Logiciels et Plateformes, Communications et Médias, Haute Technologie, Santé, Secteur Public, Sciences de la Vie, Distribution et Biens de Consommation, Voyage, Industrie, Énergie, Services Publics, Chimie ou Ressources Naturelles).

- Capacité à analyser des données et à traduire les résultats en recommandations structurées et exploitables.

QUALIFICATIONS SOUHAITÉES
- Maîtrise des outils de cartographie ou de modélisation des processus.

- Solides capacités analytiques et aptitude à communiquer des résultats complexes sous forme de recommandations claires et structurées pour les entreprises.

- Expérience dans un rôle de conseil ou de relation client.

- Utilisation autonome et fluide des outils d’IA, y compris la création d’agents, afin de produire des livrables de meilleure qualité répondant aux enjeux métier.

- Intégration des principes de l’ AX Design dans les spécifications de processus (comportements des agents, niveaux d’autonomie, mécanismes de transfert vers l’humain).

- Capacité à identifier les étapes des processus clients pouvant être transformées grâce à l’IA agentique et à en expliquer les implications en matière de conception.

- Utilisation d’outils d’analyse, de visualisation et de benchmarking assistés par l’IA pour étayer les conceptions des processus cibles.

- Engagement démontré dans l’apprentissage continu des nouveaux outils et technologies d’intelligence artificielle.

jobs.description:
Entrando in Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering lavorerai al cuore della value chain - dal sourcing e procurement, all'engineering e R&D, dalla manifattura e operations, ai capital projects - per aiutare le aziende a reinventare l'intera catena del valore, alimentata da dati, AI e tecnologie di nuova generazione.
Nell'area Value Chain Reinvention accompagnerai i clienti nella ridefinizione dei loro modelli operativi e delle strategie di value chain: trasformazioni integrate che partono dalla visione e arrivano all'execution, combinando pensiero strategico, intelligenza dei dati e tecnologie avanzate per evolvere l'intera catena del valore — non solo ottimizzarla.
Cerchiamo Manager con esperienza nel settore Semiconductor , capace di muoversi con credibilità tra la complessità operativa e la dimensione strategica, per supportare programmi di evoluzione della value chain e dei modelli operativi e digitali.

- Guidare iniziative di trasformazione lungo i processi chiave della value chain Semiconductor — R&D, product engineering, supply chain, manufacturing e operations — con visione end-to-end e impatto misurabile.

- Contribuire alla costruzione di roadmap, business case e target operating model in contesti complessi e ad alta intensità tecnologica.

- Orchestrare progetti e workstream coordinando team multidisciplinari — business e IT — con autonomia e capacità di influenza sugli stakeholder.

- Presidiare l'evoluzione del settore Semiconductor, portando al cliente una lettura anticipatoria dei trend tecnologici e competitivi.

In this role, you will help clients modernize their technology landscape, accelerate digital transformation, optimize operational performance, and realize measurable business value from their infrastructure investments.

Client Advisory & Strategy

- Develop business cases and executive presentations that articulate business outcomes, costs, risks, and value realization.

Transformation Leadership

- Define transformation roadmaps, governance models, and implementation strategies.
- Drive program execution while managing scope, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
- Ensure alignment between business objectives and technology investments.

- Contribute to the development of practice offerings, assets, methodologies, and thought leadership.

Business Development
- Support pursuit teams in opportunity shaping, solution development, and proposal creation.
- Participate in client workshops, executive briefings, and strategic planning sessions.
- Build strong relationships with key client stakeholders and ecosystem partners.
- Drive account growth through identification of additional transformation opportunities.

Leadership & Talent Development
- Lead and mentor high-performing consulting and delivery teams.
- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
- Coach managers and consultants on client engagement, delivery excellence, and career development.
- Contribute to practice growth through recruiting, capability development, and knowledge sharing.

This role could need you to travel 25 -50% or as required

Required
- Minimum 10+ years of experience in infrastructure consulting, technology transformation, cloud strategy, or enterprise architecture.
- Minimum 10+ years experience leading large-scale infrastructure modernization and transformation programs.
- Minimum 10+ years understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid infrastructure, networking, workplace technologies, and IT operations.
- Minimum 10+ years experience engaging with senior executives and presenting recommendations to C-suite stakeholders.
- Minimum 10+ years demonstrated ability to manage complex programs, multiple workstreams, and diverse stakeholder groups.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 10 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 10 years work experience)

Preferred
- Experience in infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, operating model design, or IT service transformation.

- Familiarity with industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, Communications, or Products.
- Relevant industry certifications (AWS, Azure, TOGAF, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent).

What Success Looks Like
- Trusted advisor to senior client leadership.
- Successful delivery of complex transformation programs with measurable business outcomes.
- Growth of strategic client relationships and transformation opportunities.
- Development of high-performing teams and future leaders.
- Contribution to innovative offerings that differentiate the practice in the market.

Why Join Us?
- Lead transformational work for Fortune 500 clients.
- Influence technology strategy and business outcomes at the executive level.
- Work with industry-leading talent across strategy, architecture, cloud, security, and operations.
- Shape the future of intelligent infrastructure through innovation, automation, and emerging technologies.

jobs.description:
We are:
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology, and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song .

The work:

Lead commercial and revenue transformation
- Lead end-to-end Pricing, CPQ, Quote-to-Cash, Lead-to-Cash, Revenue Lifecycle Management, and Sales Transformation programs.

- Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Pricing, Finance, Product, Operations, Legal, Customer Service, and IT to set the transformation agenda.

- Facilitate executive workshops, frame strategic choices, resolve cross-functional issues, and translate ambition into sequenced roadmaps.

Shape pricing strategy and commercial excellence
- Design pricing strategies, monetization models, price architecture, segmentation, discount frameworks, pricing guardrails, approval policies, and value-based pricing approaches.

- Assess margin leakage and commercial performance, identify improvement opportunities, and embed pricing discipline into frontline execution.

- Design or strengthen Pricing Centers of Excellence, including governance, roles, decision rights, processes, analytics, and performance management.

Define future-state CPQ capabilities
- Design guided selling, product and service configuration, costing, pricing, approvals, quote and proposal generation, commercial commitments, change orders, renewals, and downstream handoffs.

- Create scalable global process blueprints while accommodating justified business-unit, geographic, product, channel, and customer differences.

- Translate business strategy into capability requirements, prioritized backlogs, acceptance criteria, release plans, and adoption outcomes.

Connect the revenue technology ecosystem
- Define target-state architectures and integration principles across CRM, CPQ, pricing engines, CLM, ERP, order management, billing, invoicing, and analytics.

- Lead platform and vendor evaluations, solution option assessments, implementation strategies, and architecture trade-off decisions.

- Work with business and technical leaders to ensure technology choices support reusable processes, trusted data, auditable controls, and enterprise scale.

Build the case for change
- Develop executive-level business cases that quantify revenue growth, margin improvement, seller productivity, quote quality, cycle-time reduction, discount leakage reduction, compliance improvement, and cash-flow impact.

- Define baselines, benefit hypotheses, KPI frameworks, investment requirements, payback expectations, and value-realization governance.

- Convert complex findings into clear decision materials for executive sponsors, steering committees, and investment boards.

Lead delivery, adoption, and value realization
- Lead assessments, strategy engagements, pilots, MVPs, global rollouts, and enterprise implementations.

- Mobilize and direct multidisciplinary teams across strategy, process, product, architecture, data, integration, change, testing, and program management.

- Own executive governance, delivery quality, risks, dependencies, business readiness, training, adoption, stabilization, and continuous improvement.

Grow clients, teams, and market capabilities
- Shape pursuits, proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, delivery plans, staffing models, assumptions, and commercial constructs.

- Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior functional leaders and serve as a credible advisor on profitable growth and commercial modernization.

- Mentor practitioners, develop reusable assets and thought leadership, strengthen ecosystem partnerships, and contribute to practice growth.

Basic Qualifications:
- 12+ years' experience in consulting, commercial transformation, pricing, sales operations, revenue operations, product management, enterprise platforms, or a related field. Experience should include:
- Demonstrated experience leading CPQ, pricing, Quote-to-Cash, Lead-to-Cash, or broader revenue transformation initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of product or service configuration, pricing, costing, discounting, approvals, quoting, proposal generation, contracting handoffs, change orders, and renewals.

- Experience translating executive objectives into operating models, process blueprints, business requirements, solution roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders across business and technology organizations.

- Experience developing business cases, value hypotheses, executive presentations, proposals, and transformation plans.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ, Conga, SAP CPQ, Oracle CPQ, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or comparable enterprise revenue platforms.

- Experience with pricing technologies such as PROS, Vendavo, Pricefx, or Zilliant, and with CLM, ERP, billing, or order-management platforms.

- Knowledge of value-based pricing, price optimization, pricing analytics, commercial finance, SaaS or subscription monetization, usage-based models, and complex deal economics.

- Experience in industrial products, manufacturing, automotive, chemicals, life sciences, medical devices, distribution, logistics, high tech, or other complex B2B environments.

- Experience leading change networks, role redesign, training, adoption, governance, and value-realization programs.

- Advanced business, technical, analytics, or engineering degree.

Ambas posiciones participarán en proyectos de B2B Sales Transformation , trabajando sobre procesos Lead-to-Order y Renewal, Sales Performance Management, Sales Planning, Incentive Compensation Management, optimización de ventas, cross-sell, upsell, renovaciones y optimización de deals.
Los proyectos podrán desarrollarse para clientes de industrias como Financial Services, Technology, Software & Platforms, Healthcare y Life Sciences, en colaboración con equipos globales y multidisciplinarios.

Consultant | B2B Sales Transformation
Como Consultant , tendrás un rol analítico y de ejecución dentro de los proyectos, colaborando con clientes, líderes y equipos multidisciplinarios en el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de soluciones comerciales.

- Analizar procesos de Sales Planning, segmentación, territorios, modelos de cobertura, capacidad comercial y definición de cuotas.
- Participar en el diseño y mejora de procesos de Sales Performance Management, Sales Operations y Seller Enablement.
- Apoyar la optimización del ciclo completo del deal, incluyendo oportunidades, CPQ, pricing, contratación, CLM y facturación.
- Analizar procesos de renovaciones, cross-sell, upsell y modelos de ingresos recurrentes.
- Participar en workshops con stakeholders de negocio y tecnología.
- Traducir desafíos comerciales en recomendaciones, casos de uso, análisis y business cases.

- Colaborar con equipos onshore y offshore en entornos ágiles y globales.

- Más de 2 años de experiencia en consultoría, estrategia, transformación comercial o roles equivalentes.
- Experiencia en territory planning, capacity planning, quota planning, seller enablement o modelos operativos de Sales Operations.
- Experiencia con Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics u otras plataformas de CRM, CPQ o ICM.

Governance:
- Develop cyber frameworks, policies, processes, procedures, guidelines, and related documentation.

- Review existing and proposed policies and related documentation with stakeholders.

- Develop reporting metrics, KPIs, and dashboards.

- Monitor how effectively cybersecurity policies, principles and practices are implemented in the delivery of planning and management services.

- Provide policy guidance to cybersecurity management, staff and users.

Risk Management:
- Effectively communicate Cybersecurity risks and posture to senior management.

- Develop risk mitigation strategies to effectively manage risk in accordance with organizational risk appetite.

- Ensure that decisions relating to Cybersecurity are based on sound risk management principles.

- Perform risk analysis whenever an application or system undergoes a major change.

- Provide input to the risk management framework and related documentation.

- Ensure Cybersecurity risks are identified and managed appropriately through the organization's risk governance process.

- Carry out a Cybersecurity risk assessments.

- Work with others to implement and maintain a Cybersecurity risk management program

- Identify and assign individuals to specific roles associated with the execution of the Risk Management Framework

- Establish a risk management strategy for the organization that includes a determination of risk tolerance

- Conduct an initial risk assessment of stakeholder assets and update the risk assessment on an ongoing basis

- Work with organizational officials to ensure continuous monitoring tool data provides situation awareness of risk levels

- Use risk management related tools such as eGRC and monitoring tools to assess risks

- Develop methods to effectively monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts.

- Determine and document supply chain risks for critical system elements, where they exist.

Compliance & Regulation:
- Analyze the organization's Cybersecurity policies and configurations to evaluate compliance with regulations and organization compliance frameworks

- Recognize patterns of non-compliance with Cybersecurity policies and related documentation to identify ways to improve the documentation

- Periodically review Cybersecurity strategy, policies, and related documents to maintain compliance with applicable legislation and regulation

- Work with stakeholders to resolve Cybersecurity incidents and vulnerability compliance issues

- Develop methods to effectively monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts

- Develop specifications to ensure that risk, compliance, and assurance efforts conform with Cybersecurity requirements.

- Monitor and evaluate a system's compliance with Cybersecurity, resilience, and dependability requirements

- Develop Cybersecurity compliance processes and audits for services provided by third parties

- Maintain knowledge of applicable legislation, regulation, and accreditation standards and regularly review these to ensure continued organizational compliance

- Cooperate with relevant regulatory agencies and other legal entities in any compliance reviews or investigations.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills

- Ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment

- Flexibility to travel

- Consulting, stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.

- Fluent in Arabic and English language

- Ability to effectively communicate insights relating to an organization’s threat environment to improve its risk management posture.

- Ability to work with the organization's leadership to provide a comprehensive, organization wide approach to address Cybersecurity risk and compliance.

- Ability to work with the organization's leadership to develop a risk management strategy to address Cybersecurity related risks.

- Ability to develop and maintain Cybersecurity policies, standards and related documentations to support business strategy and maintain compliance with legislative, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

- Ability to communicate technical and planning information at the same level as a stakeholder’s understanding.

- Knowledge and understanding of risk assessment, mitigation, and treatment methods.

- Knowledge of relevant Cybersecurity aspects of legislative and regulatory requirements, relating to ethics and privacy.

- Knowledge of Cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities posed by new technologies and malicious actors.

- Knowledge and understanding of risk assessment, mitigation, and management methods.

- Knowledge of the likely operational impact on an organization of Cybersecurity breaches.

- Knowledge of national Cybersecurity laws and regulations such as SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, etc.

- Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO 27001/27002, NIST, PCI DSS, ITIL, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in information security, Cybersecurity or relevant.

- 5+ years of experience in similar position

- Should be Certified in CRISC, GRCP, ISO 27001 LI or equal certifications.

You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology.

Business Case & Value Transformation: Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations. Agentic AI Design: Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms. Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components for AI solutions. Scaled AI Deployment: Evaluate options for AI productionisation and scaled deployment, including MLOps, AI governance, value realisation tracking, and change management.

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role

- Enterprise AI & GenAI Strategy: Design & guide development of enterprise-wide AI & GenAI strategy for clients. Leverage strong expertise and certification in cloud AI platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson — as well as open-source models.
- Scaled AI Deployment & MLOps: Guide implementation from advisory and prototype through to production-grade, scaled AI deployment, covering AI productionisation, MLOps, AI governance, model monitoring, change management, and value realisation frameworks.
- Responsible AI & Governance: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI & GenAI frameworks, including bias detection, explainability, fairness, and regulatory compliance, to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations.
- Business Case & Value Realization: Define an AI use case driven value realization framework and build quantitative and qualitative business cases relevant to the client's industry. Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers.
- Proof of Concepts & Prototyping: Help design and lead POCs and high-level solutions using AI or GenAI analytics to derive insights from data. Collaborate with business experts, platform engineers, and technology teams for prototyping and client implementations.
- Discovery Workshops & Stakeholder Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & GenAI opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.
- Solution Architecture & Technology Landscape: Assess impact to client's technology landscape/architecture; formulate guiding principles and platform components. Demonstrate knowledge of IT & enterprise architecture concepts — Cloud, API-first, MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, observability.
- Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI transformation engagements.

Read more about us.
- The rise of forerunners
- Recent Blogs

Your Experience Counts!
- MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred.
- 3 – 5 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.
- 2+ years of experience in designing and building end-to-end Enterprise AI and GenAI strategic solutions using cloud and non-cloud platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson, DataRobot, or equivalent.
- Excellent understanding of Traditional AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and Advanced Cognitive methods to derive insights and actions.
- Demonstrated ability to design agentic AI workflows, including LLM architecture, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and AI agent design for production environments.
- 2+ years of experience writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives or AI & Data transformation, including value realisation and AI governance frameworks.
- Good working knowledge in formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components with expertise in Responsible AI frameworks, including bias, explainability, and regulatory compliance.
- 2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing AI strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs.
- Deep understanding of data supply chain and how it enables AI productionisation and scaled deployment.
- Mandatory knowledge of IT & Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience — Cloud, API-first, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MLOps, observability.
- Strong understanding in any of the following industries preferred: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, Transportation, Automotive/Industrial, or equivalent.
- Cloud AI Practitioner Certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) desirable but not essential.

What's in It for You?

- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

jobs.description:
Job Description
We are
We are a global collective of innovators applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. Help us show the world what’s possible as you partner with clients to unlock hidden value and deliver innovative solutions. Empowered with innovative tools, continuous learning, and a global community of diverse talent and perspectives, we drive success in a new business architecture that disrupts conventional practices. Our expertise spans 40+ industries across 120+ countries and impacts millions of lives every day. We turn ideas into reality.

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond to, and recover, at all points of the security lifecycle. We hire the very best security talent and arm them with the coolest tools and latest tech so they can help our clients build resilience as we create integrated, customized turnkey solutions. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

You Are
Passionate about security, you love what you do and have a genuine desire to outsmart the bad guys. You have experience in leading discovery conversations with client security teams (CISO, SOC leads, architects) to understand the current state, identify gaps, and map Falcon platform capabilities to business outcomes.  You have designed and delivered
compelling technical demonstrations of the Falcon platform, including NG-SIEM, Exposure Management (CTEM), Identity Protection, Cloud Security, and Charlotte AI, tailored to the client's environment and priorities.  You excel at the development and presentation of solution proposals, architecture diagrams, and business value assessments (BVAs) that articulate clear value outcomes and benefits.
The Work
We are expanding our team in search of experienced professionals to grow our Cyber Defense and Resilience practice, helping our clients modernize to an AI-powered defense posture.  Accenture provides the opportunity to support world-class cybersecurity programs for some of the largest organizations in the world, through a focus on rapid threat identification, incident response, cyber threat intelligence infusion, and mitigations to ensure defensive resiliency.
You will work alongside Accenture's CrowdStrike Business Group as a trusted technical expert, supporting pre-sales engagements with deep platform knowledge and experience in hands-on delivery of CrowdStrike Falcon platform implementations for enterprise clients.  You will work at the intersection of Accenture's consulting expertise and CrowdStrike's technology leadership, helping clients transform their security operations, consolidate tools onto the Falcon platform, and realize measurable outcomes.
You will be part of a specialized team that advises our clients on how to manage their cyber risk and solve hard security problems through a combination of strategic vision and operational expertise. You will contribute to the development and market positioning of Accenture CrowdStrike specific offerings and position those offerings at the core of opportunity pipeline acceleration support activities.
Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Job Qualifications
Here's what you need
-  Minimum 5 years in a pre-sales, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical delivery role within the cybersecurity industry
- Minimum 3 years hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform (endpoint protection, EDR, or adjacent modules), either in a vendor, partner, or customer capacity
- Minimum 7 years demonstrated experience leading technical client conversations at the CISO, security architect, or SOC lead level
- Minimum 5 years experience with at least two of the following: SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, Sentinel, Chronicle), endpoint security, identity threat detection, cloud security posture management, or vulnerability/exposure management
- Minimum 7 years experience with enterprise security architectures, including identity infrastructure, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), OT/ICS environments, or hybrid data center
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus points in you have
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executive audiences
- Active CrowdStrike certification(s): CCFA, CCSE, or CrowdStrike Champions Professional/Expert
- Direct experience with CrowdStrike NG-SIEM: migration delivery, parser development, CQL, or LogScale administration
- Experience delivering managed security services or working within an MSSP/MDR environment
- Experience leading or collaborating with global teams
- Experience with CTEM (Cyber Threat Exposure Management), vulnerability prioritization platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7), or attack surface management
- Working knowledge of compliance frameworks: NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA, HIPAA, or FedRAMP
- Familiarity with threat intelligence operationalization (CrowdStrike CAO/Intel, MITRE ATT&CK, adversary tracking)

- Life Sciences Commercial Domain Expertise (AI fluent): Working knowledge and hands-on experience with implementing AI across one or more Life Sciences commercial sub-functions: - CRM & Customer Engagement (field force optimization, intelligent call planning and execution, HCP/HCO master data and alignment, dynamic territory and account planning, closed-loop marketing, regulatory & compliance, key account management)

- AI Delivery & Responsible AI (Commercial): Experience taking at least one AI, GenAI or agentic AI use case through discovery, design, prototype or pilot, testing, rollout or production; working knowledge of prompt and knowledge design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool and API integration, and model and agent evaluation; application of Responsible AI controls – security, privacy, bias, hallucination and guardrail design, traceability and human oversight – in a regulated commercial environment

GOOD TO HAVE EXPERINCE:
- AI prototyping with GenAI and agent builders
- Process Mining (Celonis/Signavio/Soroco)
- RPA (UiPath/Automation Anywhere)
- Low-Code/No-Code development tools (Copilot Studio, Salesforce Flow, N8N, etc.)
- SQL and Python basics
- Data visualization and storytelling (Tableau / Power BI / CRM Analytics)
- Understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, business analysis, product ownership, testing and UAT, and release planning
- Hands-on configuration or delivery experience on the platforms listed above, plus incentive compensation tools (ZS Javelin, Varicent, Anaplan) and patient hub platforms (CareMetx, Mercalis, AssistRx) etc.
- Content supply chain and MLR review operations, or commercial analytics solutions
- AI and Agentic AI certifications such as Salesforce Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce Certified AI Associate, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud Accredited Professional, Veeva CRM certification, or equivalent cloud AI certifications (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud)
- Prior consulting or in-industry operating experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medtech or healthcare organizations, across commercial operations, sales force effectiveness, patient services / hub operations, or brand marketing

jobs.description:
About the Role
Join our Financial Services practice and help organizations transform their Finance and Risk operating models. As a Business Process & Finance Transformation Analyst/Consultant within the Risk CFO team, you will work with leading financial institutions to design, optimize, and implement business processes that improve financial planning, governance, reporting, and operational efficiency.
You will collaborate with business stakeholders, finance teams, risk functions, and technology teams to drive process transformation initiatives across areas such as budgeting, expense management, financial forecasting, cost allocation, and data governance. This role combines business process design expertise with financial management skills to support strategic decision-making and organizational change.
The successful candidate will bring strong analytical capabilities, experience working within finance transformation environments, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Business Process Design & Transformation
- Design and implement business processes aligned with customer requirements and organizational objectives.
- Analyze current-state processes and operating models to identify optimization opportunities.
- Develop future-state process designs by leveraging established methodologies, tools, and best practices.
- Facilitate workshops and requirements gathering sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
- Support large-scale transformation initiatives across finance and risk functions.

Finance & CFO Transformation
- Support the design and improvement of end-to-end finance processes.
- Contribute to expense management and spend governance initiatives.
- Support forecasting and planning processes, including Profit & Loss (P&L) forecasting.
- Assist in the design and optimization of cost allocation frameworks and methodologies.
- Collaborate with finance and risk stakeholders to improve financial transparency, reporting accuracy, and decision-making capabilities.
- Support finance transformation programs aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and governance.

Data Governance & Compliance
- Drive data governance initiatives to improve data quality, consistency, and controls.
- Ensure business processes comply with regulatory and internal governance requirements.
- Support risk assessment and control activities throughout transformation initiatives.
- Collaborate with compliance and risk management teams to embed governance into process design.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
- Develop and implement change interventions that support organizational transformation.
- Engage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful adoption of new processes.
- Communicate recommendations, risks, and opportunities to business leaders and project teams.
- Support training, communications, and transition activities associated with new processes and systems.

Required Qualifications
Education
- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience
- Minimum 2 years of experience in Business Process Design, Finance Transformation, CFO Advisory, Risk Transformation, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Data Governance, or a related discipline.
- Experience working with financial planning, forecasting, expense management, cost allocation, or management reporting processes.
- Experience collaborating with business, finance, risk, and technology stakeholders.

- Advanced proficiency in Business Process Design.
- Advanced proficiency in Data Governance.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Experience mapping and optimizing end-to-end business processes.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable process solutions.

Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
Experience with at least one of the following ecosystems:
- SAP , including modules supporting: - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

- Financial Accounting (FI)
- Cost Management
- Financial Reporting

- Oracle , including modules supporting: - Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)
- Financial Planning
- Financial Consolidation
- Cost Allocation
- Management Reporting

Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) & Forecasting Tools
Experience with one or more of the following solutions:
- OneStream
- Anaplan
- Infor

Data & Transformation Tools
- Experience working with data governance frameworks and financial data management processes.
- Familiarity with process mapping and transformation methodologies.
- Exposure to finance and risk data management environments is highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications
Financial Services & Risk CFO Experience
- Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Capital Markets, or Insurance.
- Understanding of Risk CFO operating models and finance transformation initiatives.
- Experience supporting forecasting, budgeting, expense management, and cost allocation processes.
- Exposure to finance and risk regulatory environments.

Additional Skills
- Intermediate proficiency in Regulatory Compliance.
- Intermediate proficiency in Process Improvement.
- Intermediate proficiency in Change Management.
- Intermediate proficiency in Risk Assessment.
- Beginner proficiency in Strategic Planning.
