Develop your career and thrive in a stimulating and dynamic environment, working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve meaningful business challenges.
Industry X  drives the digital transformation of industrial processes by integrating advanced technologies such as IoT, artificial intelligence, digital twins, and robotics.  Its goal is to optimize the design, production, and maintenance of products and services, improving operational efficiency, sustainability, and business resilience.
This practice works with clients across multiple industries to reinvent how they create value—connecting data, people, and machines in real time.

🛠️ Principal Duties and Responsibilities
As part of  Industry X , you will help transform how capital projects are delivered—bringing innovation, deep industry knowledge, and cutting-edge technology to our clients.
Your mission will be to:
- 💼  Deliver business value  by supporting clients in industries such as Data Centers, Semiconductors, Public Infrastructure, Utilities, and Oil & Gas.
- 📊  Support planning, monitoring, and control  of mega/large capital projects—ensuring timely execution, budget adherence, quality standards, and sustainability goals.
- 🧠  Provide insights  across key areas like Planning & Scheduling, Cost Management, Data Analytics & Reporting, Contract Management, and Capex Procurement.
- 🤝  Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders  throughout the project lifecycle to generate meaningful reports and drive informed decision-making.
- 🧩  Work with leading platforms  such as MS Project, Primavera, Prism, Unifier, ProCore, and EcoSys—including solution implementation across the lifecycle.
- 📝  Develop project-specific deliverables  like Operating Models, Risk Registers, Communication Matrices, Governance Frameworks, and tailored processes.
- 🚀  Shape, sell, and deliver transformation projects —from current state assessments to efficiency opportunities, solution design, business cases, and roadmaps.
- 🔧  Design future ways of working —including operating models, business functions, processes, and technology strategies in collaboration with experts.
- ⚠️  Manage risk governance  across the project lifecycle, supporting mitigation strategies and contingency planning.
- 🔄  Evaluate and manage scope changes , assessing their impact on budget and schedule, and communicating effectively with stakeholders.
- 📈  Prepare progress reports  and capture lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
- 🌐  Design and implement digital strategies , including digital architecture, within defined timelines and budget requirements.

🎓   Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar fields
- Analyst : 2–5 years of experience in Project Management & Execution for Capital Projects.
- Consultant : 6–8 years of experience with strong understanding of managed services in Capital Build.
- Advanced written and spoken English   is required.
- Experience in large-scale capital projects across industries and geographies.
- Background in management consulting with direct client-facing roles, including exposure to Project Management, Project Controls, and Software/Tool Implementation.
- Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives.
- Preferred : Familiarity with various construction methodologies and resource planning for optimized execution.
- Preferred : Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, QlikView.
- Proficiency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint is   mandatory ; experience with VB Scripts and Macros is a   plus .

🧠   Key Competencies & Skills
- Expertise in one or more of the following: - Implementation of digital tools and strategies.
- End-to-end business processes and workflows.
- Capital Projects lifecycle with focus on schedule, cost, reporting, and risk management.
- Data analytics for actionable insights.

- Strong knowledge of project planning, monitoring, and control—from conceptualization to commissioning.
- Ability to develop dashboards, red flag reports, schedule analysis, and other MIS reports highlighting project progress and criticalities.
- Skilled in translating quantitative data into strategic recommendations.
- Flexibility to travel and adapt to client expectations and return-to-office plans.
- Willingness to collaborate across time zones with offshore teams.
- Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.

Benefits We Offer You
- 🍔   Pedidos Ya   delivery credits

- 🌐   Connectivity reimbursement

- 🧸   Financial support for childcare
- ➕ And many more!

We want you to have the tools you need to keep learning, growing, and making a difference in the world.
We offer valuable opportunities for both your professional and personal development, including access to exclusive courses and certifications.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Planning Transformation Senior Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

We are Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering reinvention partner for Life Sciences. We embed innovation, intelligence, and AI-native operations into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes products. We serve Life Sciences clients across the value chain to help bring lifesaving medicines and products to patients through harnessing the power of advanced technologies.

The Work:
Accenture is seeking a Senior Manager to lead Planning transformation work within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice for Life Sciences. This executive will serve as a trusted advisor to C suite and operations leaders, helping clients plan and manage operations using the power of AI.

The role is responsible for shaping, selling, and delivering large scale Planning Transformation programs. The Senior Manager will assess growth, build client relationships, drive origination and own end to end delivery while building Accenture’s differentiated Planning capability.

Key Responsibilities:
Client Leadership & Growth
- Serve as a trusted advisor to C suite, operations, and planning leaders, guiding AI transformation projects for Planning from conceptual design through handover.

- Build and expand executive relationships across priority accounts, driving sustained growth and value realization through consistent follow-through and a long-term partnership mindset.

- Navigate complex stakeholder environments with multiple competing priorities, aligning diverse groups around a shared transformation vision and maintaining trust under pressure.

- Synthesize ambiguous client situations into clear, actionable strategic direction, translating complexity into narratives that resonate at the board level and drive decisions.

- Anticipate client needs before they surface, proactively shaping the agenda and positioning Accenture as a strategic partner rather than a transactional vendor.

- Support client sales origination and develop thought leadership, points of view, and go-to-market assets that differentiate Accenture's Planning offering.

Planning Program Leadership
- Integrate engineering, supply chain, digital manufacturing, automation, and sustainability into a single transformation vision connecting technical detail to business value in a way that drives executive alignment and investment decisions.

- Oversee complex, multi-partner delivery managing through influence, not just authority, to keep diverse teams aligned and accountable.

- Apply structured problem-solving and systems thinking to break down large transformation challenges into sequenced, manageable workstreams with clear ownership and milestones.

- Exercise sound judgment and decisive leadership when navigating delivery risk, scope ambiguity, or shifting client priorities escalating and course-correcting proactively.

- Own financial performance, delivery excellence, and risk management across the portfolio with transparency and disciplined execution.

AI-Enabled Transformation
- Sell and deliver major transformation programs spanning Patient-Based Demand Forecasting, IBP/S&OP, S&OE, Inventory Optimization, or CMO/CDMO Supply Planning

- Find solutions to clients’ life sciences supply chain and planning challenges — including demand volatility, CMO/CDMO constraints, regulatory holds, and launch planning complexity

- Spot and solve challenges using your analytical & strategy skills to dive into data and compare vs. industry peers

- Assist with workshops that look for ways to improve organizations and processes

- Determine what methods and procedures to use when completing projects

Meet our Technology Strategy and Advisory Team
Our Technology Strategy and Advisory services help reinvent organizations and build business value thanks to resilient industry-specific technology architectures, as well as cost-efficient and flexible cloud and data solutions. We guide our Clients throughout the transformation journey , we start with a technology and ecosystem strategy that lays a future-ready foundation.

We deliver consulting assignments across industries and geographies. We work with some of the biggest organizations worldwide , your impact will be truly global  and you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry.

What’s in it for you
Join our team, where we help organizations better understand, manage and optimize the value of their technology investments.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of IT, Finance and Strategy , supporting clients in building transparency, improving decision-making and driving real business outcomes from technology spend.
You will be involved in:
- Supporting IT Finance / TBM / FinOps transformations for large organizations

- Conducting assessments of IT cost transparency and IT financial management maturity , and defining actionable improvement roadmaps

- 2-5 years of experience in IT Finance, TBM, FinOps or related areas

jobs.title: Finance, Risk and Compliance Consultant in Financial Services
jobs.description:
Accenture’s Industry & Enterprise – Financial Services practice operates across industries, including financial services.
The Finance, Risk and Compliance (F&R&C) team focuses on supporting the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Chief Risk officer (CRO) and Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in transforming their respective functions to make them future proof. With strong expertise, our F&R&C professionals design, build and deliver high-value solutions to our clients.
As a consultant in the Finance, Risk and Compliance team, you will contribute to both your project team and your client counterpart at leading financial institutions in BeLux and abroad in the financial services industry:
- You will be responsible for designing, building, and delivering high value solutions that help our clients move forward in every part of their Finance Function.
- You will contribute to both your project team and your client counterpart at leading clients in BeLux and abroad in the financial services (FS) industry.
- Project management is key: following up on both the difficulties as well as on the impact of the solutions you have proposed and implemented.
- You will be involved in diverse business development activities and sell innovative projects to transform the Finance function together with the industry and functional experts.

Duties
- Manage projects related to the implementation of new regulations, remediation of audit findings, and advisory on organizational and technical optimization to meet regulatory requirements efficiently.
- Leverage analytical and technical skills to steer the team towards exceptional insights.
- Develop a strong network of clients, experts, colleagues, and colleagues within Accenture.
- Actively keep track of latest regulations and compliance trends and opportunities they entail.

In addition, you will:
- Build and maintain strong client relationships to accelerate company business growth.
- Act as the entrepreneur of your own career by defining and executing business development and sales initiatives.
- Provide subject matter expertise, industry perspectives and relevant point of views to drive client value.
- Attract, mentor and inspire talent by driving teams towards outstanding results.

Your team
As part of our Industry & Enterprise – Financial Services team , you will join a team that helps clients continuously reinvent themselves in a world of constant change. We combine deep industry expertise with advanced technology, data, and AI to drive end-to-end transformation.
Operating at the intersection of business, technology, and financial services, we support leading banks, insurers, and capital markets players in responding to evolving customer expectations, regulatory pressures, and digital disruption. We don’t just define strategy — we bring it to life, from ideation to execution.
With a strong focus on innovation, operating model reinvention, and future-ready capabilities, our teams design and deliver scalable solutions that create lasting value. Together, we empower our clients to stay competitive, resilient, and ready for what’s next.

Your background
- Master’s degree in law, European affairs, business economics, Finance/Risk Management or related fields.
-  2 to 5 years of experience within the financial services industry, in regulatory and compliance functions, public affairs, compliance transformation, non-financial risk management or GRC implementation.
- Proficiency in English and Dutch or French
- Understanding and knowledge of relevant regulatory landscapes such as Mifid/IDD, KYC/AML/Anti-Financial crimes, PSD II, Data privacy & GDPR, SFRD, CSRD, EU taxonomy & ESG requirements, DORA.
- Understanding of digitalization and data analytics potentials for process optimization.
- Entrepreneurial mindset and interest in supporting business development.
- Experience in client-facing environments, delivering changes through activities such as requirements definition, gap analysis, and solution design.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills (e.g., storytelling, stakeholder management).
- High proficiency with MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
- Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Python) is a plus.

Ability related to:
- Supporting clients in defining non-financial risks appetites.
- Transform business & regulatory needs into actionable IT requirements.
- Setting up adequate governance structures and controls frameworks to ensure compliance.

Our offer
Within the CFO & Enterprise Value practice of Accenture Belgium and Luxembourg, you will get the opportunity to work for leading financial institutions on high-value end-to-end projects. You will be able to build your skills and expertise by leveraging our state-of-the-art assets, methodologies, global network of experts and comprehensive training curriculum. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted in classrooms, online or in collaboration with external parties. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable steppingstone to build a career.
We offer opportunities to evolve in your career and grow your impacts and responsibilities over time.
Besides our high-profile, challenging projects and our nurturing work environment, we offer excellent employee benefits, including:
- 32 days of holidays
- Federal Mobility Budget
- Internet at home
- Net allowance
- Laptop and smartphone
- Hospitalization insurance and extensive group insurance package

- Bonus program and Flexrewards: decide on your rewards package with our flexible benefits tool

There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why we love it here! This is an extraordinary chance to create a rewarding career at Accenture Technology. Working in a digitally driven, innovation-led environment where you can help clients shift to the New using leading-edge technologies on some of the coolest projects you can imagine.

We are:
Accenture’s SAP practice, and we bring the New to life using design thinking, agile development methodologies, and the latest smart tech like IoT, automation, and AI. It’s also nice to know our hard work doesn’t go unrecognized. A transformation maven with the skills to help clients meet the challenges of digitization. Your superpower? Using your know-how to solve clients’ most complex business problems to help their companies do more. You’re as comfortable working in teams and leading projects as you are diving into the details of workstreams and configuring SAP solutions. And you’re up for traveling regularly to client sites.

The work:
- Strategically define how data will be stored, consumed, integrated and managed by different data entities and systems.
- Analyze, design and or implement data design and best practices through technology solutions. Aligned with data governance, predictive modeling, and or data visualization.
- Use your business smarts to kick-start transformation programs, whether domain- or platform-led
- Work in a team where you wear lots of hats – interacting with clients, managing workstreams, collaborating with other teams – and where you may need to be in charge
- Run the workstream and/or project activities you’ve been given
- Interact with all workstreams – technical, reports, conversion, change management, project management and more.
- Tweak current methods, tools and procedures to create solutions that meet clients’ needs.
- Check business requirements to find configuration solutions
- Keep a record of requirements, solutions and impacts, alternatives and final decisions

- Atleast 5+ years experience in SAP FI SAP FI including GL, AR, AP, PS and AA
- Atleast 2 years experience with S/4 HANA
- Atleast  1 year experience managing teams in a Global Delivery module
- Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience
- Ability to act as a Functional Solution Architect within the functional area, providing high-level design expertise.
- Extensive experience in SAP S/4 transformations and a track record of successful project implementations.
- Proven capability in defining SAP Finance functional roadmaps and strategies for clients.
- Experience in leading business process reengineering efforts to optimize finance-related workflows and enhance process efficiency.
- Ability to collaborate with stakeholders at various levels, including C-suite executives, to present functional strategies and gain buy-in.
- Must have federal government security clearance or be eligible to obtain it.
- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. - You’ve got external consulting experience
- You know how SAP’s business development process works and you can help clients understand how SAP will help their company do more

- Fantastic opportunities to develop your career across industries with local and global clients.

The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology.

Business Case & Value Transformation: Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations. Agentic AI Design: Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms. Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components for AI solutions. Scaled AI Deployment: Evaluate options for AI productionisation and scaled deployment, including MLOps, AI governance, value realisation tracking, and change management.

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role
- Process Hotspot Identification: Identify high-value business processes where Agentic AI can eliminate friction and unlock measurable value, using process analysis, business process mapping, process mining, and value-led prioritisation frameworks across target industries.

- Proof of Concepts & Prototyping: Help design and lead POCs and high-level solutions using AI or GenAI analytics to derive insights from data. Collaborate with business experts, platform engineers, and technology teams for prototyping and client implementations.
- Discovery Workshops & Stakeholder Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & GenAI opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.

jobs.description:
AI Architect — Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from AI and GenAI architecture.
Practice : Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work : GenAI Strategy & Architecture
Level : Manager
Location : Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
Years of Experience : 10 to 15 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.

The Practice — A Brief Sketch
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology.

Business Case & Value Transformation: Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations. Agentic AI Design: Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms. Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components for AI solutions. Scaled AI Deployment: Evaluate options for AI productionisation and scaled deployment, including MLOps, AI governance, value realisation tracking, and change management.

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role
- Process Hotspot Identification: Identify high-value business processes where Agentic AI can eliminate friction and unlock measurable value, using process analysis, business process mapping, process mining, and value-led prioritisation frameworks across target industries.
- Agentic AI Design & Architecture: Design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production deployment. Demonstrate deep expertise in LLM architecture, prompt engineering, GenAI platforms, and framework selection (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent).
- Enterprise AI & GenAI Strategy: Design & guide development of enterprise-wide AI & GenAI strategy for clients. Leverage strong expertise and certification in cloud AI platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson — as well as open-source models.
- Scaled AI Deployment & MLOps: Guide implementation from advisory and prototype through to production-grade, scaled AI deployment, covering AI productionisation, MLOps, AI governance, model monitoring, change management, and value realisation frameworks.
- Responsible AI & Governance: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI & GenAI frameworks, including bias detection, explainability, fairness, and regulatory compliance, to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations.
- Business Case & Value Realization: Define an AI use case driven value realization framework and build quantitative and qualitative business cases relevant to the client's industry. Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers.
- Proof of Concepts & Prototyping: Help design and lead POCs and high-level solutions using AI or GenAI analytics to derive insights from data. Collaborate with business experts, platform engineers, and technology teams for prototyping and client implementations.
- Discovery Workshops & Stakeholder Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & GenAI opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.
- Solution Architecture & Technology Landscape: Assess impact to client's technology landscape/architecture; formulate guiding principles and platform components. Demonstrate knowledge of IT & enterprise architecture concepts — Cloud, API-first, MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, observability.
- Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI transformation engagements.

jobs.description:
Gestalte die Finanzwelt von morgen mit und treibe den digitalen Wandel der Branche voran!

Als Manager:in Finance Transformation betreust du namhafte Kunden aus der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche bei ihrer digitalen Transformation. Mit deiner Expertise in den Bereichen Gesamtbanksteuerung und Finanzarchitekturen hast du für jede regulatorische Herausforderung die richtige technologische Lösung parat. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden definierst du nachhaltige Geschäftsmodelle und erarbeitest, wie diese in Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, Controlling und Co. Optimal umgesetzt werden können. Außerdem entwickelst du innovative Daten- und Analysemodelle, identifizierst die passenden Softwarelösungen und begleitest anschließend deren Implementierung.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

- Führe dein Projektteam zum Erfolg.
Du tauschst dich eng mit unseren Kunden und deinen Kolleg:innen aus und koordinierst dein Team.

- Übernimm die fachliche Konzeption.
Du entwickelst Themen eigenständig weiter und treibst sie bis zur Marktreife voran.

- Nutze deine Kreativität.
Du hinterfragst traditionelle Methoden der Finanztransformation, findest innovative Ansätze und setzt sie erfolgreich um.

- Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in einigen Projekten im Umfeld der Finanztransformation oder der Implementierung von Systemen der Gesamtbanksteuerung bei Banken gesammelt – teilweise sogar Projekte selbst geleitet

- Idealerweise kennst du dich mit SAP-Bankenlösungen (SAP FSDM, SAP FPSL etc.) und Meldewesen-Systemen aus.

Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Every day, we imagine the future and bring it to life using design thinking, agile development methodologies, and new smart tech like IoT, automation, and AI. We even built our own platform, myConcerto, that mixes the best parts of Accenture and Oracle to help companies come into their own as digital leaders. Ready to find genius answers to seriously hard business challenges and work with some of the best? Come join a team that feels personal even though it's over 54,000 strong. As a Global Cloud Elite and Platinum member of the Oracle Partner Network with over 145 awards, we're proud the industry is taking notice of our work, too. Visit us here to find out more about Accenture's Oracle practice
( https://www.accenture.com/us-en/services/oracle-index .)

You Are:
A senior Oracle Utilities reporting strategist who brings the vision and execution capability to define and deliver a comprehensive reporting program for a complex IT transition. You understand how operational, financial, and regulatory reporting requirements translate into Oracle Utilities data models and reporting architectures. You lead with strategy — designing frameworks that are sustainable and scalable — while remaining close enough to the work to ensure delivery quality. You speak fluently to both business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, and you know how to turn data into decisions.

The Work:
- Define and lead the onshore reporting strategy for a large-scale Oracle Utilities IT transition, establishing reporting architecture, tooling standards, delivery approach, and governance frameworks.

- Translate business, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements into Oracle Utilities reporting designs using tools including Power BI, OBIEE, and Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC).

- Lead the design and delivery of priority reporting deliverables, ensuring alignment with program milestones and client business needs.

- Collaborate with Oracle Utilities functional leads, data architects, and integration teams to ensure reporting designs are grounded in accurate, accessible data models.

- Manage onshore and offshore reporting team resources, setting delivery priorities, quality standards, and review cadences.

- Engage client business stakeholders and IT leadership to validate reporting requirements, review designs, and present completed deliverables.

- Define report design standards, templates, and documentation conventions to ensure consistency across the reporting library.

- Support program leadership with KPI dashboards and operational reporting to track program health and delivery progress.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum 10 years of experience in Oracle Utilities reporting, BI, or analytics roles, including a minimum of 5 years leading reporting strategy or architecture on enterprise programs.
- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with Power BI, OBIEE, or Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) in an Oracle Utilities context.
- Minimum 3 years of experience in a senior lead or manager role responsible for reporting delivery on an Oracle Utilities implementation or IT transformation program.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate's Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6 years' work experience.

Bonus Points If:
- Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or OBIEE certification.
- Experience with Oracle Utilities data warehouse or analytics accelerator products.
- Familiarity with utility industry regulatory reporting requirements (FERC, state PUC, etc.).
- Prior experience building reporting capability from the ground up on a large Oracle Utilities transformation program.
- Minimum 2 years of experience translating regulatory or operational reporting requirements into Oracle Utilities data models and BI report designs.

jobs.title: Temenos Senior Consultant and Functional Architect – Core Banking & Payments
jobs.description:
Be yourself, make a difference.
Are you ready to help leading banks modernize their core banking and payments platforms?

This is an opportunity to build a rewarding career at Accenture, working at the intersection of banking, technology, transformation and platform modernization. We are looking for experienced Temenos Functional Architect to join our growing Financial Services team in Finland.

In this role, you will work with leading Nordic and international financial institutions on core banking transformation initiatives involving Temenos Transact / T24, Temenos Payments Hub and related banking platforms. You will help clients translate complex business needs into practical solution designs, functional specifications, configuration decisions and delivery outcomes.

You will act as a bridge between business, architecture and technology teams. Your main goal is to ensure that Temenos-enabled transformations are aligned with banking processes, client objectives, regulatory expectations, integration needs and implementation realities.

The role is suitable for professionals who combine strong Temenos platform expertise with banking domain understanding, structured delivery skills and the ability to work with senior client stakeholders. Depending on your experience, you may act as a functional architect, solution lead, workstream lead, senior consultant or techno-functional advisor in client engagements.

You will also get access to Accenture’s Nordic and global Banking, Payments and Temenos communities, experienced colleagues, delivery assets, learning opportunities and cross-border client engagements.

Qualifications
We are looking for professionals with deep Temenos experience, strong banking domain expertise and proven delivery experience from complex core banking or payments transformation programs. You do not need to be an expert in every Temenos module, but you should bring hands-on experience in Temenos-enabled delivery and the ability to work confidently with both business and technology stakeholders.

Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end requirement gathering with business stakeholders, with a strong focus on Retail Banking processes
- Translate business requirements into T24 functional solutions
- Lead business workshops and training sessions
- Understand and support configuration and customization of Temenos T24/Transact modules
- Support development of business requirements (BRDs), functional specifications (FSDs) and other documentation to guide delivery
- Guide preparation and execution of system testing, validation, and quality assurance, ensuring alignment with business requirements
- Support UAT, integration testing, and production readiness activities
- Support product configuration and release management
- Support preparation and delivery of end-user training and post-implementation support
- Collaborate with technical teams on system design, workflows, and data architecture
- Contribute to As-Is / To-Be architecture definition and solution design
- Ensure effective stakeholder communication and governance across delivery streams
- Contribute to market analysis and client solutioning (techno-functional perspective)

Requirements
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a relevant field, such as business, finance, economics, technology, engineering, information systems or another applicable discipline.
- Typically 6+ years of experience within the Temenos ecosystem.
- Hands-on experience with Temenos Transact (T24) including Arrangement Architecture (AA) - accounts, deposits, loans, treasury, payments or product configuration.
- Experience with Temenos Payments Hub (TPH) and treasury.
- Hands-on experience in parameter setup and configuration, preparation of Configuration Specification Documents, BRDs and CCE questionnaires.
- Experience across TDH and Financial Crime Mitigation (FCM).
- Proven experience in core banking implementations and support in European markets (Nordics is a plus).
- Familiarity with SaaS, cloud banking, managed service or modern platform delivery models is considered an advantage.
- Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and translate them into clear decisions and deliverables.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence both client and internal teams.
- High drive, proactive attitude and comfort working in high-autonomy environments with multiple parallel workstreams.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Finnish or another Nordic language is considered an advantage.
- Resident in Finland.

What’s in it for you
- Opportunity to work with leading Nordic and international financial institutions on business-critical core banking and payments transformation programs.
- A role where you can combine Temenos platform expertise, banking domain knowledge, functional architecture and technology-enabled delivery.
- Access to Accenture’s Nordic and global Banking, Payments and Temenos knowledge base, experienced colleagues, methods, assets and communities of practice.
- A chance to help build and shape a growing core banking and Temenos capability in Finland, with close collaboration across the Nordics and globally.
- Exposure to modern banking topics such as SaaS delivery models, cloud banking, digital core modernization, payments modernization and AI-enabled banking transformation.
- International and cross-border expert teams supporting you in client engagements and professional development.
- A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports continuous learning, career development and wellbeing.
- Competitive rewards and benefits package according to Accenture Finland practices.

Interested? Make your move – apply online and attach your CV and letter of application in English. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
Role: Management Consultant – Public Sector (Business Case & Financial Modelling Specialist)
Location: London, Manchester, Newcastle
Mobility: Up to 100%
Career Level:  Consultant

Due to the nature of client work you will be undertaking, you will need to be willing to go through a Security Clearance process as part of this role. This requires at least 5 years residency in the UK and not having left the country for more than 30 days consecutively.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:

The Public Sector Strategy & Consulting team are working at the centre of high-profile transformations across the UK government and healthcare sectors, including significant work with public safety organisations. Within the practice, you will work on innovative projects with colleagues and clients to drive excellence from strategy through to implementation, making changes that directly impact citizens. You will be using the latest technologies and methodologies with clients to help them achieve tangible outcomes and accelerate value.
Do you want to work in an environment that is cutting-edge, collaborative and challenging, doing work that really matters?
You'll learn, grow and advance in a collaborative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. At Accenture, you can truly take control of your own career.
If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you.

In our team you will learn:
- How to develop and deliver solutions to real world problems, partnering with clients to achieve positive outcomes through collaboration
- How to maximise the use of data in everything you do, using this data to drive solutions and tell meaningful stories to our clients
- How to lead with user-centricity at the heart of our work
- To obsess about driving value for your clients
- How to advise our clients on major transformations and reinventions, via the development of HM Treasury Green Book-compliant business cases and supporting analysis

As a H&PS Consultant, you will:
- Work on projects across a range of clients delivering services to the public, including central government departments, the NHS, arms lengths bodies, private health clients, research and regulatory and integrated care systems.
- Be the face of Accenture to the client in your engagements, working with senior stakeholders to advise, challenge and coach as needed
- Develop detailed understanding of your client’s business and drive issue-based discussions grounded in a clear understanding of client challenges and barriers.
- Cultivate trust-based client relationships
- Identify and address client business issues through root cause analysis and by applying pragmatic, results-driven problem-solving techniques and creative insights.
- Use a human-centred approach to solve problems, frame opportunities, and achieve innovation through collaboration and co-creation.
- Own streams of complex work that meets client expectations on delivering value-centric, data-driven outcomes

We are looking for experience in the following skills:

The most important thing for us is that you display the right attitude. We would like you to actively contribute to our community and clients as practitioners, think logically to tackle problems and engage others. We want you to be driven to develop yourself and others, an ability to see and articulate the bigger picture of how individual projects and deliverables create value for citizens and a passion for innovation and the latest technology trends. This role will require creative thinking, excellent client communication skills and the ability to identify new innovative ways to apply our skills and services to solve a wider set of client problems.

Specific to this role, we are seeking experienced consultants who can credibly lead and deliver business cases and financial models for public sector clients, supporting senior decision‑makers on complex investment, transformation and policy choices.
You will combine strong analytical and quantitative capability with the ability to structure problems, develop clear strategic narratives and work confidently with senior stakeholders in government and health settings.

As well as the above, you should have experience/expertise in one or more the following areas:
- Creating and/or managing complex business cases
- Building and reviewing financial, economic or analytical models, ideally aligned to HM Treasury Green Book principles
- Experience translating analysis into clear recommendations and decision points for senior stakeholders
- Analytical problem solving skills and continuous improvement techniques
- Strategic thinking skills and the ability to bring insight to complex problems
- Designing and/or implementing operating models
- Designing or delivering supply chain transformation
- Working with data in the design or delivery of consulting services in the public sector
- Working with technology to design or deliver transformation of public services
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the capability to influence senior stakeholders
- Experience of working with public sector clients, either in government departments or health & care clients
- Experience driving new business in terms of strategy, relationships and identifying growth opportunities
- Experience in project & programme management methodologies and governance – including best practice industry techniques and frameworks (e.g. PRINCE/ MSP)
- Experience of delivering projects using Agile techniques and frameworks and the ability to lead Agile teams
- Ability to operate at all stages of a project/programme lifecycle, from proposal through to full programme delivery, and experience managing risks and working with senior client partners.

Set yourself apart:
- In-depth understanding of the specific government or healthcare landscapes you have worked in
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with confidence working in Excel and interpreting complex data sets
- Direct experience developing or assuring Green Book business cases (including Five Case Model)
- Exposure to spending reviews, investment committees or assurance processes (e.g. IPA, departmental investment boards)
- Professional qualifications or training in financial modelling, economics, appraisal or related disciplines
- Experience working on complex, ambiguous policy or transformation problems where evidence is contested or incomplete
- Experience with data science or data architecture
- Experience in owning and managing relationships with leadership (either with your clients or internal stakeholders)
- Trained in Agile methodologies, programme or project management techniques (e.g. Prince 2, Managing Successful Programmes) and/or a Design Thinking practitioner
- Experience of using data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Qlik, etc) to support analytical storytelling
- Exposure to current technologies (e.g. Cloud, Agentic / Generative AI)
- PowerPoint skills, specifically in terms of communicating complex topics and messages to aid decision-making

What’s in it for you

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jobs.title: SAP Finance Transformation Manager (Order to Cash)
jobs.description:
SAP Finance Transformation Manager (order to Cash)
Career level: Manager (CL7) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (SAP)

Why this role
This role owns the Order-to-Cash workstream end to end on large-scale SAP S/4HANA finance transformation programmes, in front of the client — the full credit-to-cash cycle, from billing and collections through to how revenue is recognised. It's a role to become the finance design authority clients rely on across O2C, and to grow into the practice's go-to for getting revenue recognition right.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
Order-to-Cash expertise. Deep command of the credit-to-cash cycle in SAP S/4HANA finance: order and contract management, accounts receivable and billing integration (FI-AR), credit management, collections, dispute and deduction management, and cash application and clearing. You know how customer master data, profit-centre and reporting structures shape finance insight and control, and how O2C design flows through to working capital, cash flow and the close.

Revenue Recognition. Strong knowledge of how revenue is recognised across the O2C cycle — IFRS 15 and event-based revenue recognition — and how to align O2C process design to it so that billing, contracts and the recognition model hold together. You understand how that design lands in revenue and margin reporting, controls and revenue assurance.

Commercial and revenue models. A strong grasp of the commercial mechanics behind O2C — pricing, discounts, rebates and deductions — and how they play through to revenue, margin and cash. You read SAP SD through the finance and revenue lens: the parts of the sales and billing flow that determine the number finance has to stand behind.

Finance process context. Real Record-to-Report depth around the close, and a clear view of how O2C connects to financial close and controls, and to the adjacent finance processes it depends on.

Leading delivery. You lead the O2C workstream end to end — fit-to-standard, business process design, testing and deployment — as the primary finance design authority for the domain. You manage dependencies with adjacent finance processes, work closely with SAP delivery and integration teams while keeping ownership of the finance outcome, and lead functional teams across onshore and offshore delivery. You facilitate design forums with senior finance, sales and operational stakeholders, and keep programme leadership clear through structured status, issue management and decision recommendations.

Growing the practice. You contribute to how the practice grows — supporting proposals and bids, shaping O2C and revenue-recognition transformation approaches, and building reusable assets and points of view.

Job Description

Sumate y sé el motor que impulsa a Accenture, una empresa que brinda servicios de consultoría y externalización a más de 40 industrias, incluyendo 89 de las FORTUNE 100, y gobiernos de todo el mundo.

El equipo de Deal Structuring & Pricing (DSP) busca perfiles graduados y experiencia en finanzas, inglés avanzado (excluyente) y residencia actual en las capital o zonas cercanas a Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Mendoza, Salta, Rosario o Mar del Plata.

Descripción del equipo y funciones
El equipo de (DSP) brinda soporte financiero especializado a los equipos comerciales de Accenture durante todo el ciclo de desarrollo de negocios. Su responsabilidad central es la estructuración, análisis y validación económico-financiera de las transacciones comerciales, definiendo las condiciones contractuales que rigen los servicios ofrecidos a clientes a nivel global. Por lo tanto el analista del DSP será responsable clave de definir el pricing de contratos de servicios mediante el desarrollo de modelos financieros avanzados, incluyendo forecast, análisis de P&L, estructura de costos, revenue y márgenes. Hands-on experience across the phases of an S/4HANA programme — discovery and envisioning, fit-to-standard and design, business integration and testing, and deployment and stabilisation. You bring a solid understanding of period-end close, finance controls and reporting in an S/4HANA environment, and you can use the platform's capabilities to simplify and standardise how finance runs. You act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with SAP delivery and integration teams while keeping ownership of the finance and business agenda.

Working with finance stakeholders. You're comfortable facilitating workshops with senior finance stakeholders to define future-state processes, co-developing and securing design decisions, and aligning finance, tax, operations and technology around them. You build trusted relationships and have the credibility to challenge and influence finance leaders on the calls that matter. As you grow, you'll contribute to how we win and shape work too — supporting bids, helping shape finance transformation propositions, and articulating CFO-relevant value.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. If you already work this way, that's a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience.

Who you are
You take ownership and follow through, and you're comfortable in the ambiguity that comes with complex client organisations. You work well in a team, build trusted relationships across finance, operations and technology, and communicate clearly — you can run a discovery session with a client and explain a design call to a mixed room with equal ease. You bring good judgement and critical thinking to problems that don't arrive fully formed. You're early in your trajectory and set on building the rest.
Things that set strong candidates apart: experience of S/4HANA finance transformations in complex environments (multi-country, multi-entity, or integrated ERP landscapes); familiarity with fit-to-standard delivery and SAP Activate methods, and a pragmatic sense of where differentiation actually earns its keep; experience designing finance processes with controls, compliance and data integrity built in; an understanding of how intercompany, transfer pricing, tax or treasury concepts interact with core finance; experience across both public and private cloud S/4HANA programmes; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP
Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led S/4HANA finance transformations, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on SAP-enabled finance transformation while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

This role involves flexibility and travel — you'll spend time onsite with our clients and partners to deliver the first-class services we're known for.

Accenture, c'est une communauté de plus de 750 000 talents et une mission commune : réaliser la promesse technologique alliée à l’ingéniosité humaine.

Dans un monde en perpétuel changement, nous accélérons la transformation des plus grandes entreprises, de la stratégie à la réalisation des projets, à l’aide des technologies de demain et dynamisons leur croissance grâce à l'expertise multi-sectorielle de nos experts.
Digital Core, c’est une équipe dynamique, engagée et passionnée par la transformation des organisations.
Nous travaillons dans une ambiance collaborative et stimulante, où l’entraide, la créativité et l’intelligence collective permettent à chacun de progresser et de contribuer à des projets à fort impact.

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, ou de genre et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
Job Qualifications
Imaginez, transformez et impactez le monde positivement : rejoignez l’équipe Strategy & Consulting Digital Core et vivez au cœur du changement en tant que Senior Manager  SAP spécialisé dans la transformation de la fonction Finance.
Reconnu(e) pour votre expertise de la consolidation (statutaire, prudentielle, management reporting) et votre maîtrise des enjeux SI, vous savez de comprendre en profondeur les enjeux métiers des Directions Finance, de prendre de la hauteur sur des problématiques complexes, de structurer des trajectoires de transformation ambitieuses et d’accompagner vos clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques. Curieux(se), exigeant(e) et orienté(e) résultats, vous aimez transmettre vos connaissances, encadrer des équipes et contribuer activement au développement d’un cabinet de conseil.
Rejoignez Accenture et réalisez demain. Dès maintenant.

Vos missions
En tant que Senior Manager SAP Consolidation au sein de l’entité Finance – SAP Strategy Consulting (Digital Core), vous intervenez sur des programmes de transformation à forte valeur ajoutée et assumez un rôle clé auprès de nos clients.
Pilotage de la transformation Consolidation & expertise SAP
- Piloter l’analyse des processus métiers Finance et Consolidation  (close,consolidation, interco, IFRS, reporting statutaire, réglementaire et managérial ).
- Traduire ces processus métiers en processus ciblés outillés, en veillant à leur cohérence fonctionnelle, leur efficacité opérationnelle et leur adéquation avec les solutions SAP et l’écosystème existant.
- Définir et organiser les trajectoires de transformation en articulant modules SAP et solutions de consolidation, dans une logique de création de valeur mesurable. (qualité de données, accélération du closing, conformité, auditabilité, maîtrise des coûts).
- Structurer et sécuriser des architectures cibles (Finance data model, intégrations, gouvernance des données, contrôles) intégrant les solutions SAP (ex. SAP Group Reporting) et/ou les solutions de consolidation du marché, en fonction des besoins client.

Cadrage, choix de solution et architecture d’entreprise
- Conduire des cadrages (diagnostic, cible, business case, roadmap).
- Apporter une connaissance solide des solutions de consolidation du marché (principes, forces/faiblesses, cas d’usage, critères de choix, patterns d’intégration avec S/4HANA) et coordonne les démarches de sélection (RFI/RFP, POC cadrés, recommandations exécutives).
- Être le point de contact crédible entre Directions Finance (CFO, Consolidation, Contrôle, Trésorerie, Risques) et DSI/IT (architecture, data platform, sécurité, intégration, exploitation), en jouant un rôle de traducteur entre enjeux métier et solution technologiques, en sécurisant les arbitrages.

Responsabilité programme et relation client
- Assurer un leadership sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du cadrage au déploiement.
- Piloter la relation client au quotidien, garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des engagements (délais, budget, qualité) ; gérer les escalades, risques et décisions de gouvernance.
- Porter la narrative exécutive (Comex/CFO) : décision, arbitrages, risques, impacts, valeur, plan de sécurisation.

Leadership, développement des équipes et du cabinet
- Encadrer et faire monter en compétences les équipes (managers/consultants), animer une communauté Consolidation, structurer la capitalisation.
- Contribuer au développement des offres SAP Finance / Consolidation / Fast-close (méthodo, assets, benchmarks).
- Participer activement au développement business : propositions commerciales, soutenances, stratégie de l’entité, recrutement, partenariats éditeurs/intégrateurs.

Innovation et veille
- Suivre les évolutions SAP (S/4HANA, Group Reporting, Sap Analytics Cloud) et les tendances du marché de la consolidation (EPM, data / contrôles, audit trail).
- Assurer une veille sur les évolutions réglementaires et leurs impacts sur la consolidation et le reporting (IFRS, exigences prudentielles selon secteurs).

Votre évolution chez Accenture
Vous construisez une carrière managériale agile, soutenue par :
- Des formations continues, certifications SAP et parcours de leadership.
- Des feedbacks réguliers et un accompagnement personnalisé.
- Des projets variés en France et à l’international, auprès de grands comptes.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail flexible, favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, avec des modalités de télétravail adaptées aux projets et aux équipes.

Votre profil
- Diplôme Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou université équivalente).
- 10+ ans d’expérience en cabinet de conseil et/ou sur des programmes complexes de transformation finance, avec une expertise forte en consolidation et reporting.
- Maîtrise des problématiques de consolidation : périmètre, variations, intra-groupes, écritures de retraitement, contrôles, traçabilité, auditabilité, calendrier de closing, gouvernance.
- Bonnes connaissances des solutions de consolidation : SAP (notamment Group Reporting) et compréhension des solutions du marché (positionnement, cas d’usage, intégration, migration).
- Capacité à faire le lien entre les métiers et l’IT sur les exigences fonctionnelles, la data, le run et la qualité des données.
- Expérience de pilotage : gouvernance, planning, budget, risques, qualité ; posture de « trusted advisor » auprès de sponsors CFO/DSI.
- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en français, anglais fluent obligatoire
- Aisance avec les méthodologies projet (Agile, hybride, gouvernance programme).
- Autonomie, sens de l’impact, exigence sur la qualité, esprit d’initiative et sens du collectif.

Compétences et aptitudes clés
- Solides capacités d’analyse, de structuration et management d’équipe
- Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et à la narration ; capacité à synthétiser des sujets complexes en récits clairs et accessibles aux dirigeants.
- Forte posture client, aisance dans l’animation d’ateliers et dans la présentation de projets aux décideurs.
- Sens commercial aiguisé et expérience en développement de portefeuille clients et en élaboration de propositions.

jobs.description:

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic leader with deep expertise in Sales and Commerce Transformation within Financial Services Industries (Banking, Capital Market and Insurance). This person will have expertise to both Shape, Sell and Deliver Sales and Commerce Transformations with experience across go to market strategy, sales effectiveness, digital sales/commerce, Customer Relationship Management, cross/up sell, branch optimization, market places within the Financial Service industries.

The work:
- Bring both breadth and depth of expertise across Sales and Commerce delivering profitable growth
- Implement and improve sales processes to maximize to drive Sales effectiveness and efficiency.
- Understanding of both Direct and Indirect Channel Selling motions to act as a Connector across Sales, Operations, Technology including data and AI.
- Evaluate clients’ current front sales and commerce functions (e.g., go to market strategy, sales talent management, incentive management, enablement, and operations) and recommend solutions that address their unique organizational needs
- Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends across Sales and Commerce Transformation and emerging technologies; Partner with key ecosystem partners
- Approach work with consulting experience with an Advisory mindset – who can build strong client relationships across Sales and Delivery.
- Develop, support, and identify new growth strategies, including maximizing value from new routes to market, driving digital engagement, and deploying advanced analytics
- Assess dynamics of client landscape and identify new market opportunities to thrive in the digital era.
- Create compelling value propositions by helping clients improve their competitive agility by integrating digital and physical sales channels including agents, advisors, relationship managers and other distribution partners
- Help clients align and prioritize sales efforts to meet sales goals
- Identify capability gaps and guide recommendations to optimize the distinctiveness of your client’s workforce, sales productivity, offerings, or customer strategy
- Lead change-management initiatives that drive adoption, ease implementation, and position clients’ sales and partner transformation solutions for ongoing success
- Establish long-term client relationships and support business development efforts
- Mentor junior team members, and continue to grow your own expertise to help Accenture maintain its thought-leadership position

- At least 8 years of professional experience in the following: - Analyzing and assessing sales processes for GTM, inside sales, field/partner, and operations
- Using data analytics on sales and business performance
- Experience with partner and field sales, recruit, and partner/field sales execution
- Experience building, leading, or advising high performing partner programs, partner development, sales, and/or business development teams

- Cloud and on-premises applications for channel partner compensation or incentives, and for channel sales data collection

- At least 4 years of experience in a consulting environment

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience; Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or business

A growth focused sales professional who has successfully created consistent and positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.  You have run all phases of a large deal sales cycle, including opportunity origination, qualification, sales pursuit and close by applying deep sales process and technical expertise.
You develop relationships with key buyers and decision-makers at new and existing clients, using a combination of Banking & Capital Markets Industry-led solutions.  And you’ll partner with other parts of Accenture to craft Cloud, Data and AI solutions as a foundation to deliver all of our services.
As a Sales Capture Senior Manager you will originate, shape, sell and close large deals that are single or multi-service and which are valuable to our clients and profitable to Accenture.

The Work:
Create solutions to address complex technology business problems/opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs. Interacts with senior client stakeholders and Accenture peers and leadership to shape and drive strategic pursuits. Defines pursuit strategies, develops compelling client messaging, and builds trusted executive relationships. Brings differentiated, industry leading perspectives leveraging AI-enabled capabilities across technology strategy, data and AI, application development and management, and infrastructure services. Demonstrates strong proficiency in cloud (AZURE/AWS) and AI platforms (such as Anthropic, OpenAI and others) to shape and deliver scalable, business driven solutions. Has latitude in decision-making and determining objectives and approaches to critical opportunities. Operates within large teams and directs specific team sales activities. Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 25 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need:
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in selling Banking & Capital opportunities
- Minimum of 8 years of sales experience.
- Minimum of 5 years of sales experience with quota preferably in excess of $15M+
- Minimum of 5 years of sales experience selling financial services opportunities
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in Cloud (AZURE/AWS)
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in AI Platforms (such as Anthropic, Open AI, etc.)
- Strong financial acumen and complex deal shaping experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience.

Bonus Points if you have:
- Experience working with G500 customers.
- Experience with C-Level client relationship building and relationship management.
- Proven ability to operate within a highly-matrixed, team-oriented environment.
- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting; either military or civilian.
- High energy level, focus and ability to work well in demanding client environments.
- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
- Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision-making abilities.
- Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility, and character.

What’s in it for you?
You will be part of a diverse, vibrant, global Accenture community; pushing the boundaries of new business capabilities and emerging technologies and services, sharing their experiences and lessons learned with each other.  You’ll have the chance to thrive in an environment where your ideas are valued and your voice matters. At Accenture, you will be able to work on meaningful and innovative projects, powered by the latest technologies and industry best practices such as event-driven architectures and domain driven design. Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll learn from and work with Accenture’s certified practitioners and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack, sales skills, and certifications. You'll be immersed in the design and implementation of human-centric solutions to help solve complex challenges with some of the world’s largest companies.

POSITION TITLE: Capital Markets Ops Manager
WORK SETUP: Return to Office

OVERALL PURPOSE:
As an integral part of the Wealth Advisor's in-market team, the Wealth Solutions Center Service Specialist is dedicated to delivering superior service and problem-resolution experience to assigned bank clients. This role leverages virtual communication channels such as phone, email, and chat.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Serve as the primary point of contact for service and problem resolution for Wealth clients and advisors via phone and electronic service requests.
2. Develop a thorough understanding of all banking products, processes, and programs, staying updated on any changes.
3. Provide tailored solutions for clients with complex financial needs while adhering to branch operations manuals, audit requirements, and regulatory frameworks.
4. Build and maintain professional, ongoing relationships with Wealth advisors and internal partners to address client needs effectively.
5. Handle day-to-day transactional needs for assigned Wealth clients with a focus on efficiency and accuracy, ensuring service level agreements are met (e.g., transfers, overdrafts).
6. Facilitate wire agreements and process time-sensitive wire requests for Wealth clients, ensuring high attention to detail and accuracy in execution.
7. Accurately document client interactions and resolutions in CRM/Salesforce.com.
8. Consistently meet required performance standards, including quality, productivity, and behavioral expectations.
9. Support the Wealth division in achieving target Client Service Measurement (CSM) scores.
10. Work a flexible schedule as needed, including shifts between Monday and Friday (8 AM to 8 PM) and Saturday (8 AM to 5 PM), with a day off during the week when working a Saturday shift.
11. Perform other duties as assigned.

OTHERS:
Project Shift Schedule: Night Shift
Project Rest Day: Weekends Off
Project/Team Location: Taguig Uptown Bonifacio Tower 3

SKILL AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• 8 years of experience in Wealth management (Relationship Managers in Bank, Private Banking, Investment, Financial Planning, Financial Analysis, Portfolio Management, Investment Consultant)
• 5 years of Supervisory Role

What would you do? Applied Technology & Operations for Markets (ATOM) is a multi-client processing on-demand service platform. A trade processing service for the trading and treasury entities of our clients that they can plug onto in parts or entirely while focusing their efforts on what differentiates them on the market. ATOM BPaaS leverages cloud hosted architectures to deliver high quality run and change services. It integrates infrastructure and IT management services with business processes execution supported by an orchestrated layer of intelligent operations assets.Event Announcement & Market Monitoring Monitor market sources (custodians, exchanges, SWIFT messages) for upcoming voluntary corporate actions. Validate event details such as terms, deadlines, eligibility, and tax implications. Ensure accurate event setup in corporate actions systems. 2. Client Notification & Response Management Notify clients of voluntary corporate actions via official communication channels. Provide clients with event details, decision deadlines, and options (e.g., cash vs. stock election). Track client responses and ensure timely submission to custodians and agents. 3. Election Processing & Instructions Management Capture and validate client instructions for corporate actions. Ensure accurate processing of elections and submit them before market deadlines. Coordinate with custodians, depositaries, and counterparties for confirmation. 4. Entitlement Calculation & Allocation Calculate entitlements based on event terms and client positions. Reconcile entitlements against custodian records to ensure accuracy. Allocate proceeds (cash or securities) to client accounts post-event. 5. Risk & Exception Management Identify and escalate discrepancies in event terms or entitlements. Investigate and resolve breaks related to missing instructions, incorrect elections, or unprocessed entitlements. Work closely with risk and compliance teams to mitigate operational risks. 6. Regulatory Compliance & Tax Processing Ensure adherence to regulatory frameworks (SEC, FCA, MiFID II, CSDR). Apply correct tax treatment based on client eligibility and jurisdiction. Process withholding tax reclaims where applicable. 7. Reconciliation & Break Resolution Perform daily reconciliations of corporate action positions and entitlements. Investigate and resolve mismatches with custodians and internal books. Work with finance and settlement teams to ensure correct postings.

•Ability to perform under pressure
