jobs.title: Banking Consultant / Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission
Bei Accenture gestaltest du gemeinsam mit führenden Finanzinstituten die Zukunft – von neuen Geschäftsmodellen und Prozessen bis zur technologischen Umsetzung.

Als Teil unseres Industry & Enterprise Teams im Bereich Banking & Capital Markets (BCM) gestaltest du zentrale Transformationsinitiativen der Bankenbranche. Dabei verbinden wir tiefes Branchen- und Prozessverständnis mit Strategy, Consulting und Technology und begleiten unsere Kunden von der strategischen Ausrichtung über Operating Models und Prozesse bis zu Plattformen und technologischen Lösungen.

Dabei bringst du deine Banking-Erfahrung gezielt ein, übernimmst Ownership und treibst zentrale Transformationsfelder entlang der gesamten Banking Value Chain proaktiv voran .

Du möchtest die Zukunft des Bankings aktiv gestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und mit deinen Ideen sichtbare Wirkung beim Kunden erzielen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

Ob Retail Banking, Commercial & Corporate Banking, Payments, Banking Operations, Risk & Finance, oder Strategy : Du bringst deine Expertise dort ein, wo sie den größten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schafft.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dein Arbeitsumfeld flexibel und passend zu deinen Stärken – in Voll- oder Teilzeit und als Teil eines Teams, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Banking neu definieren:
Du gestaltest neue Banking-Produkte, Geschäftsmodelle und Customer Journeys und treibst deren Weiterentwicklung beim Kunden aktiv voran .
- Transformationen End-to-End gestalten:
Du strukturierst komplexe strategische und operative Herausforderungen, entwickelst eigenständig tragfähige Lösungen und treibst deren Umsetzung konsequent bis zum Ergebnis .
- Ownership übernehmen:
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Projekte und Workstreams , steuerst deine Themen eigenständig von der fachlichen und technologischen Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und stellst eine hohe Qualität der Ergebnisse sicher.
- Kunden und Stakeholder aktiv steuern:
Du moderierst Workshops, strukturierst Entscheidungen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und vertrittst deine Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen überzeugend gegenüber unseren Kunden.
- Business und Technology verbinden:
Du verbindest fachliche Banking-Expertise mit technologischen Möglichkeiten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Strategy, Technology, Data und AI sowie unseren Technologiepartnern zusammen.
- AI und neue Technologien realisieren:
Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Generative und Agentic AI, Data, Cloud und Automation , entwickelst daraus relevante Banking Use Cases und treibst deren Überführung in skalierbare Lösungen.
- Unser Banking-Geschäft mitgestalten:
Du bringst deine Expertise und deinen unternehmerischen Drive in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Banking-Angebote ein und unterstützt aktiv dabei, neue Themen und Lösungen beim Kunden zu entwickeln und zu positionieren.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium , z. B. der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs, sowie mindestens vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung
- Nachweisbare Banking- und Transformationserfahrung aus einer Beratung, einer Bank, einem FinTech oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
- Fundierte Expertise in mindestens einem relevanten Banking-Schwerpunkt, z. B. Retail Banking, Commercial & Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments, Banking Operations, Risk & Finance, Core Banking oder Plattform-transformation
- Erfahrung darin, Projekte oder Workstreams eigenständig zu strukturieren, zu steuern und erfolgreich zum Ergebnis zu führen
- Ausgeprägte IT-Affinität und Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Banking und Technology, idealerweise mit Bezug zu AI, Data, Cloud, Automation oder modernen Banking-Plattformen
- Unternehmerischer Drive, ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und hoher Qualitätsanspruch – du erkennst Handlungsbedarf, übernimmst Ownership und treibst Themen proaktiv voran
- Souveränes Auftreten im Kundenumfeld sowie ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft, unsere Kunden bei Bedarf auch vor Ort zu begleiten

Was wir bieten
- Umfassende Trainingsangebote, Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Hilfreiche Begleitung und sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Mentor:innen und Projektleiter:innen
- Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, sowie mobiles Arbeiten
- Attraktive Aufstiegschancen
- Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität & Inklusion fördert

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Das Jahresbruttogehalt für diese Position startet, je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung bei 61.000€ als Consultant und 76.000€ als Manager.

jobs.title: Digital Assets & Digital Money Consultant
jobs.description:
You Are
A management consultant who understands how asset managers, fund managers and other financial institutions operate and how emerging technologies can reshape the future of money, securities and market infrastructure. You can work with clients to assess opportunities across wholesale and retail CBDC (such as the digital euro), crypto, tokenised assets, stablecoins, and tokenised deposits, define business requirements through structured business analysis, design operating models and support the delivery of transformation programmes.
You have a strong interest in DLT and tokenisation, and you can bridge the gap between business stakeholders, technology teams, risk functions and regulatory considerations. You enjoy tackling complex problems, running experiments and prototypes, producing high-quality client materials and contributing to delivery in a fast-moving environment.

We Are
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organisations build their digital core, optimise their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services – creating tangible value at speed and scale. Across more than 120 countries, our people combine technology, industry experience and functional expertise to help clients reinvent and grow.
We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, technologists, data and AI specialists, risk and regulatory practitioners and change experts to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. Our team partners with fund managers, asset managers, commercial banks, central banks and other financial institutions – alongside capital markets, market infrastructure providers and payment providers – to explore, design and deliver the next generation of digital assets and digital money.
Our work spans distributed ledger technology (DLT) and tokenisation across the full spectrum of digital money and digital assets: wholesale central bank digital currency (CBDC), retail CBDC such as the digital euro, stablecoins, tokenised deposits, crypto assets, tokenised securities and other tokenised assets, digital asset custody and DLT-enabled market infrastructures We help clients move from experiments and prototypes through to scalable, production-grade capabilities.

What You’ll Do
As a Consultant, you’ll own workstream tasks and contribute to client delivery, offering development and business development, mainly in the fund and asset management area. Your responsibilities will typically include:
- Supporting transformation programmes across digital assets and digital money – strategy development, business case creation, operating model design and implementation planning.
- Defining and assessing use cases in the space of wholesale and retail CBDC, tokenised deposits, stablecoins, crypto, tokenised securities and other tokenised assets, collateral mobility, digital asset custody, DLT-based payments and smart contract-enabled processes.
- Performing business analysis on client business, operating, risk, compliance and technology requirements.
- Designing and running experiments, prototypes and proofs of concept, then helping clients translate the results into a scalable delivery path.
- Helping design future-state capabilities, roles and responsibilities, governance models, controls, processes and technology requirements.
- Evaluating digital asset ecosystem providers, DLT platforms, custody and tokenisation solutions, financial crime tools and data/analytics capabilities.
- Developing high-quality deliverables such as current-state assessments, target operating models, capability maps, business cases, implementation roadmaps and executive presentations.
- Supporting project management activities, including planning, status tracking and stakeholder coordination.
- Contributing to proposals, market offerings, points of view and internal knowledge assets.
- Working transversally with different Accenture teams, in Luxembourg and globally.

Here’s What You Need
- 3+ years of experience in consulting, financial services, fintech, technology, capital markets or digital assets.
- A master’s degree in a relevant discipline.
- Experience supporting business analysis, operating model design, process design, requirements gathering, implementation planning or transformation delivery.
- A deep understanding of capital markets, securities services and/or market infrastructure.
- Foundational business and technology knowledge of digital assets, DLT, blockchain, tokenisation, stablecoins, tokenised deposits, CBDCs, tokenised securities, smart contracts or crypto assets.
- The ability to structure complex problems, conduct analysis and develop clear recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French / German; additional languages are a plus.

Professional Skills
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
- The ability to simplify complex business and technology topics.
- A collaborative style across business, technology, risk and operations teams.
- A client-focused mindset and strong communication skills.
- The ability to manage workstream tasks, deadlines and deliverable quality.
- Curiosity, learning agility and a passion for emerging technologies.
- Energy, professionalism and integrity.

Why Join Us
You’ll work at the frontier of financial services, on topics that are reshaping how money and assets move around the world. We’ll back you with:
- Early, hands-on exposure to some of the most significant transformation programmes in banking, payments and capital markets.
- A clear, structured career path with continuous learning, certifications and the support of experienced mentors.
- Access to Accenture’s global network, assets, platforms and ecosystem partnerships across technology, data, AI and industry.
- An inclusive culture built around our commitment to wellbeing and to creating 360° value for our clients, our people and our communities.

Within Industry & Enterprise at Accenture Luxembourg, we offer a wide range of support to our clients. This also implies that we give you room to develop and grow your skills in various ways. We take the time and listen to where you want to go, how this fits within Accenture (win-win situation) and how we can facilitate that (contact with experts or client’s upper management) growth. Very practically, together we create, and over time adjust, your career plan and see, together, how to achieve this. After all – you are Accenture’s biggest asset! Obviously, we offer the traditional benefits you can expect from a top-line and sustainable consulting firm such as Accenture. These benefits include:
- 26 days of holidays: Providing ample time to recharge and spend quality moments with loved ones.
- Laptop and smartphone: Equipping you with the necessary tools to excel in your role, regardless of location.
- Hospitalization insurance and extensive group insurance package: Prioritizing your health and well-being, so you can focus on what matters most.
- Bonus program: Recognizing and rewarding your exceptional contributions to the team's success.
- Training & learning opportunities: Encouraging continuous growth and skill development to reach your full potential.
- Green mobility program: Supporting environmentally friendly commuting options like e-bikes, public transport, bike-to-work allowance, and more.
- Flexrewards: Empowering you to customize your rewards package with our flexible benefits tool to suit your individual needs.
- Discount program: Offering discounts at your favorite (online) shops, so you can enjoy life outside of work.
- Employee shares purchase plan: Providing an opportunity to become a stakeholder in the company's success.

jobs.title: Supply Chain AI&Data – Data Foundations – Consultant / Manager
jobs.description:
If you are ready to lead the total reinvention of companies through technology and data, you have the opportunity to join Accenture’s team and help shape the future of our clients and society.

As a Consultant / Manager within the SC&O Data Foundations team, you will help organizations design, build, and scale the data backbone required to unlock value from analytics, AI, and agentic solutions across Supply Chain and Operations.
You will work on complex data‑driven transformation initiatives, combining data strategy, data management, data products, and AI capabilities to create scalable, trusted, and business‑critical data assets.
Depending on your seniority, you will take ownership of delivery workstreams, act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to team leadership and capability development.

What You Will Do
- Lead and contribute to data‑driven transformation projects across Supply Chain and Operations.

- Drive “value‑through‑data” initiatives, translating business problems into scalable data foundations and data products.

- Design, build, and evolve Supply Chain data products that are reusable, governed, and AI‑ready.

- Lead data management, harmonization, and semantic modeling activities across complex Supply Chain datasets.

- Support and lead data strategy and data governance activities, including:
- Business data definitions

- Data quality rules and controls

- Metadata management and lineage

- Contribute to the design and implementation of agentic AI solutions to augment and automate data and Supply Chain processes.

- Oversee the development of analytics and reporting layers, including self‑service and “talk‑to‑your‑data” experiences.

- Collaborate closely with data engineers, AI specialists, architects, and Supply Chain business stakeholders.

- Support project proposals and go‑to‑market initiatives.

- For Manager roles: lead project teams and own client delivery, as well as sales, commercial processes and go‑to‑market initiatives

What We Are Looking For
- Consultant : typically 4–6 years of experience in data, analytics, AI, or consulting roles.

- Manager : typically 7+ years of experience, including leading teams or delivery workstreams and client facing expertise.

- Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, and modern data management principles.

- Hands‑on experience with data & analytics tools such as Cloud platforms , Databricks, Power BI, SQL‑based platforms , Python .

- Solid exposure to data governance, data quality, and metadata concepts .

- Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and client‑facing communication skills.

- Interest and experience applying AI and agentic AI to data and business processes.

- Consulting mindset, flexibility and ability to work in cross‑functional, multicultural environments, remote and on-site.

- Very strong sense of ownership and results-driven focus.

Why Join Us
- Work on large‑scale Supply Chain data transformations with tangible business impact.

- Be at the forefront of Data Foundations, Data Products, and Agentic AI .

- Grow across technical, functional, and leadership career paths within Data & AI.

- Be part of a team shaping how data and AI enable the next generation of Supply Chain transformation.

BENEFITS
At Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, we promote a hybrid work model supported by our technology, culture of inclusion, and diverse teams, making us the most diverse company in the world according to Refinitiv.
In addition, we offer:
- Health, life, and accident insurance

- Flexibility programs (working hours, time off, holidays)

- Individualized training path

- Sustainability programs and Accenture Foundation initiatives

You Are
A motivated consulting professional with experience in Utility Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Work Management, or Field Operations who is passionate about helping electric and gas utilities modernize their operations. You enjoy solving complex business challenges by combining utility industry knowledge with technology-enabled transformation, helping clients improve asset reliability, workforce productivity, operational performance, and customer outcomes.

You thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy working directly with clients, and are excited by opportunities to leverage Data & AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital technologies to transform utility operations. Management Level: 11 - Analyst- Program Management

Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Pune, Mumbai, Kolkata

Must have skills: Program Planning & Execution, Stakeholder & Team Management, Curriculum Development Coordination, Learning Platform (LMS) Management, Data-Driven Decision Making, Budgeting & Resource Allocation, Process & Quality Management, Performance Tracking (KPIs, OKRs), Cross-Functional Collaboration and Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills.

Good to have skills: Leadership, Experience in EdTech Operations, Knowledge of Instructional Design & Learning Pedagogy

Experience: 2+ years of experience is required

Job Overview: We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Analyst - Program Management to support the planning, execution, and delivery of learning programs. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth program operations, high participant engagement, and strong stakeholder satisfaction.

Support end-to-end program management, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of learning programs

Identify operational gaps and support implementation of process improvements

Assist in managing program budgets and optimizing resource utilization

Graduate with 2-4 years of relevant experience in program management, operations, or a related field

Prior experience in the EdTech industry is preferred

Strong organizational and coordination skills with attention to detail

Good stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities

Strong analytical skills with the ability to track and interpret performance metrics

Effective communication skills (written and verbal)

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

Proficiency in tools such as Excel, project management platforms, and reporting dashboards

jobs.title: Security Consulting Practitioner
jobs.description:
Project Role : Security Consulting Practitioner
Project Role Description : Provide enterprise-level advice to make organizations cyber resilient. Assist in navigating the complex landscape of cyber threats, ensuring robust digital asset protection while maintaining trust with stakeholders.
Must have skills : Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Security Advisor, we are seeking a Data Source Onboarding Consultant to lead and support the integration of critical data sources into our security infrastructure. This role focuses on the technical and procedural aspects of onboarding logs and telemetry from various systems (on-premises, cloud, network, application, etc.) into our SIEM (CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM) and related platforms to ensure comprehensive visibility and threat detection.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Work with IT and business units to identify relevant data sources for security monitoring.
- Onboard logs into the SIEM (CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM) using data connectors, Falcon Log Collector, and other supported ingestion methods.
- Validate log ingestion, ensure proper parsing, and verify that logs align with established schemas (e.g., CEF, LEEF, Syslog, JSON).
- Map log data to security use cases and detection rules and Configure log collection agents (e.g., Syslog, Fluentd).
- Set up API integrations for cloud-native sources.
- Customize and maintain parsers, log collectors, and transformation rules.
- Maintain detailed documentation of onboarding procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting steps.
- Conduct data quality reviews and log validation exercises.
- Optimize data ingestion for performance and cost-effectiveness (e.g., reducing noisy logs, adjusting retention settings).
- Tune and test correlation rules associated with newly onboarded data sources.
- Work cross-functionally with SOC analysts, SIEM admins, application owners, and infrastructure teams

Professional & Technical Skills:
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
- Strong understanding of incident response and threat detection methodologies.
- Experience with security monitoring tools and techniques.
- Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulations related to cybersecurity.
- Ability to analyze security incidents and provide actionable recommendations.
- Experience with cloud logging (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, GCP Logging).
- Scripting and automation skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash).
- Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or other security frameworks.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and organizational skills.
- Project management skills and ability to handle multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.

Additional Information:
- The candidate should have minimum 8+ years of experience in a cybersecurity, security engineering, or SIEM-related role.
- Experience with onboarding data into SIEM platforms such as CrowdStrike Next-Gen, Splunk, Azure Sentinel.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
- Strong understanding of logging standards and protocols (Syslog, Windows Event Logs, API, JSON, CEF, etc.).
- Familiar with common operating systems (Linux, Windows), networking devices, cloud environments, and enterprise applications.

15 years full time education

jobs.title: Life Sciences MedTech Commercial, Management Consulting Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture’s Life Sciences MedTech Practice sits at the forefront of commercial innovation. In the face of increasing external macrodynamic and customer cost pressures, we partner with leading MedTech organizations to evolve their commercial engines to drive both topline growth and better execution. From commercial strategy and growth acceleration to sales transformation, channel optimization, AI-enabled customer engagement, and commercial operations, we help leading MedTech organizations reinvent how they bring products and services to market. Our work spans commercial operating model transformation, commercial excellence, omnichannel engagement, commercialization of data and digital solutions, and next-generation revenue growth strategies powered by AI. We are looking for leaders who share our passion for commercial innovation and want to help us grow this foundational pillar of our MedTech business.

You Are:
- A natural connector. You build relationships with senior commercial and marketing leaders at MedTech companies, identify where the real pain is, and turn those conversations into scoped, signed engagements.

- An AI enthusiast with substance. You understand how AI and data are reshaping MedTech commercial and marketing organizations and you can speak credibly about it in front of a skeptical business leader.

- A MedTech insider. You understand the commercial process across different MedTech segments, from commercial strategy to marketing to field sales to commercial enablement. You have the segment depth to be seen as a peer, not just a consultant.

- A commercial transformation leader. You understand how commercial strategy, sales, marketing, pricing, contracting, customer success, field service, and commercial operations work together to drive growth. You can connect strategic vision with the operational changes required to deliver measurable business outcomes.

- A builder. You thrive in white space. You're energized by creating something — a new client relationship, a new capability, a new team — rather than maintaining what already exists.

- A leader worth following. Your teams deliver quality work on time because they want to, not because they have to. You invest in developing people and leave every engagement with talent that's grown.

The Work:
- This is not a delivery-only role. We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Manager who can walk into a room with a Business Unit President or General Manager, earn their trust, and originate meaningful work - then lead a team to deliver it exceptionally.

- You will be a key driver of our MedTech Commercial growth agenda: building client relationships from scratch, shaping compelling propositions, closing engagements, and developing the next generation of Accenture consultants. AI fluency is central to how we work and what we sell.

- You will help MedTech clients rethink growth in a rapidly changing environment, helping them deploy AI, redesign commercial operating models, optimize go-to-market strategies, improve productivity, and unlock new sources of revenue.

Key Responsibilities:
- Establish and manage business development pipeline of new client engagements across the MedTech industry — including top OEMs and digital health companies

- Develop C-suite and VP-level client relationships, positioning Accenture as a long-term strategic partner in commercial reinvention.

- Lead commercial transformation programs including commercial operating model redesign, sales excellence, omnichannel engagement, commercial enablement, and go-to-market optimization.

- Partner with clients to evaluate, design and scale AI and advanced analytics to improve commercial decision-making, territory design, lead generation, customer segmentation, channel effectiveness, and field productivity, improving both efficiency and topline metrics

- Develop business cases and value realization roadmaps that quantify revenue growth, productivity improvements, and customer experience outcomes.

- Shape and pitch compelling propositions that connect Accenture’s capabilities – strategy, technology, AI, and operations – to our clients’ most urgent commercial challenges

- Lead global, high-performing consulting teams delivering commercial and marketing engagements across MedTech segments

- Build and scale Accenture offerings, assets, and thought leadership across AI-enabled commercial transformation and MedTech growth strategy.

- Mentor and develop junior talent, building the next generation of Accenture's MedTech Commercial practice.

Travel - candidate should be willing to travel up to 75% to client locations.

Here's What You Need:
- Minimum of 8 years of MedTech commercial experience and expertise, including sales, marketing, commercial operations, commercial excellence, market access, customer engagement, or business unit leadership.
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in commercial and marketing continuums from strategy to execution.
- Minimum of 8 years in at least one area: cardiovascular, surgery, diabetes, diagnostics, digital health, or adjacent fields.
- Minimum of 5 years of consulting experience, with a strong track record of delivery, business development, and client origination.
- Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated ability to build senior client relationships independently and convert them into revenue — a proven hunter, not just a relationship manager.
- Minimum of 5 years hands-on experience applying or selling AI, data, or digital solutions within a commercial or marketing context.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Bonus Points If:
- Experience with leading commercial technology platforms including Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft, Adobe, ServiceNow, or AI-enabled commercial platforms.
- Experience commercializing connected devices, software, services, data products, or digital health solutions.
- An existing network of senior commercial, marketing, or business leaders at MedTech companies who see you as a trusted advisor
- A track record of building and managing a pipeline with discipline: staged opportunities, conversion metrics, and a clear point of view on where to invest your time.
- Experience helping clients build AI-enabled commercial and marketing organizations — not just recommending AI, but designing and implementing it.
- Thought leadership presence — publications, conference appearances, or a professional reputation in the MedTech commercial/marketing space.

jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at  www.accenture.com .

YOU ARE
You produce solid analytical work — assessing trends and forces shaping your industry or function, designing future-state processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in your domain and a point of view on how AI and automation can change the way it operates. You're comfortable working with structured guidance while taking on more with each engagement.  You understand that designing how AI agents interact within processes — AX Design — is just as important as the process design itself, and you're starting to apply those principles in your work.

THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
- Produce trend and forces assessments for your assigned industry or function, including benchmarking analyses that show where the client stands relative to peers and where the reinvention opportunity lies.
- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for your domain area.
- Conduct process analysis and support delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations.
- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools.
- Conduct benchmarking analysis with AI-accelerated industry and peer comparison tools.
- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
- Apply your industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.
- Contribute to the reference library and keep your domain expertise current through continuous learning.
- Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs — defining how AI agents should behave within each redesigned process step, what they handle autonomously, and when they hand off to a person.

Ability to travel up to 80%; travel as needed based on client expectations.

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS
- Minimum 3 years of experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting

- Minimum 1 year using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or benchmarking tools (e.g. Platform Native AI capabilities)

- Minimum 1 year of integrating AI and automating business process design

- Minimum 1 year of  experience delivering project work in consulting environment OR industry experience in at least one domain (e.g., Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities or Chemical and Natural Resources) OR worked within

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience.  (If Associates Degree, must have minimum of 6 years work experience).

- Experience producing industry or function trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, or change-impact assessments
- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations
- Familiarity with process mapping or process modeling tools

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms/structured recommendations

- Client-facing consulting or advisory experience

- Applies AI tools fluently and independently, including building agents, for higher-quality deliverables to business problems

- Embeds AI Design principles into process specifications (agent behaviors, autonomy levels, handoffs)

- Uses AI-assisted analytics, visualization, and benchmarking tools to ground future-state designs

jobs.description:
Job Title - GCC Advisory Manager
Management Level: 07 – Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
Must have skills: GCC / GBS Strategy, Functional Operating Model Design, Shared Services Design, Sourcing & Location Strategy, Business Case Formulation, Functional Transformation such as Finance Process Transformation (O2C / P2P / R2R / FP&A)
Good to have skills: Multi-function GBS, Transition & Migration Management, Service Management & SLA Design, Agentic AI in functions, Data Visualization Tools
Job Summary:
- Manage defined workstreams within GBS / GCC and operating model transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines
- Own and lead projects – guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
- Manage client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
- Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks , and supporting models for GBS / SSC setup and transformation assignments
- Apply a process and operating-model perspective across GBS design, governance, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as Gen AI–enabled processes
- Lead business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development
- Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends

Roles & Responsibilities:
- GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup : Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0–L5) design for new and scaling shared services
- Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations independently
- Operating Model : Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery
- Cost Analysis and Value Realization : Lead analysis and detailed cost model development covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
- Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams – roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
- SSC Location Strategy: Lead location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best-fit delivery locations for shared services
- KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
- Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
- Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
- Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations
- Gen AI in Functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes – such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting

Professional & Technical Skills:
- 7-10 years of total experience in GBS consulting, operating model, functional transformation, or advisory, or in-house shared services; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
- Experience leading workstreams in GBS / GCC design, functional operating model, or shared services engagements
- Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing & location strategy, org design & sizing, process maturity assessment, governance & interaction model design
- Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
- Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures ; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
- Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or operating-model maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
- Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0–L5 process hierarchy
- Understanding of ERP and digital technologies (e.g. SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and automation tools such as RPA and process mining
- Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
- Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint ; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

Additional Information:
- Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
- Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
- Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
- Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology, and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song .

You are:
An experienced professional with sales performance management project experience in any of these industries: insurance, banking, software & platforms, high-tech, telecommunications, healthcare, and life sciences. Key areas you focus on may include sales territory planning, sales capacity planning, quota planning, incentive compensation management, seller enablement, and sales operations operating model design leveraging leading sales performance management platforms such as Anaplan or Varicent. You are a problem solver with consulting (preferred) and/or industry experience who is comfortable working in fast-paced, agile environments. You have experience managing management and solution architect level client relationships as a trusted advisor, facilitating workshops, developing business recommendations, and building business cases for sales performance management use cases. You know how to balance leading your team with directly contributing to the team’s collective work products.

You also are:
- Passionate about helping clients solve complex profitable sales growth challenges and supporting them through critical sales transformation projects.

- Knowledgeable about the financial services, technology, healthcare and/or life sciences industries, as well as front-line sales and commerce organizations broadly, and are ready to apply your knowledge to help clients optimize and transform their sales solutions.

- Experienced with scoping & designing solutions and implementing leading sales performance management technology platforms such as Anaplan or Varicent.

- Ready to dive deep into problem solving using creative and analytical thinking to transform business challenges into opportunities to drive benefits.

- Energized by working in an agile, fast-paced environment and are at your best when collaborating with a team.

- Familiar with the selling process and have contributed to developing and presenting proposals and solutions to help solve client challenges.

The work:
As a Consultant, Song Sales & Commerce Sales Performance Management, you will apply your expertise in sales planning and incentive compensation management on Anaplan and/or Varicent to transform front office sales strategies and solutions to help clients achieve top line growth and profitability objectives.

Job Qualifications

Here’s what you’ll need:
- 3+ years of Sales Performance Management domain experience leading sales transformations specifically focused on sales planning and incentive compensation management. A strong understanding of the Financial Services, Technology, Healthcare and/or Life Sciences industries including market trends and challenges and the regulatory environment, along with experience on topic areas such as sales territory planning, sales capacity planning, quota planning, incentive compensation management, seller enablement, and sales operations operating model design leveraging leading sales performance management platforms such as Anaplan or Varicent, is required.

- 2+ years of experience in management or technology consulting, with broad experience in engagement management, business development, and leading complex projects / programs.

Bonus Points If:
- You have excellent communication (written and spoken) and interpersonal skills, including compelling story telling skills for an executive audience and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.

- You have strong client executive relationship development and management skills.

- You have experience in delivering CRM, CPQ, Lead to Order, Sales Transformation implementations.

- You have experience working with onshore and offshore delivery teams.

- You bring an existing network of relationships within the Financial Services, Technology, Healthcare and/or Life Sciences industry from past work experiences.

- You are familiar with AI, GenAI, or other emerging technologies.

jobs.title: Life Sciences MedTech R&D, Management Consulting Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture’s Life Sciences MedTech practice sits at the intersection of science, technology, and human impact. We partner with the world's leading MedTech companies to reinvent how they discover, develop, and deliver innovations that improve patient outcomes. From strategy through execution, we help clients navigate regulatory complexity, accelerate product development timelines, and build the AI-enabled operating models that will define the next era of medical technology. Our R&D practice is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business - and we're looking for the people who will shape it.

You Are:
- A natural hunter. You build relationships with senior R&D and commercial leaders at MedTech companies, identify where the real pain is, and turn those conversations into scoped, signed engagements.

- An AI enthusiast with substance. You understand how AI and data are reshaping R&D operations and you can speak credibly about it in front of a skeptical R&D business leader.

- A med tech insider. You know the product development lifecycle, the regulatory landscape, and the pressures that keep R&D leaders up at night. You have the segment depth to be seen as a peer, not just a consultant.

- A builder. You thrive in white space. You're energized by creating something - a new client relationship, a new capability, a new team - rather than maintaining what already exists.

- A leader worth following. Your teams deliver quality work on time because they want to, not because they have to. You invest in developing people and leave every engagement with talent that's grown.

Job Description:
This is not a delivery-only role. We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Manager who can walk into a room with a Chief R&D Officer or VP of Innovation, earn their trust, and originate meaningful work - then lead a team to deliver it exceptionally.

You will be a key driver of our MedTech R&D growth agenda: building client relationships from scratch, shaping compelling propositions, closing engagements, and developing the next generation of Accenture consultants. AI fluency is central to how we work and what we sell.

Key Responsibilities:
- Establish and manage business development pipeline of new client engagements across the MedTech industry - including top OEMs and digital health companies

- Lead C-suite and VP-level client relationships, positioning Accenture as a long-term strategic partner in R&D transformation.

- Design and deploy AI-enabled solutions that help clients accelerate product development, improve clinical operations, and build data-driven R&D organizations.

- Shape and pitch compelling propositions that connect Accenture's capabilities - strategy, technology, AI, and operations - to clients' most urgent R&D challenges.

- Lead high-performing consulting teams delivering R&D transformation programs across product development, regulatory affairs, clinical operations, and medical affairs.

- Contribute to Accenture's thought leadership in MedTech R&D - writing points of view, speaking at industry events, and shaping our market positioning.

- Mentor and develop junior talent, building the next generation of Accenture's MedTech R&D practice.

Travel - candidate should be willing to travel up to 75% to client locations.

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum of 10 years working in or advising the MedTech R&D industry, with deep understanding of the product development and regulatory lifecycle. Deep segment expertise in at least one area: cardiovascular, neuromodulation, surgical robotics, diagnostics, digital health, or adjacent fields.
- Minimum of 7 years of management consulting experience, with a strong track record of business development and client origination. Demonstrated ability to build senior client relationships independently and convert them into revenue — a proven hunter, not just a relationship manager.
- A Bachelor's degree (science, engineering, or health-related field preferred).

Bonus Points If You Have:
- Hands-on experience applying or selling AI, data, or digital solutions within an R&D or clinical context.
- An existing network of senior R&D, innovation, or commercial leaders at med tech companies who see you as a trusted advisor
- Experience at a top-tier consulting firm with a strong emphasis on origination and client development — not just delivery
- A track record of building and managing a pipeline with discipline: staged opportunities, conversion metrics, and a clear point of view on where to invest your time.
- Experience helping clients build AI-enabled R&D operating models — not just recommending AI, but designing and implementing it.
- Thought leadership presence — publications, conference appearances, or a professional reputation in the Med Tech R&D space.

- Strategic and execution excellence: Craft comprehensive strategies and translate them into actionable, results-driven roadmaps—including network rollout and deployment optimization, operations transformation, and OSS/BSS modernization—grounded in real operational outcomes.

- Travel as needed, up to 80%.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience advising on or delivering network transformation initiatives—spanning one or more phases of the network lifecycle (Design / Build / Operate)
- Experience across fiber/wireline, wireless (4G/5G, RAN), and/or cable networks, serving consumer and/or enterprise segments
- Experience applying AI, GenAI or agentic automation to network-led transformation—for example, AI-enabled design, intelligent deployment, autonomous/self-healing operations or next-generation NOCs
- Working knowledge of OSS (e.g., inventory, provisioning/activation, orchestration and service assurance) as an integral part of network transformation
- Experience engaging network stakeholders (e.g., CTO, Network Operations, Network/Capital Planning, Engineering) and translating technology shifts into roadmaps and investment cases
- Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points If:
- Experience at a consulting firm or systems integrator serving communications/network clients
- Experience contributing to both sales/origination and delivery—supporting offering development, pipeline growth and pursuits
- MBA or equivalent graduate degree
- Experience driving insights using visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau or Alteryx, and analytics tools
- Published thought leadership in the Communications & Media / Networks space

Role- Agentic Commerce Consultant
Location- London
Level- Consultant

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients by combining creativity, technology, and data-driven intelligence. Within Song, our Commerce & AI practice helps organisations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems — embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalisation, autonomous merchandising, and intelligent customer engagement at scale.

We are entering an exciting era of agentic commerce — where new AI channels, AI agents and enhanced customer experiences are reshaping how people discover, evaluate, and buy online. We are looking for those who are energised by this shift, and want to be at the forefront of defining what it means for our clients at Accenture as the world's largest consultancy.

You bring expertise in ecommerce strategies and / or operations, with exposure to how ecommerce works, the key technology players involved, a good understanding of the key channels which drive traffic, conversion and sales, and a passionate interest in the disruptive commerce changes ahead. You are energised by the explosion of LLM-influenced online commerce journeys (e.g. Gemini, ChatGPT), to the launch of immersive conversational-AI experiences, to the role of AI in optimising core commerce processes and operational support models.

A basic understanding of the agentic commerce landscape and hands-on curiosity with AI tooling are central to this role – passion to become an expert in our team is critical. You are a problem solver with strong digital commerce experience in industry or consulting, comfortable working in fast-paced environments and directly with multi-disciplinary teams. You will be confident building your own strategic insights and recommendations to drive value for our clients – and then delivering them.

Key Responsibilities
- Working closely with clients to understand challenges, capture needs and requirements and contribute to commercially grounded solutions that advance their goals across ecommerce strategy, operations and technology capabilities
- Leading interviews, workshops and co-creation sessions with clients of varying degrees of seniority – in-person and virtually
- Applying your knowledge of commerce technology across areas such as commerce platforms, search and merchandising or content and data systems to help clients make well-informed, platform agnostic decisions
- Contributing to the shaping and delivery of commerce transformation programmes by supporting current state assessments, target state designs and roadmaps
- Leading project delivery workstreams and owning the production of high-quality deliverables alongside key inputs into other streams
- Adopting and applying AI tooling as a core part of day-to-day working — including LLMs, AI-assisted development tools, and emerging agentic platforms — to enhance the quality and pace of you and your team's delivery
- Getting hands-on with emerging tools, whether that's exploring new agentic platforms, experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, or helping bring a client idea to life quickly in a workshop setting
- Contributing to Accenture points of view and client-ready assets that advance our clients and Accenture Song's position in the agentic commerce market

Required Experience
- ~4 years of professional experience, either in a consulting role with significant commerce exposure, or in an industry commerce role (e.g. ecommerce, trading, merchandising, commerce operations)
- Good understanding of ecommerce strategy and digital commerce — including the key players in the space and market shaping technology platforms
- Working knowledge of commerce operations — how ecommerce businesses run day-to-day, including trading, fulfilment, merchandising and the relationship between technology and operational performance
- Familiarity with the overall commerce technology landscape, including deeper knowledge of at least one or two of: commerce platforms like Shopify or Commercetools, search, merchandising, PIM, CMS
- Demonstrable interest in agentic commerce and AI through strategic work, POCs, independent learning, or a developed point of view on how AI agents and agentic search will reshape commerce
- Active day-to-day use of AI tooling (including LLMs and emerging agentic platforms) as part of how you already work
- Good communication skills — able to present ideas clearly to clients and contribute to narratives that land with senior stakeholders

Preferred Experience
- Familiarity with the emerging agentic commerce landscape: Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), AI-native search, LLM-powered applications and brand or consumer-facing agents
- Some exposure to AI and agentic platforms — such as Google Gemini, OpenAI Agent SDK, LangGraph, n8n, Microsoft Agent Foundry or AWS Bedrock
- Familiarity with one or more areas of the commerce technology ecosystem: commerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Commercetools, Shopify, BigCommerce), search and merchandising (Algolia, Bloomreach, Elasticsearch), or PIM and content management (Salsify, Akeneo, Contentful, Adobe Experience Manager)

Our  Total Rewards   consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits. These include perks such as:
- Up to 30 days of leave to spend each year plus 3 extra volunteering days per year for charitable work of choice.

London, Manchester, Edinburgh

Our mission:   Is to help our clients to deliver exceptional human and agentic experiences that deliver simplicity, cost transformation, and an engine for growth.

Every interaction is a moment to resolve, deepen trust, build loyalty, and demonstrate the brand promise when it counts most.

If you're looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of specialists, this is the role for you.

As a team

The Service practice sits within Accenture Song. Our   vision is to deliver iconic client outcomes. A shared purpose for our people; to grow, to build new skills, and do our best work.

We focus on:

- Reinventing   customer service   across physical, digital/app-based and AI-powered channels

- Data-driven transformation across service to reduce cost and drive growth

- Designing   future-ready service models , enabled by platforms, data and automation

- Embedding   GenAI, intelligent automation and decisioning   into customer service journeys and operations

- Supporting clients to define a   customer-first mindset , helping them shape their business and operating models

- Delivering   measurable business outcomes , not just great experiences

We work across the full lifecycle: from ambition and vision, through design and experimentation, to scaled delivery and adoption.

What you'll do

Build agentic experiences to production

- Design and build agentic experiences end-to-end, from brief to deployed agent in a production environment

- Prompt engineer, test and iterate on deployed AI agents across client use cases

- Work across   LangGraph, LangChain, Claude   Code/Codex/Gemini   and RAG pipelines

Bridge CX and engineering

- Hold the full stack from CX design to shipped agent

- Collaborate with AI Experience Designers, Conversational PMs and Strategy leads

- Translate CX requirements into technical implementations

Grow people, capability and the practice

- Contribute to Song's reusable agentic delivery assets and accelerators

- Stay at the frontier of agentic tooling; new frameworks, model releases, platform updates

- Build your craft in production AI engineering within a supported, high-growth environment

Experience Required

Professional engineering experience with hands-on involvement in AI or agentic systems in production, not just in demos.

The most important thing for us is that you have the right combination of engineering skill and design curiosity .   W e want people who think about what the agent experience feels like, not just whether the code runs.

Core experience

- Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight
- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
- Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

- MBA from Tier-1 B Schools and BE/BTech from Tier-1 engineering institutes

jobs.title: Enterprise Architecture Consultant - Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture
jobs.description:
Role: Enterprise Architecture Consultant
Location: London, Manchester, Edinburgh
Mobility : Up to 100%
Career Level: Consultant (ML9)

Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture (ITSA)

About ITSA
Industry Technology Strategy & Architecture leads at the intersection of business and technology, driving maximum client value through the exploitation of AI, technology and data. We serve as the primary architect of our clients' industry-relevant technology estate, defining future-state visions, building the business case for change, and designing the enterprise architecture that turns ambition into an executable roadmap.

Our work spans four solution areas: Business Technology Strategy, Technology Visioning / Future Tech & Innovation, Enterprise & Technology AI & Data Strategy, and Industry Enterprise Architecture. Across all of them we deliver measurable outcomes: full traceability between business priorities and technology investment, stronger investment alignment and prioritization, reduced architectural complexity and duplication, and faster identification of AI, data and digital opportunities.

Your responsibilities

- Support the delivery of enterprise architecture engagements that modernise the client technology estate for the intelligence era.

- Assess how business strategy and industry trends drive the need for change in the enterprise architecture across organisation, applications, data, infrastructure and operations.

- Co-create the client's enterprise architecture vision, strategy and roadmap, aligned to business objectives.

- Develop recommendations and translate them into actionable transformation plans for complex, large-scale technology environments, applying Lean and Agile enterprise principles.

- Support the development of value cases and investment justifications that guide architecture and technology decisions.

- Work across business, technology and third-party stakeholders to formulate, communicate and conclude key architectural decisions.

- Provide architecture governance through the transformation programme, keeping new initiatives aligned to agreed guidelines without jeopardising business objectives.

- Support the creation of enterprise architecture blueprints setting out the end-to-end landscape across applications, integrations and data.

- Support the design and governance of enterprise data and AI platform capabilities, and the definition of operating models and implementation roadmaps.

- Conduct vendor and platform assessments and enterprise architecture maturity assessments on behalf of clients.

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis and analysis, validating their outputs with logic, evidence and domain knowledge.

- Work autonomously on defined workstreams, managing priorities, progress, risks and capacity, and coordinate and support junior colleagues to deliver to agreed time, budget and quality expectations.

- Produce consistently high-quality, well-structured documents, presentations, architecture outputs and other deliverables that communicate clear insights and recommendations and are ready to be presented to C-suite and executive-level audiences.

- Contribute to the growth and effective operation of the Accenture practice and ITSA by supporting and, where appropriate, driving knowledge sharing, training and community activities, recruitment, reusable assets and thought leadership, while meeting internal business obligations.

- Build trusted relationships with immediate client stakeholders, contribute confidently in meetings, workshops and presentations, and begin to understand and own their issues and success measures.

- Support business development by recognising client issues beyond the immediate scope, helping shape proposals and work orders, and matching client needs to relevant Accenture offerings.

We are looking for the following skills and experience

Core capabilities

- High-level thinking: suggest innovative ways to improve your work and client service, synthesise complex information to identify trends and root causes, and stay effective amid complexity and ambiguity while keeping objectives and client value in view.

- Execution: clarify priorities and build logical, realistic plans; document progress and follow through; take responsibility and stay professional under pressure; work to budget; and act ethically while managing risk and protecting data.

- Collaboration: share knowledge and team across boundaries, build respectful and inclusive relationships, and synthesise diverse perspectives into clear, shared outcomes.

- Communication: make difficult concepts easy to understand, adapt your style to the audience, communicate risks and trade-offs clearly, and connect through compelling storytelling.

- Learning and development: commit to continuous learning and build subject-matter expertise, develop yourself and others, seek and offer honest feedback, and evaluate outcomes to improve.

Enterprise architecture skills

- Experience working within or across the enterprise architecture domains: business, application, data and technology.

- Experience designing cloud, data-platform and AI solutions, including GenAI, with a strong interest in emerging technologies.

- Working knowledge of architecture governance, IT governance and frameworks such as TOGAF.

- Capability in enterprise architecture modelling and planning, application architecture design, technology architecture assessment, and blueprint and roadmap definition.

Set yourself apart

We're very interested in hearing from you if you have some or all of the following.
- Prior experience as a technology strategist or enterprise architect.

- Experience in business capability and process taxonomies, maturity assessments and mapping gaps to enabling technology solutions.

- Experience designing or establishing an enterprise architecture operating model or governance capability, such as a Technical Design Authority.

- Experience on major EA engagements such as application rationalisation, re-platforming or modernisation.

- Experience on mergers, acquisitions and divestments.

- Hands-on experience with EA tooling (e.g. LeanIX, Ardoq, iServer or ServiceNow).

- Familiarity with frameworks such as APQC Process Classification Framework, Zachman, or SAFe.

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Accenture reserves the right to close the role prior to this date should a suitable applicant be found.

jobs.description:
Security Consultant - H&PS
Location: Newcastle (hybrid)
Security Consultant - H&PS
Salary: Competitive Salary & Package (Dependent on Experience)

Please Note: Any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory BPSS and SC security clearance which requires 5 years continuous UK address history (typically including no periods of 30 consecutive days or more spent outside of the UK) at the point of application. This role also requires full British Nationality at point of application.

Note: The above information relates to a specific client requirement

As a team :
You'll work on innovative projects with colleagues to drive collaboration from strategy through to implementation. You will be using the latest technologies with clients to help them get to the next level. Do you want to work in an environment where you will be part of a thriving team working on the most complex security challenges in the UK health, public sector, Defence and Central Government.

You'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways.
If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you. As part of our global team, you'll be working with cutting-edge technologies and will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of new skills on the job.

Responsibilities:
- Reduce cyber risk within technology projects by ensuring appropriate security requirements, controls, monitoring, and assurance activities are identified, specified, and evidenced throughout the project lifecycle.

- Conduct threat modelling activities, including alignment with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, to identify credible threats and define proportionate security controls.

- Define monitoring and logging requirements to detect control failures, security incidents, or compromises in live operational environments.

- Support procurement activities by developing security requirements and contractual security schedules.

- Maintain traceability and evidence linking security obligations, threats, requirements, controls, testing outcomes, risks, and decision-making.

- Provide assurance evidence to support risk owners' go-live and in-service risk decisions.

- Interpret relevant laws, policies, standards, and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical security requirements for project teams.

- Support compliance and governance activities by ensuring security requirements are understood, implemented, and evidenced throughout delivery.

- Work collaboratively with project teams to embed security controls and risk management practices into technology solutions from design through to operation.

We are looking for experience in the following skills:
- Strong technical knowledge in at least one of the following areas:
- Public cloud

- Application security

- Networking

- On-premises infrastructure

- Understanding of threat modelling, security controls, and risk analysis principles.

- Ability to assess risks and recommend proportionate security controls and monitoring measures, rather than relying solely on templates or standard security checklists.

- Experience working across cloud, hybrid, third-party, and non-standard technology environments.

- Familiarity with at least one recognised security framework

- Ability to validate security assumptions through evidence-based activities, including:
- Security testing

- Configuration reviews

- Technical investigations

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed security recommendations based on technical evidence.

- Ability to translate technical security concepts into practical guidance for delivery teams and stakeholders.

- Comfortable working within varying levels of service complexity and autonomy, aligned to SFIA levels 3–5.

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 25 -- 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there may be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Operating Model Strategy/Design Consultant

Do you want to shape the organizations of tomorrow? Are you passionate about Operating Model and Organisation Design?

Are you interested in advising boards and executive teams of global businesses and iconic brands on how they reinvent their operating models in the age of AI?

Your Mission
As an Enterprise Operating Model (EOM) Consultant, you will work at board level advising clients on how to transform their businesses and enhance operational performance in a dynamic business context. EOM defines the critical structural and organisational moves that turn strategy into execution — clarifying where decisions are made, how accountability flows, and how work is distributed across human and AI teams. Through proven approaches and AI-enabled insight, you will support clients in building the distinctive capabilities, governance, and ways of working that drive growth, productivity, and agility — contributing across our three integrated sub-offerings:

- Enterprise & Business Unit Operating Model: Support the design and activation of operating models that translate strategy and business model into execution — contributing to enterprise structure, governance design, and the capability-building required to deliver at scale.

- Value Stream, Function & Team Design: Help design and activate how value is created and delivered — contributing to value stream design, function configuration, and team structures that enable cross-functional execution through humans and AI.

- Operating Model Intelligence & Optimisation: Support the design and deployment of the intelligence and management layer that enables organisations to continuously evolve their operating model — combining decision intelligence with governance and optimisation work.

What to expect
- An international team : As part of Accenture Strategy, you will be part of a European team of international experts from all industries and functions.
- Different industries: Our methodical focus allows you to gain experience in different industries - from car manufacturers and energy producers to technology start-ups; everything is represented.
- Diverse areas of responsibility: Due to the broad perspective of our projects, you can also expect a diverse range of tasks, which guarantees a steep learning curve. You will deal with in-depth qualitative organizational issues while also supporting quantitative analyses and benchmarking e.g., for employee costs or team sizes.

jobs.title: Partners in Performance - Strategy Senior Associate - NAELFY27
jobs.description:
This role is with our Partners in Performance  team, part of Accenture.

Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture is a global management consulting firm with a focus on human performance working alongside client partners to make change happen. We’ve got offices in Australia, New Zealand, South-East Asia, Africa, North and South America and Europe but prefer to spend as little time in them as possible. Instead, we work alongside our clients to unleash their potential and deliver lasting impact that you hardly ever achieve by sitting in a boardroom.

IF YOU THINK CONSULTING IS MAKING GREAT POWERPOINT DECKS, KEEP WALKING.

Don’t get us wrong. We admire a sharp PowerPoint™ presentation as much as the next global consulting company. Heck, we make plenty ourselves. And we respect the people who are good at making them. But give us the choice between a column of perfectly aligned bullet points and delivering a plan that helps turn a client’s business around and the decision is a no-brainer. At Partners in Performance, being a Senior Associate isn’t about writing reports, or standing up and presenting them. It’ about the results. We’re here to deliver big, rapid, sustainable results for our clients. Deliver. Not just recommend. So, our end product isn’t a report, it’s what happens once we work alongside the client to implement what’s in it. It’s why our clients around the world choose us, and why we choose a certain type of person to fill our key roles. Like this one: Senior Associate

Now that you are completing your MBA – and maybe even had a few years in a commercial role – you’ll be looking for the opportunity to turn your insights into business results. As a Partners in Performance Senior Associate those results could impact some of the world’s largest companies.

This role combines analysis with outcomes in a way that will challenge and develop you– all the time with the full support and mentoring of your fellow Partners in Performance colleagues. Once the recommendations built on your analysis are agreed to, you can expect to work alongside clients from the shop floor to the C-suite to help make them happen. Whether it’s process improvement, supply chain optimization or back office transformation, you’ll help turn your recommendations into results for your clients.

The nuts and bolts

We’re looking for Senior Associates in our Americas business. You’ll also need a distinction average in a Master’s degree or MBA and up to 6 years’ commercial experience is desirable. Working with Analytics is like breathing to us, so Excel and general math ability are important. We love interesting people, so please include your community, sporting and volunteering experience in your CV. Our priority is to work along side our clients at the site, where the action is happening. Work travel and working on heavy industry, construction like sites, are a norm for us. Come work with the front lines, boots on the ground and be a part of the action.  This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 70% as part of the role. This will include US and Canadian travel, as well as other international opportunities.

Key competencies: To be successful consultant at Partners in Performance, you not only need to be an outstanding academic performer, but also be dynamic, passionate and prepared to roll up your sleeves and work inside our clients’ businesses.  You need to care about people and developing them, as coaching is a big part of our success.

Visit pip.global , Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture on LinkedIn, or @lifeatpip on Instagram to get to know us better.

Basic Qualifications
- MBA with an anticipated graduation date by August 2027
- 5+ years of experience of professional experience
- Bachelors degree

Preferred Qualifications
- Natural Resources industry experience
- Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with on-site travel comprising approximately 80% of the role
- Experience on mining, heavy industry, or construction sites
- Analytics experience including excel and general math
