jobs.title: Supply Chain Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
Join the leading Strategy & Consulting practice in Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O), based in Madrid or Barcelona—two of Europe's most dynamic cities, combining a strong international business ecosystem with exceptional quality of life.

We are especially interested in AI-driven, data-savvy professionals with a strong ambition to shape the future of operations, with experience in:

1) Cost & Productivity Reinvention Our Cost & Productivity Reinvention practice partners with C-suite leaders to turn operational complexity into competitive advantage. We design and deliver large-scale cost transformation programs—combining AI, advanced analytics and deep functional expertise to improve cost discipline, reduce margin pressure and unlock hidden value across operations, supply chain and procurement, always anchored in measurable business outcomes.

2) End-to-end Supply Chain & Operations Transformation Shape and deliver large-scale SC&O transformations, driving initiatives across logistics, fulfillment, transportation, planning, procurement, and operations. Translate strategy into implementable, technology-enabled roadmaps with clear value tracking and measurable outcomes.

3) Procurement & Supplier Transformation with Sustainability Embedded Support the transformation of procurement processes and supplier evaluation models, embedding objective, defensible sustainability and ESG criteria. Leverage data, analytics, and digital tools to enhance supplier insights and align with existing supplier ecosystems.

4) AI & Advanced Analytics Value Management in Operations Work with client business and technology teams to identify, structure, prioritize, and scale AI and analytics use cases across operations. Define ways of working, governance, and value realization frameworks across the full lifecycle—from ideation and pilot to production, scaling, and continuous improvement. We welcome profiles with hands-on AI experience as well as those eager to deepen their AI capabilities and apply them to real operational challenges.

5) Operating Model, Organization Design & Operational Excellence Design pragmatic operating models and organizational improvements, including governance structures, capability building (continuous improvement, digitalization, data & AI literacy), service sourcing models, and performance management. Prioritize initiatives and drive execution in complex, data-rich environments.

#LI-EU

Preferred Skills & Profile
- Experience in Strategy Consulting and Supply Chain & Operations.
- Strong interest in AI, analytics, and digital transformation, with ambition to continuously learn and innovate
- Ability to execute projects end-to-end and bring AI-enabled, value-driven solutions to clients
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate ideas and results at all organizational levels
- An entrepreneurial mindset with the drive to build and grow a high-impact practice at functional and industry level
- People development and team-building skills • Fluent in Spanish and English is mandatory
- Location: Madrid or Barcelona

This is a unique moment to join a practice at the forefront of AI-driven transformation in Supply Chain & Operations. If you are ready to work on the challenges that matter most to global organizations—and grow alongside a team that is shaping the future of the industry—we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Change Management Manager
jobs.description:
In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa per reinventare interi settori di mercato, lavorando con le aziende più importanti a livello mondiale. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive
Entra a far parte del Reinvention Partner Talent in ambito Market Wide. Guiderai programmi di trasformazione digitale e organizzativa per clienti nazionali e internazionali. In particolare, potrai:
- Guidare stream di Change Management all’interno di programmi di trasformazione complessi.

- Disegnare strategie di Change Management, comunicazione, engagement e formazione.

- Coordinare team di progetto e collaborare con stakeholder client a tutti i livelli.

- Supportare attività di proposal, RFP e sviluppo di offerte.

- Monitorare adozione, readiness e risultati delle iniziative di cambiamento.

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento A1 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico .
La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 50.000 € e 71.400 €.

Se anche tu condividi la passione per la consulenza in ambito Talent e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Change Management, preferibilmente maturati in un contesto consulenziale.

- Esperienza nella gestione di programmi Digital, Cloud, ERP o CRM.

- Competenze in stakeholder management, comunicazione, formazione e adoption.

- Esperienza nella gestione di team e nel rapporto diretto con il cliente.

- Laurea e ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.

jobs.title: Core Supply Chain Manager/Associate Manager
jobs.description:
Job Role: Supply Chain & Engineering – Core Supply Chain Manager/Associate Manager
Location: UK (with expected travel)
Career Level: Consultant
Salary: Competitive, plus benefits.

As a team:
Supply Chain & Engineering is a major Core supply chain practice: we help our clients reimagine and transform tomorrow’s supply chains and operations to positively impact business, society, and the planet. We do this through a human-centred and data driven approach that encourages our people and clients to continuously innovate and generate significant, sustainable global impact. Built on the three pillars of customer centricity, zero-based mindset, and responsible operations & organizations, this is what we call the Intelligent Supply Chain.

If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you. As part of our global team, you'll be working with cutting-edge technologies and will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of new skills on the job.

Supply Chain & Engineering – Core Supply Chain is seeking to recruit a Manager and Associate Manager with advisory consulting experience and a history of supply chain planning, fulfilment & Service projects. The Planning & Fulfilment community is one of the key components of Accenture’s Core Supply Chain service that operates across industry groups.

In our team you will:
Learn at the forefront of the industry, provide actionable insights to the world's top organisations, helping them address priority C-suite issues with strategies and improvements they can execute with speed and at scale.

Play a central role enabling our Supply Chain & Engineering capabilities in working with some of the best global companies in the world, responsible for helping the CSCO/COO, and their business partners, address some of the critical business issues faced today, including:
- Demand and Supply Planning:

Implement advanced demand planning techniques to accurately forecast customer demand, aligning supply with market needs through dynamic supply planning models. Develop real-time scenario planning to balance supply constraints with fluctuating demand, ensuring service level optimisation.
- Fulfilment:

Implement advanced warehousing and fulfilment capabilities addressing core supply chain needs, developing real time scenarios to manage warehousing and transportation taking into account service levels and costs.
- Supply Chain Strategy & Segmentation (Operating Model, Process Design, etc.):

Develop tailored supply and demand planning strategies that optimise the flow of goods and services, segmenting supply chain operations based on customer demand patterns and service levels to maximize efficiency and responsiveness.
- Control Towers:

Establish digital control towers to provide visibility into demand and supply fluctuations, enabling real-time adjustments to production schedules, inventory levels, and supplier coordination, ensuring seamless synchronization of supply chain operations.
- Platform-Driven Transformation (Technology Strategy, Systems Implementation, etc.):

Lead the integration of demand and supply planning technologies (e.g., SAP IBP, Kinaxis, Oracle Cloud, Kinaxis, BlueYonder, o9 Solutions, Manhatten) to automate planning & fulfilment processes, improve demand signal accuracy, and enable real-time collaboration across the supply chain.

In this role you will:
- Lead and support delivery teams in our Core Supply Chain group to formulate and execute customer-centric planning strategies
- Support end-to-end strategy implementation of supply chain digital and analytics capabilities, including but not limited to SAP, S4/IBP, Oracle, BlueYonder, Kinaxis, 09 Solutions, OMPartners, Analplan, Manhatten etc.
- Work on supply chain transformations in line with client’s business challenges: - Create capabilities (process/tools/people) in line with the future operating model
- Analyse and model financial data to support large scale cost reduction programmes, utilising functional and cost category benchmarks, process definitions and enterprise value targeting tools
- Help clients improve their ability to drive business outcomes through digital planning, reporting, and analytics
- Help clients harness digital and emerging technology solutions to power their operational strategies (including via RPA, IoT, Blockchain, Analytics, AI)

- Refine and optimise the client's ability to organise and analyse financial, operational and external information to create substantial shareholder value
- Maintain an understanding of advancements in technology and innovations which are happening across digital, analytics, the supply chain ecosystem and broader marketplace
- Make, build and sustain trusted client relationships by remaining highly attuned to client needs and styles.

What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes up to 30 days vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services, we are known for.

Closing Date for Applications: 30/11/2026

Accenture reserves the right to close the role prior to this date should a suitable applicant be found.

- Analyse client challenges, understand financial performance links between operations, supply chain and corporate results and think strategically to create a benefit/business case
- Lead and Support the origination of new work and the sales process
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
- Support commercial aspects of consulting engagements
- Ability to establish and strengthen client relationships at multiple levels of the client organisation
- Structure ideas and solutions, to communicate clearly and concisely
- Ability to develop new concepts and break-through thinking
- Excellent written, oral and presentation communication skills
- Working in high-performing teams

- Functional experience should include some of the following: sales & operations planning, order management, inventory management, demand planning, supply planning, supply chain control tower, physical logistics, warehouse management system, warehouse automation / robotics, network modelling
- Supply chain technology and digital disruptor awareness, including but not limited to SAP, S4/IBP, BlueYonder, Kinaxis, o9, OMPartners, Anaplan, intelligent automation, Internet of Things (IoT), blockchain and analytics, etc.; other specific systems / applications relevant from previous experience

jobs.title: SRE Program Manager
jobs.description:
Program Manager – Site Reliability Engineering (Cloud Native Platform Team)

Role Summary
The Program Manager will drive day-to-day operations of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, ensuring alignment with organizational goals for reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. This role requires a strong technical background in SRE practices and proven program management expertise to drive cross-functional initiatives, optimize processes, and deliver measurable business and operations value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Operational Leadership
o Drive adoption of SRE best practices such as error budgets, SLIs/SLOs, and automation to reduce toil.
o Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory standards in all reliability initiatives.
2. Program Management
o Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria for reliability initiatives.
o Develop and maintain quarterly roadmaps for SRE projects in collaboration with platform engineering teams.
o Track progress, risks, and dependencies across multiple projects using tools like JIRA and Confluence.
o Facilitate communication between SRE, development, and leadership teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
3. Performance Measurement
o Establish and monitor KPIs for reliability and operational efficiency.
o Prepare executive dashboards and reports to translate technical metrics into business impact narratives.
o Lead continuous improvement initiatives based on data-driven insights.
4. Stakeholder Engagement
o Act as the primary liaison between SRE and other teams (Product, Engineering and Delivery-SOC).
o Influence decision-making at all levels through clear communication and structured reporting.

Performance Measurement Parameters
Incident Metrics:
o Mean Time to Detect (MTTD)
o Mean Time to Respond (MTTR)
o Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
o Incident Frequency and Severity
Change Management:
o Change Failure Rate
o Change Success Rate
Reliability Metrics:
o System Uptime / Availability
o Service Level Objective Achievement Percentage
Operational Efficiency:
o Automation Rate
o On-call Burden Reduction

Measurement Matrix for Leadership Presentation
Use a dashboard approach combining:
Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation.
Monthly/Quarterly trends on SLO
Incident Heatmaps: Highlighting root causes and resolution times.
Business Impact Metrics: Cost savings, risk reduction, and ROI from reliability improvements.
Tools: Datadog

Experience Requirements
Technical Background:
o Prior hands-on experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in DevOps roles.
o Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems).
Program Management Expertise:
o 5+ years in program or technical project management.
o Proven ability to manage cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced environments.
o Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (JIRA, Confluence).
Leadership & Communication:
o Experience presenting technical and operational metrics to executive leadership.
o Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.

Certifications: PMP, SAFe, or SRE Foundation – SAFe preferred

We are:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.  We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human + AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

About the role:
- The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
- This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
- This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

The Work:
- Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy & Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
- Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
- Leverage AI-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
- Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
- Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast-moving transformation engagement

You are:
An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

- Program or project management at a top-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
- A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
- Experience leveraging AI-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
- Strong executive-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision-ready materials.
- Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.

- Experience managing AI-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
- Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
- Track record at a top-tier consulting firm managing large-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com .

Within Accenture's Utilities Practice, We use our deep industry expertise in digital customer engagement and operations, connected energy services and customer platforms to help retail energy and utility providers with cost effectiveness, revenue assurance/extension and customer satisfaction and loyalty. Transmission & distribution (T&D) organizations must innovate, invest strategically, and modernize infrastructure to balance supply and demand, optimize assets and teams, and drive towards net-zero emissions.  Learn more about Accenture's Utilities Transmission & Distribution Practice here>> Transmission & Distribution | Accenture

You Are:
A skilled Utilities industry practitioner with deep experience in electric distribution operations and the ability to help clients modernize how they operate and manage the grid. You understand the critical role that Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS), Outage Management Systems (OMS), and distribution control room technologies play in improving reliability, resiliency, storm response, and the overall customer experience. You bring a combination of functional expertise, technology knowledge, and strong consulting skills, enabling you to work with utility operations leaders to translate complex business challenges into practical transformation strategies and solutions. You are comfortable leading teams, advising senior stakeholders, and working across business, operations, and technology organizations to deliver complex programs. You are also excited about the future of grid operations, including the growing role of DERs, automation, analytics, and AI in transforming the distribution control room.

The Work:
- Lead consulting engagements for electric distribution utilities focused on ADMS and OMS modernization, distribution control room transformation, and storm and outage response.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to distribution operations leadership, helping clients define ADMS/OMS strategy, implementation roadmaps, sequencing, and expected business value.

- Lead or support ADMS and OMS implementations across areas including DSCADA integration, network model management, DMS applications, FLISR/self-healing networks, Volt/VAR Optimization, load flow, outage prediction, restoration management, crew dispatch, ETR, and customer communications.

- Develop distribution operations roadmaps aligned with grid modernization initiatives, reliability improvement programs, DER integration requirements, and key performance measures such as SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI.

- Lead cross-functional teams across functional and process design, network model development, integrations, testing, deployment, operator readiness, training, and change adoption.

- Partner across CIS, GIS, AMI, Mobile Workforce Management, IVR, and other platforms that enable modern distribution and outage operations.

- Build trusted relationships with clients across business, operations, and technology organizations, from executive leadership through control room and field operations.

- Support business development activities by shaping ADMS/OMS opportunities, contributing to proposals and client workshops, and collaborating with technology and platform partners on joint pursuits.

- Bring innovative thinking to clients around the evolution of distribution control rooms, including ADMS-OMS-DERMS integration, grid automation, analytics, and AI-enabled operations.

- Contribute to practice development and thought leadership while mentoring consultants and analysts and helping build ADMS/OMS capabilities across the team.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's what you need:
- Minimum of 8 years of experience within the Utilities industry delivering ADMS, OMS, DMS, distribution grid operations, or related transformation programs within a utility, consulting organization, technology vendor, or systems integrator.
- Minimum of 3 years of functional experience with one or more leading ADMS or OMS platforms, such as GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, Oracle, AspenTech, or equivalent solutions.
- Experience with distribution operations and core ADMS capabilities, including DSCADA, distribution network modeling, switching, FLISR, Volt/VAR Optimization, load flow, or related applications.
- Experience with OMS processes and capabilities, including outage prediction, restoration management, crew dispatch, estimated time of restoration (ETR), storm response, or customer communications.
- Working knowledge of integrations between ADMS/OMS and supporting utility platforms such as GIS, CIS, AMI, Mobile Workforce Management, and IVR.
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an, Associate’s Degree with 6 years of work experience)

Professional Skill Requirements:
- Proven ability to lead or contribute to complex, cross-functional utility transformation programs.
- Strong understanding of electric distribution operations and the business processes supporting modern grid and control room environments.
- Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a complex problem-solving environment.
- Ability to translate technical and operational challenges into clear business recommendations and transformation roadmaps.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across utility business, operations, IT, and executive leadership.
- Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment across clients, vendors, and implementation partners.
- Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong interest in emerging grid technologies, automation, DERs, analytics, and AI-enabled utility operations.

Bonus Points If:
- You have led an ADMS or OMS replacement, upgrade, implementation, or major release deployment.
- You have experience with GIS platforms such as Esri/ArcFM or Smallworld, including GIS data quality, GIS-to-ADMS data flows, CIM-based integration, or distribution network model development.
- You have direct storm restoration or major-event experience, including mutual assistance, major event protocols, or EEI reporting.
- You have previous consulting or client advisory experience.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Life Sciences Manager
jobs.description:
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at   accenture.com .

We are:

Accenture Supply Chain & Operations practice   who specializes   at   the intersection of functional consulting, data, & technology. Our Life Sciences clients — spanning biopharma, med tech, and CDMO/CMO organizations — operate in one of the most complex, regulated, and high-stakes supply chain environments in the world. We come at their challenges from all sides with deep industry expertise, data-driven insights, and digital leadership. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in planning, manufacturing, and supply chain operations — while meeting the demands of patient safety, regulatory compliance, and an evolving global supply network. How do we do it? We apply life sciences–specific planning frameworks, connect internal and external manufacturing networks, and build operating models that work for both biopharma and med tech environments.

You are:

A Life Sciences Supply Chain and Operations professional who helps biopharma and med tech clients implement and optimize end-to-end planning processes across their supply networks. You bring deep understanding of the regulatory environment, product lifecycle complexity, and external manufacturing dynamics that define this industry. You will lead and implement Integrated Business Planning (IBP), demand planning, supply planning, production scheduling, and inventory management capabilities — ensuring reliable product availability while managing the unique constraints of GMP-compliant, patient-centric supply chains.

As part of working with clients you will help with several aspects of life sciences integrated planning including:

- Integrated Planning Strategy: Design and implement IBP/S&OP frameworks tailored to life sciences environments, accounting for regulatory release cycles, CMO/CDMO network complexity, and the distinct planning dynamics of biopharma and med tech product portfolios.

- S&OP / IBP: Lead the full IBP cycle — including demand review, supply review, portfolio review, and executive S&OP — integrating commercial, clinical, regulatory, and operations inputs to drive aligned decision-making.

- Demand & Supply Planning: Develop demand and supply planning processes that account for life sciences–specific drivers including patient-based forecasting, launch ramp modeling, loss of exclusivity (LOE), batch yield variability, QA release buffers, and CMO/CDMO lead time dynamics.

- S&OE: Translate IBP decisions into short-horizon execution plans, ensuring production schedules, batch campaign sequencing, CMO order management, and serialization-compliant logistics are aligned with near-term patient and customer demand.

- Inventory Optimization: Develop multi-echelon inventory strategies that account for shelf life, retest dating, temperature-controlled storage, and regulatory hold periods — balancing service levels against working capital and write-off risk.

- Process Improvement & Digital Enablement: Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, reduce supply risk, and accelerate planning cycles. Implement AI-enabled planning tools, digital twins, and advanced analytics to modernize life sciences supply chain operations.

- Performance Management: Define and track life sciences–relevant KPIs including OTIF, forecast accuracy, batch cycle time, CMO on-time delivery, inventory days-on-hand, and write-off rate. Develop action plans to address gaps and drive continuous improvement.

- Operating Model: Design governance frameworks and planning operating models that integrate commercial, medical affairs, regulatory, quality, and operations functions — enabling coordinated decision-making across complex biopharma and med tech organizations.

- Stakeholder Engagement: Build and sustain relationships across client organizations — engaging executive leadership, commercial teams, supply chain functions, quality, and regulatory affairs — to   align on   planning priorities and communicate performance outcomes.

- Risk Management: Proactively identify supply chain risks specific to life sciences environments — including CMO/CDMO capacity constraints, API supply disruption, regulatory holds, and cold chain failures — and develop mitigation strategies to protect patient supply continuity.

- Reporting & Analytics: Provide data-driven insights into planning performance through advanced reporting and visualization — enabling senior leadership to make informed decisions on supply strategy, capacity investment, and network configuration.

The work:

- Find solutions to clients’ life sciences supply chain and planning challenges — including demand volatility, CMO/CDMO capacity constraints, regulatory holds, and product lifecycle complexity

- Spot and solve challenges using your analytical & strategy skills to dive into data and compare vs. industry peers

- Lead workshops that look for ways to improve organizations and processes

- Determine what methods and procedures to use when completing projects

- Give clients insights that help make their companies work better, faster, and more efficiently

- Challenge legacy ways of working using constructive techniques that fuel client growth

- Use digital tech to help clients find new ways to make their orgs more effective and efficient

- Lead small to medium sized teams with diverse   backgrounds   skills and knowledge

- Effectively manage and coach others, collaborating with internal and external parties

- Support client sales origination and thought leadership development

- Ensure that projects help clients meet their key goals

- Drive a positive impact in the communities where we work

- Support delivery of generative AI and agent-based modeling to accelerate   scalable use cases   for Agentic planning operations   -   translating complex technical outputs into executive-ready insights   and scalable solutions.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary from 10-75%.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum of 5 years of experience working on Supply Chain initiatives

- Minimum of 5 years of experience working on Integrated Planning initiatives

- Minimum of 5 years of experience working in one or many of the following industries: Biopharma, Medical Devices / Med Tech, CDMO/CMO, or adjacent Life Sciences sectors

- Minimum of 2 years of external experience at a consulting firm or 5 years of internal consulting experience in a role equivalent to Manager level within industry

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus points if:
- You have a deep specialization in one or more of the following life sciences planning domains: Patient-Based Demand Forecasting, IBP/S&OP, S&OE, Inventory Optimization, CMO/CDMO Supply Planning, or Clinical-to-Commercial Supply Transition

- You have the proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment

- You excel in building and developing relationships, overseeing complex programs and demonstrating leadership

- You’ve earned an MBA or equivalent graduate degree

- You have hands-on experience with life sciences planning platforms such as OMP, Kinaxis RapidResponse, SAP IBP/S4, o9 Solutions, or Blue Yonder, and familiarity with adjacent systems such as Veeva Vault, SAP ERP, or MES/MOM platforms

- Lean or Six Sigma qualifications

- You can use the latest data analytics tools to spot opportunities for improvement

- Prior experience in driving insights using visualization tools (i.e. Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (i.e. Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics)

jobs.title: AI Transformation & Process Excellence Consultant (all genders)
jobs.description:
You produce solid analytical work — assessing trends and forces shaping your industry or function, designing future-state processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in your domain and a point of view on how AI and automation can change the way it operates. You're comfortable working with structured guidance while taking on more with each engagement.

You understand that designing how AI agents interact within processes — AX Design — is just as important as the process design itself, and you're starting to apply those principles in your work.

THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
- Produce trend and forces assessments for your assigned industry or function, including benchmarking analyses that show where the client stands relative to peers and where the reinvention opportunity lies.

- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for your domain area.

- Conduct process analysis and support delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations.

- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools.

- Conduct benchmarking analysis with AI-accelerated industry and peer comparison tools.

- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.

- Apply your industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

- Contribute to the reference library and keep your domain expertise current through continuous learning.

- Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs — defining how AI agents should behave within each redesigned process step, what they handle autonomously, and when they hand off to a person.

#LI-EU

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION

- Experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting

- Experience producing industry or function trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, or change-impact assessments

- Previous usage of AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or benchmarking tools (e.g. Platform Native AI capabilities)

- Experience integrating AI and automating business process design

- You have previously delivered project work in consulting environment OR industry experience in at least one domain (e.g., Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities or Chemical and Natural Resources) OR worked within

- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations

Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad

- Experience in process excellence, process redesign, process optimization, benchmarking, and data analysis .
- Ability to analyze current-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support the design of future-state Sales processes and operating models .
- Working knowledge of AI, GenAI, automation, and AI-assisted analytics and their application to business and Sales process transformation.
- Ability to conduct research, analyze industry trends, and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and progressively take ownership of assigned deliverables.

Good-to-Have Skills

- Client-facing consulting, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management experience.
- Exposure to change-impact assessment across people, process, technology, data, and operating model dimensions.
- Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, GenAI platforms , or other analytics and visualization tools.

Job Summary
As a consultant – B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence , you will support clients in analyzing, redesigning, and transforming their end-to-end B2B Sales processes . You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities , including research, solution development, process narratives, capability presentations, proposal content, and client-ready materials. The role will involve working with Sales platforms and enterprise applications , understanding how technology enables business processes, and supporting digital and platform transformation initiatives. You will use tools such as Microsoft Visio, Power BI, Tableau, and GenAI-enabled platforms to analyze, visualize, and communicate findings. You will also develop an understanding of AX Design , recognizing how AI agents can be embedded within redesigned Sales processes. This includes defining where AI can operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, and how AI-to-human handoffs should be designed. You will primarily support engagements across the Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media industries, while developing broader cross-industry Sales transformation expertise.

B2B Sales Process & Transformation

- Support the design of future-state Sales processes , identifying opportunities for simplification, standardization, digitization, automation, and AI enablement.
- Develop process assessments across the Sales lifecycle, including:

- Lead-to-Opportunity
- Lead Qualification
- Opportunity Management
- Pipeline Management
- Sales Forecasting
- Account Management
- CPQ and Deal Management
- Contract Management
- Order Management
- Sales Operations and Revenue Operations

- Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for process improvement.
- Support the development of Sales operating models, process standards, functional requirements, playbooks, and transformation of roadmaps .

Process Excellence & Analytics
- Conduct process excellence, benchmarking, and maturity assessments to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop industry and functional trend assessments across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media .
- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted analytics and visualization tools .
- Analyze business and operational data and translate findings into structured insights and recommendations.
- Conduct peer and industry benchmarking to assess client performance against relevant market practices.
- Develop supporting materials, dashboards, presentations, and executive-ready recommendations.

- Develop process maps and workflows using Microsoft Visio and other process modeling/visualization tools .
- Support requirements gathering, functional analysis, process design, and platform transformation activities.
- Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, AI, and GenAI across Sales process steps.

AI, GenAI & AX Design
- Apply relevant AI and GenAI tools across research, analysis, process assessment, documentation, and deliverable creation.
- Explore opportunities to embed AI and automation within Sales processes to improve productivity, decision-making, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
- Apply AX Design principles when assessing AI-enabled processes.
- Define how AI agents could operate within individual Sales process steps, including: - Activities handled autonomously by AI
- Decision-making boundaries
- Human intervention requirements
- AI-to-human handoffs
- Controls and governance

- Support the development of AI-enabled process concepts, use cases, and transformation recommendations.

- Support Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities .
- Conduct client, industry, competitor, and market research to support pursuit strategies.
- Develop RFP responses, solution narratives, process diagrams, capability presentations, case studies, and proposal content .
- Translate client requirements into structured Sales transformation approaches and solution concepts.
- Support development of value propositions, solution approaches, delivery models, and transformation roadmaps .
- Contribute to client presentations, workshops, demonstrations, and pursuit discussions.
- Collaborate with senior consultants and leadership teams to develop differentiated and client-relevant solutions.

Client & Engagement Support
- Participate in client workshops and stakeholder discussions to understand business requirements, pain points, and transformation objectives.
- Support interviews and working sessions with Sales, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders.
- Develop clear and structured communication materials for clients and leadership review.
- Conduct change-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating model changes.
- Incorporate stakeholder feedback into process and transformation designs.

Professional & Technical Skills
- Strong understanding of B2B Sales processes and Sales process steps .
- Knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation concepts.
- Experience or exposure to process excellence, process redesign, benchmarking, and process optimization .
- Ability to perform data analysis and AI-assisted analytics .
- Working knowledge of how AI, GenAI, automation, and digital technologies can be incorporated into business processes.
- Experience with or exposure to Sales platforms and applications such as CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, and Order Management.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, GenAI platforms , or similar analytical and visualization tools.
- Ability to convert analytical findings into structured business recommendations and executive-ready deliverables .
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Business Development & Consulting Skills
- Exposure to RFP/RFI response management and proposal development .
- Ability to develop client-ready presentations, solution narratives, process diagrams, and supporting materials.
- Strong research and problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to communicate complex business and technology concepts in clear business language.
- Exposure to client-facing consulting, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation.
- Ability to work effectively with distributed, cross-functional, and multicultural teams.
- Demonstrated ability to take increasing ownership of workstreams and deliverables.

- Software & Platforms

- Communications & Media

Candidates should demonstrate an interest in understanding industry-specific Sales models, go-to-market strategies, operating models, Sales processes, and technology landscapes.

- Familiarity with process mapping and modeling using Visio or similar tools.
- Growing understanding of AX Design , AI-agent behavior, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, and human-machine collaboration.
- Ability to work across both client delivery and Business Development/RFP activities .
- Willingness to continuously build expertise across Sales processes, Sales platforms, industry trends, AI/GenAI, and consulting methodologies .

You are expected to bring a developing point of view on how AI and automation can reinvent the way commerce organizations manage content, discoverability, assortment, pricing, channels, and fulfilment — and to actively leverage AI tools in every aspect of your work.
You Are
You produce solid analytical work — assessing the trends and forces reshaping commerce, designing future-state content, digital shelf and channel operations processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in commerce platforms, data-driven performance management, and the operating models that underpin modern commerce — and you have a point of view on how AI is changing all of it.
You understand that designing how AI agents interact within commerce processes — from content enrichment and digital shelf monitoring to assortment, pricing, and order orchestration — is just as important as the process design itself. You're starting to apply AX Design principles in your work, ensuring that how AI agents behave within each commerce workflow is as intentional as the workflow itself.
Areas of Work
Commerce Process Excellence — Commerce Operating Model, Commerce Content & Experience Design, Off-Platform & AI Discoverability, Commerce Intelligence & Optimization, Agentic Commerce Operations

·       Produce trend and forces assessments for commerce functions — covering shifts in shopper behaviour, channel and marketplace dynamics, platform evolution, data and privacy regulation, and the growing role of AI and agents in commerce operations.

·       Build analytical frameworks using AI-assisted data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, GenAI synthesis platforms) to surface reinvention opportunities across the commerce value chain.

·       Apply commerce domain knowledge to review and improve function-specific reinvention designs, capability frameworks, and commerce playbook content.
·       Support delivery of digital and platform solutions — including PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS, marketplace and retail media ecosystems — across client engagements.

·       Contribute to the reference library and keep commerce domain expertise current through continuous learning and assigned development modules.

·       Hands-on experience using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or performance tools; comfortable synthesizing large data sets into clear commerce insights.
·       Ability to analyze complex commerce performance data and translate findings into structured, client-ready recommendations across process, channel mix, and operating model design.
·       Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce polished, senior-ready deliverables with limited direction.
·       Comfortable working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments with client-facing accountability.
Additional Information
·       Familiarity with process mapping or process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) applied to commerce workflows — content supply chain design, product onboarding flows, order-to-fulfilment mapping — is a strong differentiator.
·       Growing familiarity with AX Design concepts as applied to commerce — specifically how AI agent behaviours, autonomy levels, and handoff protocols are designed within content, digital shelf, merchandising, and channel execution workflows.

·       Experience with end-to-end commerce operations — from product onboarding and content enrichment through activation, merchandising, measurement, and optimization — is highly desirable.
·       Familiarity with data-driven commerce concepts: product data governance, assortment and pricing analytics, digital shelf measurement, and attribution across channels.

Good to Have Skills: AX Design, Commerce & Content Platforms (PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS), Data Visualization (Tableau / Power BI), AI Discoverability & GEO Concepts

Job Summary

In this role, you will produce rigorous analytical work across commerce functions — assessing how AI is reshaping the commerce operating model, designing future-state commerce processes, and building the deliverables that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations for clients. You are expected to bring a developing point of view on how AI and automation can reinvent the way commerce organizations manage content, discoverability, assortment, pricing, channels, and fulfilment — and to actively leverage AI tools in every aspect of your work.
You Are
You produce solid analytical work — assessing the trends and forces reshaping commerce, designing future-state content, digital shelf and channel operations processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in commerce platforms, data-driven performance management, and the operating models that underpin modern commerce — and you have a point of view on how AI is changing all of it.
You understand that designing how AI agents interact within commerce processes — from content enrichment and digital shelf monitoring to assortment, pricing, and order orchestration — is just as important as the process design itself. You're starting to apply AX Design principles in your work, ensuring that how AI agents behave within each commerce workflow is as intentional as the workflow itself.
Areas of Work
Commerce Process Excellence — Commerce Operating Model, Commerce Content & Experience Design, Off-Platform & AI Discoverability, Commerce Intelligence & Optimization, Agentic Commerce Operations
Roles & Responsibilities
As part of the team, you will utilize AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation — including building agents and other tools — to drive the following:
Commerce Trends, Forces & Benchmarking
·       Produce trend and forces assessments for commerce functions — covering shifts in shopper behaviour, channel and marketplace dynamics, platform evolution, data and privacy regulation, and the growing role of AI and agents in commerce operations.
·       Conduct benchmarking analyses that show where the client's commerce organization stands relative to peers across dimensions such as content quality and completeness, digital shelf performance, discoverability, conversion, operational efficiency, and AI adoption.
·       Build analytical frameworks using AI-assisted data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, GenAI synthesis platforms) to surface reinvention opportunities across the commerce value chain.
Future-State Commerce Process Design
·       Design future-state process specifications for core commerce workflows — including product content creation and enrichment, digital shelf and channel operations, merchandising and assortment, pricing and promotions, order management, and performance measurement — covering AI integration points, platform requirements, human-machine interaction design, and workforce adoption approaches.
·       Map current-state commerce operating models and identify where AI-enabled automation, intelligent decisioning, and real-time optimization can drive step-change improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.
·       Apply commerce domain knowledge to review and improve function-specific reinvention designs, capability frameworks, and commerce playbook content.
·       Support delivery of digital and platform solutions — including PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS, marketplace and retail media ecosystems — across client engagements.
Change Impact & Commerce Capability Analysis
·       Develop change-impact assessments for commerce transformation initiatives — documenting implications for roles, team structures, operating rhythms, governance, and capability requirements as AI is embedded into commerce workflows.
·       Contribute to the reference library and keep commerce domain expertise current through continuous learning and assigned development modules.
AX Design Application in Commerce
·       Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs across commerce processes — defining how AI agents should behave within each step of the commerce lifecycle, what they handle autonomously (e.g., content variant generation, digital shelf monitoring, price and availability checks), and when they hand off to a human practitioner.
·       Ensure AX Design documentation is embedded within commerce process specifications and is consistent across all content, channel, and platform deliverables.
Professional & Technical Skills
·       1-4 years of experience in commerce transformation, digital commerce, process excellence, or management consulting with a commerce focus — with increasing independence across engagements.
·       Demonstrated experience producing commerce trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, capability assessments, or change-impact assessments for senior stakeholder review.
·       Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into commerce process design — including AI-driven content production, automated digital shelf management, intelligent pricing and assortment decisioning, and agent-assisted shopper journeys.
·       Familiarity with the commerce technology ecosystem: product information and asset management (PIM, DAM), content management, order management (OMS), marketplace and retail media platforms, and analytics tools.
·       Working understanding of AI-driven discovery and off-platform visibility — including AI-ready product content, structured product data and knowledge foundations, and visibility across answer engines and LLM surfaces.
·       Hands-on experience using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or performance tools; comfortable synthesizing large data sets into clear commerce insights.
·       Ability to analyze complex commerce performance data and translate findings into structured, client-ready recommendations across process, channel mix, and operating model design.
·       Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce polished, senior-ready deliverables with limited direction.
·       Comfortable working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments with client-facing accountability.
Additional Information
·       Familiarity with process mapping or process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) applied to commerce workflows — content supply chain design, product onboarding flows, order-to-fulfilment mapping — is a strong differentiator.
·       Growing familiarity with AX Design concepts as applied to commerce — specifically how AI agent behaviours, autonomy levels, and handoff protocols are designed within content, digital shelf, merchandising, and channel execution workflows.
·       Client-facing consulting or advisory experience in commerce transformation, platform enablement, or digital commerce strategy; ability to build credibility with commerce and commercial leadership.
·       Experience with end-to-end commerce operations — from product onboarding and content enrichment through activation, merchandising, measurement, and optimization — is highly desirable.
·       Familiarity with data-driven commerce concepts: product data governance, assortment and pricing analytics, digital shelf measurement, and attribution across channels.
·       Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI developments reshaping commerce, including generative AI for content, AI-driven discovery, and agent-mediated purchasing.

Job Summary
As a consultant – B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence , you will support clients in analyzing, redesigning, and transforming their end-to-end B2B Sales processes . You will work across key Sales process steps, from Lead Management and Qualification through Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations , helping identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, platform enablement, and AI-led transformation. You will conduct industry research, benchmarking, data analysis, and process assessments to develop insights that support transformation recommendations.
You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities , including research, solution development, process narratives, capability presentations, proposal content, and client-ready materials. The role will involve working with Sales platforms and enterprise applications , understanding how technology enables business processes, and supporting digital and platform transformation initiatives. You will use tools such as Microsoft Visio, Power BI, Tableau, and GenAI-enabled platforms to analyze, visualize, and communicate findings. You will also develop an understanding of AX Design , recognizing how AI agents can be embedded within redesigned Sales processes. B2B Sales Process & Transformation

- Contract Management

jobs.title: I&P GN - Song – Service- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
jobs.description:
Job Title – Service Operating Model & Process Design – Consultant – I&P GN

Management Level : 09 - Consultant
Location: Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Chennai
Must have skills: Process Excellence, Process Re-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma
Good to have skills: Customer Experience Design, AI-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design

Job Summary:
As a Service Operating Model & Process Design Team Lead/Consultant, you will support process and service transformation engagements, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will produce structured analytical work and supporting materials that enable senior practitioners to shape transformation recommendations.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
- Map and model current-state and future-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
- Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
- Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
- Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
- Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI-accelerated industry and peer-comparison tools.
- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
- Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
- Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Basic Qualification :
- Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
- Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
- Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
- Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.
Preferred Qualification:
- Experience in a management consulting firm.
- Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
- Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.
- Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
- The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.

Experience: Minimum 4 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification: MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute

You will combine process re-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. Roles & Responsibilities:
- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
- Map and model current-state and future-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
- Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
- Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
- Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
- Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI-accelerated industry and peer-comparison tools.
- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
- Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
- Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Basic Qualification :
- Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
- Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
- Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
- Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.

Preferred Qualification:
- Experience in a management consulting firm.
- Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
- Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.
- Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
- The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.

jobs.description:
Consultant

Join our team in Technology Strategy for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology

Practice: Technology Strategy & Advisory, S&C Global Network  I Areas of Work : Agile/Cloud/ Data/ AI/5G/Digital Architecture/Security/Transformation Management I Level: Consultant | Location: Gurgaon/Mumbai/ Bangalore /Kolkata/Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune | Years of Exp: >3

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you passionate about leveraging technology for large-scale transformation and innovation for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?

Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory .

The Practice- A Brief Sketch:

jobs.title: HR Reinvention Consulting Manager, Insurance
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com .

We are:
Accenture’s Talent Reinvention Partner and we’re helping clients reinvent how people and organizations work—delivering leadership, talent, operating models, workforce intelligence, and change solutions to accelerate the workforce agenda in the age of AI.

Role Overview:
As an HR Reinvention Manager, you will lead and shape how organizations approach HR in the digital age. Your role involves defining, shaping, selling and executing HR reinvention projects that integrate digital solutions, automation, process, and organization optimization. You will work closely with clients to improve HR functions, enhancing both business performance and employee satisfaction. This high-visibility role requires strategic thinking, deep expertise in HR reinvention, strong client relationships, and effective project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
Client Leadership & Relationship Management
- Build strong, trusted long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.

- Advise clients on HR operating models, technology, and transformation strategies aligned with business goals.

- Build perspectives on how the HR Strategy needs to evolve based on the evolution of the business strategy.

- Help clients optimize HR functions for efficiency, scalability, and strategic alignment.

HR Reinvention Strategy and Value Case
- Develop and implement HR reinvention strategies that blend traditional HR practices with digital innovations like AI, GenAI, and automation.

- Leverage analytics to assess current HR operations and design future-state models with technology-driven solutions to improve talent management, employee engagement, and workforce planning.

- Drive HR activity analysis to understand allocations of HR staff time and effort; compare to industry benchmarks and leading practices. Recommend options to optimize HR resource allocation and align with organizational goals.

- Work with clients to create HR reinvention value cases and roadmaps that align HR with business strategy and deliver measurable outcomes.

HR Operating Model and Service Delivery Framework
- Design new HR operating models and service delivery frameworks for clients, infusing leading practices from areas such as employee experience, digital HR, shared services, and outsourcing.

- Lead HR organization design efforts, articulating interaction models, location strategy, and sizing.

Employee Experience & Talent Management
- Lead initiatives to enhance employee experience through personalization, engagement, and alignment with company culture.

- Use HR technology, process improvement methodologies, and data analytics to improve talent acquisition, performance management, and employee well-being.

- Design talent management frameworks that integrate automation and AI to optimize workforce planning.

HR Technology Evaluation & Selection
- Lead the evaluation and selection of HR technologies (e.g., HRIS, AI tools) that fit client needs, culture, and business goals.

- Guide clients through the vendor selection process, including creating RFPs and evaluating capabilities.

Generative AI & Emerging Technologies
- Articulate how organizations should leverage GenAI and other advanced technologies to improve the HR function.

- Stay up to date on emerging digital HR trends and bring innovative solutions to clients.

HR Operations, Shared Services & Outsourcing
- Advise clients on transforming HR operations through shared services, outsourcing, and integrating digital tools and automation.

- Help clients evaluate sourcing options, driving cost efficiency and quality.

- Design and implement HR operating models leveraging these components.

Process Optimization & Automation
- Lead initiatives to streamline HR processes using automation, AI tools, and data analytics.

- Implement intelligent automation solutions to enhance process efficiency, scalability and accuracy.

Project Management & Delivery
- Lead end-to-end delivery of HR reinvention projects, ensuring timely, on-budget, and high-quality outcomes.

- Manage cross-functional teams to execute solutions across HR domains.

- Integrate new technologies like cloud-based HR systems and AI platforms into existing HR ecosystems.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
- Guide change management efforts to ensure smooth transitions to new HR processes and technologies.

- Facilitate stakeholder engagement, ensuring alignment with key business leaders and fostering buy-in and commitment at all levels of the organization.

- Empower clients with the knowledge and tools needed to activate, apply, and sustain transformation initiatives long-term.

Business Development & Sales
- Lead business development efforts by identifying and generating new HR reinvention opportunities, building on strong relationships with prospective clients.

- Write and present high-quality client proposals, business cases, and RFP responses that clearly articulate the value of our HR reinvention capabilities, ensuring alignment with client needs and expectations.

- Support business growth by working closely with senior leadership on strategic business development initiatives, offerings, and cultivating a pipeline of potential opportunities.

Practitioner Development, Thought Leadership, and Innovation
- Develop and coach practitioners on the functional craft of HR Reinvention; support learning programs and training efforts to develop our people.

- Contribute to thought leadership on HR reinvention trends and emerging areas of interest.

- Represent Accenture at industry events and conferences to enhance visibility and reputation.

- Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the HR Reinvention practice.

- Ability to travel is required.

Here's what you need:
- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in HR transformation, digital HR, or HR technology consulting, with at least 2 years in a managerial or leadership role.
- Minimum of 2 years leading HR reinvention programs, including operating model, process, technology, or service delivery transformation initiatives
- Minimum of 1 year of experience applying AI, GenAI, automation, or analytics tools to improve HR processes, employee experience, workforce planning, or talent outcomes.
- Minimum of 1 year of Insurance Industry experience

Bonus Points if:
HR Technology Expertise:
- In-depth understanding of leading HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and their role in transforming HR operations and the employee experience.
- Expertise in evaluating HRIS, talent management systems, and AI-driven solutions.
- Experience managing vendor relationships and technology selection processes.

HR Operating Model Design:
- Strong understanding of HR operating models, including shared services, outsourcing, and service delivery optimization.
- Ability to design and optimize HR operating models that integrate digital tools to drive efficiency and business outcomes.

Employee Experience Focus:
- Proven experience enhancing employee engagement and well-being through innovative HR strategies and digital solutions.
- Ability to design employee-centric HR solutions that align with company culture and business objectives.

Project Management & Delivery:
- Expertise in managing complex projects from strategy to execution, on time, within budget, and with quality.
- Familiar with Agile and Waterfall methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project).

Business Development & Sales:
- Skilled in leading business development leadership and building strong client relationships.
- Experience writing compelling proposals and presenting to senior leadership to win HR transformation engagements.

Thought Leadership & Innovation:
- Contributions to industry thought leadership through writing, speaking engagements, and research.
- Active participation in industry events to stay current on HR transformation trends.

Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management:
- Strong interpersonal skills for building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior stakeholders.
- Ability to influence senior leadership on HR strategy and technology decisions.

Consulting & Strategic Thinking:
- Ability to think strategically and develop innovative HR solutions that leverage digital technologies.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex HR transformation concepts into clear, actionable strategies.
- Strong business acumen and ability to align HR transformation with organizational goals.

Advanced Data Analytics & HR Metrics:
- Experience with workforce analytics and creating HR dashboards using tools like Power BI or Tableau.

Global & Multinational Experience:
- Experience with global clients and knowledge of international HR practices and compliance.

Agile & Scrum Certification:
- Certification in Agile or Scrum methodologies.
- You are staying current with GenerativeAI capabilities and toolsets applicable to Talent functions.
