jobs.title: #ACN S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - AI Architect - Senior Manager
jobs.description:
AI Architect — Senior Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from AI and GenAI architecture.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: GenAI Strategy & Architecture
Level: Senior Manager
Location: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
Years of Experience: 14 to 20 years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.
The Practice — A Brief Sketch
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology.
1.    Business Case & Value Transformation: Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations.
2.    Agentic AI Design: Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms.
3.    Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components for AI solutions.
4.    Scaled AI Deployment: Evaluate options for AI productionisation and scaled deployment, including MLOps, AI governance, value realisation tracking, and change management.
Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role
•    Process Hotspot Identification: Identify high-value business processes where Agentic AI can eliminate friction and unlock measurable value, using process analysis, business process mapping, process mining, and value-led prioritisation frameworks across target industries.
•    Agentic AI Design & Architecture: Design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production deployment. Demonstrate deep expertise in LLM architecture, prompt engineering, GenAI platforms, and framework selection (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent).
•    Enterprise AI & GenAI Strategy: Design & guide development of enterprise-wide AI & GenAI strategy for clients. Leverage strong expertise and certification in cloud AI platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson — as well as open-source models.
•    Scaled AI Deployment & MLOps: Guide implementation from advisory and prototype through to production-grade, scaled AI deployment, covering AI productionisation, MLOps, AI governance, model monitoring, change management, and value realisation frameworks.
•    Responsible AI & Governance: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI & GenAI frameworks, including bias detection, explainability, fairness, and regulatory compliance, to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations.
•    Business Case & Value Realization: Define an AI use case driven value realization framework and build quantitative and qualitative business cases relevant to the client's industry. Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers.
•    Proof of Concepts & Prototyping: Help design and lead POCs and high-level solutions using AI or GenAI analytics to derive insights from data. Collaborate with business experts, platform engineers, and technology teams for prototyping and client implementations.
•    Discovery Workshops & Stakeholder Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & GenAI opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.
•    Solution Architecture & Technology Landscape: Assess impact to client's technology landscape/architecture; formulate guiding principles and platform components. Demonstrate knowledge of IT & enterprise architecture concepts — Cloud, API-first, MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, observability.
•    Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI transformation engagements.
Read more about us.
•    The rise of forerunners
•    Recent Blogs

What's in It for You?
•    An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
•    Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
•    Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
•    Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
•    Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
About Accenture Strategy & Consulting
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Global Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us-en/Careers/capability-network
Accenture Global Network  | Accenture in One Word

At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

Your Experience Counts!
•    MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred.
•    7 – 10 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.
•    5+ years of experience in designing and building end-to-end Enterprise AI and GenAI strategic solutions using cloud and non-cloud platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson, DataRobot, or equivalent.
•    Excellent understanding of Traditional AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and Advanced Cognitive methods to derive insights and actions.
•    Demonstrated ability to design agentic AI workflows, including LLM architecture, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and AI agent design for production environments.
•    5+ years of experience writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives or AI & Data transformation, including value realisation and AI governance frameworks.
•    Good working knowledge in formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components with expertise in Responsible AI frameworks, including bias, explainability, and regulatory compliance.
•    5+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing AI strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs.
•    Deep understanding of data supply chain and how it enables AI productionisation and scaled deployment.
•    Mandatory knowledge of IT & Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience — Cloud, API-first, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MLOps, observability.
•    Strong understanding in any of the following industries preferred: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, Transportation, Automotive/Industrial, or equivalent.

SAP MDG-MDM Functional Consultant Role – Level 9 Join Accenture’s Technology Strategy & Advisory team and help global organizations unlock exceptional business value through technology. If you’re passionate about SAP MDG/MDM and data-driven transformation, this is your opportunity to make an impact. Practice: Technology Strategy & Advisory, Capability Network I Areas of Work: Proficient as SAP MDG/MDM functional Consultant and expertise in SAP Data & Analytics with proven track record across Platform strategy, migration, assessment, implementation I Level: Functional Analyst | Location: Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai | Years of Exp: 9 (Minimum) Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture Are you passionate about leveraging technology for large-scale transformation and innovation for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture? Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory. The Practice – A Brief Sketch The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies. Here is a glimpse of your day-to-day responsibilities: • Work as SAP Functional Analyst contributing to documentation for end-to-end request for system changes, configurations, and enhancements • Maintain documentation to analyze client needs and translate them into technical solutions • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes and optimize SAP functionalities • Identifying, assessing and solving complex business problems across SAP S4 HANA ERP landscape throughout the project lifecycle, providing subject matter expertise with a strong strategic awareness of the SAP market and associated technologies • Train end-users on SAP MDG-MDM processes and ensure they are proficient in using the system • Ensure the system remains functional and consistent after implementation • Ensure adherence to industry standards and project plans during implementation • Assisting clients to build the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance • Mentoring and developing our people and contributing to asset creations like project blueprints and configuration documents

Job Role Requirements: • MBA from a Tier-1 institute. • Minimum 9 years of SAP ERP experience, having led at least 1 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation project. • Design and business blueprinting for greenfield implementations of SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA, focusing on Master Data Governance (MDG) and Master Data Management (MDM) as part of enterprise-wide architecture. • Hands-on experience with SAP MDG domains (Business Partner, Material, Finance), including BRF+ workflows, Change Request orchestration, Data Replication Framework (DRF), and mass processing/consolidation. • Hands-on experience with SAP Data Migration for master data objects such as: • Business Partner (Customer/Vendor) • Material Master • Product Hierarchies • Classification Data • Strong understanding of data migration strategies from ECC or non-SAP ERPs to S/4HANA using SAP Data Services • Strong understanding of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP Datasphere for data modeling and reporting. • Ability to perform Data Assessments and ensure data quality and compliance. • Familiarity with SAP Joule and AI-driven solutions for intelligent data management. • Ability to conduct requirement gathering sessions, perform AS-IS assessments, Fit-Gap analysis, and define TO-BE design aligned with SAP best practices. • Exposure to hybrid ERP environments (SAP on-prem + SaaS solutions) and SAP Public Cloud offerings. • Experience in large-scale ERP transformation and migration projects, including integration with third-party systems. • Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology, clean core principles, and Fiori-based MDG applications. • Understanding SAP integration technologies: SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), and SAP BTP for extensibility. • Knowledge of latest MDG practices:  MDG Cloud Edition and integration with SAP Data Intelligence for advanced governance.  AI/ML-driven data quality improvements and automation.  MDG extensibility via APIs and SAP BTP services. • Ability to create functional prototypes, support business case development, and demonstrate MDG value in S/4HANA deployments. Good to have (not mandatory) - SAP Certification (good to have, not mandatory).

jobs.title: #ACN S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Advisory - Cloud Architecture - Manager
jobs.description:
About Accenture:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 750K people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

About Global Network:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.

To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Global Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit www.accenture.com/capabilitynetwork .

Practice Overview:

Skill/Operating Group
Technology Consulting
Level
Manager
Location
Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Travel Percentage
Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100%

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, it’s more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client’s toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:
Helping Clients : Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.
Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.
Transforming Businesses : Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connected landscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties
And Responsibilities:
Project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.

The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape

Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities.

- Lead Hybrid Cloud Projects: Guide clients through application modernization and migration initiatives, designing strategies and roadmaps for hybrid environments.
- Architect Hybrid Solutions: Develop cloud architectures integrating public cloud services with on-premises and private cloud platforms, using technologies such as OpenShift, Anthos, and VMware.
- Application Modernization: Design composable architectures using microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA), and cloud-native technologies across hybrid environments.
- Hybrid Cloud Integration: Implement solutions that enable seamless workload portability and management across on-premises, private, and public clouds.
- DevOps & Automation: Establish CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Deployment Manager, OpenShift templates), and automated operations across hybrid environments.
- Data Integration & Analytics: Architect data platforms that span cloud and on-premises, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and secure data exchange.
- Security & Compliance: Design secure hybrid architectures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for identity, access, and data protection.
- Client Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor, communicating hybrid cloud architecture, best practices, and transformation strategies to technical and business stakeholders.
- Thought Leadership: Develop reusable assets, publish whitepapers, and contribute to the hybrid cloud community.
- Business Case & ROI Analysis: Build financial models for cloud adoption, including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI. Advise on cost optimization strategies and AWS pricing models.
- Operating Model Design: Design cloud operating models for governance, security, and compliance. Recommend organizational changes for cloud adoption (e.g., Cloud Center of Excellence).
- Resilience & DR Strategy: Define RTO/RPO tiers, multi-region patterns, backup/restore policies
- Design Architecture Review Board charters, NFR baseline templates

Key Competencies and Skills:
The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes –
- Expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, integration, and cloud-native development.
- Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift), and event-driven design.
- Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation across hybrid environments

Other desired skills -
- Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
- Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
- Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
- Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
- Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
- Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POV’s

Additional Information:

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion, or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic, or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree
- MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)
- 9-13 years of large-scale consulting experience and/or working with hi tech companies leading Projects on Cloud Strategy, Assessment, Cloud architecture, App Modernization, Containers, information security and information management.
- Professional Cloud Architect Certification (GCP or AWS)

Experience:
- We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale engagements in application modernization, cloud architecture, and cloud strategy. The ideal candidates will have technical expertise in cloud strategy, assessments, cloud architecture, application modernization, and containers, across all stages of the innovation lifecycle, with a focus on shaping the future in real-time."
- The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

jobs.title: I&P GN - I&E - Life Science – R&D Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
jobs.description:
Practice: Accenture S&C- GN- Industry & Enterprise
Capability: Life Sciences – R&D (General R&D, Clinical, Safety & Regulatory)
Career Level : Consultant
Experience: 3-7 yrs
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
- AI Transformation Advisory: AI opportunity identification and qualification across Life Sciences R&D functions; AI-ready process design and solution shaping for drug discovery, clinical development, and regulatory workflows; experience conducting client workshops and capability assessments in Life Sciences context
- Life Sciences R&D Domain Expertise (AI fluent): Working knowledge of one or more Life Sciences R&D sub-functions and their data: General R&D (target identification, drug discovery, R&D portfolio management, translational research); Clinical (protocol development, site selection, patient recruitment, clinical data management, EDC, CTMS, eTMF and other systems); Safety & Regulatory (pharmacovigilance, adverse event management, signal detection, regulatory submissions – IND/NDA/BLA/CTD, labeling, regulatory intelligence etc.)
- Process Excellence + AI (R&D): Process discovery and redesign across R&D sub-functions; business process modelling for clinical operations, regulatory submissions, and safety workflows; process analysis and optimization with knowledge of GxP compliance requirements and validation considerations
- Life Sciences R&D Functional Transformation: Functional process knowledge across R&D value chain – study start-up, clinical trial management, pharmacovigilance operations, regulatory affairs, and medical writing; familiarity with key platforms such as Veeva Vault (CTMS, RIM, Safety, eTMF), Medidata Rave, Argus Safety etc.
- AI Value Architecture (R&D): Value discovery and benefit quantification for AI initiatives in R&D contexts (e.g. cycle time reduction in clinical trials, submission timelines, PV processing efficiency); business case development with understanding of R&D cost drivers and regulatory risk dimensions
- Life Sciences R&D Data & AI: Data readiness assessment for AI across R&D data types (clinical trial data, ICSR/safety data, regulatory documents, scientific literature); understanding of data standards (CDISC – SDTM/ADaM, MedDRA, WHO Drug); data product concepts and AI adoption support in GxP-compliant environments
- Agentic Enterprise (R&D): Identification and scoping of agentic AI opportunities across R&D sub-functions; agent workflow mapping and orchestration design for multi-step R&D processes; human-in-the-loop design with sensitivity to regulatory and patient safety considerations; knowledge of agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g. LangChain, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock Agents) and their applicability in Life Sciences contexts
- Across all: AI fluency (fundamentals of AI, GenAI, Agentic AI); requirements definition; understanding of Life Sciences regulatory environment (FDA, EMA, ICH guidelines); consulting skills including structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, and ability to engage with both scientific and business audiences

GOOD TO HAVE EXPERINCE:
- AI prototyping with GenAI and agent builders
- Process Mining (Celonis/Signavio/Soroco)
- RPA (UiPath/Automation Anywhere)
- Low-Code/No-Code development tools (co-pilot studio, N8N, etc.)
- SQL and Python basics
- Data visualization and storytelling
- Understanding of SDLC and Business Analysis
- Familiarity with Life Sciences R&D platforms: Veeva Vault (CTMS, RIM, Safety, eTMF), Medidata Rave / Rave RBQM, Oracle Clinical One, Argus Safety, ARIS-g etc.
- Knowledge of data standards relevant to Life Sciences: CDISC (SDTM, ADaM), MedDRA, WHO Drug, HL7 FHIR
- Prior consulting experience in Life Sciences, or in-industry operating experience in R&D, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or Pharmacovigilance

jobs.title: Workforce & Change Consultant/Manager - Life Sciences
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.
Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.  We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human + AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

The Workforce & Change Consultant supports workforce design and change management delivery across the pod. This role conducts stakeholder assessments, develops change materials, tracks adoption, and ensures the organization is ready and able to adopt new ways of working

You Are:
An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

Role Overview
• Support workforce design and change management delivery across the pod's functional transformation workstreams
• Conduct stakeholder assessments, change impact analyses, and organizational readiness surveys
• Develop communications, change materials, and adoption plans tailored to functional audiences
• Track adoption signals and surface resistance patterns to the Workforce Design Lead
• Coordinate with the Learning & Development Partner to align change activities with training delivery

Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

Basic Qualifications
- Candidates must have at least 3 years of combined experience in the following:
• Change management, organizational development, or HR transformation in a consulting or in-industry context
• Demonstrated experience with change impact analysis, stakeholder mapping, and change readiness assessment
• Experience developing change communications and adoption materials for functional audiences
• Familiarity with change management methodologies (Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter, or equivalent)
• Strong written communication skills for developing clear, audience-appropriate change materials

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting AI-augmented workforce transitions — helping employees adopt AI-enabled workflows
- Background in Life Sciences functional change programs (commercial launch, enterprise transformation, or manufacturing modernization)
- Familiarity with employee sentiment measurement tools and adoption analytics platforms
- Experience working alongside process design and technology teams in agile delivery environments

jobs.title: Digital Manufacturing Transformation Consultant | Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

WHO WE ARE

We are Accenture ’s   Supply Chain and Engineering   reinvention partner for Life Sciences . We embed innovation, intelligence, and   AI-native   operations   into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and   distributes   products. We   serve Life Sciences clients across the   value chain to help bring   lifesaving   medicines and products to patients   through   harnessing the power of advanced   technologies.

The Work:
You produce   data-driven   analytical work — assessing trends and forces shaping your industry or function, designing future-state processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in your domain and a point of view on how AI and automation can change the way it operates. You're comfortable working with structured guidance while taking on more with each engagement.

You understand that  how AI agents   and humans   interact within processes — AX   (Agentic Experience)   Design — is just as important as the process design itself, and you're starting to apply those principles in your work.

Accenture is seeking a   Consultant   for   Manufacturing   and Operations    t ransformation   work   within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice   for Life Sciences   with a focus on Data and AI transformation .   We work with our pharmaceutical, biotech, medical technology, distributor and consumer health clients globally to redefine the future of the life sciences industry: combining the latest technology with scientific breakthroughs to revolutionize how medical treatments are discovered, developed and delivered to patients around the world.

The role sits at the intersection of manufacturing,   quality    and supply chain, and is responsible for   delivering   AI-enabled transformations for our clients and their patients .

Key Responsibilities:

Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of   low-code proof of concepts (POCs),   agents and other    artifacts   that    facilitate:

- Be able to analyze client’s current state   by assessing processes, technology tools and   organizational structure   with an intent to transform   to a data and AI insight driven future state.

- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches   applicable to Life Sciences manufacturing and quality functions. .

- Conduct process analysis and support delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations.

- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools.

- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.

- Apply your industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

- Contribute to the reference library and keep your domain expertise current through continuous learning.

- Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs — defining how AI agents should behave within each redesigned process step, what they handle autonomously, and when they hand off to a person.

At a Consultant level   within Life Sciences Supply Chain and Engineering , key   project   responsibilities could include:

- Apply generative AI and agent-based modeling to accelerate scenario planning, exception management, and autonomous decision-making.

- Define and implement AI-enabled supply chain control towers for real-time visibility, risk sensing, and proactive disruption management.

- Collaborate with clients to deploy predictive maintenance, digital twins, and intelligent automation in manufacturing and distribution networks.

jobs.title: Pharma/MedTech Warehouse & TMS Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

WHO WE ARE
We are Accenture's Supply Chain and Engineering reinvention partner for Life Sciences. We embed innovation, intelligence, and AI-native operations into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes products. We serve Life Sciences clients across the value chain to help bring lifesaving medicines and products to patients through harnessing the power of advanced technologies.

The Work:
Accenture is seeking a Consultant to drive hands-on execution across Life Sciences Warehouse and Transportation Management transformation programs within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice. We work with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and specialty distributor clients to modernize warehousing and logistics operations — combining regulated-industry delivery expertise with AI-powered automation and intelligent transportation management.  The role provides the execution depth needed across multi-workstream fulfillment programs, supporting the implementation of warehouse management and transportation solutions across both pharma and medical device client engagements. This role requires hands-on delivery depth across both warehouse and transportation management systems — candidates must bring meaningful experience in each.

Key Responsibilities:
At a Consultant level, key responsibilities could include:
- Support the delivery of warehouse management and transportation management system implementations across life sciences clients — managing project workstreams, coordinating with system integrators and client teams, and driving execution across platforms including SAP EWM/TM, Manhattan WMS/TM, Blue Yonder WMS/TM, and others in GxP-regulated environments.

- Support validation activities and audit trail documentation requirements consistent with life sciences quality standards — working across pharma and medical device regulatory frameworks to ensure system implementations meet applicable GxP, GDP, and quality management obligations.

- Lead design and implementation of TMS solutions for cold chain carrier management, lane optimization, and temperature excursion alerting across pharma and device distribution networks.

- Support the integration of warehouse and transportation management platforms within a broader enterprise architecture — connecting WMS/TMS solutions with ERP, quality management, and supply chain visibility systems to enable end-to-end operational execution.

- Apply AI and automation capabilities to warehouse and transportation operations — including intelligent slotting, AI-driven exception management, robotics integration readiness, and predictive quality alerts.

- Design order fulfillment processes for life sciences commercial, hospital, and IDN channels — including pick/pack/ship workflows, returns management, recall execution, and consignment or loaner inventory flows.

- Contribute to the development of reusable delivery assets, validated configuration templates, and warehouse design accelerators for the Life Sciences Fulfillment practice.

- Engage deeply in project delivery with hands-on work, leading work products and supporting senior team members across active engagements.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience delivering both warehouse management and transportation management system implementations in pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader life sciences environments — candidates with experience in only one discipline will not be considered.

- Demonstrated platform fluency across both WMS and TMS — including hands-on project delivery with SAP EWM/TM, Manhattan WMS/TM, or Blue Yonder WMS/TM. Familiarity with one side of the stack alone is not sufficient.

- Minimum 3 years of TMS delivery experience specific to life sciences distribution — including cold chain carrier management, regulated product routing, lane optimization, and temperature excursion alerting across pharma or device networks.

- Experience integrating WMS and TMS platforms within a broader enterprise architecture — connecting to ERP, quality management, and supply chain visibility systems to enable end-to-end operational execution.

Bonus Points If:
- Working knowledge of life sciences validation concepts and quality documentation requirements — including GxP, GDP, and applicable pharma or medical device quality management standards as they apply to system implementations.

- Working knowledge of order fulfillment process design — pick/pack/ship, returns, and recall workflows in regulated life sciences environments.

- Curiosity and growing fluency in AI, automation, and digital capabilities as applied to warehouse operations and logistics management.

- Strong delivery orientation — ability to execute independently, manage work products, and communicate clearly with client and project teams.

- Experience across both pharma and medical device distribution environments, or familiarity with the distinct fulfillment and quality requirements of each.

- Exposure to robotics, AMRs, or warehouse automation technologies in life sciences distribution.

- Familiarity with product traceability workflows — serialization, lot genealogy, or device traceability — integrated within WMS or TMS environments.

jobs.description:
We are:
Sourcing & Procurement, and we move fast, think fast, and work fast. Our clients need big-picture change, so we come at their challenges from all sides with functional insights, data power, digital leadership, and extensive industry know-how. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in cost-out, strategic category management, and procurement operations.

You are:
A strategic Sourcing and Procurement professional with chemicals expertise who helps clients develop strategies and operating models to advance procurement capabilities and drive bottom-line financial impact. You use your data skills to develop and implement strategies that improve the value and performance delivered by clients’ supply base, while establishing strategic procurement category plans and processes to sustain long-term value. You’ve also got the communication skills to make sure that everyone understands your ideas and how to get them working as quickly as possible. Your experience means that people look to you for guidance and ideas. And you know how to make sure teams get their work done on time, every time.

The work:
There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why we love it here! This is an extraordinary chance to begin a rewarding career at Accenture Interactive Immersed in a digitally compassionate and innovation-led environment, here is where you can help top clients shift to the New using leading-edge technologies on the most ground-breaking projects imaginable.

Whether identifying opportunities to reduce clients’ chemicals costs and environmental impacts or proposing innovative solutions that curb the effect of soaring prices and longer lead times, Accenture’s Sourcing & Procurement team delivers tangible business results for our clients – while also enhancing the employee experience, customer satisfaction, and community impact.

As a Senior Manager, you will be responsible for running most aspects of client cost optimization or procurement process optimization projects, including project management, client and supplier communications, supplier negotiations, and delivery of results. You will also actively lead and mentor our junior staff resources.  As Accenture’s Chemicals Center of Excellence leader, you will play an important role in deepening our expertise and knowledge capture to support business development opportunities while helping scale Accenture’s chemicals sourcing capabilities. You will be accountable for:

- Developing project plans and leading some or all parts of the client engagement

- Managing project support resources and coordinating with subject matter experts from within and outside the firm

- Developing creative cost reduction strategies and recommendations

- Presenting to client executives

- Building consensus among client stakeholders

- Developing and nurture relationships with clients

- Assessing client expenditures and identifying targets to reduce costs and improve quality

- Reengineering procurement processes

- Manage Chemicals Center of Excellence sales target, sales pipeline,

- Lead sales calls providing category expertise with clients

- Coach and develop internal team members career growth plans

- Provide chemicals industry thought leadership and benchmarking

- Create and curate deliverable content (POV slides, case studies, whitepapers, etc.)

- Build and expand internal category knowledge capture and technologies

The ideal candidate possesses experience in chemicals procurement and/or negotiations across areas such as Petrochemicals, Chlor-Alkalis, Inorganic Chemicals, and working across industries from chemicals manufacturing, industrial products, to consumer products.  While depth in all areas is not required, you will be expected to infuse Accenture’s Sourcing & Procurement consulting business with any existing knowledge and to build upon your current chemicals Procurement base by demonstrating a strong aptitude for learning.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary from 10-50%.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum of 7+ years of experience executing strategic sourcing and procurement projects/programs, including 4+ years in chemicals sourcing or chemicals negotiations
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points If:
- You have proven experience sourcing a broad range of types of chemicals such as Chlor-Alkali (e.g., Caustic Soda), Petrochemicals, Specialty Chemicals (e.g., excipients)
- Consulting experience with a well-regarded firm
- Strong analytical skills including the ability to manage resources performing complex analytics to develop client decision support data
- Ability to effectively plan and manage multiple projects, tasks, and/or initiatives simultaneously, especially related to chemicals projects
- Strong work ethic and high level of integrity

jobs.description:
Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech, and leading companies across industries.

Capability: Talent(HR Consulting)
Location: Uptown 3 BGC, Taguig City

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Are you an outcome-oriented problem solver? Do you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clients? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then , Accenture Industry and Process is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.

As a Process Excellence in Talent (HR Consulting),

You own the full process transformation design cycle for your industry or function — from assessing how market forces, regulatory shifts, and technology changes are reshaping the landscape, through specifying the future-state process, to defining how people will adopt new ways of working. You're the domain authority on your team: clients and colleagues come to you because of what you know about how this industry or function actually works.

You are designing at the intersection of human, agent, and process as part of the transformation work. When you design a future-state process, you naturally consider how AI agent experiences should be shaped to serve both the business outcome and the people working alongside those agents.

The Work:

Embed AI into future state design for clients as well as in ways of working for your team using the appropriate AI tools and creating agents strategically to aid in deliverable creation.

• Lead future-state process specification, AI integration design, operating model changes, and adoption planning for your assigned industry or functional area.
• Run client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership; manage day-to-day client relationships and issue resolution.
• Drive benchmarking analysis and change-impact assessments grounded in deep knowledge of how your industry or function operates.
• Facilitate design thinking sessions and co-creation workshops with cross-functional client teams.
• Connect operating model to future-state processes to drive transformation approaches that are practical and credible.
• Build and maintain documented redesign methods and playbook contributions for your assigned functional process areas.
• Contribute to business development by qualifying opportunities and co-authoring proposals.
• Coach junior practitioners on process redesign methods, domain-specific trend assessment, and operating model design.
• Embed AX Design principles into process specifications — defining how AI agent experiences should be shaped within each process step in your domain, including agent autonomy levels, escalation triggers, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.

Your experience counts!

- Minimum 2–8 years of experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting
- Demonstrated ability to lead client discovery workshops and present recommendations to senior leadership
- Experience using AI-assisted tools for benchmarking, analytics, or workshop facilitation
- Experience designing future-state processes with AI integration points, operating model changes, and adoption approaches
- Proven track record building benchmarking analyses and change-impact assessments
- Deep expertise in at least one industry or functional domain

Preferred Qualification:
• Familiarity with process mining or digital twin approaches for process validation

Accenture’s Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality
and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test,
evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of
content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on
society.

flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns.
This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at
times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively
engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual,
or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need
strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the
support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accenture’s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety
community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.
What are we looking for? •Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills
• Excellent comprehension, communication, and (insert language) skills
• Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of
client policies
• Strong attention to detail
• Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
• Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
Preferred Qualifications
• Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
• High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and
region that will be supported
Roles and Responsibilities: •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines
• Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor
• In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks
• The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised
• You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work
• Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts
•Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client
guidelines, using specific tools and channels
• Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry
trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or
responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
• Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
• Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to
responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
• Analyze the model s responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending
disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
• Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues
based on a model s responses.
• Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible
AI governance and policy

This role is within Accenture Internal Procurement Team known as Center of Excellence responsible for driving Innovation and Transformation across our Source-to-Pay cycle. Our Mission is to ensure our systems are in line with Legal & Regulatory evolutions without any business disruptions

Center of Excellence (COE’s) are individuals who own an end-to-end process across functional silos, geographic and business unit boundaries.

The Position:
Identify candidates with relevant experience in SAP S4 Hana, SAP BTP(Public Cloud). Individual is expected to own the End-to-End tool including changes, Enhancements, Issues, Business engagements around process improvements without disrupting our core system that could potentially impact other associated teams using the same tool. Apart from the core R&R, one needs to be also driving new tool implementations including Project Management, Requirement gathering, Technology Discussion, Testing of product including UAT, Regression, Sign-off, deployment and hypercare.

Roles & Responsibilities
Drive standardization, efficiency, top quartile performance & business outcomes across P2P
- Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP FI module with a specialization in Accounts Payable processes aligned with Indirect Procurement workflows.
- Ensure accurate invoice processing, vendor payments, and GR/IR reconciliation, working closely with Procurement, AP teams, and external suppliers.
- Handle high-priority (P1/P2) incident tickets and deliver effective resolutions within SLAs, collaborating with both internal finance/procurement teams and external vendors.
- Work with business stakeholders across Procurement, R2R, OTC, and Intercompany Accounting teams to ensure seamless financial operations.
- Evaluate and implement enhancement requests related to procurement-to-pay (P2P) processes, ensuring alignment with SAP standards and business requirements.
- Review and sign off on Functional Design Documents (FDD), ensuring completeness and accuracy of requirements.
- Support and coordinate Product Testing (PT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing alongside business and technology teams.
- Maintain audit readiness by producing necessary documentation and evidences for local/global internal and external audits.
- Monitor and validate change requests for compliance with SAP core principles, ensuring no adverse impact on upstream/downstream finance functions.
- Work with third-party vendors and integration partners to resolve data inconsistencies, interface errors, and ensure accurate financial postings.
- Support finance teams during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, especially around procurement accruals, vendor reconciliation, and clearing.

Educational Requirement:
Must have:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.

Skills and Work Experience
Must Have:
- 12+ years of total experience with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Transformation
- Experience in F&A Process transformation, business process automation, process improvement and data analytics, specifically you must have led at least two F&A transformation projects
- Experience shaping large scale digital AP transformations. You should be well versed with Industry digital F&A technologies and leading tools (SAP 4 HANA, SAP BTP, Power BI, Excel, Power Point), automation, artificial intelligence (AI) and analytics and have a proven track record of implementing digital finance solutions
- Experience in process diagnostic, recommendation, documentation and implementation of leading process and procedures for finance and accounts functions, including Procure to Pay (P2P), Record to Report (R2R), planning and budgeting, credit and collection, treasury, and taxation
- Compliance with and understanding of regulatory requirements
- Willingness to “constructively dissent” and challenge senior management thinking

Platform and software contact centers use to provide customer support. The quality and capabilities of the technology have a significant impact on both customer and agent experience, as well as contact center performance.

Experience Required

• 1–2 years in a supervisory or team lead role, with strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

• Support agents in handling complex complaints, escalations, and sensitive consumer cases for a timely resolution
• Review team and individual performance data, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement
• Prepare and present daily/weekly/monthly performance reports
• Create concise and impactful operational briefing decks for stakeholder meetings
• Collaborate closely with end-market Team to ensure alignment on performance metrics, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, IT) to resolve systemic issues and improve processes
• Conduct regular one-on-one and on-the-floor coaching sessions to build capability and engagement
• Manage team schedules, attendance, and adherence to shift timings
• Ensure adherence to quality, compliance, and data protection standards or regulatory guidelines
• Utilize SAP and Salesforce to oversee case management, order flows, and performance metrics
• Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
• Identify opportunities for upselling and service enhancement through onboarding, agent training upskilling and coaching
•In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of increasingly complex problems
• Your day to day interactions are with peers within Accenture
• You are likely to have some interaction with clients and/or Accenture management
• You will be given minimal instruction on daily work/tasks and a moderate level of instruction on new assignments

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
• Certifications in customer service or leadership (a plus)

• Prepare and present daily/weekly/monthly performance reports
• Create concise and impactful operational briefing decks for stakeholder meetings
• Collaborate closely with end-market Team to ensure alignment on performance metrics, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, IT) to resolve systemic issues and improve processes
• Conduct regular one-on-one and on-the-floor coaching sessions to build capability and engagement
• Manage team schedules, attendance, and adherence to shift timings
• Ensure adherence to quality, compliance, and data protection standards or regulatory guidelines
• Utilize SAP and Salesforce to oversee case management, order flows, and performance metrics
• Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
• Identify opportunities for upselling and service enhancement through onboarding, agent training upskilling and coaching

jobs.description:
Accenture is seeking a Semiconductor Materials Manufacturing Digital Process Transformation Engineer to support ERP-led transformation programs across semiconductor materials, fabrication, equipment, and OSAT manufacturing environments. This role focuses on leveraging SAP S/4HANA to modernize manufacturing, costing, engineering, commercial, and project execution processes, enabling operational excellence and scalable digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines semiconductor manufacturing domain expertise with strong SAP functional capabilities and consulting skills to translate complex business requirements into practical, value-driven digital solutions.

• Support SAP-driven manufacturing and engineering transformation initiatives, including process assessments, business case development, and future-state operating model design.

• Design and optimize manufacturing cost management processes, including product costing, variance analysis, capital project tracking, and engineering cost control.
• Support commercial process transformation initiatives involving pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and settlement management using SD and Vistex solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree or MBA in Engineering, Technology, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.

- Production Planning (PP)

jobs.title: Consultant Digitale Transformatie & Verandermanagement – Publieke Sector
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar om publieke organisaties te begeleiden in hun digitale transformatie met oog voor de mens achter de verandering?
Wil jij strategie en uitvoering verbinden en duurzame impact creëren door mensen, teams en publieke organisaties te helpen groeien in een steeds digitalere wereld?
Digitalisering, duurzaamheid en maatschappelijke verwachtingen vragen om een wendbare overheid. Daarom zoeken wij een strategisch verandermanager die helpt onze klanten binnen de publieke sector toekomstbestendig te maken als Transformational Change Consultant Health & Public Services

Samen bouwen we aan een wendbare, digitale en mensgerichte overheid, die klaar is voor de uitdagingen van morgen. Je draagt bij aan een toekomstbestendige overheid die beter aansluit bij de behoeften van burgers en bedrijven.

Jouw werk:
- Leid publieke transformaties: Begeleid ministeries, uitvoeringsinstellingen, gemeenten, en zorginstellingen bij complexe digitale transformaties.
- Concrete veranderinitiatieven: je bent de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je vertaalt de digitale koers van bestuur en directie naar concrete veranderinitiatieven binnen teams en afdelingen. Daarbij combineer je strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak, zodat visie ook echt wordt omgezet in zichtbaar resultaat.
- Mensgerichte transformatiestrategieën: Vertaal beleidsambities en maatschappelijke doelstellingen naar praktische, flexibele veranderprogramma’s die cultuur, samenwerking en organisatiegereedheid versterken. Bijvoorbeeld bij de invoering van digitale loketten en data-gedreven werkwijzen, de implementatie van AI-ondersteunde processen of de herinrichting van werkprocessen rondom nieuwe technologie
- Data- en AI-gestuurd verandermanagement: Gebruik data, analyses en AI-tools om leiderschap af te stemmen op de veranderambitie, verandertrajecten te monitoren en medewerkers effectief te ondersteunen bij nieuwe manieren van werken.
- Technologie als enabler van verandering: Activeer het menselijk potentieel van nieuwe technologieën via grootschalige systeemimplementaties en AI-ondersteunde veranderingstrajecten.
- Datagedreven impactmetingen: Meet adoptie, gebruik en tevredenheid van medewerkers en stakeholders met voorspellende analyses om de effectiviteit van veranderingen continu te verbeteren.
- Stakeholdermanagement & samenwerking: Bouw sterke, betrouwbare relaties met bestuurders, managementteams en projectteams, bewaak de voortgang van programma’s en identificeer kansen voor duurzame samenwerking.
- Business development: Ontwikkel voorstellen en strategieën voor nieuwe samenwerkingen en projecten die de publieke sector helpen sneller te innoveren en maatschappelijke waarde te vergroten.

Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team dat complexe, grootschalige projecten uitvoert. Je werkt nauw samen met klantteams en internationale collega’s om praktische oplossingen te implementeren voor uitdagende organisatievraagstukken, zoals procesoptimalisatie, digitale transformatie of herinrichting van de digitale strategie.
Veelal geef je leiding aan kritieke werkstromen, coördineer je activiteiten tussen verschillende teams, begeleid je junior collega’s en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opleveren van concrete, meetbare resultaten.

Wie we zijn
Bij Accenture   Strategy   & Consulting veranderen we bedrijven elke dag met onze inzichten, kennis en innovatieve ideeën.   Samen met ’s werelds toonaangevende bedrijven en onze ongeëvenaarde branche- en functie experts gaan we de uitdaging aan om samen   transformatieve   bedrijfsoplossingen te creëren, te innoveren en ze te implementeren. Door de nieuwste technologie te gebruiken, helpen we onze klanten om beter contact te maken met hun klanten, de veerkracht te verbeteren en duurzame groei te stimuleren.

Ons team Talent & Organization (T&O) richt zich op mensgerichte transformatie: we helpen leiders, teams en organisaties succesvol te veranderen in een digitale wereld. In Nederland bestaat het T&O-team uit circa 65 enthousiaste consultants die actief zijn in sectoren als Overheid, Zorg, Onderwijs, Financiële Dienstverlening en Technologie. Onze expertise omvat onder andere Change Management, Leiderschap & Cultuur, Operating Model/Talent Strategy/HR-transformatie, en Cyber Human Factors.

Strategy   & Consulting is een van de vijf services als onderdeel van Accenture – de andere zijn Operations, Technology, Song   en   Industry   X.

#LI-EU

Wie jij bent
- Afgeronde masteropleiding, bijv. in Bestuurskunde, Organisatiekunde, Arbeid & Organisatiepsychologie of Bedrijfskunde.
- 2–5 jaar ervaring met organisatieadvies of verandermanagement binnen de publieke sector (bijv. ministeries, uitvoeringsinstellingen, gemeenten en zorginstellingen).
- Ervaring met strategische (digitale) transformatieprogramma’s en het realiseren van duurzame verandering.
- Combinatie van strategisch inzicht en hands-on uitvoering: je kunt richting geven én resultaten boeken.
- Sterke advies- en communicatieve vaardigheden op management- en bestuursniveau.
- Affiniteit met digitalisering, innovatie en mensgerichte transformatie.
- Bestuurlijke sensitiviteit. Het vermogen om effectief te navigeren binnen complexe politieke en organisatorische verhoudingen.

Wat er voor jou in zit

Accenture is een geweldige plek om te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Kies je voor Accenture, dan word je een schakel in een bedrijf op wereldniveau. Door de vele samenwerkingsverbanden en relaties met klanten zijn wij trots op onze levendige en diverse bedrijfscultuur. Wij staan voor een agile aanpak, end-to-end services en een realistische mindset. Wij willen de echte jij leren kennen en je verder helpen met je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Je doorloopt gedurende je carrière bij ons meerdere leertrajecten (formeel en informeel) om je vaardigheden en expertise binnen je rol uit te breiden. Wij beloven:
- Flexibel werken in een cultuur gebaseerd op vertrouwen
- Een mindset van duurzame groei
- Een door mensen geleidde cultuur van inclusie en diversiteit door diep om al onze mensen te geven
- Leid en transformeer onze klanten met technologie
- Maak verbinding met ons wereldwijde netwerk van 800.000 collega's

Naast onze uitdagende projecten, bieden wij jou ook nog het volgende:
- Een fijne en open werkomgeving waarbij de focus op jouw (persoonlijke) ontwikkeling ligt en waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt
- Mogelijkheden om zowel vanuit onze kantoren in Nederland als thuis te werken
- Korting op Accenture aandelen
- Goede benefits zoals laptop, mobiele telefoon, maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding, mobiliteitsbudget en meer

Wat wij geloven
Accenture is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Onze leiders zijn toegewijd aan het bouwen van een beter, sterker en rechtvaardiger bedrijf voor toekomstige generaties om positieve, langdurige verandering te creëren. Inclusie en diversiteit zijn fundamenteel voor onze cultuur en kernwaarden. We zetten ons in voor het creëren van een inclusieve omgeving voor al onze medewerkers. jobs.title: Consultant Senior en transformation digitale Supply Chain & Achats F/H
jobs.description:
Réinventer avec Accenture. En tant que Consultant Senior en transformation digitale Supply Chain & Achats F/H à Toulouse, vous intervenez sur des projets de transformation alliant expertises métiers, technologies et usage avancé de l’intelligence artificielle.

Le contexte
L'aéronautique et la défense vivent leur transformation la plus profonde depuis trente ans : montées en cadence sous tension, résilience des chaînes d'approvisionnement, souveraineté technologique, pression sur les coûts et les délais.
Face à ces enjeux, l'IA générative cesse d'être un sujet de conférence pour devenir un levier de performance opérationnelle. Copilotes de sourcing, agents d'analyse contractuelle, prévision de la demande, détection anticipée des dérives programme : ce que nous concevions hier en PowerPoint, nous le prototypons aujourd'hui en quelques semaines et le déployons à l'échelle.
C'est exactement ce que vous viendrez faire chez nous.

Votre rôle
Vous rejoignez la practice Supply Chain & Engineering d'Accenture, au cœur des programmes de transformation des plus grands acteurs de l'Aerospace & Defense.
Vous intervenez sur toute la chaîne de valeur du conseil : cadrage stratégique, diagnostic, business case, conception de solution, pilotage de déploiement, conduite du changement. Avec une constante, vous ne livrez pas des recommandations, vous livrez des résultats mesurables chez le client.

Vos principales missions

Conseil & transformation
- Cadrer et piloter des programmes de transformation Achats, Supply Chain, Manufacturing et Engineering
- Conduire des diagnostics de maturité, des analyses de performance et construire les business cases associés
- Définir des trajectoires de transformation et sécuriser leur exécution : jalons, budgets, risques, ressources
- Accompagner la mise en place de nouvelles organisations, méthodes de travail et démarches d'excellence opérationnelle
- Intervenir sur les briques S2P, P2P, CLM, SRM, ERP, TMS, WMS et analytics

IA & data appliquées
- Identifier les cas d'usage IA à plus forte valeur dans les processus achats et supply chain, et les qualifier économiquement
- Concevoir et prototyper des solutions d'IA générative et prédictive : copilotes métiers, agents d'analyse documentaire, génération de user stories, automatisation du reporting programme
- Industrialiser ces prototypes avec nos équipes Data & AI, de la preuve de valeur au déploiement à l'échelle
- Traiter les sujets de gouvernance, de qualité de données et de souveraineté (hébergement de confiance, conformité réglementaire) qui conditionnent l'adoption réelle
- Déployer les méthodes agiles et les solutions de data-visualisation qui rendent la performance lisible

Développement commercial
- Contribuer aux pitchs clients, réponses à appels d'offres et soutenances orales
- Participer à la construction de nos offres et de nos points de vue sectoriels
- Détecter et faire mûrir de nouvelles opportunités sur vos comptes

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Intégrer une culture IA au service de la transformation des leaders sectoriels
Grâce à des formations IA continues et un écosystème technologique de pointe, reposant sur une expertise métier reconnue.
Nourrir vos aspirations grâce à nos communautés
Evoluez dans notre réseau d’experts, local et international, propice au mentorat, au partage d’expertise et à l’apprentissage continu.
Evoluer dans un environnement de travail hybride et évolutif
Avec la possibilité de télétravailler selon votre projet et ajustée avec votre manager.
Vivre une expérience interne riche et stimulante
Participez aux évènements sportifs, aux actions solidaires via la Fondation Accenture, aux coachings thématiques et autres évènements dans nos locaux Profitez des initiatives portées par le CSE. CSE.

Votre profil

Vous détenez un Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université) et avez à minima 4 ans d'expérience en conseil ou en entreprise sur des sujets de transformation Supply Chain, Achats, excellence opérationnelle ou digitale.

Nous cherchons surtout :
- Une connaissance solide du monde industriel , idéalement Aerospace & Defense, et l'envie d'y construire une expertise reconnue
- Une appétence réelle pour l'IA et sa mise en œuvre concrète : vous avez déjà expérimenté, prototypé, ou vous brûlez de le faire
- De la rigueur analytique et la capacité à structurer un problème mal posé
- De l' aisance relationnelle : vous savez tenir une conversation avec un acheteur, un ingénieur et un directeur de programme dans la même journée
- La maîtrise des solutions digitales de l'écosystème achats / supply chain
- Français courant et anglais professionnel (environnement client bilingue)

A propos de nous :
Accenture, c'est une communauté de plus de 750 000 talents et une mission commune : réaliser la promesse technologique alliée à l’ingéniosité humaine.
Dans un monde en perpétuel changement, nous accélérons la transformation des plus grandes entreprises, de la stratégie à la réalisation des projets, grâce à la technologie, la data et l’IA et nous créons de la valeur pour nos clients et pour nos collaborateurs grâce à notre expertise multi-sectorielle.

jobs.title: Digital Risk & Compliance Consultant
jobs.description:
In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa al cuore del cambiamento, lavorando con le aziende più importanti a livello mondiale per trasformare interi settori di mercato. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

Entra a far parte del Reinvention Partner di Industry & Enterprise in ambito Risk&Compliance . Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, collaborando alla realizzazione di grandi programmi di trasformazione digitale delle funzioni di Risk & Controls. In particolare, potrai:
- Contribuire alla trasformazione della funzione AML / AFC, supportando l’evoluzione del modello operativo end‑to‑end, dalla definizione di strategia e governance fino al ridisegno dei processi core (KYC, CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, fraud e sanctions). Lavorerai sul superamento di approcci frammentati attraverso l’integrazione dei presidi, il rafforzamento della collaborazione tra funzioni, migliorando l’efficacia complessiva della funzione in contesti ad elevata complessità regolamentare e operativa.

- Supportare l’evoluzione del Sistema dei Controlli Interni, analizzando e ridisegnando processi aziendali per identificare rischi e controlli chiave, razionalizzare il control framework e rafforzarne la governance. Le attività includeranno process mapping, disegno e testing dei controlli, monitoraggio e reporting a supporto delle funzioni di controllo e del management.

- Partecipare alla progettazione e all’ottimizzazione dei processi di Digital Compliance & GRC, lungo l’intero ciclo di vita (policy, requisiti regolamentari, risk assessment, issue management e reporting), contribuendo a rendere i presidi di compliance più integrati, strutturati e tracciabili, abilitando modelli operativi più solidi e scalabili.

- Contribuire ai programmi di Digital Transformation, attraverso l’utilizzo di data, AI e GenAI applicati in modo trasversale ai processi di risk, compliance e controllo, supportando l’analisi documentale e regolamentare, il miglioramento delle attività di assessment e monitoring, la gestione delle evidenze e la produzione di insight a supporto delle decisioni.

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B3 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico. La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 36.906,87€ e 46.700€.

Se condividi la nostra passione per la consulenza in ambito Risk & Compliance e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
- Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ambito AML / Financial Crime, controlli interni, compliance o GRC, con esposizione a processi complessi e ad elevati requisiti di governance.

- Capacità di lavorare su processi end‑to‑end, comprendendone logiche operative, flussi informativi e interazioni tra funzioni.

- Familiarità con tematiche di KYC, CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, fraud, sanctions, sistemi di controllo interno o processi di compliance regolamentare.

- Interesse concreto verso la trasformazione digitale delle funzioni di controllo, inclusi redesign dei processi, automazione e utilizzo di soluzioni digitali.

- Attitudine analitica e strutturata, con capacità di tradurre requisiti normativi e di governance in modelli operativi sostenibili e applicabili.

- Buone capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, per interagire con stakeholder di business e funzioni di controllo.
