jobs.title: Security Transformation Consultant (regular/senior) (She/He/They)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

The Cyber Security team, part of Accenture Security, supports organizations in building secure, resilient, and scalable security capabilities across complex enterprise technology landscapes — integrating security into software development, cloud adoption, digital transformation, and technology modernization so that security by design and security by default are reflected in how systems are actually built and operated, not only in policy.

We act as trusted advisors to some of the world's leading organizations, helping them define pragmatic security operating models, improve security maturity, and align cybersecurity capabilities with their business and technology objectives . Working at the forefront of the industry means constant exposure to complex, high-stakes security challenges and the latest technologies — across banking, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, and public sector, each with its own regulatory context and technical scale.

As part of a global security leader, you work on engagements that span the full breadth of modern enterprise security — from securing AI-enabled systems and cloud-native architectures to embedding security into large-scale digital transformation programmed. The variety of clients, industries, and technology stacks .

THE WORK:

- Lead and support security maturity assessments across applications, software delivery processes, infrastructure and enterprise environments, and define pragmatic transformation roadmaps.

- Design and improve Secure SDLC operating models, security governance frameworks and assurance processes for clients across industries.

- Advise clients on security-by-design and shift-left security practices, translating principles into actionable requirements across development, platform and engineering teams — and directly supporting those teams where needed.

- Conduct security architecture reviews for end-to-end solutions spanning legacy, hybrid, cloud-native and modern application environments, including platforms on AWS, Azure or GCP.

- Facilitate threat modeling and risk assessment activities for complex applications, distributed architectures and enterprise transformation programs.

- Assess security implications of application modernization, cloud transformation and technology migration initiatives, including challenges specific to on-premises and hybrid environments.

- Define security requirements, assurance processes and governance mechanisms for applications, platforms and enterprise environments, referencing frameworks such as OWASP ASVS, MITRE ATT&CK and relevant industry standards.

- Support development of software supply chain security capabilities, vulnerability management programs and secure engineering practices.

- Establish security metrics, reporting models and continuous improvement mechanisms to drive measurable progress in client security posture.

- Lead workshops with technical, operational, business and senior stakeholders, translating complex security risks into clear recommendations for decision makers.

- Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing guidance on secure design principles, emerging security trends and practical risk-based decision making.

Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances.

With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Work on   international   cybersecurity transformation   program   for some of the world's leading   organizations   — on network security challenges that go far beyond routine operations, into architecture, strategy, and large-scale   modernization .

- Breadth you cannot get in-house. In a single year you see how   organizations   across banking, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, and public sector approach the same   network   security and Zero Trust challenges — and where   they fail. That range, across cloud security, identity, application security, and network transformation, takes far longer to accumulate on a single internal team.

- The opportunity to move beyond network operations .   If you have a strong network security foundation and want to develop into cloud security, Zero Trust architecture, AI security, or security consulting, this role is built for that transition.

- Room to set direction and grow as a trusted advisor. On most engagements you are the person defining what a modern, secure network architecture looks like for a client — leading discussions with architects, platform teams, and senior stakeholders, not   maintaining   someone else's rule set.

- Collaborate with a diverse team of over 150 cybersecurity experts in Poland and thousands across the globe, in an environment focused on innovation, continuous learning, and practical business outcomes.

- A wide catalogue of development opportunities: technical,   soft-skills , and language training, e-learning platforms, GenAI training, and security certifications — open to everyone who wants to grow.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

We are looking for someone who can navigate complex security landscapes end-to-end — a broad perspective and the ability to translate security into business outcomes matter as much as technical depth.

- Several years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, application security, security architecture, DevSecOps , security governance, or a related discipline.

- Basic understanding of Secure SDLC concepts, with the ability to design or improve security processes, governance frameworks, and operating models across software delivery.

- Experience leading or supporting security maturity assessments and translating findings into actionable transformation roadmaps for both technical and business stakeholders.

- Good working knowledge of application security principles, with practical application of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP ASVS in security assessments, architecture reviews, and secure design guidance.

- Hands-on familiarity with at least one cloud platform — AWS, Azure, or GCP — sufficient to assess architecture decisions, identify security gaps, and advise on secure design across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

- Experience facilitating threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and risk assessments for complex applications and distributed enterprise environments.

- Ability to define practical and scalable security requirements, assurance processes, and governance mechanisms across development, platform, and enterprise environments.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable engaging with development and platform teams on day-to-day security topics, as well as leading workshops and presenting to senior audiences.

- Good proficiency in both Polish and English (minimum B2 level), as projects are delivered for clients in Poland and internationally.

- Leadership mindset with the ability to drive security initiatives and build trusted relationships with clients and cross-functional teams.

Seniority levels

Regular ( approximately 3 –5 years of relevant experience). Candidates at this level are expected to deliver defined workstreams — conducting network security assessments, supporting Zero Trust and cloud architecture reviews, and communicating findings to client technical teams. A solid network security foundation is expected, with active development toward cloud security, Zero Trust, and security advisory capabilities.

Senior (approximately 5+ years of relevant experience). Candidates at this level are expected to lead workstreams, provide technical direction, and mentor junior colleagues. This requires demonstrated depth in network security architecture, combined with real breadth across at least one adjacent domain — cloud security, Zero Trust, identity, or application security — and the standing to present and defend a position to senior client stakeholders up to CISO level.

If you are moving across from development, platform engineering, or an in-house security role, tell us what you have built and we will work out where you fit. That conversation happens in the interview, not in the CV screen.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

- Experience in enterprise security transformation programs or security operating model design.

- Practical knowledge of DevSecOps tooling and security integration within modern software delivery pipelines.

- Experience with AI governance, AI risk management or securing AI-enabled applications and services.

- Industry-recognized certifications in cybersecurity or cloud security.

- Experience working across multiple industries or in large-scale, complex enterprise environments.

jobs.title: I&P-GN-SC&E-Consultant- VCR - Digital Thread
jobs.description:
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .

Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
- Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.

- Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.

- Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain.

Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
- Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.

- Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.

- Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
- Strong analytical skills to reach clear-cut, methodical solutions

- Experience working with low-code/no-code or agentic orchestration platforms

- Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver clients delight

- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

- Storytelling with data and communicating AI/automation impact to non-technical stakeholders

- Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

- Ability to lead cross-functional pods integrating data scientists, process analysts, and automation engineers

- Strong team-management skills

Your experience counts!
- MBA from Tier 1 B-school

- 3-6 years of Hands-on experience developing digital twin or simulation-based prototypes to model physical products, assets, operations or supply networks, enabling scenario analysis, disruption testing and performance optimization

- Experience working on process improvement, operating model transformation, supply chain planning, manufacturing, logistics, engineering, digital transformation, data, analytics, GenAI or AI-enabled business transformation program

- Certified expertise as functional value architect for process discovery and mining tools like Celonis, Signavio, Power automate process mining

- Experience conceptualizing and deploying agentic or AI-assisted workflows for process optimization

- Experience working with GenAI, LLMs and agentic AI solutions, including prompt engineering, model orchestration, AI copilots, multi-agent workflows and LLM-based insight generation

- Exposure to Digital Thread, Digital Twin, Connected Twin, control tower, supply network visibility, simulation, IoT-enabled operations, product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, scenario planning, network modelling or supply chain decision intelligence programs is preferred

- Industry domain experience is desirable in industries like Manufacturing, Consumer Goods & Retail, Life Sciences, Telecom, BFSI, Oil & Gas, Energy & Utilities, or High-Tech industries

- Experience developing client-ready presentations, process maps, business cases and use-case documents, with a strong understanding of responsible AI/GenAI governance and the ability to communicate complex concepts effectively across business and technology stakeholders

jobs.title: I&P-GN-SC&E-Consultant- VCR - Digital Thread
jobs.description:
Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech, and leading companies across industries.
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network I Areas of Work: Digital Thread and Connected Twins | Level: Analyst / Consultant | Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata | Overall Relevant Exp: 2-5 years
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .

Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
- Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.

- Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.

- Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain.

Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
- Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.

- Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.

- Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
- Strong analytical skills to reach clear-cut, methodical solutions

- Experience working with low-code/no-code or agentic orchestration platforms

- Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver clients delight

- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

- Storytelling with data and communicating AI/automation impact to non-technical stakeholders

- Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

- Ability to lead cross-functional pods integrating data scientists, process analysts, and automation engineers

- Strong team-management skills

Your experience counts!
- MBA from Tier 1 B-school

- 3-6 years of Hands-on experience developing digital twin or simulation-based prototypes to model physical products, assets, operations or supply networks, enabling scenario analysis, disruption testing and performance optimization

- Experience working on process improvement, operating model transformation, supply chain planning, manufacturing, logistics, engineering, digital transformation, data, analytics, GenAI or AI-enabled business transformation program

- Certified expertise as functional value architect for process discovery and mining tools like Celonis, Signavio, Power automate process mining

- Experience conceptualizing and deploying agentic or AI-assisted workflows for process optimization

- Experience working with GenAI, LLMs and agentic AI solutions, including prompt engineering, model orchestration, AI copilots, multi-agent workflows and LLM-based insight generation

- Exposure to Digital Thread, Digital Twin, Connected Twin, control tower, supply network visibility, simulation, IoT-enabled operations, product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, scenario planning, network modelling or supply chain decision intelligence programs is preferred

- Industry domain experience is desirable in industries like Manufacturing, Consumer Goods & Retail, Life Sciences, Telecom, BFSI, Oil & Gas, Energy & Utilities, or High-Tech industries

- Experience developing client-ready presentations, process maps, business cases and use-case documents, with a strong understanding of responsible AI/GenAI governance and the ability to communicate complex concepts effectively across business and technology stakeholders

jobs.title: Management Consultant (S&C GN Talent & Organization - Intelligence and Insights Platform Automation Engineer)
jobs.description:
Looking for a rewarding career with global impact?   Then consider Accenture’s rapidly expanding Global Network with approximately 9,000 Management Consulting and Strategy professionals (we like to call them rock stars!) based in a network of prominent locations around the world.
Global Network Professionals:
- Thrive in a fast-paced, inclusive environment with countless opportunities to learn and grow

- Collaborate with diverse organizations on groundbreaking projects

- Enjoy the camaraderie of working together towards a common goal and forming lasting friendships

If this sounds like the right team for you, we invite you to read on.

Key Responsibilities:
Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as Intelligence and Insights Platform Automation Engineer in our Talent & Organization (T&O) practice, a typical day might include: This role operates at the intersection of Data Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Platform Engineering, and Responsible AI governance, and goes beyond pure LLM feature development.
- Fetching secondary data & research information from various sources and analyzing it to better understand organization related metrics
- Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis

- Build out data mockups to test the prescriptive analytics hypothesis

- Working knowledge on development, deployment and prototyping platform & insight solutions to improve the product landscape

- Working with cloud platforms and services for GenAI development, such as Azure for using OpenAI models

- Design LLM orchestration workflows using Azure OpenAI with strict prompts, structured outputs, agent chaining, and cost control.

- Implement vector retrieval and grounding using vector DB to support LLM-based insights.

- Hands on experience with Machine Learning Algorithm, supervised and unsupervised modelling, classification, regression and NLP techniques such as sentiment analysis and entity detection

- Run numeric simulations leveraging statistic techniques such as self-organizing maps, boosting methods, support vector machines neural network etc.

- Perform custom analytics to deliver insight to clients and present results to non-technical stakeholders in a clear manner

- Understand framework design organizational concepts and linking analytics results with Behavioral Science or Industrial and Organizational Psychology related concepts

- Contribute to innovation and new product development in the people and organization analytics space

Job Qualifications :
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computational Science, Statistics, Operational Research, or similar field.

- Self-learners with conceptual clarity with fundamentals of statistics

- 3 to 5 years of experience in business data analysis and research related to Computational Science/ Data Engineering/ Statistical Model Development

- Data fluency and working knowledge of using LLMs and machine learning models

- Experience with Azure-based Data and AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure Translator, and Cosmos DB, including rate limits, retries, and cost awareness.

- Exposure to data engineering & hands-on experience with APIs. Writing SQL query would be an add on

- Design and operate multi-stage, idempotent analytics pipelines for multilingual organizational data.

- Perform advanced data wrangling and quality control using Python (pandas), including encoding normalization, deduplication, deterministic batching, and chunking/reassembly with provenance tracking.

- Generally curious & has a knack for solving ambiguous problems. Is able to think critically & out-of-the box.

- Fluency in English and ability to perform in a non-structured and dynamic environment

Your Winning Qualities:
- Natural leader; easily establishes relationships with clients and colleagues

- Team Player; enjoys the intellectual stimulation of collaborating with colleagues around the world

- Determined; appreciates a challenge and overcoming obstacles to achieve results

- Digitally savvy; continuous learner

Our Commitment to You – You will enjoy:
- A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression

- A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning

- A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do

- A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities

jobs.title: Data & AI Technology Sales Director
jobs.description:
We Are:
The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.

With over 77,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture’s Data & AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem.

You are:
A growth focused sales professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.  You know – and have run all phases of a sales cycle, including qualification, sales pursuit and close by applying deep sales process and technical expertise. You develop relationships with key buyers and decision-makers at new and existing clients by utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest cloud-based technologies.

As a Sales capture, you will originate new sales opportunities unrelated to extensions or renewals in a complex environment, typically cross service-group. Lead early-stage positioning with clients and develop and execute the origination strategy to identify and qualify specific opportunities. Continue working with the sales team to ensure closure of sales. May focus on a single large account, leveraging deep content knowledge and client relationships to originate and close opportunities at that client.

The work:
- Create solutions to complex technology business problems/opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs.

- Interacts with senior management levels at clients and within Accenture, determines pursuit strategies, develops client messaging plans and relationships, and applies industry-leading Snowflake or Databricks transformation strategies and practices.

- Has latitude in decision-making and determining objectives and approaches to critical assignments.

- Operates within large teams and directs specific team sales activities.

- Ability to mobilize the Ecosystem partners ( AWS , MS , SAP etc ) for driving larger Mega deals – driving business outcomes tied to RPO ( remaining performance obligations) of the ecosystem.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

What you need:

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in selling data solutions, analytical data warehouses, cloud data migration solutions, analytics/reporting solutions to harness the power of AI and GenAI for our clients.
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in selling Snowflake and/or Databricks platforms.
- Minimum of 5 years previous experience of selling into any of these industries is required; Financial Services, Communications/Media/Technology, Products (Consumer, Retails, Industrial), Public Sector, Resources (Utilities, Oil & Gas, Energy)
- Minimum of 8 years’ Sales Pursuit Management experience.
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience in direct sales, preferably with quota of $10M+
- Proven ability to manage the entire sales cycle (customer identification, outreach, proposal creation, contract negotiations, closing, metrics reporting)
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate’s degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus points if you have:
- Thought leadership in data migration, modernization and managed services, building new data architectures (Mesh/Fabric), data products and marketplaces, cloud data & analytics platforms and use cases, AI and Gen AI foundation model services.
- Experience working within G2000 customers.
- Experience with C-Level client relationship building and relationship management.
- Proven ability to operate within a team-oriented environment.
- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting; either military or civilian.
- High energy level, focus and ability to work well in demanding client environments.
- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
- Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision-making abilities.
- Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility and character.
- Strong Ecosystem selling experience with AI led Data engineering transformational programs.

What’s in it for you?
- You will be part of a diverse, vibrant, global Accenture community; teams pushing the boundaries of new business capabilities and emerging technologies and services, sharing their experiences and lessons learned with each other.  You’ll have the chance to thrive in an environment where your ideas are valued and your voice matters.
- At Accenture, you will be able to work on meaningful and innovative projects, powered by the latest technologies and industry best practices such as event-driven architectures and domain driven design.
- Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll learn from and work with Accenture’s certified practitioners and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack, sales skills, and certifications.
- You'll be immersed in the design and implementation of human-centric solutions to help solve complex challenges with some of the world’s largest companies.

In addition to base pay, this Sales role is eligible for additional incentive compensation which is based on achievement toward individual sales metrics, subject to Plan terms

jobs.title: SAP Utilities Sales Director (all genders)
jobs.description:
Drive the growth of a leading SAP Utilities platform and shape digital energy solutions. Lead strategic sales and expand the market across Germany and Europe.

Your Mission
You lead the commercial success of a flagship SAP Utilities platform — driving go-to-market strategy and personally originating complex, multi-million euro sales opportunities across Germany and CEE. This is a hybrid role: part GTM architect, part hands-on deal originator. You will shape the commercial framework the wider sales team operates within, and personally lead strategic pursuits as the platform expands.
You will work closely with the Product Manager and pre-sales function to define licensing models, modularisation entry points, and a repeatable GTM motion — building the commercial infrastructure of a scaling platform inside a firm with genuine assets, client relationships, and brand behind it.

At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.

What you can expect
- Define the commercial model.
Develop and own the licensing framework across on-premise, SaaS/multi-tenant, and SI-led models; set pricing principles and guardrails so the sales team can operate consistently

- Build the GTM architecture.
Define the Ideal Customer Profile across Germany and CEE, shape the modularization strategy with the Product Manager, and map the competitive landscape

- Lead high-value sales pursuits.
Personally originate and close complex deals, typically exceeding €10M in contract value, including EU public procurement and tender processes

- Expand and leverage your network.
Build pipeline from Accenture's existing client base and net-new targets; use your utility industry network and presence at E-world, BDEW, SAP for Utilities, and CEE industry forums

- Define the CEE entry strategy.
Identify priority markets, assess partner vs. direct models, and lead the first pursuits in the region

- Professionalize the commercial motion.
Systematise what is currently deal-by-deal selling: qualification criteria, proposal standards, pricing governance, and pipeline forecasting

- Feed market intelligence back into the product.
Translate prospect objections, competitor moves, and lost deal analysis into structured input for the Product Manager and Product Owner

What we are looking forward to
- 10+ years in enterprise software or platform sales - with
a demonstrable track record closing complex deals in the utility or energy sector

- Deep functional knowledge of SAP IS-U or SAP S/4HANA Utilities - sufficient to be credible with a utility CIO or Head of Billing from day one

- An active, senior network in DACH utility procurement, IT leadership, or transformation decision-making

- Experience selling both on-premise and SaaS/managed service models - and a genuine understanding of the commercial and contractual differences between them

- Comfortable operating at CIO, functional VP, or programme director level - whether selling to that audience or having been that audience

- Able to build commercial structure from scratch — not just operate within an existing playbook

- Fluent in German and English - additional CEE language capability is a plus

Candidates who will stand out have done one or more of the following: personally built or materially shaped a SaaS recurring revenue model for an enterprise software product; worked across Germany and at least one CEE market; or have past professional experience at SAP AG, a SAP Value Added Reseller, or in a utility CIO/programme director capacity.

What we offer you
- A senior role with direct ownership of commercial strategy and platform growth — with Accenture's client relationships, brand, and delivery capability behind you

- Competitive compensation benchmarked to ISV and product-company norms, including performance-based incentives

- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

- Access to Accenture's executive network and global career development infrastructure

- Comprehensive benefits including pension, wellbeing programmes, and learning platforms

The Accenture culture: This is where YOU make the difference
Your skills, your character, and your ambitions make you unique. And when a wide variety of talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something great emerges: ideas that make a difference in the world. That is why, at Accenture, we believe in diversity and the freedom to develop. Create a work environment in which you thrive. With tasks that matter to you. With a workload that suits you. And with a way of working that aligns with your goals. How you network, continue learning, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We help you shape it the way you imagine it.

Contact Us
Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com.

We look forward to your application.

jobs.title: Sales Executive, Azure Consulting Services
jobs.description:
We are:
A leading partner to the world’s major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. The formation of Accenture Cloud First, with a $3 billion investment over three years, demonstrates our commitment to deliver greater value to our clients when they need it most and offers huge growth opportunities for you! Our Cloud First group of more than 70,000 cloud professionals delivers a full stack of integrated cloud capabilities across data, edge, integrated infrastructure and applications, deep ecosystem skills, culture of change along with a deep industry expertise to shape, move, build and operate our clients’ businesses in the cloud. To accelerate our customers' transformation leveraging cloud, we combine world-class learning and talent development expertise; deep experience in cloud change management; and cloud-ready operating models with a commitment to responsible business by design — with security, data privacy, responsible use of artificial intelligence, sustainability, and ethics and compliance built into the fundamental changes Accenture helps companies achieve.

You are:
As the Accenture Microsoft Business Group (“AMBG”) Technology Account Sales Capture, you are a growth-focused sales professional who has successfully created positive impact by identifying client problems and using Microsoft Azure technologies to solve them. You are an experienced business development professional with expertise in all phases of the sales cycle, including account development, opportunity identification, relationship development, and qualification by applying strategic sales processes and technical expertise. You are deeply familiar with Azure’s offerings and stay up to date on their latest product developments. You are also intimately aware of client challenges in the Retail, Financial Services, and Insurance sectors. Using the combination of your knowledge of Azure suite of tools and your understanding of client challenges, you will focus on origination of Cloud First opportunities with AMBG offerings. You will drive business development and lead with the value of Azure + Accenture for our clients.

You will develop primary relationships with key Accenture and Microsoft account personnel, most significantly client account leads (CALs and Account Executives), to identify and qualify opportunities to solve client pain points and growth objectives leveraging the latest Azure cloud-based technologies and accelerators. Additionally, you will support account personnel in building relationships with key buyers by bringing business and technical expertise to business development conversations throughout the qualification and deal progression phases. You are integrated as one Accenture with Technology, Strategy & Consulting, and Cloud First Market Unit leaders to ensure the best of One Accenture is brought to our clients.

Your focus on the Azure partnership is a key objective, ensuring that the relationships with the Partner Development Manager are nurtured and a culture of trust is established. You will also grow and maintain account-level relationships with the Azure Cloud Consulting lead, Customer Engineer, Account Executive, and other team members, ensuring that we are showing up as a single, integrated team to our clients.

The responsibilities for the Primary Sales Capture Lead (PSCL) within Accenture's sales process include:
- Client-centric approach:  Building and maintaining strong client relationships is crucial for winning deals and driving success.

- Deal qualification:  Assessing whether a deal is winnable and desirable through early and consistent qualification efforts.

- Proposal management:  Developing and managing proposals effectively, regardless of opportunity size, while managing available Business Development funds efficiently.

- Sales process compliance:  Adhering to internal sales and approval processes to ensure the pursuit of suitable deals with the right cost structures.

- Post-proposal resources:  Utilizing resources to support activities after proposal submission, including client clarifications and negotiations.

- Training resources:  Leveraging training resources and assets to build trust-based relationships and effective sales strategies.

- Understanding client needs:  Gaining insights into client needs and ensuring accurate opportunity data for informed decision-making.

- Closing strategies:  Applying structured approaches to closing deals, including managing the close plan and ensuring compliance with pricing policies.

- Identifying complex technology business problems/opportunities:  Requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs and Accenture + Azure solutions.

- Creating differentiated opportunities:  Based on Azure Cloud offerings and joint go-to-market plays developed through the Accenture Microsoft Business Group (AMBG).

- Interacting with senior management levels:  At clients, within Accenture, and Azure to develop, align, and execute pursuit strategies, develop client contact plans and relationship maps, and apply industry-leading AMBG transformation and operations strategies and practices.

- Finding and developing new opportunities:  Proactively through client account leads and direct client contact.

- Progressing new opportunities:  Rapidly qualifying and advancing deals to a Priced Proposal.

- Client-facing responsibilities:  Being able to travel as required to meet client needs and drive success.

What’s in it for you?
- You will be part of a diverse, vibrant, global Accenture community; teams pushing the boundaries of new business capabilities and emerging technologies and services, sharing experiences and lessons learned with each other. You’ll have the chance to thrive in an environment where your ideas are valued and your voice matters.

- At Accenture, you will be able to work on meaningful and innovative projects, powered by the latest technologies and industry trends.

- Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll learn from and work with Accenture’s certified practitioners, and Accenture will support you in growing your own sales skills and certifications.

- You'll be closely connected to delivery teams implementing human-centric solutions to help solve complex challenges with some of the world’s largest companies.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum of 5 years of Business Development in the professional services space.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience selling services on the Azure platform

- Minimum of 8 years’ Successful Sales Pursuit Management experience.

- Minimum of 8 years Originating and Shaping complex deals for a major consulting and/or professional services organization

- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in direct sales with a quota of up to $20M+ and achieved or exceeded plan.

- Channel and Ecosystem partner management experience and ways of working.

- Bachelor’s degree or completion of a college program in a related discipline.

- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US, and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

Bonus points if you have:
- Previous experience in conceptualizing, planning, and implementing cloud migration, modernization, cloud-native development, or cloud-managed services.

- Experience working within industry with our customers.

- Experience with C-Level client relationship building and relationship management.

- Proven ability to operate within a team-oriented environment.

- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork, and collaboration in a professional setting; either military or civilian.

- Ability to discuss cloud modernization, data and analytics (including generative AI), and operations “on the fly” with VP+ clients and working-level technical resources.

- Previous experience working with Azure Cloud products.

- High energy level, focus, and ability to work well in demanding client environments.

- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.

- Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

- Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility, and character.

A growth focused sales professional who has successfully created consistent and positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.  You have run all phases of a large deal sales cycle, including opportunity origination, qualification, sales pursuit and close by applying deep sales process and technical expertise.
You develop relationships with key buyers and decision-makers at new and existing clients, using a combination of Payments Industry-led solutions.  And you’ll partner with other parts of Accenture to craft Cloud, Data and AI solutions as a foundation to deliver all of our services.
As a Sales Capture Senior Manager you will originate, shape, sell and close large deals that are single or multi-service and which are valuable to our clients and profitable to Accenture.

Create solutions to address complex technology business problems/opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs. Interacts with senior client stakeholders and Accenture peers and leadership to shape and drive strategic pursuits. Defines pursuit strategies, develops compelling client messaging, and builds trusted executive relationships. Brings differentiated, industry leading perspectives leveraging AI-enabled capabilities across technology strategy, data and AI, application development and management, and infrastructure services. Demonstrates strong proficiency in cloud (AWS) and AI platforms (such as Anthropic, OpenAI and others) to shape and deliver scalable, business driven solutions. Has latitude in decision-making and determining objectives and approaches to critical opportunities. Operates within large teams and directs specific team sales activities. Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 25 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need:
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in selling Banking & Capital opportunities

- Minimum of 8 years of sales experience.

- Minimum of 5 years of sales experience with quota preferably in excess of $15M+

- Minimum of 5 years of sales experience selling financial services opportunities

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in Cloud (AWS), demonstrating strong proficiency

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in AI Platforms (such as Anthropic, Open AI, etc.), demonstrating strong proficiency

- Strong financial acumen and complex deal shaping experience.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience.

Bonus Points if you have:
- Experience working with G500 customers.

- Experience with C-Level client relationship building and relationship management.

- Proven ability to operate within a highly-matrixed, team-oriented environment.

- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting; either military or civilian.

- High energy level, focus and ability to work well in demanding client environments.

- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.

- Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision-making abilities.

- Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility, and character.

You will be part of a diverse, vibrant, global Accenture community; pushing the boundaries of new business capabilities and emerging technologies and services, sharing their experiences and lessons learned with each other.  You’ll have the chance to thrive in an environment where your ideas are valued and your voice matters. jobs.title: Sales Senior Manager- Products Industry
jobs.description:
Accenture, reconocida como Great Place To Work®, una compañía líder mundial en servicios profesionales que ayuda a las principales empresas, administraciones públicas y otras organizaciones del mundo a desarrollar su core digital, optimizar sus operaciones, acelerar el crecimiento de sus ingresos y mejorar los servicios para los ciudadanos, creando valor tangible a velocidad y escala.

¿Te gustaría formar parte de un equipo enfocado en generar crecimiento y abrir nuevas oportunidades de negocio? Buscamos un perfil claramente orientado a la captación de clientes, la construcción de relaciones ejecutivas y el desarrollo de oportunidades comerciales dentro del sector Products.
Esta posición tendrá un papel clave en la expansión del negocio en el area de Mid Market, identificando nuevas cuentas, desarrollando oportunidades y convirtiendo relaciones comerciales en crecimiento sostenible para Accenture

Buscamos un profesional con experiencia relevante que permita para impulsar el crecimiento de nuestra práctica de Products en España. Esta posición estará enfocada en la generación de nueva demanda, apertura de clientes, desarrollo de relaciones ejecutivas y gestión de oportunidades comerciales desde la identificación inicial hasta el cierre.

Dentro del sector de Products, se valorara la experiencia en : Non- Food, Automocion, Farma, Contrucción , sector agricola y Servicios Generales .

El profesional seleccionado dedicará la mayor parte de su tiempo a la actividad comercial directa, identificando oportunidades de transformación y colaborando con equipos internos para convertirlas en negocio.

Funciones

- Identificar, desarrollar y abrir nuevas cuentas dentro del sector Products, generando oportunidades de negocio de forma continua.
- Construir relaciones con directivos y responsables de negocio para posicionar las capacidades de Accenture y detectar necesidades de transformación.
- Liderar actividades de sales capture, incluyendo cualificación de oportunidades, definición de estrategia comercial y coordinación de propuestas.
- Colaborar con Client Account Leads, líderes de industria y equipos de Reinvention Services para acelerar la conversión de oportunidades en ventas.

Responsabilidades

- Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de crecimiento comercial en cuentas nuevas y existentes del sector Products.
- Gestionar el ciclo completo de venta consultiva, desde la prospección hasta el cierre de contratos.
- Mantener una actividad comercial constante mediante reuniones con clientes, networking ejecutivo, eventos sectoriales y generación de pipeline.
- Coordinar equipos multidisciplinares para construir propuestas de valor competitivas y diferenciadas.
- Garantizar la correcta gestión del pipeline comercial, forecasting y gobierno de oportunidades.
- Identificar tendencias de mercado, retos sectoriales y oportunidades de crecimiento para impulsar nuevas iniciativas comerciales.
- Establecer relaciones de confianza con decisores de negocio y ejecutivos de nivel

Requisitos imprescindibles

- Mínimo 10 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de negocio, ventas consultivas, captura de oportunidades o funciones comerciales similares.
- Mínimo 5 años de experiencia vendiendo servicios de consultoría, tecnología o transformación digital.
- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia generando negocio de forma directa mediante apertura de nuevos clientes.
- Experiencia gestionando ciclos completos de venta y oportunidades complejas de múltiples millones de euros.
- Experiencia coordinando propuestas comerciales y procesos de pursuit management.
- Nivel de inglés C1.
- Grado en Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Economía, Ingeniería o titulaciones afines.
- Experiencia previa en el sector Products en especifico en alguna de las siguientes: Non- Food, Automocion, Farma, Contrucción , sector agricola y Servicios Generales

Requisitos valorables

- Experiencia trabajando en compañías de consultoría estratégica, tecnológica o servicios profesionales.
- Experiencia en venta de programas de transformación digital, IA, cloud, data o ciberseguridad.
- Experiencia desarrollando relaciones con ejecutivos de nivel C-Level.
- Participación en procesos internacionales de venta y coordinación de oportunidades en varios mercados.
- Certificaciones en metodologías comerciales, gestión de cuentas o ventas consultivas.

Se requiere conocimientos y experiencia en el uso de inteligencia artificial generativa y herramientas de IA aplicadas al puesto de trabajo, en línea con la apuesta de Accenture por un uso responsable y efectivo de la IA.

Beneficios y compensaciones
En Accenture, compañía reconocida como Great Place To Work®, apostamos por un modelo híbrido de trabajo que, gracias a la tecnología y a nuestras instalaciones, nos permiten mantener la conexión humana esencial para trabajar con nuestros equipos y clientes. Una conexión que nos permite mantener nuestra cultura de inclusión y diversidad y ser, según Refinitiv, la empresa más diversa del mundo.

- Seguro médico, de Vida y accidentes
- Servicio médico y programas de bienestar
- Programa de retribución flexible y compra de acciones

jobs.description:
About Accenture:

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

We Are:

The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.

With over 77,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture’s Data & AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem.

You are:

A growth focused sales professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.  You know – and have run all phases of a sales cycle, including qualification, sales pursuit and close by applying deep sales process and technical expertise. You develop relationships with key buyers and decision-makers at new and existing clients by utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest cloud-based technologies.

As a Sales capture, you will originate new sales opportunities unrelated to extensions or renewals in a complex environment, typically cross service-group. Lead early-stage positioning with clients and develop and execute the origination strategy to identify and qualify specific opportunities. Continue working with the sales team to ensure closure of sales. May focus on a single large account, leveraging deep content knowledge and client relationships to originate and close opportunities at that client.

- Interacts with senior management levels at clients and within Accenture, determines pursuit strategies, develops client messaging plans and relationships, and applies industry-leading Snowflake or Databricks transformation strategies and practices.
- Has latitude in decision-making and determining objectives and approaches to critical assignments.
- Operates within large teams and directs specific team sales activities.
- Ability to mobilize the Ecosystem partners ( AWS , MS , SAP etc ) for driving larger Mega deals – driving business outcomes tied to RPO ( remaining performance obligations) of the ecosystem.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

What you need:
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in selling data solutions, analytical data warehouses, cloud data migration solutions, analytics/reporting solutions to harness the power of AI and GenAI for our clients.
- Minimum of 8 years’ Sales Pursuit Management experience.
- Minimum of 5 years previous experience of selling into any of these industries is required; Financial Services, Communications/Media/Technology, Products (Consumer, Retails, Industrial), Public Sector, Resources (Utilities, Oil & Gas, Energy)
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience in direct sales, preferably with quota of $10M+
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience managing the entire sales cycle (customer identification, outreach, proposal creation, contract negotiations, closing, metrics reporting)
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate’s degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus points if you have:
- Thought leadership in data migration, modernization and managed services, building new data architectures (Mesh/Fabric), data products and marketplaces, cloud data & analytics platforms and use cases, AI and Gen AI foundation model services.
- Experience working within G2000 customers.
- Experience with C-Level client relationship building and relationship management.
- Proven ability to operate within a team-oriented environment.
- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting; either military or civilian.
- High energy level, focus and ability to work well in demanding client environments.
- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
- Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision-making abilities.
- Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility and character.
- Strong Ecosystem selling experience with AI led Data engineering transformational programs.

What’s in it for you?
- You will be part of a diverse, vibrant, global Accenture community; teams pushing the boundaries of new business capabilities and emerging technologies and services, sharing their experiences and lessons learned with each other.  You’ll have the chance to thrive in an environment where your ideas are valued and your voice matters.
- At Accenture, you will be able to work on meaningful and innovative projects, powered by the latest technologies and industry best practices such as event-driven architectures and domain driven design.
- Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll learn from and work with Accenture’s certified practitioners and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack, sales skills, and certifications.
- You'll be immersed in the design and implementation of human-centric solutions to help solve complex challenges with some of the world’s largest companies.

En tant que Senior Technology Sales Manager , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la stratégie go-to-market d’Accenture sur les offres Cloud & Infrastructure. Vous piloterez des opportunités stratégiques depuis leur identification jusqu’à la signature des contrats, en combinant compréhension des enjeux clients, excellence commerciale et expertise technologique.
À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- Piloter des cycles de vente complexes autour des services Cloud et Infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, Cloud Hybride, transformation des datacenters, digital workplace et services managés), depuis l’identification des opportunités jusqu’à la négociation et la signature des contrats.
- Identifier, qualifier et conclure de nouvelles opportunités commerciales auprès de clients grands comptes et ETI.
- Interagir avec des décideurs de niveau C-Level afin d’adresser leurs enjeux stratégiques et positionner la technologie comme un levier de création de valeur.
- Collaborer avec les équipes delivery, avant-vente et architecture de solutions pour concevoir des propositions à forte valeur ajoutée.
- Coordonner les équipes impliquées dans les opportunités commerciales en travaillant étroitement avec les experts techniques, les équipes pricing, juridiques, delivery et account management.
- Construire les business cases, modèles tarifaires et structures financières permettant d’optimiser la valeur pour le client et la croissance d’Accenture.
- Assurer l’atteinte des objectifs de vente, le pilotage du pipeline commercial et les prévisions d’activité.
- Contribuer aux réponses aux appels d’offres (RFP/RFI) et aux grands programmes de transformation.
- Développer les ventes croisées autour des projets de migration Cloud, de modernisation, d’exploitation d’infrastructures et de services managés.
- Maintenir une veille active sur les tendances du marché et l’évolution des technologies Cloud et Infrastructure.

Pourquoi rejoindre ce poste ?
- Travailler sur des opportunités stratégiques à forte visibilité qui contribuent directement à la croissance d’Accenture.
- Être exposé(e) aux équipes de direction ainsi qu’aux décideurs de grands groupes.
- Évoluer au cœur des enjeux d’innovation, de stratégie commerciale et d’exécution des transformations technologiques.
- Accélérer votre évolution vers des postes de leadership commercial et de direction.

Votre profil
- Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans la vente de services technologiques, Cloud ou Infrastructure.
- Bonne maîtrise des environnements suivants : Cloud public (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) Architectures hybrides et multi-cloud Transformation des infrastructures et services managés Nouveaux modèles d’intelligence artificielle, tant sur les aspects opérationnels que financiers (GenAI et systèmes agentiques)
- Expérience avérée dans la conclusion de contrats complexes et la gestion de portefeuilles clients de plusieurs millions d’euros.
- Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires technologiques (hyperscalers, acteurs de la data et de l’IA, éditeurs de logiciels).
- Excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
- Esprit stratégique, résilience, curiosité et forte capacité d’exécution.
- Les certifications AWS, Azure ou GCP constituent un atout.
- Anglais courant indispensable ; toute autre langue sera appréciée.

Ce que nous vous offrons
- Un rôle stratégique avec un fort niveau d’autonomie et d’impact.
- L’accès à l’écosystème mondial d’Accenture, à son expertise et à ses capacités d’innovation.
- Des opportunités de formation continue, de certifications et d’exposition aux équipes dirigeantes.
- Un environnement de travail flexible favorisant à la fois la performance et l’équilibre professionnel.

jobs.description:
Who we are:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

About Accenture and the Physical AI Team
Accenture's Supply Chain & Engineering team helps clients transform how physical operations are designed, simulated, automated, operated and continuously improved. Our Physical AI portfolio spans strategy and operating model, digital twins and simulation, robotics intelligence and training, orchestration, industrial integration and managed operations across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and other asset-intensive environments.

The Work:
The Robotics Services Sales Senior Manager originates, shapes and closes robotics automation and robotics-services opportunities within Accenture's broader Physical AI portfolio. The role requires a working understanding of the full Physical AI transformation, from strategy and simulation through robotics intelligence, orchestration and managed operations, combined with deep specialization in robotics automation, autonomous systems, fleet operations and production deployment.

This leader may own standalone robotics pursuits or serve as the robotics-domain sales lead within broader Physical AI transformations. The role works with account teams, industry leaders, Physical AI solution architects, robotics architects and engineers, delivery teams, commercial teams and ecosystem partners to create technically credible, commercially sound and scalable client solutions.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute a robotics-services sales strategy across priority accounts and industries, aligned to the broader Physical AI portfolio and client transformation agenda.

- Build and manage a qualified pipeline across industrial robotics, collaborative robots, AMRs/AGVs, mobile manipulation, machine vision, robotic material handling, inspection, intralogistics and autonomous operations.

- Identify and qualify opportunities based on operational pain points such as labor constraints, throughput, cycle time, quality, safety, uptime, fleet utilization, material flow and cost per task or movement.

- Build trusted relationships with operations, manufacturing, engineering, automation, supply chain, warehouse, technology and executive stakeholders.

- Lead robotics pursuits from discovery and qualification through value case, solution shaping, ecosystem strategy, proposal, commercials, negotiation, contracting and delivery transition.

- Serve as the robotics and automation domain sales lead in broader Physical AI pursuits involving digital twins, simulation, AI training, orchestrators, industrial data, edge platforms and managed operations.

- Work with solution and technical architects to shape scalable robotics roadmaps covering pilot, production deployment, multi-site rollout, lifecycle support and operating model.

- Develop commercial constructs spanning consulting, systems integration, platform-enabled services, managed robotics operations, Robotics-as-a-Service and outcome-linked services.

- Ensure proposals address automation feasibility, site readiness, safety, IT/OT integration, partner and hardware responsibilities, business value, deployment risk and scale pathway

- Create executive presentations, workshop materials, proposals, demonstrations, case studies and reusable sales assets that connect robotics capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

- Develop joint go-to-market motions and co-sell opportunities with robotics OEMs, AMR and fleet providers, vision and sensing vendors, automation companies, NVIDIA, cloud and edge providers, and industrial software partners.

- Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecast accuracy, pursuit governance, win/loss learning and transition quality.

- Convert successful robotics engagements into repeatable offerings, credentials, reference patterns and scaled client programs.

Physical AI Breadth and Robotics Specialization
The role must understand how robotics services fit within an end-to-end Physical AI transformation while bringing deep robotics automation expertise.
Working understanding across Physical AI: Enterprise strategy and operating model; digital twins; discrete-event and physics-based simulation; synthetic data and robot training; robotics intelligence; orchestration; industrial data; edge/cloud platforms; managed operations and outcome-based services.
Deep specialization in robotics automation: Industrial robots, cobots, AMRs/AGVs, mobile manipulation, vision-guided automation, robot cells, controls integration, fleet operations, safety, commissioning, production support and multi-site scale.

Specialist role in broader pursuits: Translate the robotics portion of a Physical AI agenda into a value case, solution scope, partner model, commercial construct, deployment roadmap and scalable operating service.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here's what you need:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Business or a related field.
- 8+ years of experience across technology sales, robotics, automation consulting, industrial services, manufacturing solutions, warehouse automation or supply chain technology.
- At least 3 years of experience focused on robotics, automation, autonomous systems or advanced manufacturing services.
- Demonstrated record of originating and closing robotics, automation or industrial-technology services engagements with complex client stakeholders.
- Experience selling consulting, solutioning, integration, implementation or managed services rather than only robotics hardware.
- Working understanding of the Physical AI transformation lifecycle and the relationship among simulation, robot training, robotics deployment, orchestration and ongoing operations.
- Sufficient technical knowledge of industrial robots, AMRs/AGVs, cobots, machine vision, PLC integration, fleet management and production deployment to engage credibly with engineering and operations buyers.
- Experience leading cross-functional pursuits involving account, industry, technical, delivery, alliance, commercial, finance and legal stakeholders.
- Ability to connect robotics technology to measurable outcomes and communicate effectively with executive, operational and technical audiences.

Bonus Points If:
- Experience with robotics intelligence platforms, simulation-driven deployment, synthetic data, robot training or simulation-to-real workflows.
- Experience with unified operations platforms, multi-vendor fleet orchestration, robotics control towers or managed fleet operations.
- Experience scaling robotics from proof of value through production and multi-site rollout.
- Experience shaping Robotics-as-a-Service, outcome-based automation, fleet operations, managed support or platform-enabled service models.
- Familiarity with NVIDIA robotics and simulation technologies, cloud and edge platforms, robotics OEM ecosystems, AMR providers, fleet managers, machine-vision platforms and industrial automation vendors.
- Understanding of robot safety, OT cybersecurity, commissioning, acceptance testing, change management and operating support considerations that affect client buying decisions.
- Existing relationships with operations, engineering, manufacturing, warehouse, autonomy or supply chain leadership in priority industrial sectors.
- Experience with robotics deployment economics, commissioning effort, hardware dependencies, fleet support, and multi-site scaling economics.
- Experience at a consulting firm, systems integrator, robotics provider, automation company, industrial technology firm or related professional-services organization.
- Master's degree, MBA or relevant robotics, automation, manufacturing, supply chain or technology certification.

Measures of Success
•    Growth and progression of qualified robotics-services pipeline.
•    Robotics bookings, profitable revenue and conversion of pursuits to signed work.
•    Quality, credibility and deliverability of robotics solutions and commercial constructs.
•    Conversion of pilots into production deployments, multi-site programs and lifecycle services.
•    Contribution of robotics expertise to broader Physical AI pursuits and account expansion.
•    Growth of ecosystem-generated opportunities and repeatable robotics offerings.

- Guide enterprise clients through security operations transformation, platform consolidation, and cyber resilience programs.

- Contribute to the growth of Accenture's CrowdStrike offerings through thought leadership, innovation, and opportunity development.

- Deep expertise in the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including NG-SIEM, Exposure Management (CTEM), Identity Protection, Cloud Security, and AI-driven capabilities.

- Strong understanding of security operations, threat detection, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and enterprise cyber defense strategies.

- Proven ability to engage senior stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable security architectures and solutions.

- Broad knowledge of enterprise security ecosystems, including cloud platforms, identity infrastructure, hybrid environments, and vulnerability management technologies.

- Excellent communication, consulting, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts in business terms.

- CrowdStrike certifications such as CCFA, CCSE, or CrowdStrike Champions credentials.

- Experience delivering CrowdStrike NG-SIEM implementations, migrations, parser development, CQL, or LogScale administration.

- Background in managed security services, MSSP/MDR environments, or large-scale security operations programs.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Creating and maintaining client relationships

- Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, global environment.

- Ability to learn new and understand new tools/solutions.
- Identify new opportunities, develop solutions and own proposals end to end.
- Contribute to offering development skills to identify areas of growth related to specific skills, platforms, assets etc. that contribute to enhancing the offering.

Additional Information:
- Proven working experience (5+ years) in Marketing and digital data management/ audience management with tools like Adobe experience platform (RT CDP), Oracle unity, salesforce CDP, Tealium etc. and relevant marketing technology solutions (including implementations), particularly within the industry (E-Commerce, Retail, Telecom, Pharma, Banking etc.)

DSPs, Google, FB etc.) and owned media platform integrations, web/app analytics tools, Omniture, campaign tracking & attribution tools, firebase, Appsflyer also beneficial.

- Sustainable Value Creation: Help clients build supply chain operating models that are economically efficient while embedding environmental and social responsibility across procurement, operations, and logistics.

- Supply Chain Transformation Roadmaps: Develop implementation road maps for resilient and sustainable supply chains, leveraging data-driven insights across themes such as circular economy, supply chain decarbonization, traceability, and responsible sourcing.

- Circular & Traceable Supply Chains: Design go-to-market and entry strategies for clients embedding circularity, traceability, and regulatory compliance (EUDR, CSDDD, DPP) into their supply chain and product strategies.
