Roles & Responsibilities:
- Support Supply Chain Sustainability & Resilience Projects
Conduct research, analysis, and problem-solving to help clients design resilient and sustainable supply chain strategies across procurement, operations, and logistics.

- Analyse Data & Develop Insights
Leverage qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, assess risks, evaluate sustainability performance, and generate actionable recommendations for clients.

- Develop Client-Ready Deliverables
Create high-quality presentations, reports, business cases, and implementation roadmaps that effectively communicate strategic recommendations and transformation plans.

- Drive Sustainability Transformation Initiatives
Assist in projects focused on supply chain decarbonization, circular economy, traceability, responsible sourcing, and ESG-related value chain transformations.

- Collaborate with Cross-Functional Stakeholders
Work closely with global client teams, industry experts, technology partners, and internal stakeholders to support project delivery and stakeholder management activities.

- Leverage Digital, AI & Sustainability Technologies
Assess supply chain technologies, utilize AI/GenAI-enabled tools for analysis and reporting, and recommend digital solutions that improve efficiency, transparency, resilience, and sustainability outcomes

Professional & Technical Skills:
- Strategic & Consulting Mindset - Ability to work on complex client problems and recommend innovative approaches and solutions

- Skillset to analyze large amounts of qualitative and quantitative data to draw insights and trends

- Structured problem solving and strong analytical skills

- Ability to present the recommendations in a compelling narrative through client ready deliverables.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to leverage that to for project delivery and stakeholder management

- Building relationships with potential and existing clients and being responsible for business development in assigned areas

- Potential to work with diverse teams and to be able to foster learning, exchange and innovation

- Grasp of MS power point, Excel and Word is important. Other tools like Power BI and Tableau are a plus

- Familiarity with AI and GenAI tools and their application in supply chain and sustainability contexts, including data analysis, report generation, and scenario modelling

MBA from a tier 1 institute with work experience in consulting or related fields preferred

Additional Information:
We are hiring across multiple roles! Experience in one or more categories listed below will be preferred.

AREA 1: RISK & RESILIENCE
- Experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) - including supplier risk assessments, risk scoring frameworks, and sustainability-linked due diligence

- Hands-on experience with N-tier visibility tools and scenario simulation

- Ability to design and implement supplier risk monitoring frameworks, including financial, operational, and ESG-linked risk indicators

- Experience conducting supply chain risk mapping — identifying single points of failure, geographic concentration risks, and supplier dependency analysis

- Ability to develop risk mitigation roadmaps and resilience strategies that integrate sustainability considerations across supply chains

- Experience working with risk and resilience platforms such as Osapiens, Interos, or ProcessUnity

OR

AREA 2: TRACEABILITY
- Strong understanding of traceability regulations and standards including EUDR, CSDDD, PPWR, Digital Product Passport (DPP), and GS1 standards

- Experience designing and implementing traceability and transparency solutions across complex, multi-tier supply chains

- Familiarity with Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), product-level carbon footprint methodologies, and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approaches

- Knowledge of regulatory landscape including extended producer responsibility (EPR), waste management regulations, and product compliance frameworks (EU Taxonomy, CBAM)

- Experience with ESG data and technology architecture for traceability use cases

- Ability to gather business requirements, identify platform fits and gaps, and develop functional specifications for traceability and sustainability reporting use cases

OR

AREA 3: CIRCULAR SUPPLY CHAINS
- Strong experience working on circular economy projects across thematic areas such as plastic packaging, e-waste, textiles

- Experience designing circular transformation strategies across supply chains — including reverse logistics, take-back model design, and material flow analysis

- Knowledge of technology enablement and service plays that support circularity — including digital platforms (e.g. Agora) for tracking material flows and closed-loop systems

- Understanding of circular strategy and business model design, including circular operating model design and sustainable product portfolio steering

- Proven experience with P&L modelling, business model innovation, and go-to-market strategy in the context of circular product and service innovation

- Experience with supplier assessments and supplier development using tools such as Eco Vadis, with a focus on circular economy compliance

OR

AREA 4: SUPPLY CHAIN DECARBONIZATION
- Strong experience in supplier decarbonization managed programs — including supplier engagement & onboarding, emissions baselining, and decarbonization roadmap development

- Experience with science-based target setting (SBTi) and delivering science-based targets as a service

- Deep understanding of Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions accounting, carbon neutrality strategies, and low-carbon energy transition across key geographies (US, EU, India, Australia)

- Strong experience working on clean energy projects including onsite/offsite Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and carbon offsets

- Experience with ESG reporting frameworks and sustainability data platforms (SAP, Workiva, Enablon, Oracle, MSM) for carbon and climate disclosure use cases

- Understanding of ESG Intelligence capabilities including gap assessment vs ESG frameworks, GenAI-powered sustainability report generation, and end-to-end ESG platform implementation

jobs.title: Adobe Workfront Consultant/Architect
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Over 500,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at  www.accenture.com .

You Are:
We're looking for a senior Adobe Workfront expert to join our team in a solution consulting and architecture role to help clients adopt the Adobe Marketing Cloud and support large-scale business transformations. This is a combined pre-sales and solution leadership role requiring deep technical platform expertise, strong commercial acumen, and proven experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder programs.

The Work:
- Pre-sales Support – Working closely with our growth, alliances, and client service teams to help accelerate the sales process and onboard clients. This will include defining marketing technology strategies & solutions, roadmaps, and budgets; as well as writing proposals and SoWs.
- Solution Leadership – Working with our clients in an advisory capacity to help them define solutions and accelerate delivery as a product owner, or work in support of a client product owner, on large-scale implementations and transformation programs.
- Internal Capability Enablement – Working with our internal teams to help accelerate practice growth through knowledge sharing, service definition, training, and partner certification.
- Organizing and facilitating discovery and requirement capture workshops with senior client stakeholders.
- Writing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Epics, and Stories.
- Defining functional and technical solution architecture and working with project managers to shape the overall delivery approach.
- Owning business objectives and requirements during delivery, and coordinating dependencies and priorities across multiple teams.
- Leading and supporting new Workfront implementations, from discovery through deployment, as well as assessments of existing implementations with roadmaps for future development.
- Contributing to large-scale programs that extend beyond Workfront or marketing technologies — including data platforms, analytics, experience platforms, and creative/production services.
- Overseeing acceptance testing and driving issue resolution to completion.
- Supporting business change including process engineering, role definition, workflow automation, and skills transfer.
- Working with strategy and planning teams to define marketing activation use cases that leverage solution capabilities and best practices.
- Supporting new business qualification to ensure focus on the right types of opportunities.
- Providing pre-sales support for growth and client service teams, including proposal writing, pitch delivery, and statements of work.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

What You Need:
- Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Workfront System Administrator or in a consultancy Workfront delivery role
- Minimum of 2 years of experience with Workfront implementation and project optimization
- Minimum of 1 years experience showcasing the ability to lead discovery and requirements workshops with cross-functional stakeholders
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an, Associate’s Degree with 6 years of work experience)

Bonus Points If:
- You have an Adobe Experience Cloud certification in one or more of the following: Workfront, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Marketo, or Adobe Analytics
- You have 1+ years of experience leading multi-platform Adobe solutions as a product owner, technical client service lead, or solution consultant
- You have 1+ years of experience configuring integrations and automations using Workfront Fusion

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/06/2026.

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Consulting Manager - Utilities Customer Experience and Transformation
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture’s Utilities Industry and Enterprise group is seeking a Management Consultant Manager, Utilities, to help shape the next chapter of our Utilities Customer practice in Canada. This role supports gas and electric utilities across Quebec, Ontario and Western Canada, working at the intersection of customer operations, meter-to-cash, customer demand-side programs (DSM), energy transition, and digital innovation.
Our Utilities Customer practice is a dedicated industry team with established client relationships and access to Accenture’s North American utilities portfolio, drawing on precedent and delivery assets from programs at a scale few individual markets produce.

You Are:
As a trusted advisor, you will help clients navigate the shifting energy landscape, from evolving customer expectations to the growing importance of decarbonization, electrification, and demand-side management programs. You’ll play a leading role in designing and implementing strategies that enhance customer engagement, optimize operational performance, and enable the transition to a more sustainable energy future.
You will build depth within a single industry rather than across unrelated sectors, and you will contribute to the growth of the practice as well as to the delivery of its work.

The Work:
- Lead and advise clients on customer transformation, customer operations, customer experience, contact center modernization, and digital customer strategy in the context of energy transition and demand-side management initiatives.

- Work across the meter-to-cash lifecycle, from service requests and metering through billing, payments, credit and collections, and advise on how customer information systems support it.

- Analyze, design, and document new business processes that enable efficient delivery of customer and energy programs, including energy efficiency, electrification, and distributed energy solutions.

- Leverage analytics, customer insights, and artificial intelligence to identify opportunities for improving customer experience, reducing cost to serve, and advancing energy efficiency goals.

- Build and grow client relationships at the director and vice-president level, contributing to proposals, client pursuits, and thought leadership in areas such as customer innovation, energy transition, and energy efficiency.

- Mentor and guide team members, fostering excellence in business process design and stakeholder management.

Here’s What You’ll Need:
- Fluent in French speaking and writing, including client workshops and written deliverables.
- 5+ years’ experience in the Utilities industry, including 2+ years leading a workstream and its team, in Customer Operations, Customer Transformation, or Business Process Design.
- Experience in Meter-to-Cash, customer operations, or utility program design.
- Working knowledge of the platforms supporting utility customer functions, such as Oracle Customer Care and Billing, Oracle Customer to Meter, SAP for Utilities, S/4HANA Utilities, Salesforce, or comparable customer information and customer relationship environments. Experience of a system replacement or major upgrade is an asset.
- Strong knowledge of Energy Transition, Demand Side Management, and Digital Customer Strategy.
- An informed perspective on the application of artificial intelligence within a regulated customer function, and ideally practical experience applying it.
- Proven ability to manage consulting engagements, lead client relationships, and advise on complex transformation programs. Familiarity with the Canadian regulatory environment, including the Régie de l’énergie and the Ontario Energy Board, is an asset.
- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company’s activities to avoid this requirement.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Warehousing Functional Lead
jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

We Are:
Accenture’s Supply Chain & Operations practice, and we live in the details that make distribution centers run. Our clients—Fortune 500 leaders across retail, e-commerce, grocery, consumer goods, third-party logistics, and industrial manufacturing—count on us to design, configure, and stand up the systems and processes that power their warehouses. From WMS solution design and configuration through go-live and stabilization, our Warehousing & Distribution Engineering team combines deep functional expertise, hands-on operations knowledge, and Accenture’s global delivery capability to solve the problems that other firms treat as out of scope. If it touches how goods move inside four walls, we own it.

You Are:
A hands-on WMS functional expert and distribution center operations specialist who has spent your career in the details—configuration workbooks, fit-gap analyses, process flow diagrams, UAT scripts, and go-live war rooms. You bring deep, practical expertise in Manhattan Active® WM (or a comparable enterprise WMS platform) and you know the operations side just as well: receiving and putaway, wave planning and pick/pack/ship, labor management, slotting, cycle counting, and returns. You can walk a client’s operations floor, immediately identify what is broken or sub-optimal, and translate that observation into a WMS configuration or process change that actually fixes it. You are an effective facilitator who earns the trust of warehouse managers and IT leaders alike, and you thrive guiding client super users through design decisions that will shape how thousands of associates work every day. You are ready to be on-site where the work happens—and traveling 60 to 80 percent of the time suits you fine.

The Work:
- Lead the WMS functional workstream on large distribution center implementation programs, owning requirements gathering, process design, configuration, testing, and go-live for Manhattan Active® WM and comparable enterprise WMS platforms.
- Conduct structured current-state assessments of distribution center operations across all functional domains—inbound (receiving, cross-dock, putaway), outbound (wave planning, pick/pack/ship, loading), inventory management (replenishment, cycle counting, location management), labor management, returns processing, and yard management—identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and WMS configuration opportunities.
- Facilitate solution design workshops with client operations, industrial engineering, and IT stakeholders; translate operational requirements into documented functional specifications, configuration decisions, and process design documents aligned with the WMS platform's capabilities and best practices.
- Own and maintain configuration workbooks, functional specifications, fit-gap analyses, process flow documentation, and requirements traceability matrices across the full implementation lifecycle, ensuring changes are version-controlled and communicated across project workstreams.
- Design and execute end-to-end WMS testing strategies—unit testing, systems integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT)—including test script development, defect logging and triage, regression testing, and go-live readiness certification in partnership with the client, SI, and automation vendors.
- Lead WMS cutover planning and execution for go-live events, including parallel processing support, cutover checklists and rehearsals, hyper-care protocols, issue escalation, and post-launch stabilization in live distribution environments.
- Design and deliver role-based end-user training programs for warehouse associates, team leads, supervisors, and system administrators across all WMS functional modules; develop training documentation, quick-reference guides, and on-floor job aids.
- Support configuration and optimization of labor management systems (LMS), engineered labor standards, slotting programs, wave optimization rules, and warehouse performance dashboards that integrate with or operate adjacent to the WMS.
- Apply distribution center operations expertise—flow path analysis, slotting strategy, SKU velocity profiling, labor model design, and staffing ramp planning—in support of new DC launches, facility expansions, and operational transformation programs.
- Mentor WMS analysts and junior functional consultants on the engagement team, transferring WMS configuration expertise, DC operations knowledge, and client-facing delivery skills.
- Contribute to Accenture’s WMS accelerator library, configuration templates, and methodology assets; support proposal development and solution presentations as a subject matter expert in WMS functional delivery and DC operations.

Travel Requirements:
This role requires 60–80% travel, primarily to client distribution center and project sites across the United States and potentially internationally. Travel is aligned with active project needs and current health and safety guidelines.

Here's what you need:
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in distribution center operations, WMS implementation, or supply chain technology delivery, including at least 4 years in a hands-on WMS functional lead or configuration role on enterprise WMS platforms.
- Minimum 3 years hands-on WMS functional expertise—Manhattan Active® WM strongly preferred—including direct experience configuring and validating modules across inbound, outbound, inventory management, wave planning, labor management, and integration to ERP and WCS/WES layers, combined with solid working knowledge of distribution center operations across receiving, putaway, replenishment, pick/pack/ship, cycle counting, returns processing, yard management, and labor management.
- Experience leading or directly supporting WMS fit-gap analysis, solution design sessions, requirements documentation, unit, integration, and UAT testing, test script authoring, defect management, triage, go-live readiness assessment, cutover, hyper-care, and post-go-live stabilization in live distribution environments.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

·

Bonus Points If:
- You hold Manhattan Active® WM certification or formal platform training credentials from Manhattan Associates.
- Strong communication and facilitation skills; proven ability to run structured design workshops with diverse client stakeholder groups (operations, IT, finance, HR) and translate outputs into clear, actionable documentation.
- You have direct experience with labor management systems (LMS), engineered labor standards development, or time-and-motion studies in a distribution or fulfillment environment.
- You have hands-on experience with slotting optimization tools (e.g., Manhattan Slotting, Blue Yonder Slotting, OPEX or similar) and understand the interplay between slotting, wave strategy, and pick path optimization.
- You have hands-on experience with Blue Yonder Luminate Warehouse Management, SAP EWM, Oracle WMS Cloud, or other leading enterprise WMS platforms in addition to Manhattan.
- You have worked in a distribution center in an operations or industrial engineering role (operations supervisor, IE analyst, DC manager) and bring direct floor-level experience managing warehouse processes and teams.
- You have experience integrating WMS with warehouse automation systems—WCS/WES, AS/RS, conveyor and sortation, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), or robotic picking solutions.
- You bring Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt or Green Belt), APICS CSCP/CLTD, or other supply chain or operational excellence certifications.
- You have consulting or systems integrator experience delivering WMS implementations for retailers, grocers, 3PLs, e-commerce fulfillment operations, or consumer goods manufacturers.
- You have earned an MBA or an advanced degree in a related discipline.

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Supply Chain and Operations houses individuals who help clients develop strategies and operating models that integrate planning, procurement, product design, manufacturing, and fulfillment functions within an organization, as well as connect suppliers and customers across the extended supply chain.

You are:
A Blue Yonder TMS (Transportation Management) Consultant that will help contribute, develop and grow our Fulfillment business for the BY TMS platform.

The Work:
The Blue Yonder (“BY”) Consultant leads the overall workstream delivery of a customer's Transportation capability, working with the Solution Architect, Delivery Lead and Technical Architect who leads the technical design and delivery.  The BY Consultant works with cross functional teams and is a key contributor to communications between program delivery leads, customer stakeholders, and IT teams.  They are comfortable presenting business process, solutions and program status to a variety of audiences including executive project sponsors.  They influence the customer to adopt industry’s best practices and define how the Blue Yonder Transportation solutions will be configured and delivered to ensure customer objectives and goals are achieved.

Responsibilities:
- Key lead in all aspects of customer journey throughout discovery, design, construction, testing, deployment and hypercare focused on transportation capabilities

- Lead functional design and integration of future state capabilities using a suite of products, to include Blue Yonder Transportation Planning, Transportation Modeling, Load Builder as well as a variety of other complimentary solutions

- Facilitate customer change management leveraging industry best practices and process methodologies

- Design and develop solutions to close gaps between customer requirements where functionality does not exist in the out-of-box solutions

- Serve as an overall solution owner attending and contributing to key meetings between Project Manager, Technical Architect, key customer contacts, and customer users

- Provide variety of support to the project team, including quality assurance/design review, environment configuration, batch operations consulting, troubleshooting, and system testing

- Work with Blue Yonder Support Services team to ensure environment readiness and to proactively resolve customer issues

- Guide and conduct user acceptance testing and training sessions for end users, as project demand dictate

- Work with Cloud service team to ensure a seamless transition to Blue Yonder Steady State team

- Support the Transportation Segment Lead in client discovery, origination and solutioning of client needs during sales cycles

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need:
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in enterprise level solution design, configuration, deployments, and cloud integrations working with the Blue Yonder Transportation Management Suite or similar platform
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent (minimum 6 years work experience)

- Strong understanding of functional transportation processes and translation of the functional requirements into configuration with the Blue Yonder Transportation Management suite.
- Experience in business requirements gathering, user story development and translating requirements to development teams
- Experience delivering transportation programs for clients
- Transportation functional knowledge (to include tariffs, routes, freight bill and audit, etc) and process design.
- Unit, system integration and functional testing experience

We are:
We are part of a fast-moving Supply Chain organization helping Fortune 500 clients reinvent how they source, procure, and manage third parties. Our work sits at the intersection of operating model design, process reinvention, AI-enabled procurement, digital platforms, and cost transformation with deep industry context at the core.

You are:
As a manager, you will own and lead end-to-end sourcing and procurement transformation initiatives, working directly with senior leadership within Accenture Sourcing & Procurement practice and driving relationship with Energy client stakeholders (Category managers, Functional leads, VP level). Your responsibilities will span strategy, design, and execution across the following dimensions:

The Work:
Operating Model & Organization Design
- Design future-ready procurement operating models
- Define roles, governance, decision rights, and ways of working across business, procurement, and suppliers,
- Integrate AI and Agentic AI into procurement workflows to improve speed, quality, and scalability.

Process Reinvention & Digital Enablement
- Redesign core sourcing and procurement processes using a digital-first and automation-led approach,
- Identify opportunities to embed AI, analytics, and intelligent agents across business partnering, category management, sourcing, contracting, buying, and supplier management,
- Guide clients through procurement technology enablement (e.g., Work orchestration, S2P platforms, analytics).

Sourcing, Cost & Value Delivery
- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and cost take-out programs across categories.
- Drive value beyond savings, including reliability, supplier performance, and risk reduction.
- Support and lead complex supplier negotiations.

Data, Insights & Performance
- Use data and analytics to identify bottlenecks, cost opportunities, and performance gaps.
- Define procurement KPIs and 360 value tracking mechanisms aligned with business outcomes / priorities.

Leadership & Client Delivery
- Lead multi-disciplinary teams and manage delivery for one or several workstreams.
- Act as a team lead accountable of team delivery, leading relationship with client stakeholders, translating pain points and strategies into executable solutions.
- Support change management and capability uplift to ensure sustainable adoption.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Sourcing, Procurement, or Supply Chain.
- Minimum 2 years of management consulting experience or equivalent internal consulting role.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points If:
- Strong understanding of procurement operating models, sourcing, and process design.
- Proven ability to lead teams, manage clients, and deliver complex programs
- Hands-on exposure to procurement technology implementations (e.g., SAP Ariba, Oracle, Coupa).
- Experience with AI, advanced analytics, or automation in procurement contexts.
- Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement certifications.
- Proficiency with analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
- MBA or advanced degree.

jobs.title: Procurement Reinvention Consultant
jobs.description:
Meet our Sourcing & Procurement Team

Join the largest and most experienced Sourcing & Procurement consulting team (+80 professionals) across CEE!

About us:
For over 15 years our teams have been working on the largest S&P transformations for local and global companies, across multiple industries.
We are a team of results-driven procurement experts, who stay away from repetitive tasks and want to address the real challenges, taking ownership and pride in what we do. We focus on end-to-end Procurement transformation, delivering meaningful impact by implementing pioneering procurement strategies, methodologies, and tools. We drive change in Procurement organizations focusing on the hottest topics: Digital, Innovation, Sustainability, Supply Assurance, Cost reinvention across both Indirect and Direct categories.
This is a great opportunity to accelerate your career as you gain exposure to multiple Client and industry challenges.

THE WORK:

- Drive value by tackling a variety of procurement issues from operational to strategic topics, removing internal inefficiencies and overcoming external market challenges using our experience, data analytics and market insights.

- Work hand in hand with Clients and AI agents to identify source of the issue, validate it with data and your procurement experience.

- Manage client interactions, clearly communicating your insights and proposed solutions.

- Cooperate with colleagues and ecosystem partners to identify the best-in-class solution for each Client challenge.

- Deliver the impact on Client organizations, by driving the implementation and building client capabilities via process redesign, tool development, sourcing projects.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

- Challenging and rewarding job in a dynamic, international, supportive and multicultural environment, embracing challenges as opportunities, motivated to embrace new opportunities.

- Opportunity to leverage your expertise and broaden it, by working on challenging projects in exposure to clients.

- Grow your career in a planned way, with enabled progress to lead work streams and engagements.

#LI-EU

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- Minimum bachelor’s degree

- 3+ years’ procurement function experience (e.g. Category Management, Strategic Sourcing):
- Strategic thinker and project management skills

- Managing sourcing of complex categories (e.g. CSO)

- Benefits case realisation using digital technologies and data orchestration

- Awareness of leading Procurement concepts and software solutions

- Teamwork and ability to work in dispersed delivery environment

- Proactiveness and clear ownership of tasks

- Skilled in using key calculation & visualization solutions

- Experience in project-based work

- Excellent English communication and presentation skills (written & spoken)

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

- German language

- Consulting experience

- Hands-on experience in driving change of how organizations operate

- Knowledge of sourcing tools (Coupa sourcing optimiser)

- Experience working with AI Agents to manage data and develop conclusions

WHAT WE OFFER?

- Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.

- A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification).

- Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.

- Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares.

- Paid employee referral program.

- Private medical care and life insurance.

- Access to the WorkSmile benefits platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card).

Working Conditions:

- Employment contract (umowa o pracę)

- Headquarter in Warsaw.

- Traveling  to work with prestigious clients and deliver large-scale transformational change. We deliver our work in hybrid model, remotely, in our offices but also traveling and working closely with our Clients in their offices. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. jobs.description:
GN - SONG - C&S - Commerce AI - Consultant | CGRT
Job Title: GN - SONG - C&S - Commerce AI - Consultant | CGRT
Management Level: 09 / Consultant
Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai
Must Have Skills: Digital Transformation, Commerce Content Strategy, Consumer Goods & Retail Industry Experience
Good to Have Skills: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), AI-driven Customer Experience, AI Search Visibility Tools
Job Summary

In this role, you will support digital commerce transformation for Consumer Goods and Retail clients — helping them grow, engage, and remain discoverable across channels as customer discovery increasingly shifts from traditional search to AI-driven platforms. You will bring solid foundations in SEO and digital performance, and apply that expertise to help clients navigate Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and the broader implications of agentic commerce on how products are found, evaluated, and purchased. Working as part of a GN SONG consulting team with deep CGRT expertise, you will connect digital commerce execution with emerging AI search capabilities — helping clients adapt structurally and stay commercially relevant.

Areas of Work

Digital and Agentic Commerce (Search & Generative Engine Optimization)

Roles & Responsibilities

As part of these, you will support and contribute to the following:

- Digital commerce transformation in CGRT: Contribute to programmes that improve how Consumer Goods and Retail brands sell and grow across D2C, marketplace, and omnichannel environments — bringing both commerce execution and search expertise to client engagements.
- Commerce and discoverability assessment: Evaluate client digital commerce capabilities including product content quality, channel strategy, and platform structure — identifying gaps that impact performance across traditional and AI-driven discovery environments.
- GEO & AEO strategy and roadmap support: Build optimization roadmaps that bridge proven SEO fundamentals with GEO and AEO principles — helping CGRT clients adapt how their products, content, and brand presence perform in an AI-first search landscape.
- Product discoverability across AI platforms: Identify and implement improvements to how client products and content are surfaced and cited by AI platforms — spanning content structure, technical SEO, and product and brand entity alignment across digital touchpoints.
- Performance management and reporting: Track and report on digital commerce and search performance metrics — including brand citation trends, share of voice in generative results, and visibility coverage — connecting findings to commercial outcomes.
- Cross-functional collaboration: Work alongside SEO, content, PR, analytics, and technology teams to ensure search and commerce efforts are integrated across channels and embedded in broader transformation programmes.
- Sector-focused capability building: Develop working knowledge of GEO, AEO, and agentic commerce trends with a specific lens on their implications for product discovery and shopper journeys in Consumer Goods and Retail.

Professional & Technical Skills

- Hands-on experience in SEO, digital marketing, or content strategy within Consumer Goods or Retail — with a developing understanding of GEO, AEO, and AI-driven search.
- Understanding of how Consumer Goods and Retail commerce works — including product content, category management, digital shelf, and performance levers across D2C and marketplace environments.
- Ability to connect digital commerce and search performance to commercial outcomes — translating findings into clear, business-relevant recommendations for client stakeholders.
- Familiarity with enterprise SEO and digital analytics tools; exposure to GEO/AEO tracking tools is a plus.
- Experience developing client-facing reports, dashboards, and presentations.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to work across marketing, technology, and strategy teams in a consulting environment.

Additional Information

- MBA/PGDM from Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution preferred; Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Minimum 5–7 years of total experience, with at least 3+ years in digital commerce, SEO, or content strategy within Consumer Goods or Retail.
- Exposure to GEO, AEO, or agentic search concepts is preferred — curiosity and appetite to build this capability is equally valued alongside experience.
- Prior exposure to consulting or client-facing advisory roles is an advantage.
- This role requires alignment to the US market; English proficiency is essential.

Qualifications: Any Graduation

About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. What would you do? The 1st Line Audit / Risk & Compliance role is responsible for embedding risk ownership and control discipline within US insurance business operations. The role ensures day to day processes comply with US regulatory requirements, internal control standards, client policies, and contractual obligations, while proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, compliance, and conduct risks as part of the First Line of Defense (1LoD) framework.
Risk & Compliance involves identifying, assessing, and managing risks to ensure an organization adheres to laws and regulations. This role includes developing risk management strategies, conducting compliance audits, and implementing policies to mitigate risks. It also involves monitoring regulatory changes and ensuring the organization remains compliant. The goal is to protect the organization from legal and financial risks while maintaining ethical standards.
Anticipate, plan for, and react to risks and issues to the project, including categorizing their severity, taking into account the likelihood of occurrence, mitigation & contingency planning. Follow an agile approach that builds risk management into scrum roles, artifacts, and events and helps in continuous project delivery.
What are we looking for? Technical / Functional Skills
• Strong understanding of Insurance Operations and First Line risk management
• Experience with internal controls, RCMs, audit testing, and issue remediation
• Familiarity with US insurance regulatory environment and client governance expectations
• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for analysis and reporting
Behavioral & Professional Skills
• Strong analytical and problem solving capability
• High attention to detail and documentation discipline
• Clear, concise, and professional communication skills
• Ability to work effectively with auditors, compliance teams, and business stakeholders
• Strong ownership, execution focus, and time management

• Graduate / Post Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, or related fields
• CA Inter / CPA / MBA / Equivalent qualification preferred
• 8+ years of experience in Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, or Control Assurance
• Prior experience supporting US Insurance (Life, Annuities, Retirement Services, or P&C) strongly preferred
Roles and Responsibilities: •First Line Risk & Control Execution
• Execute risk and control assessments, walkthroughs, and self testing across insurance operations supporting the US market.
• Perform Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Operating Effectiveness (ToE) for key controls embedded within business processes.
• Identify, assess, and document risks (High / Medium / Low) based on impact, likelihood, and regulatory exposure.
• Ensure adherence to approved policies, procedures, underwriting guidelines, and operational SOPs.
Audit & Assurance Support
• Support internal audits, SOX testing (where applicable), regulatory exams, and client audits by coordinating walkthroughs, evidence, and responses.
• Maintain and update audit issue and action plan trackers, ensuring timely remediation and validation.
• Prepare audit working papers, control narratives, and management responses.
• Conduct follow up reviews to validate effectiveness of corrective actions and prevent repeat findings.
Regulatory & Compliance (US Insurance Focus)
• Ensure compliance with applicable US insurance regulatory requirements, internal governance standards, and client mandated controls.
• Perform periodic checks across key insurance processes, including:
o Policy issuance and underwriting
o Premium processing and reconciliations
o Claims adjudication and payouts
o Customer onboarding and servicing
o Data privacy and customer information handling
• Support compliance activities related to AML, fraud prevention, consumer protection, and data governance, as applicable.
Risk Reporting & Documentation
• Draft clear, objective, and well structured risk observations, control gaps, and root cause analyses.
• Prepare risk summaries, dashboards, and thematic insights for senior management and client stakeholders.
• Escalate material risks, control failures, or regulatory concerns in a timely and professional manner.
Governance & Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, control standardization, and automation.
• Support enterprise initiatives related to operational resilience, risk governance, and quality uplift.
• Promote a strong risk culture and reinforce accountability within business teams.

Any Graduation

jobs.title: Resources Industry Consultant with AI - ICH Europe
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting , Technology, Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song.

Intelligent Consulting Hub (ICH) Resources Team is providing industry-specific business and technology consulting services to clients in Energy Downstream, Upstream, Fuel Retail and Utilities area s . We believe that data analytics tools combined with state-of-the-art system infrastructure are the foundation for the intelligent enterprise: from the wellhead, through the forecourt to the boardroom. Join our team as Data & Analytics Reinvention Consultant for the Energy Industry to participate in bringing to live business solutions based on latest Cloud Technologies and Analytics Tools.

Our Consultants have excellent communication skills with the ability to explain compl ex things simply . They are experts in Data & Analytics projects, spanning likes of Data Strategy , Governance, Migration , Integration and Consolidation , Data Warehousing and Data Lake Implementation , Business Intelligence (BI) and Reporting . The most experienced talents lead and manage these projects, financials, and build relationship s with C lient s and cooperate with our delivery centers across the globe. At ICH Energy Team, we measure our success by building trusted relationships with Global Accenture Teams and Client stakeholders across business and IT. To learn more about Strategy & Consulting please visit our website .

THE WORK:
You will partner with Clients in the Resources sector (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Chemicals, Mining) to shape and deliver AI enabled improvements —assessing business needs, defining high value opportunities, building value cases, supporting pilots, and helping Clients scale the right solutions across the organization. You’ll combine deep knowledge of your business domain with consulting methods and practical AI knowledge to make impact at scale and pace.. If you’ve already developed one or two pragmatic AI automations (e.g., document intelligence, conversational service, forecasting, scheduling, optimization, etc.), we want to talk.

Your work will include:
- AI Use Case Discovery & Prioritization — conducting workshops, mapping processes, and identifying high impact AI and automation opportunities.

- AI Enabled Process Improvement — shaping simple MVPs (e.g., document intelligence, agent based solutions, workflow automation) and supporting iterative pilots.

- Business Analysis & Value Assessment — defining KPIs, estimating business impact, and supporting benefit tracking with stakeholders.

You will also have opportunities to step outside core AI work and contribute to a wide range of Accenture and Client initiatives.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?  ​
- Meaningful work on international projects , helping you grow your skills every day.

- Exposure to leading technologies and business practices.

- A dynamic career path in a global organization that values impact, collaboration, and trusted Client relationships — giving you space to grow long-term.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

jobs.title: Graduate & Junior Consulting Professionals
jobs.description:
Are you a recent graduate or about to graduate from university? Are you interested in helping organizations solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful change?

Accenture's Consulting graduate track is designed for graduates who want to build a career at the intersection of business transformation, industry expertise and technology. From day one, you'll work alongside experienced consultants on real client challenges, helping organizations improve how they operate, adapt to change and create lasting business value.

As part of the graduate track, you'll gain hands-on experience, continuous coaching and mentorship, and develop the consulting, analytical and leadership skills needed to thrive in a rapidly changing business environment. You'll also learn how organizations are applying AI, data and technology to improve decision-making, enhance performance and create new sources of value.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping organizations reinvent through strategy, consulting, technology and operations. We combine industry, functional and technology expertise to help clients turn ambition into measurable business outcomes.
Accenture offers graduate opportunities across Technology, AI & Data, Strategy and Consulting.

About the Consulting Graduate Track
The Consulting graduate track focuses on helping organizations translate business ambitions into practical action and sustainable business outcomes.

Depending on your team and project assignments, you may work on challenges with either an industry or functional focus, such as supply chain, finance, customer transformation, workforce transformation and AI-enabled enterprise transformation.

Consulting focuses primarily on helping organizations improve performance, redesign how work gets done and translate strategic ambitions into operational results.

Consulting helps organizations answer questions such as:
- How can we improve performance and efficiency?
- How can we create more value through better processes and operations?
- How can we simplify and improve the way we work?
- How can we adapt our organization to changing business needs?
- How can we leverage AI, data and technology to enhance business performance?
- What operating models, processes or capabilities are needed to achieve our ambitions?
- How can we successfully implement change and realize business value?

Consulting Topics and Focus Areas
Depending on your team and area of specialization, you may work with topics such as:
- Business Transformation
- Process Excellence & Optimization
- Supply Chain & Operations
- Finance Transformation
- Customer & Commercial Transformation
- Workforce & Talent Transformation
- Digital Core Transformation
- AI-enabled Enterprise Transformation

Over time, you'll build broad consulting capabilities while developing deeper expertise in selected transformation areas.

What You Will Do
As part of project teams, you'll help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
Examples of work may include:
- Supporting business transformation programs
- Analyzing challenges across people, processes, technology and data
- Conducting stakeholder interviews, workshops and research
- Identifying opportunities to improve performance and create value
- Supporting organizational change and adoption initiatives
- Helping redesign business processes and operating models
- Defining and documenting business requirements
- Applying data, analytics and AI-enabled approaches to support decision-making
- Developing recommendations, business cases and presentations for client stakeholders
- Helping turn recommendations into implementation roadmaps and action plans

You will work closely with experienced consulting teams while receiving ongoing coaching to support your development.

What's In It for You?
Joining the Consulting graduate track provides:
- A dedicated consulting-focused graduate track
- Early exposure to complex business challenges
- Extensive training, coaching and mentorship
- Opportunities to develop AI capabilities and understand how AI is reshaping business operations and decision-making
- Exposure to senior stakeholders and high-impact transformation programs
- Access to Accenture's global expertise and knowledge networks
- A strong foundation for a long-term career in consulting and business transformation

Who We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, ambitious and analytically minded graduates who enjoy solving complex problems and working with others.

You:
- Have a master's degree or will receive your degree before September 2027
- Can start at Accenture in early autumn 2027
- Have strong academic results in a relevant field
- Are an analytical problem-solver with strong business acumen
- Have an interest in consulting, transformation, operations or business development
- Are curious about how organizations operate and create value
- Are interested in how AI, data and technology are transforming business performance
- Have strong written and verbal communication skills
- Are collaborative, proactive and eager to learn
- Are fluent in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing

Relevant educational backgrounds may include Business & Economics, Industrial Engineering & Management, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Human Resources and related disciplines.

Office and Start Date
We are recruiting graduates to our offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö, with a start date in early autumn 2027. Depending on the assignment, work may take place from an Accenture office, a client location or remotely as part of multidisciplinary teams. Flexibility and mobility are therefore expected.

Application Process
Please submit:
- CV including GPA on a five-grade scale
- Cover Letter
- University Transcripts/Grades

Please upload all documents under Upload Resume/CV.

Only complete applications will be reviewed.

In your cover letter, we would like to learn:
- Why you are interested in Consulting
- Which transformation topics interest you most
- Relevant academic, professional, extracurricular or leadership experiences
- Which office location you are applying to

The screening and selection process is conducted on an ongoing basis.

Candidates progressing to the next stage will be invited to complete assessments designed to evaluate analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the next generation of consulting professionals to Accenture.

jobs.title: Applied AI Process Consultant
jobs.description:
You produce solid analytical work — assessing trends and forces shaping your industry or function, designing future-state processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in your domain and a point of view on how AI and automation can change the way it operates. You're comfortable working with structured guidance while taking on more with each engagement.

You understand that designing how AI agents interact within processes — AX Design — is just as important as the process design itself, and you're starting to apply those principles in your work.

THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
- Produce trend and forces assessments for your assigned industry or function, including benchmarking analyses that show where the client stands relative to peers and where the reinvention opportunity lies.

- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for your domain area.

- Conduct process analysis and support delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations.

- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools.

- Conduct benchmarking analysis with AI-accelerated industry and peer comparison tools.

- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.

- Apply your industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

- Contribute to the reference library and keep your domain expertise current through continuous learning.

- Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs — defining how AI agents should behave within each redesigned process step, what they handle autonomously, and when they hand off to a person.

#LI-MP

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION

- Experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting

- Experience producing industry or function trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, or change-impact assessments

- Previous usage of AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or benchmarking tools (e.g. Platform Native AI capabilities)

- Experience integrating AI and automating business process design

- You have previously delivered project work in consulting environment OR industry experience in at least one domain (e.g., Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities or Chemical and Natural Resources) OR worked within

- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

- Familiarity with process mapping or process modeling tools

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms/structured recommendations

- Client-facing consulting or advisory experience

- Applies AI tools fluently and independently, including building agents, for higher-quality deliverables to business problems

- Embeds AI Design principles into process specifications (agent behaviors, autonomy levels, handoffs)

- Identifies where agentic AI can transform specific client process steps and articulates design implications

- Uses AI-assisted analytics, visualization, and benchmarking tools to ground future-state designs

- Demonstrated continuous learning with emerging AI tools

jobs.title: GN-I&E- Comms and Media Lean Telco Consultant
jobs.description:
Analyst & Consultant | S&C GN - Non-Network
Management Level
Level 11 to 09
Location
Bangalore / Gurgaon / Pune
Entity
S&C GN - Non Network
Job Summary
As a Lean Telco Analyst / Consultant, you will help Communications & Media clients design and execute large-scale business and operating model transformations across the offerings of Lean Telco strategy and roadmap, Company-wide re-invention, telco restructuring and carve-outs, NetCo/ServCo separation, B2C care reinvention, B2B sales process reinvention, Process Driven IT Reinvention and AI-enabled operational improvement.
You will own defined modules or workstreams focused on assessing current-state operations, processes and operating models; defining future-state and North Star target states; developing value and business cases; and designing transformation roadmaps and implementation plans that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Must-Have Skills
Cross-Cutting Industry & Consulting Skills
·       Understanding of telecom operating models, value chains and functional processes across BSS, OSS, CRM, Order management, billing, provisioning, assurance, customer operations etc.
·       Familiarity with process discovery, BPMN-based process mapping, process mining and value realization concepts
·       AI Fluency (fundamentals of AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI concepts) and ability to identify and qualify AI/agentic use cases within client engagements.
·       Strong strategic analysis and structured problem-solving skills, including hypothesis-led issue framing, research, benchmarking, data interpretation and data-driven decision making
·       Strong quantitative analysis, Excel-based modelling and business case development capabilities
·       Excellent PowerPoint storytelling, presentation development and executive communication skills
·       Experience supporting proposals, POVs, thought leadership and/or practice/capability development initiatives

Must-Have Skills by capability area
You are expected to possess proven experience and skills in one or more of the following capability areas

Lean Telco Strategy & Roadmap
·       Experience supporting Lean Telco strategy and roadmap engagements spanning transformation ambition definition, North star definition, operating model assessment, value architecture development and roadmap creation
·       Ability to assess current-state telecom operating models and performance drivers to identify transformation opportunities
·       Experience developing value cases, business cases, benefits baselines and value realization frameworks
·       Ability to support governance, KPI and value tracking mechanisms to drive realization of transformation outcomes
·       Exposure to AI-first telco operating model concepts – where AI/agentic capabilities are designed into the target operating model from the outset
Process-Driven Reinvention
Business Reinvention
·       Experience leading telecom process assessments, value discovery and eTOM-based business process transformation
·       Ability to redesign customer journeys, operating models and As-Is/To-Be processes across care, sales and commercial functions
·       Experience in B2C care transformation, including AI-assisted contact centers, digital self-service, Customer 360 and workforce optimization
·       Experience in B2B sales transformation across lead-to-cash, quote-to-cash and order-to-cash processes, including CRM/CPQ enablement and revenue leakage reduction
·       Ability to identify AI and automation opportunities, develop business cases, and drive value realization for transformation programs
IT Reinvention
·       Experience supporting IT and telecom operations transformation across BSS/OSS and enterprise IT processes
·       Understanding of IT operating models, ITSM frameworks and service management processes
·       Knowledge of target operating model designs for IT and service management organizations
·       Experience assessing and defining future states across ITSM processes including incident, request, problem and change management
·       Experience performing gap analysis and opportunity identification for workflow automation, orchestration, AIOps and AI-enabled IT operations
·       Familiarity with eTOM, ITIL and service management frameworks
Telecom Restructuring & Carve-outs
·       Working knowledge of telco restructuring and carve-outs, including business separation, Transition Services Agreement (TSA) / service model, transition planning and commercial interface considerations
·       Ability to assess process, organization, technology and service dependencies across business units
·       Experience supporting service catalogue design, service management models, SLA frameworks and transition planning
·       Knowledge of operating model design, governance structures and service delivery frameworks
·       Understanding of TSA planning, Day-1 readiness activities and business transition requirements
·       Ability to support commercial, cost and synergy assessments associated with restructuring initiatives
Good-to-Have Skills
·       Hands-on exposure to AI/ML, GenAI or Agentic AI use cases in telecom operations, customer care, IT service management, sales, marketing, finance, procurement or HR
·       Hands-on exposure to GenAI/agent-builder tools, prompting, and low-code/no-code agent prototyping
·       Familiarity with telecom platforms and COTS products such as Amdocs, Ericsson, Netcracker, Subex, Salesforce, ServiceNow or similar BSS/OSS and enterprise platforms
·       Exposure to CRM, CPQ, contact center and service management platforms
·       Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Rally, MS Project, Power BI, Tableau, Excel-based models or other project management and visualization platforms
·       Experience with process mining tools such as Celonis, Signavio or similar platforms
·       Certifications such as Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Scrum, SAFe, eTOM or PMP are advantageous

Roles & Responsibilities
·       Own defined modules or workstreams within Lean Telco engagements, from current state assessments to future state definition through recommendation development and execution planning

jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We are:
Accenture’s Talent Reinvention Partner and we’re helping clients reinvent how people and organizations work, delivering leadership, talent, operating models, workforce intelligence, and change solutions to accelerate the workforce agenda in the age of AI. We develop forward thinking leaders who can lead effectively in an AI augmented workplace and navigate change with confidence. Our team is at the forefront of talent, HR, and organizational consulting, supporting clients across AI-enabled learning reinvention, capability transformation, skills strategy, and workforce performance.

You are:
A learning strategy consultant who delivers exceptional client work while building the foundation for a long-term advisory career. At the Consultant level, your first responsibility is delivery excellence: you work within project workstreams with rigor and produce the quality of output that makes clients trust Accenture to come back. You build strong relationships with your client counterparts at the delivery and program level, and you engage senior stakeholders with confidence when working alongside your Manager or Senior Manager. Your consulting toolkit is sharp: you think in hypotheses, structure complex problems with discipline, craft compelling narratives from your analysis, and write slides that make senior audiences lean in. You bring genuine depth in learning strategy: you know how to connect learning investment to business outcomes and demonstrate its impact with data. And you are genuinely excited about what AI is doing to the learning field: you track how best practices are shifting, you use AI tools in your own work every day, and you are always thinking about how to bring clients and Accenture’s practice to the frontier of what is possible.

The work:
- Lead day-to-day delivery of learning strategy engagements, managing workstreams, timelines, quality, and team coordination to ensure excellent client outcomes
- Build strong working relationships with client delivery counterparts, operating as a reliable and credible day-to-day partner throughout engagements
- Apply hypothesis-driven, structured problem-solving approaches to decompose complex learning and workforce capability challenges into clear, actionable insights
- Advise clients on learning vision, strategy, and operating model design, repositioning L&D as a strategic enabler of business performance and workforce reinvention
- Work on  learning capability diagnostics and needs assessments to identify gaps, benchmark against market-leading practices, and develop prioritized transformation roadmaps
- Design AI-enabled learning operating models that embed automation, personalization, and analytics, spanning governance, roles, processes, technology, and vendor relationships
- Connect learning strategy to business performance outcomes, defining measurement frameworks, learning KPIs, and analytics approaches that clearly demonstrate L&D’s impact and ROI
- Shape and deliver agentic learning strategies, helping clients embed AI-powered performance support and intelligent enablement tools into the everyday flow of work
- Develop executive-ready presentations, frameworks, and deliverables that communicate complex strategies with clarity and precision to senior audiences
- Stay at the forefront of how AI is transforming the learning field, tracking emerging trends, developing points of view, and contributing to Accenture’s intellectual property and go-to-market capabilities in a rapidly evolving advisory market

Contribute to business development through proposal writing, RFP responses, and thought leadership for the Learning Performance & Innovation offering

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in learning strategy, organizational capability development, or talent consulting
- Minimum of 1 year of experience in a consulting or professional services environment
- Minimum of 1 year of experience in the Insurance Industry
- Demonstrated fluency with generative AI platforms (including ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini) as part of your day-to-day working practice; you should be able to speak concretely to how you have applied AI tools to improve the quality and speed of your deliverables
- Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality
- Core consulting skills: structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, executive storytelling, and high-quality slide and document writing
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with clients at the delivery and program level
- Be ready to build those air miles with travel as needed

Bonus points if:
- You have experience designing agentic learning solutions or embedding AI-powered performance support tools into the flow of work
- You bring expertise in learning measurement and impact frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick, Phillips ROI, learning analytics dashboards) and have demonstrated the ability to link learning programs to business outcomes
- You have contributed to business development, proposal writing, or thought leadership in the learning or talent advisory space
- You hold an advanced degree or certification in adult education, learning science, organizational development, I/O psychology, or a related field
- You have worked with or advised on HR technology platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Cornerstone) or LMS/LXP strategy and selection

Du hast die Möglichkeit, aktiv in einem oder mehreren Themenbereichen tätig zu sein.

- Netzplanung und Netzdatenmanagement
Du bist verantwortlich für die Modellierung, Parametrierung und Analyse nationaler und regionaler Netzmodelle sowie die Entwicklung und Anpassung planungs- und betriebsrelevanter Netzstrategien. Deine Aufgaben umfassen die Durchführung von Strom-, Spannungsanalysen, (N-1), (N-1)- und Common-Mode-Analysen, sowie die Simulation von Kurzschlussberechnungen, Redispatch- und Flexibilitätsmaßnahmen. Du kümmerst Dich um die Aufbereitung und Haltung von Daten zu Einspeisern, Lasten und Betriebsmitteln, um die Konsolidierung von Datenquellen und Datenhaltung zwischen Fachabteilungen und die Implementierung ingenieursspezifischer Tools zur Auswertung, Planung und Visualisierung sowie ganzheitlichen Optimierung der Netzprozesse.

- Netzdynamik & -Stabilität
Du bist verantwortlich für die Untersuchung und Analyse der dynamischen Eigenschaften des Netzes, um dessen Stabilität zu verbessern. Du erstellst Modelle für dynamische Simulationen, um das Netzverhalten unter verschiedenen Bedingungen zu simulieren. Zudem führst Du System-Stabilitätsanalysen durch, um potenzielle Stabilitätsprobleme zu identifizieren und zu beheben. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt auf Sensitivitäts- und Spannungsqualitätsanalysen, bei denen Du die Netzreaktionen auf verschiedene Einflüsse untersuchst und die Spannungsqualität verbesserst.

- Marktstudien
Du entwickelst und führst Marktanalysen im Energiebereich durch, analysierst die aktuelle Marktlage, identifizierst Trends und bewertest Marktpotenziale für neue Technologien und Geschäftsmodelle. Zusätzlich erstellst du detaillierte Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Entwicklung von Strategien zur Marktpositionierung und bereitest die Ergebnisse in Berichten und Präsentationen für interne und externe Stakeholder auf.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit dem Schwerpunkt elektrische Energietechnik
- Du verfügst über Kenntnisse der Planung und des Betriebs von Übertragungs- und Verteilnetzen
- Du kennst typische Herausforderungen bzgl. transienter Stabilität bei Betriebsmitteln (z.B. HGÜs, Konverter, Elektrolyseure, STATCOMs) und deren Bedeutung für Netzbetreiber und Hersteller
- Du hast Interesse an Netzberechnungssoftwares (NEPLAN, Integral, PowerFactory) und bist idealerweise sicher im Umgang mit MATLAB oder Python
- Du hast Freude an innovativen Themen und die Bereitschaft, sich diese eigenständig anzueignen sowie die im Beratungsumfeld notwendige Flexibilität und Mobilität
- Du sprichst mindestens sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch

The aim is to fairly compensate employees and provide benefits that support their well-being and job satisfaction.
Design processes for performing salary adjustments, providing bonus / incentives, maintaining salary and job tables and managing employee stock purchase plan.
What are we looking for? Qualification: Graduate
Process Matter Experts are deep subject matter experts and work closely with the client and GPO’S. They are the critical link between the client and the Accenture service delivery teams.
The following table lists the PME key responsibilities for each major phase of the project:
Roles and Responsibilities: Global Design:
• Provide end to end process expertise input to future state process design
• Assist the GPOs in compiling leading practices, and process design considerations incorporating build to operate efficiency design principles
• Provide input into the technology enablement (Workday) and assist in identifying automation opportunities and address process administration gaps
• Work with GPOs to documentation process narratives needed for SOP creation
Localization:
• Compile localization practices to help with localization preparation
• Participate in the localization sessions and provide process input
• Document localization requirements needed for SOP creation
Testing:
• Provide input and compile end to end process scenarios
• Participate in testing end to end processes in order to get familiarization of various system and process scenarios for SOP creation
Standard Operating Procedures Build:
• Develop SOPs for each process area
• Work with their GPOs and their client counterparts to review and validate completeness of DTP content
Training and Service Rehearsals:
• Participate in training and service rehearsal activities for their process areas
• Train BPO process SMEs
• Help the transition management teams to plan, coordinate and monitor successful execution of training and SRT
• Monitor training and service rehearsal results and progress and help the transition team resolve issues and gap
• Provide input to the creation of a Global Quality Framework with quantified measurement criteria’s in alignment with client/contractual needs
Cutover and Ongoing Operations:
• Work with the GPOs to execute process cutover activities
• Participate in ongoing continuous process improvement analyses and monitoring of process-specific KPIs
• Provide inputs to the creation of a Global Quality Framework with quantified measurement criteria’s in alignment with client/contractual needs
• Work with Service delivery leads and help them address key/critical escalations

jobs.description:
---ONLY THOSE APPLICANTS WHO ALREADY HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE AND WORK IN THIS COUNTRY ARE ELIGIBLE TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE---

POSITION TITLE: Health Operations Analyst
WORK SETUP: Return to Office

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Manages incoming or outgoing telephone calls, e-Reviews, and/or faxes, including triage, opening of cases and data entry into client system.
• Determines contract; verifies eligibility and benefits.
• Conducts a thorough provider radius search in client system and follows up with provider on referrals given.
• Checks benefits for facility-based treatment.
• Obtains intake (demographic) information from callers, e-Reviews, and/or from faxes. Processes incoming requests, collection of non-clinical information needed for review from providers, utilizing scripts to screen basic and complex requests for pre-certification and/or prior authorization.
• Performs data entry of contact into client systems and routes as appropriate.
• Matches fax/clinical records with appropriate case.
• Consolidates inputs for approval.
• Generates the needed letters as directed by the client and/or outlined in the client’s procedure manual.
• Assigns cases/activities and work within the client’s system to facilitate workflow and productivity goals.
• Refers cases requiring clinical review to a nurse reviewer. Performs case checks and reviews to ensure case creation is complete and correct for the clinician
• Tasks cases accurately to the correct queue.
• Conducts outbound scripted calls to providers to request clinical information as directed by the clinician.

OTHERS:
Project Shift Schedule: Night Shift
Project Rest Day: Weekends Off
Project/Team Location: Taguig Uptown Bonifacio Tower 3

SKILL AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Holds a current and unrestricted Philippines Registered Nurse license.
• At least 3 months of clinical experience, which can include internships or volunteer work, not necessarily only in hospitals.
• Work experience should be as a registered nurse and not from before obtaining the license or taking the board exam.
Good to have only:
• Prior experience in healthcare setting/environment such as Utilization Management, Intake Representative, Health Insurance Claims Processor or Health Outreach Specialist is highly preferred.
