jobs.description:
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .

Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
- Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.

- Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.

- Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain.

Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
- Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.

- Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.

- Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
- Strong analytical skills to reach clear-cut, methodical solutions

- Experience working with low-code/no-code or agentic orchestration platforms

- Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver clients delight

- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

- Storytelling with data and communicating AI/automation impact to non-technical stakeholders

- Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

- Ability to lead cross-functional pods integrating data scientists, process analysts, and automation engineers

- Strong team-management skills

Your experience counts!
- MBA from Tier 1 B-school

- 3-6 years of Hands-on experience developing digital twin or simulation-based prototypes to model physical products, assets, operations or supply networks, enabling scenario analysis, disruption testing and performance optimization

- Experience working on process improvement, operating model transformation, supply chain planning, manufacturing, logistics, engineering, digital transformation, data, analytics, GenAI or AI-enabled business transformation program

- Certified expertise as functional value architect for process discovery and mining tools like Celonis, Signavio, Power automate process mining

- Experience conceptualizing and deploying agentic or AI-assisted workflows for process optimization

- Experience working with GenAI, LLMs and agentic AI solutions, including prompt engineering, model orchestration, AI copilots, multi-agent workflows and LLM-based insight generation

- Exposure to Digital Thread, Digital Twin, Connected Twin, control tower, supply network visibility, simulation, IoT-enabled operations, product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, scenario planning, network modelling or supply chain decision intelligence programs is preferred

jobs.title: Analyst/Consultant in Chemicals and Natural Resources Industry Groups
jobs.description:
The chemical and natural resources industries are undergoing a fundamental transformation as sustainability, circular economy principles, and digitalization reshape their future – creating both significant challenges related to regulatory pressure, cost competitiveness, and operational complexity, while also creating substantial opportunities for innovation, efficiency improvements, and sustainable growth. Across both industries, we partner with clients to strengthen operational resilience, enable responsible production, drive operational excellence, and realize value through digitalization, advanced analytics, and end‑to‑end value chain optimization.
We seek experienced professionals with strong communication skills—fluent in English and preferably at least one additional language—and the ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights. Our success is built on trusted client relationships and close collaboration with our global delivery centers to deliver measurable, transformative outcomes.

THE WORK:
No two days at Accenture are alike, but your typical day may include:
- Work on innovative initiatives that help Chemicals and Natural Resources clients transform, grow, and adapt in an increasingly digital world.

- Translate complex business requirements into intelligent, innovative, and harmonized solutions that drive transformation across Chemicals and Natural Resources clients.

- Collaborate within multidisciplinary, globally distributed teams, seamlessly combining business insight with technology expertise.

- Manage and grow client relationships by delivering deep industry insights across Chemicals and Natural Resources, including Metals, Mining, Forest Products, and Building Materials.

- Build new consulting capabilities by contributing to digital transformation and analytics initiatives, supporting client proposals, and maintaining strong, up‑to‑date industry knowledge.

- Working flexibly — primarily remotely within the Intelligent Consulting Hub Europe (ICH) model, but also ready to travel and collaborate onsite with clients across Europe and beyond when project needs require.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:
- Background and/or experience in the Chemicals and Natural Resources industries. Solid understanding of end-to-end value chains—from commercial functions through supply chain operations.
- Experience working in core business functions and/or ERP platforms (such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Oracle ERP Cloud), CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
- Experience working in a multinational environment, collaborating with diverse, cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.
- Hands‑on experience using digital technologies such as IoT, cloud platforms, analytics, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
- Highly driven and resilient, with the ability to perform under pressure, embrace challenges, and deliver results; excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

​
BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:
- Experience with Jira, Confluence, LeanKit, Planbox, Python
- Knowledge of German, Spanish or French.
- Hands‑on experience delivering large‑scale ERP programs within Chemicals or Natural Resources Industries, covering key implementation phases including process blueprinting, system configuration, system and user acceptance testing (SIT/UAT), data migration, cutover planning, and go‑live support.

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Competitive salary through employment contract (Umowa o pracę) with benefits package.
- Accenture employees are eligible to participate in the Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), which allows them to buy Accenture shares at a 15% discount compared to the market price. Employees who enroll automatically become eligible for quarterly dividend payments on their shares.
- A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification).
- Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.
- Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.
- Paid employee referral program.
- Private medical care, life insurance.
- Access to the WorkSmile platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card).

WHAT WE BELIEVE:

Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law.
All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

? Min 7-11 years of demonstrated work experience in managing 10+ analysts

? Proven experience in utilizing processes and tools to drive the reporting team in completing tactical tasks and meeting SLA delivery.
? Demonstrated understanding of stakeholder mapping (including other Accenture teams and Meta POC) and cross-functional interactions to facilitate comprehensive solutions.
? Ensure high-quality service delivery by managing critical points and enhancing the execution of individual tasks.
? In-depth understanding of root causes of potential problems and timely escalation of risks to the manager.
? Ability to guide the team in resolving out-of-DTP situations and solving complex issues under pressure.
? Collaborate to solve complex scenarios and inspire a proactive spirit within the team.

? Adaptable, especially during month, quarter, and year-end closings.
? Fluent in English, both oral and written, to effectively communicate with clients and teams.
? Possesses exceptional business acumen to effectively guide the reporting team.

• Process vendor payment runs as per the defined schedule following parameters given in Desktop procedure
• Managing bank portals for uploading statements and extracting statements
• Process urgent payment in agreed timeframe availing all required approvals
• Ensure quality review of the payment proposals. Ensure Prepayment and post payment validations are performed
• Co-ordinate with Vendor master team to manage the invoices/vendor hold
• Confirm Payment run is debited from the bank account
• Ensure next payment runs is performed post bank reconciliation is done by RTR side
• Co-ordinate with banking team to manage payment exceptions and vendor refunds
• Generate payment remittance advice and ensure these are sent to the vendors on timely basis
• Marinating relevant payment approval audit trail for audit and compliance purposes
• Perform Duplicate audit check
• Do the RCAs for duplicate or erroneous payment
• Maintaining duplicate audit tracker until duplicate payments are received
• Keep documentation update
• Manage periodic audit
• Ensure compliance to policies and procedure
• Ensure adequacy of process controls being in place
• Moderate to no travel depending on project involvement.

Designation: Procure to Pay Operations Analyst
Qualifications: Any Graduation
Years of Experience: 3 to 5 years
About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
What would you do? • The Invoice Processing Team ensures accurate and timely processing of invoices, verifying them against purchase orders and receipts in compliance with company policies and tax regulations. The team maintains efficient financial operations, resolves discrepancies, and contributes to process improvements, supporting smooth accounts payable functions and strong vendor relationships.
What are we looking for? • Bachelors degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
• Experience in invoice processing, accounts payable, or finance-related roles.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain a high degree of accuracy.
• Basic knowledge of accounting principles and financial documentation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (SAP, Oracle,)
• Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Possesses exceptional business acumen to effectively guide the reporting team
Roles and Responsibilities: • Invoice Processing & Validation
• Process vendor invoices and credit notes within agreed timelines, including urgent invoices requiring priority handling.
• Validate invoice details for accuracy and completeness; identify non-compliant invoices and route them to the appropriate stakeholders for correction.
• Process both PO-based invoices using 2-way, 3-way matching and Non-PO invoices following required approval workflows.
• Ensure invoice data is correctly captured in the ERP, workflow system.
• Apply basic accounting knowledge to assess impacts on supplier ledgers, including invoices, credit memos, and discounts.
• Ensure adherence to country-specific tax and VAT requirements by reviewing invoice information carefully.
• Conduct quality checks for invoices and credit notes to ensure accuracy and compliance with internal rules.
• Maintain updated documentation and support periodic audits with required records.
• Ensure full compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls, while contributing to maintaining strong process governance.
• Issue Resolution, Handling exceptions
• Raise queries with internal business partners or suppliers when parking invoices, ensuring the correct reason codes are used.
• Perform multiple follow-ups via email or phone to resolve held, parked, or stuck invoices in accordance with business guidelines.
• Manage exceptions, GR or IR balances, vendor debit balances, direct debits, and invoices on hold, ensuring timely resolution..

Any Graduation

jobs.title: OT Analyst/Consultant (Remote)
jobs.description:
Accenture is a global collective of innovators whose aim is to improve the way the world works and lives. Empowered with innovative tools, continuous learning and a global community of diverse talent, we drive success in new business architecture that disrupts conventional practices. And we are looking to add an experienced Operational Technology (OT) Transformation Security Specialist to an already outstanding team.

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond to, and recover, at all points of the security lifecycle. We hire the very best security talent and arm them with the coolest tools and latest tech so they can help our clients build resilience as we create integrated, customized turnkey solutions. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

You Are passionate about security, love what you do and have a genuine desire to outsmart the bad guys. You have the experience to analyze a clients’ security posture, anticipate security requirements and help find right-sized solutions based on industry leading practices. You have a proven track record working successfully in a fast-paced, agile environment.

The Work is an exciting opportunity to lead, influence and execute on OT security engagements in critical infrastructure and/or mission critical industry environments. In this role, you will research, analyze, and report on a broad range of cyber threats OT across all industries.  Specifically, the threat actors who target OT, their tactics, techniques, and procedures, related geopolitical motivations, national security consequences, and impact from emerging technologies.  This role involves in-depth research and collaboration with each of the Industry Intelligence and Analysis teams to produce finished operational and strategic cyber intelligence products, specifically focused on OT.
Ideal candidates for this category have previous experience, one or more of the following:
- Intelligence analysis and reporting using various cyber intelligence models and frameworks is also desired OT security sensor/tool deployment,

- OT networks, systems, and devices and how convergence, integration, and digitalization impact the OT attack surface throughout multiple industries OT security program/governance development.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

H ere's what you need
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

- Minimum 5 years of experience analyzing, producing, and briefing operational and/or strategic cybersecurity threat intelligence products.

- Minimum 2 years of experience working with OT networks, systems, assets, devices, and security solutions.

- Minimum 2 years of Operational Technology (OT) and/or Industrial Control Systems (ICS) consulting experience.

- Minimum 2 years of experience working with industrial technologies and environments, including Industrial Control Systems (ICS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), and related industrial automation technologies.

- Minimum 2 years of experience with OT/ICS architectures, industrial communication protocols, and IT/OT convergence.

Bonus points if you have
- Minimum 2 years of experience providing consulting services to clients with experience in relevant industry verticals such as Oil and Gas, Utilities, Manufacturing, Chemical, and Healthcare.

- Minimum 2 years of experience working with security analysis techniques, identifying indicators of compromise, threat hunting, and identification of intrusions and potential incidents.

- Minimum 2 years of experience in deploying or supporting OT security sensors in operational environments.

- Minimum 2 years of experience working in SOC's with security tooling such as OT NSM's, SIEMs, Endpoint Security tools for Operational Environments.

Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Security Assessment and Authorisation (A&A) consultant, to perform security risk management and assurance activities across systems, applications, and third-party services. The role ensures that systems meet required security standards; risks are properly assessed and documented, and appropriate authority to operate (ATO) are obtained and maintained.

This position works closely with system owners, architects, project teams, cybersecurity specialists, and compliance stakeholders to guide them through the A&A lifecycle and ensure alignment with organisational, regulatory, and Australian government frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:
- Security Risk Management
- Conduct risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and mitigate security risks across projects and operational environments.

- Facilitate risk workshops with stakeholders to capture and validate security risks.

- Monitor and report on risk status, treatment progress, and residual risk to governance forums.

- Ensure security controls are implemented and tested to mitigate identified risks effectively.

- Help project manage day to day tasks with the manager and program leads.

- Security Assessment and Authorisation
- Execute system security authorisation processes in accordance with ISM (Information Security Manual) and the client's security requirements, including Risk Management Framework (RMF) steps.

- Prepare and maintain risk assessments, and accreditation documentation.

- Ensure compliance with security controls for governance, identification, protection, detection, and response functions.

- Maintaning Compliance
- Develop and maintain security documentation as per the client's security guidelines (e.g., security policies, procedures, incident response plans).

- Support compliance obligations by adhering to ISMAustralian Government’s security compliance requirements for classified and controlled information handling.

- Maintain accurate records of security authorisations, exceptions, and audit evidence for accreditation reviews.

- Stakeholder Engagement
- Liaise with Authorising Officers, system owners, and project teams to ensure security documentation meets the client's required standards.

- Provide guidance on ISM, Essential Eight, and the Department’s specific security controls during project delivery.

- Monitoring & Reporting
- Support in establishment and ongoing management of GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) tooling.

- Track and report on security authorisation status, documentation, deliverables, and compliance gaps.

- Assist in continuous monitoring activities and maintain documentation for audits and inspections.

Qualifications and Skills:
- Education & Certifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field.

- Certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, IRAP Assessor, or equivalent security accreditation experience preferred.

- Technical Knowledge
- Strong understanding of Australian PSPF and ISM cybersecurity principles and NIST guidelines (Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond).

- Deep understanding of the Essential 8 requirements for classified information and processes.

- Experience with security documentation (Accreditation packages).

- Skills
- Excellent documentation and organisational skills with attention to detail.

- Ability to interpret and apply ISM and security controls in practical scenarios.

- Experience in collaboration tools (e.g., SharePoint, Confluence)

- Familiarity with security GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) platforms.

- Strong communication skills for engaging operational and business stakeholders.

Security Clearance
- Active/Inactive NV1 Security Clearance

- Australian Citizens with ability to obtain a clearance considered

Must be willing to work onsite 5 days a week

This role plays a crucial role in the planning, coordination, and execution of training programs within an organization. Their responsibilities typically include a mix of administrative, analytical and coordination tasks to ensure that learning and development activities run smoothly.

Work Experience:

• Professional experience of minimum 3years and above in service environment

• MS Office skills: Ability to understand and make sense of large amounts of data in a complex environment, strong Excel & Word skills, working knowledge of other MS Office Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint & One Note) applications, ability to comprehend and quickly learn client data bases / menu based systems and ability to present data in a comprehensible format
• Client Interfacing skills (Email & Phone): Good Email etiquette, strong email drafting & keyboard skills and good phone etiquette / technique
• English language proficiency: Strong written & verbal communication skills - grammar, right word choice, sentence structure, precise / relevant content, smooth thought flow and the ability to present more information in a short span of time / space sensibly
• Good organizational, prioritisation and multi-tasking skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Multi-cultural awareness.
• Passion for customer service.
• Team player.
• Attention to detail.
• Focus on high data accuracy.
• Quality driven – in communications and all system transactions.
• Ability to deal with customer complaints in a professional and friendly manner and escalate where appropriate.

• (9 am to 5 pm) Australian time"

What would you do? • Senior Scheduling Analyst holds a more advanced position within the learning and development team, often taking on greater responsibilities and leadership roles which includes overseeing the planning and coordination of large-scale training programs and events and collaborate with senior leadership to forecast training needs and allocate resources effectively.

• This role plays a crucial role in the planning, coordination, and execution of training programs within an organization. Their responsibilities typically include a mix of administrative, analytical and coordination tasks to ensure that learning and development activities run smoothly.
What are we looking for? • Bachelor s degree - BA, BCom, BSc, BTech
• • LMS experience of 1.5 years.
• • Strong knowledge of typical scheduling methodology
• • Professional experience of minimum 3years and above in service environment
• • MS Office skills: Ability to understand and make sense of large amounts of data in a complex environment, strong Excel & Word skills, working knowledge of other MS Office Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint & One Note) applications, ability to comprehend and quickly learn client data bases , menu based systems and ability to present data in a comprehensible format
Roles and Responsibilities: • • Oversee the planning and coordination of large-scale training programs and events.
• • Collaborate with senior leadership to forecast training needs and allocate resources effectively.
• • Coordinate with trainers, instructors, and external vendors to ensure availability and timely delivery of training sessions.
• • Book and manage training venues, facilities, and necessary equipment. Manage and update the organization s LMS, including course setup, user enrollment, and tracking of training completion.
• • Generate and analyze reports on training activities, completion rates, and participant feedback using the LMS.
• • Troubleshoot and resolve any technical issues related to the LMS if needed. Respond to incoming mail in the Scheduling mailbox and respond within the timeframes stated in agreement and processes.
• • Contact vendors, external instructors, facility owners etc. to arrange and confirm class schedules.
• • Serve as a point of contact for training-related inquiries from employees, managers, and external partners.
• • Communicate training schedules, changes, and updates to relevant stakeholders promptly, Escalate potential issues to Delivery Services Management, Capability Management and or Scheduling Team Lead.
• • Respond to incoming mail in the Scheduling mailbox and respond within the timeframes stated in agreement and processes.
• • Provide leadership and guidance to junior scheduling analysts and administrative staff.
• • Assist in maintenance of resource databases , or scheduling tools, advising when known discrepancies are found.
• • Assist in Process Improvement initiatives.
• • Communicate LMS issues or potential enhancements to Delivery Management and Scheduling Team Lead.

Any Graduation

What would you do? Manage planning, procurement, distribution and aftermarket service supply chain operations, helping clients realize $5 for every $1 spent on our services
Fulfill in supply chain planning refers to the process of completing customer orders by ensuring products are picked, packed, and delivered efficiently. It involves managing inventory, coordinating logistics, and ensuring timely delivery to meet customer expectations. The goal is to ensure that orders are accurately and promptly fulfilled.
Plan the inventory or capacity that will be used to fulfill customer orders and determine transportation or delivery of the product through the supply chain.
What are we looking for? Key Responsibilities:
• Inventory Management: Monitor and manage stock levels to ensure product availability, minimizing stockouts while avoiding overstock situations.
• Replenishment Planning: Develop and execute replenishment strategies based on sales trends, forecasts, and inventory performance.
• Supplier Relations: Collaborate with suppliers to manage order cycles, lead times, and delivery schedules. Foster strong relationships to ensure smooth operations.
• Order Management: Place purchase orders in line with demand forecasts and inventory levels, ensuring timely deliveries.
• Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze sales data, stock levels, and supplier performance to make informed decisions on replenishment strategies.
• Forecasting & Planning: Work closely with the demand planning team to review and adjust forecasts based on market trends and seasonality.
• Cost Optimization: Ensure purchasing processes align with budget targets, optimizing costs without compromising on product quality or availability.
• Problem-Solving: Address and resolve supply chain disruptions, delays, or inventory discrepancies in a timely and efficient manner.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with logistics, warehouse, and sales teams
Skills & Qualifications:
• Experience: 3-4 years of experience in purchasing, replenishment buying, or supply chain management.
• Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Logistics, or a related field is preferred.
• Strong Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis, inventory management systems, and reporting tools.
• Attention to Detail: Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
• Supplier Management: Experience working directly with suppliers to negotiate terms, resolve issues, and manage relationships.
• Software Proficiency: Familiarity with inventory management software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Excel) and advanced Excel skills.
• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and external partners.
• Problem-Solving Ability: Quick to identify issues and implement effective solutions.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Accenture CyberSecurity helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond and recover across all aspects of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business and industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, end‑to‑end solutions tailored to our clients’ needs across their entire value chain, helping them build cyber resilience and grow with confidence.

We are seeking a highly qualified professional to join our team as a Cloud Security Operations Analyst . As an essential part of our Security Transformation team, you will be responsible for monitoring, investigating, and responding to cloud-native security threats across enterprise environments. We are looking for a professional with strong expertise in Cloud Security Operations, Kubernetes security, and incident response, with hands-on experience in Sysdig CNAPP and cloud-native technologies.

Qualifications
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in Security Operations, Cloud Security, or SOC environments

- Hands-on experience with Sysdig CNAPP / Sysdig Secure for security monitoring, alert triage, and incident investigation

- Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native security concepts

- Experience with vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation processes

- Knowledge of Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs), Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), and security monitoring tools

- Experience working with incident management and ticketing systems

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

- Experience operating in production environments with critical business services

- Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or Terraform

- Fluent in English (C1 or above) , with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Responsibilities
- Monitor Kubernetes runtime security across enterprise containerized environments using Sysdig CNAPP

- Investigate, triage, and respond to security alerts affecting containers, pods, and namespaces

- Analyze and optimize runtime detection rules to improve alert quality and reduce false positives

- Escalate security incidents to Application, Platform, and Infrastructure teams, providing remediation guidance and technical recommendations

- Monitor NGFW and WAF security events and support incident response activities

- Identify, analyze, and report security policy violations, misconfigurations, and configuration drift

- Coordinate remediation efforts to ensure timely resolution of identified security risks

- Manage security incidents throughout the full lifecycle, from detection to remediation and closure

- Produce operational reports, security metrics, and activity summaries for internal stakeholders

- Maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and operational procedures

- Identify opportunities for automation and future auto-remediation capabilities

- Collaborate with Security, Platform, and Infrastructure teams to enhance cloud-native security operations and runtime protection

- Participate in on-call support rotations and respond to critical production security incidents

Nice to Have
- Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification

- Kubernetes certifications such as KCNA, CKA, or CKS

- Sysdig Certified Security Analyst certification

Additional Information
Location: Porto (Hybrid)
On-Call Requirement: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to support critical security incidents outside business hours
Travel: Flexibility for occasional travel across Europe for project deliveries and client meetings is required.

The role requires strong process knowledge, adherence to controls, timely delivery against SLAs, and effective coordination with internal stakeholders
What are we looking for? Qualifications: Bachelor - degree with Finance specialization
Years of Experience :3 to 5 years
Roles and Responsibilities: •Key Responsibilities
Order to Cash Operations
• Must act as an subject matter expert for the team, should be able to handle team and client queries
• Execute end-to-end O2C transactions in line with documented SOPs and client requirements.
• Demonstrate good understanding of interdependencies between Billing, AR, Cash Application, and Reconciliations.
• Handle routine issues independently and escalate complex exceptions appropriately.
Billing
• Create and process accurate customer invoices as per contract terms, SLAs, and pricing structures.
• Perform billing validations to ensure correctness of quantities, rates, taxes, and customer details.
• Identify, analyze, and resolve billing discrepancies in coordination with upstream teams.
Accounts Receivable (AR)
• Maintain customer accounts and perform AR postings including invoices, adjustments, credit/debit notes.
• Monitor aging reports, open items, and account balances.
• Support initiatives to improve cash flow and AR hygiene by resolving aged items.
Cash Applications
• Apply customer payments accurately using remittance advice and bank statements.
• Process payments received through lockbox, wire transfer, ACH, and electronic platforms.
• Analyze and resolve unapplied, unidentified, short, and overpayments within agreed timelines.
Reconciliations
• Perform bank, cash, and AR reconciliations with minimal supervision.
• Investigate variances and ensure timely clearance of reconciling items.
• Support month-end close activities and balance validations.

Key Skills & Competencies
Functional & Technical Skills
• Strong working knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) processes
• Hands-on experience in:
o Billing & Invoicing
o Accounts Receivable (AR)
o Cash Applications
o Reconciliations
• Experience with SAP ERP systems
• Proficient in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, aging analysis)
Behavioral & Professional Skills
• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
• Ability to work independently with limited supervision
• Effective communication with internal teams and clients
• Time management and SLA-driven mindset

jobs.title: Strategy & Consulting - Automotive Practice - CRM Manager
jobs.description:
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you an outcome-oriented problem solver? Do you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clients? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then, Accenture Strategy and Consulting is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.

The Practice – A Brief Sketch
GN Automotive Practice has deep expertise in delivering Digital Transformations, Sales & Operations Planning, Salesforce Consulting, SAP Transformation, Spare Parts & Warranty Management, Service Process Excellence, Connected Vehicles, Dealer performance Management, Process Automation & Digitization, Software Enablement, Zero Based Spend & Spend analysis, Peer Benchmarking, Value Architecture, Process Improvement, IoT and Industry Analytics

Let’s infuse fresh thinking in the systems and turn new ideas into reality. As a part of the team, you’ll help drive the following:
- Deliver consulting projects using Techno-Functional Consulting background in Salesforce CRM in automotive context (Automotive Cloud/ sales cloud/service cloud/marketing cloud
- Be a part of the Intelligent Functions team , one of the key capabilities or sub-industry areas to support Platforms-driven business design and assessment such as value assessment, business case creation, business process re-engineering and so on.
- Provide solutions for complex client problems across the Salesforce landscape throughout the project lifecycle, providing subject matter expertise with a strong strategic awareness of the SFDC market and associated technologies.
- Work as a lead Salesforce Functional Solution Architect and support with solutions for end-to-end request for proposal requests.
- Engage with clients in understanding their requirements, scoping, discovering and defining solutions , explaining business benefits and use cases and developing a roadmap to meet their goals.
- Create innovative solution designs that utilize our extensive service offerings.
- Support our business development activities , working with our sales teams in proposal generation, shaping the solution plan and delivery approach for Salesforce transformations.
- Be responsible for integration with different CRM Solutions including Salesforce and create proof of concepts as and when required.

Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
- Problem-solving skills to identify, escalate, track and resolve issues in time
- Strong project management skills and ability to run projects on his own
- Effective presentation and public speaking skills
- Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment where continuous innovation is desired
- Ability to effectively team with others in a large, global organization
- Analytical skills to bring clarity to complex issues and gather data-driven insights
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Cross cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment
- Manage and work with key stakeholders onshore and onsite

Your experience counts!
- MBA from Tier 1 and 2 business school
- Must have Industry Expertise in Automotive around functions such as
- Sales
- Aftersales (Customer Service)
- Dealerships
- Production and Logistics
- Warranty
- Spare Parts
- Procurement and Supply Chain
- Deep knowledge and experience in Salesforce application/modules/ functional expertise:
- Business process design, operational performance improvement, business value case development experience focusing on CRM, Customer Service, Sales & marketing (expertise in one or more techno-functional roles for platform implementation)
- Experience in supporting RFP, putting together solutions/value propositions which can be presented to client stakeholders.
- Process Transformation: Involves defining key performance indicators and associated work practices and collecting, managing and reporting monthly/quarterly on regional status

Job Summary:

Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:

- Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.
- Leverage proficiency in instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, content design, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.

An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
- Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.

jobs.title: Business Consultant Management
jobs.description:
Business Consultant — Workforce Software Implementation

As a Management Level 8 Business Consultant specialising in Workforce Software implementation, you will play a pivotal role in delivering workforce management transformation for clients across a range of industries. You will combine deep product knowledge with strong consulting skills to design and deploy solutions that optimise scheduling, time and attendance, absence management, and labour analytics. This senior role requires a blend of technical configuration expertise, business process acumen, and confident client leadership.
In this role you will
- Lead the full implementation lifecycle for Workforce Software, acting as the senior functional lead for client engagements.
- Partner with client HR, Operations, and IT teams to understand workforce management challenges and define optimised future-state solutions.
- Facilitate discovery workshops and process mapping sessions to capture scheduling rules, leave policies, pay rules, and compliance requirements.
- Design and configure Workforce Software modules including Time & Attendance, Scheduling, Absence Management, Forecasting, and Analytics.
- Develop integration designs for connections between Workforce Software and payroll, HRIS, and ERP platforms.
- Manage UAT cycles, coordinate test scripts and defect resolution, and drive client sign-off activities.
- Produce high-quality project artefacts including functional specifications, configuration workbooks, data migration plans, and training content.
- Support data migration activities including extraction, transformation, and validation of historical time and attendance records.
- Provide hyper-care support post-go-live and ensure effective knowledge transfer to client system administrators.
- Contribute to internal capability building through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and participation in practice development initiatives.
- Support business development by contributing to RFP responses, solution demonstrations, and client workshops during the pre-sales process.

We are looking for experience in the following skills
- Hands-on implementation experience with Workforce Software (WorkForce Suite / EmpCenter) or equivalent enterprise WFM platforms such as UKG, Kronos, or Ceridian Dayforce.
- Strong understanding of workforce management concepts including pay rule configuration, scheduling algorithms, leave accruals, and labour law compliance.
- Proven ability to gather and document complex business requirements and translate them into functional design specifications.
- Experience configuring time and attendance rules, shift patterns, overtime policies, and absence entitlements within a WFM platform.
- Familiarity with integration frameworks connecting WFM tools to payroll, HR, and ERP systems.
- Solid project delivery experience, with the ability to manage workstreams, track milestones, and proactively manage risks.
- Strong data skills, including experience with data mapping, transformation, and validation during system implementations.
- Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with confidence presenting to senior client stakeholders and operational teams.
- Experience supporting testing phases including SIT, UAT, and parallel run activities.
- Knowledge of relevant employment legislation, award interpretation, or enterprise agreements relevant to WFM configuration is highly desirable.
- Set Yourself Apart
- Workforce Software product certification or formal training accreditation.
- Experience delivering WFM implementations within complex, multi-site, or heavily unionised environments.
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities across multiple client engagements simultaneously.
- Exposure to workforce analytics and reporting configuration, including labour cost dashboards and compliance reporting.
- Experience supporting cloud migration or version upgrade projects for WFM platforms.
- Strong commercial instinct with the ability to identify and manage scope changes professionally.
- Background in operational environments (retail, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics) that strengthens appreciation of workforce management challenges.
- A consultative mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions, propose innovative solutions, and build lasting client relationships.

Designation: Business Advisory Analyst

About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. What would you do? The Vendor Program Manager / Configuration Management Analyst supports Azure hardware and networking programs through execution of networking BOM operations, product data management, engineering change management, product data readiness, and deployment readiness activities. This role helps maintain accurate network product structures, drives data quality across enterprise systems, and supports timely execution of networking-related changes needed for infrastructure readiness and scale.
What are we looking for? Years of Experience Required: 3+ overall years of experience in the field.
Degrees or certifications required: No degree is required to be eligible for this role, but an engineering degree is highly preferred.
Disqualifiers: Candidates without experience working closely with engineering teams and a cloud engineering background will not be eligible for the role.
Best vs. Average: The ideal resume would contain previous experience leading network calls or holding weekly meetings/scrums/workshops.
Performance Indicators: Performance will be assessed based on triage success and ensuring SKU builders have all data available as needed, fully functioning and timely updated PBIs

Top 4 Hard Skills Required + Years of Experience
Minimum 3 years experience with cloud engineering background.
Minimum 3 years experience with ticketing systems (preferably ADO) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools
Minimum 3 years hands-on experience with Microsoft PowerBI
Minimum 3 years experience with Engineering Change Management or program management for engineering teams

This role provides the opportunity to Work in a large Cloud Hardware Product Master Data Management Team supporting processes, data, and project governance.
High impact on product and teams.
Roles and Responsibilities: Create, maintain, and update Network BOMs, sourcing BOMs, supplier part numbers, and manufacturer part numbers in approved product data systems.
Execute ECOs, VCOs, and engineering change requests supporting networking hardware releases.
Support deployment-critical networking updates, firmware changes, security updates, and power-on readiness activities.
Investigate and resolve product data quality issues, BOM discrepancies, and configuration defects.
Partner with engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, qualification, and program management teams to ensure timely execution of networking deliverables.
Manage and triage operational work items and requests related to networking hardware data.
Maintain documentation, process compliance, audit readiness, and governance standards across networking data domains.
Contribute to KPI reporting, SLA tracking, process improvements, and automation opportunities.
Support Network & SAN / networking rack cabinet ECO reviews by ensuring correct project classification, reviewer alignment, and product data completeness.
Purpose of the Team: The purpose of this team is specialized and dedicated BOM creation and SKU processing, in a Cloud Product Data Management Engineering group.
Key projects: This role will support in managing the triage process for tickets between engineering teams to go through tickets specializing in build SKUs, support process improvement, and PowerBI maintenance & development.
Typical task breakdown and operating rhythm: The role will consist of:
Daily triage support and to coordinate between teams, identify what is needed, also support PBI maintenance and development adjusting to data requirements or process changes
Need to understand cloud engineering on top of PM

Any Graduation

jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you a master's student who wants to contribute to strategic innovation and digital transformation in the public sector?
At Accenture Netherlands, you'll work on a wide range of challenges facing government and public organizations, from developing digitalization strategies and improving public service delivery, to analyzing emerging technologies and guiding organizational change. Experienced consultants will coach you in conducting analyses, structuring complex problems, and translating insights into concrete recommendations for our clients.
Your primary focus will be on the public sector, but as part of the broader Health & Public Services (HPS) team, you'll also gain exposure to healthcare projects; broadening your perspective on strategic transformation across both domains.
Duration: 4 to 6 months, starting in February or March.
How to apply: Submit your CV and a cover letter (preferably in Dutch) explaining your interest in Accenture Netherlands and this internship. Please clearly indicate your preferred start date, the length of your internship, and whether you are applying for a work placement or a thesis internship.
What you'll do
As an intern, you'll work alongside consultants on projects for public sector organizations such as ministries, government executive agencies, and institutions in the field of justice and safety. You'll explore how public services can be made faster and more accessible, how processes can be redesigned more efficiently, or how digital technology can be applied responsibly.
You'll learn to develop and substantiate strategies through structured analysis. Your contributions may lead to reduced costs, shorter throughput times, improved digital service delivery, or more efficient processes for our clients.
What to expect
Working internship: You'll have the opportunity to shape your own experience and explore your personal interests. You'll contribute to various projects including business analyses, stakeholder and market analyses, support in developing business proposals, and research into client systems and functionalities. You are encouraged to bring your own ideas and initiatives, so you can challenge yourself and get the most out of your internship.
Thesis internship: It is also possible — in consultation with your supervisor — to combine your internship with writing your thesis. You are encouraged to choose a topic that aligns with your studies and adds value to one of our clients. You'll receive all the guidance and resources needed to complete your thesis while continuing to contribute to the HPS team.
How we reinvent
This internship sits within our Industry & Enterprise Strategy practice, where we combine deep sector expertise with advanced technology to deliver 360° value for our clients. You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team working on the future of intelligent public services, leveraging our global network, platforms, and partnerships to bring ideas to life.

Job Qualifications

What we're looking for
Education: Currently enrolled in a master's program at a Dutch university for the full duration of the internship. Preferred fields of study include Public or Business Administration, Political Science, Law, Healthcare/Life Sciences, or closely related disciplines.
Skills: Affinity with public administration, governance, and/or the public sector; you actively follow the latest developments in policy, technology, and digital government.
Mindset: Ambitious and proactive, naturally critical and analytical, a strong communicator, and a team player.
Bonus points: Involvement in extracurricular activities such as student organizations, Defensity College, Society College, De Kleine Consultant, etc.
Location: Amsterdam
Languages: Fluent Dutch and English required
What we offer
Learning opportunities: Access to our Learning & Development Platform.
Guidance: Support from a dedicated internship supervisor (People Lead) and a buddy.
Culture & Community: You'll be part of an open culture that actively encourages you to get the most out of your internship. Through close guidance and support, you'll quickly find your footing within both HPS and Accenture NL. Your week will offer a balanced mix of personal development and informal interaction with colleagues at all levels. The more proactive and assertive you are, the more you'll take away from your internship.
Extras: Competitive internship allowance and travel expense reimbursement.

jobs.description:
Internship – AI & Data – Industry & Enterprise

Are you passionate about AI and Data and looking for an internship where you can do more than observe from the sidelines?

Do you want to experience how AI solutions move from an idea or prototype to something that is actually used by customers, employees and businesses? And would you like to learn what it means to work in a professional environment alongside experienced Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Consultants?

Then an internship within Accenture’s AI & Data practice could be the right place to start.

At Accenture, you will have the opportunity to contribute to real-world AI and Data projects for some of Belgium’s and the world’s leading organizations. You will learn from experienced professionals, develop your technical and consulting skills and discover how multidisciplinary teams turn new technologies into tangible business impact.

Your job

As an AI & Data Intern, you will become part of one of our project or capability teams. You won’t simply be given an isolated academic exercise: wherever possible, you will contribute to a real business challenge, client project, prototype or AI solution alongside experienced Accenture colleagues.

Your internship will give you the opportunity to see first-hand how AI is built and applied in a professional environment including the technical challenges, but also topics such as business value, user needs, security, Responsible AI, testing, governance and change management.

Depending on your background, interests and the project you join, you may:

- Contribute to real AI & Data projects, working together with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Architects, Consultants and client teams.

- Help explore and develop solutions using technologies such as Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision or advanced analytics.

- Work with data: exploring datasets, developing analyses, preparing data, building prototypes or supporting the development and evaluation of AI models.

- Experiment with LLMs and AI agents, including prompting, RAG, tool use, evaluation and other techniques used to build reliable enterprise AI solutions.

- Help translate a business challenge into an AI or Data use case and understand how technical choices connect to actual user and business needs.

- Participate in different stages of the project lifecycle: from problem definition and experimentation to design, development, testing, evaluation and potentially deployment.

- Learn how AI solutions are developed within the realities of a large organization, taking into account areas such as security, privacy, Responsible AI, architecture, scalability and regulation.

- Use modern AI tools in your own daily work to research, prototype, analyze information and accelerate the creation of deliverables.

- Share your findings and present your work to your project team and other stakeholders.

You will receive guidance from experienced colleagues throughout your internship. At the same time, we expect you to be curious, take initiative, ask questions and gradually take ownership of your work.

The exact focus of your internship will depend on your skills and interests. Some internships will be more technical and engineering-oriented, while others may focus more on AI strategy, functional analysis, data analysis or project delivery.

What you will learn

An internship with us is an opportunity to take your first steps into the professional world while working in one of the fastest-moving areas of technology.
You will learn:
- How AI & Data projects are delivered in practice — beyond what you learn at university.

- How multidisciplinary teams collaborate to solve complex business and technology problems.

- How to turn an experiment or prototype into a robust solution that can work for real users.

- How to structure problems, communicate your ideas and present your work professionally.

- How organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.

- How consultants work with clients, manage expectations and turn technology into measurable business value.

- How to work with modern development practices, tools and collaborative platforms.

Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to learn by doing, supported by people who work with AI & Data every day.

Your Team
You will join Accenture’s AI & Data practice in Belgium, a community of professionals working at the intersection of business, data and technology. We help organizations use Data and AI to reinvent how they operate, make decisions, serve their customers and create new products and services.

Our teams work with clients across industries including Financial Services, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Industrial, Telecommunications, Resources and Public Services. This variety means you can experience something that is difficult to reproduce in an academic environment: applying AI to complex real-world problems, with real data, real users and real constraints.

You will work in a diverse and collaborative environment alongside colleagues with backgrounds ranging from Data Science and Computer Science to Engineering, Business and Strategy. Beyond your project, you will also become part of our wider AI & Data community, where colleagues exchange ideas, share new technologies and continuously learn from each other.

Your background

We are not looking for someone who already knows everything about AI. We are looking for people who are curious, motivated and eager to learn.

You are:

- Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Business Engineering or another relevant field.

- Passionate about AI, Data and technology and interested in understanding how they can be applied to real-world problems.

- Analytical and comfortable breaking down complex problems into manageable pieces.

- Curious and willing to learn new technologies, methods and industries quickly.

- Comfortable working as part of a team and open to giving and receiving feedback.

- Able to communicate your ideas clearly and willing to interact with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

- You’re perfectly fluent in English, Dutch/French and can express yourself in French/Dutch;

Our offer

An internship at Accenture is an opportunity to combine the learning environment of university with the reality of one of the world’s leading technology and consulting organizations.

You can expect:

- Real world experience: contribute to meaningful AI & Data work instead of only theoretical exercises.

- Coaching and mentorship: learn directly from experienced AI, Data and consulting professionals.

- Continuous learning: access to Accenture knowledge, training, technology partnerships and learning resources.

- Professional development: improve not only your technical capabilities, but also your communication, teamwork, presentation and problem-solving skills.

- Exposure to leading organizations: discover how large companies are adopting AI and dealing with the challenges of bringing it into production.

- A strong AI community: connect with colleagues who share your interest in AI and Data and work across many different technologies and industries.

- A diverse and international environment: collaborate with people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

- A first look at consulting: discover whether a career at the intersection of technology, business and AI is right for you.

We want your internship to be a meaningful step in your development — one where you can learn, contribute and leave with a much clearer understanding of how AI works in the real world.

Interested?

Are you ready to do an internship at Accenture where you can be yourself and do what you love? Apply now and change the world around you.

jobs.title: Security Delivery Consultant
jobs.description:
About Accenture Technology
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud, and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, Accenture offers Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, and Song services. Our people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, helping organizations accelerate innovation and create measurable value at scale.
Job Summary
We are seeking a Security Operations Lead to oversee cybersecurity operations, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring activities across enterprise environments. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership responsibilities, requiring a professional who can actively participate in security operations while guiding analysts, improving security processes, and supporting organizational cyber resilience initiatives.
The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening security monitoring capabilities, enhancing operational processes, and ensuring effective response to cybersecurity threats and incidents.
Additional Key Responsibilities
• Develop, implement, and continuously improve cybersecurity operations processes, procedures, policies, incident response plans, security monitoring workflows, and operational runbooks.
• Partner with SIEM engineers and security teams to develop, optimize, and refine correlation rules to improve threat detection accuracy and reduce false positives.
• Monitor, investigate, and analyze security events, providing technical guidance during ongoing investigations and security incidents.
• Lead incident detection, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
• Administer and manage Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, including deployment, upgrades, health monitoring, policy management, and integrations.
• Administer and manage Network Detection and Response (NDR) technologies, including policy creation, correlation rule development, platform tuning, and ongoing optimization.
• Manage vendor support engagements related to cybersecurity tools and coordinate issue resolution activities.
• Utilize incident response tools and technologies throughout the detection, investigation, and response lifecycle.
• Produce cyber threat intelligence reports and security assessments for technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership audiences.
• Lead day-to-day cybersecurity operations activities and provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to security analysts.
• Support on-call and major incident response activities when required.
• Track security incidents, trends, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
• Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams to strengthen overall security posture.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cybersecurity operations maturity and effectiveness.

Job Qualifications
Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
• 4 to 8 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Security Operations, Security Monitoring, Incident Response, or SOC environments.
• Experience working with SIEM, EDR, NDR, and threat detection technologies.
• Proven experience investigating security incidents and coordinating response activities.
• Experience leading security analysts, coordinating workstreams, or mentoring junior team members.
• Experience supporting enterprise cybersecurity operations in medium to large-scale environments.
Technical Expertise
• Strong knowledge of Security Operations Center (SOC) processes and cybersecurity operations.
• Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring tools.
• Strong experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions.
• Experience with Network Detection and Response (NDR) technologies and network security monitoring.
• Knowledge of incident response methodologies and cyber threat investigation techniques.
• Familiarity with threat intelligence processes and threat hunting methodologies.
• Strong understanding of security event analysis, attack techniques, and detection engineering concepts.
• Experience creating and tuning detection rules and alerting mechanisms.
• Knowledge of security frameworks and industry best practices.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Certifications
• CompTIA Security+
• GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
• GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
• Certified SOC Analyst (CSA)
• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
• Microsoft Security Certifications
• Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or equivalent SIEM certifications
Why Join Us?
• Work alongside leading cybersecurity professionals in a dynamic security operations environment.
• Gain exposure to advanced detection, monitoring, and incident response technologies.
• Access continuous learning and certification opportunities.
• Collaborate on complex cybersecurity challenges and enterprise-scale security programs.
• Contribute to strengthening cyber resilience and protecting critical business operations.
• Benefit from a culture focused on innovation, growth, and professional development.

• Business Partner (Customer/Vendor)

As a team:

Talent Transformation is the strategic evolution of skills, capabilities, and associated organisational wiring that support an organisation’s business strategy. It's about continuously reinventing talent by identifying and executing on the most critical changes needed across the enterprise, for teams, and for individuals. This is more than just training people, finding faster ways to hire people, or implementing a technology. It’s about truly transforming an organisation’s talent and the systems that create lasting organisational change to accelerate strategic execution, drive speed and agility, amplify talent potential, build resilience, and improve sustainability.
We partner with organisations to build a talent strategy that defines how to access, create, and unlock the potential of talent. We help access talent by strengthening diverse talent pipelines, both internal and external, matching the needs of the business to people’s skills and aspirations. We help create talent by using skills as the foundation to help people continuously build market relevant skills through equitable access to career opportunities. And we unlock potential by creating conditions across the organisation that allow people to do their best work every day and leave them net better off.

jobs.title: Financial Services Consultant - TechFS
jobs.description:
Do clients rely on your impressive ability to define and implement innovative solutions that transform valuable results? Or perhaps you’ve become the go-to thought leader for information systems within the Banking/Insurance domain? If driving the business and functional requirements of large-scale projects are within your DNA, Accenture may be the perfect place to progress your career.  It’s you, its your career, it’s your adventure, where you will go next?  You needn’t to look far!

Come join our team in Brussels & take on the next step of your career as “Financial Services Consultant”!

Your Job

Within your Accenture team, you:
- Structure the evolution & implementation of large-scale digital finance platforms  .
-   Define specific solutions and participate in the implementation of information systems of financial institutions.
- Participate in transitioning the requirements to the developers and ensure a clear and complete understanding of the requirements.
- Coordinate and supervise activities between different stakeholders (internal or external).
- Deliver user training and support to ensure a smooth adoption of the new functionalities of the systems.
- Provide support during the aftercare cycle of the delivered systems;

Your Team

Accenture Technology leverages design thinking, industry insights and the latest digital and Security methodologies to help clients innovate, grow and improve their businesses. Our expertise, capabilities and experience mean that our clients (including some of the biggest brands in the world) trust us to find the right solutions for their needs. Together with our talented international colleagues, we focus on connecting the needs of businesses with the new possibilities that come with technological progress. Because that's where the real challenges are: inventing and testing things that have never been tried before, getting new applications ready for roll-out, and ultimately guiding clients to select and implement the right technologies – including state of the art Security solutions - to transform their businesses.

Your Background
- University degree in Commercial or Civil Engineering, Economical sciences, Information Technology, or a business related study with a strong IT affinity;
- Previous experience of minimum 3 years in either insurance, banking or capital markets;
- Sound insurance and/or finance process understanding and demonstrated process and re-engineering ability;
- Functional knowledge on Payments domain is a plus (Sepa DD, Sepa CT, International Payments, Swift)
- Relevant experience in the Finance & Risk department of a Bank is an asset;
- Affinity with IT, ideally knowledge of e.g. Java, xml, sql, mainframe (Cobol);
- Excellent proficiency in English and French or Dutch is mandatory , additional languages are an asset;
- Strong analytical skills and structure problem solving;
- Team player;
- Commercial spirit;
- Result oriented;
- Ability to deliver high quality work on time;

Our Offer

Accenture is an incredible place to work - and keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation.  Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re really proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow - whatever it is you're great at. So you will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.Besides our high-profile, challenging projects and our nurturing work environment, we offer excellent employee benefits, including:

- 20 + 12 holidays (Belgium) / 26 days of Holidays (Luxembourg)
- Laptop and smartphone
- Hospitalization insurance and extensive group insurance package
- Bonus program
- Training & learning opportunities
- Different mobility options
- Flexrewards: decide on your rewards package with our flexible benefits tool
- Discount program: get discounts at your favorite (online) shops
- Employee shares purchase plan
- And many more!

About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
What would you do? • You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.

• Optimizing working capital providing real time visibility and end to end management of revenue and cash flow and streamlining billing processes This team over looks the entire processes that starts from customers inquiry sales order to delivery and invoicing The Cash Application Processing team focuses on solving queries related to cash applications and coordination with the customers The role requires a good understanding of cash applications the process of applying unapplied cash reconciliation of suspense account in cash application and process them from payment receipt to finalization

What are we looking for? • Primary skill - Collections Processing - P2 , End to end OTC understanding within Trust & Safety client
Roles and Responsibilities: • In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of lower-complexity problems.
• Your day to day interaction is with peers within Accenture before updating supervisors.
• In this role you may have limited exposure with clients and or Accenture management.
• You will be given moderate level instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instructions on new assignments.
• The decisions you make impact your own work and may impact the work of others.
• You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a focused scope of work.
• Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

• Manage OTC collection disputes such as debt collection, reporting on aged debt, dunning process, bad debt provisioning etc.
• Perform Cash Reconciliations and follow up for missing remittances, prepare refund package with accuracy and supply to clients, record all collections activities in a consistent manner as per client process (tool), delivery of process requirements to achieve key performance targets, ensure compliance to internal controls, standards, and regulations (Restricted countries).
What are we looking for? • Primary skill - Collections Processing - P1
Roles and Responsibilities: • Financial Accounting & Reporting
• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities.
• Ensure accurate preparation and review of financial statements.
• Oversee general ledger accounting and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Review journal entries, accruals, reserves, and adjustments.
• Perform variance and trend analysis on financial results.
• Insurance Accounting
• Manage accounting for:
• o Premium revenue
• o Claims and loss reserves
• o Reinsurance transactions
• o Deferred acquisition costs (DAC)
• o Unearned premium reserves (UPR)
• o Investment income
• Ensure compliance with insurance accounting standards and regulatory reporting
• requirements.
• Regulatory & Statutory Reporting
• Coordinate preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory filings.
• Ensure compliance with insurance regulators and governing bodies.
• Support reporting under US GAAP, IFRS 17, Solvency II, NAIC, or applicable local
• insurance regulations.
• Liaise with external auditors and regulatory authorities.
• Internal Controls & Governance
• Maintain an effective Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) framework.
• Ensure compliance with SOX and corporate governance requirements.
• Identify control deficiencies and implement remediation plans.
• Support risk assessments and compliance reviews.
• Audit Management
• Coordinate internal and external audits.
• Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation.
• Manage audit observations and corrective action plans.
• Act as the primary finance contact for audit-related activities.
• Business Partnership
• Partner with Actuarial, Underwriting, Claims, Treasury, Tax, and FP&A teams.
• Support new product launches and business initiatives from an accounting
• perspective.
• Provide financial insights and recommendations to leadership.
• Process Improvement & Transformation
• Drive automation, standardization, and process optimization initiatives.

Any Graduation

• Minimum of 3-5 years experience
• Written and spoken ability to communicate in English for interaction
• Attention to details
• Must be a good team player
• Excellent customer service
• Responsibility and accuracy in the completion of received tasks

• Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation related to Deductions and resolutions.
• Prepare regular reports on Deduction volumes, aging, resolution times, and root cause trends.
• Contribute to monthly O2C KPIs and dashboards.

Any Graduation

• Optimizing working capital providing real time visibility and end to end management of revenue and cash flow and streamlining billing processes This team over looks the entire processes that starts from customers inquiry sales order to delivery and invoicing The Cash Application Processing team focuses on solving queries related to cash applications and coordination with the customers The role requires a good understanding of cash applications the process of applying unapplied cash reconciliation of suspense account in cash application and process them from payment receipt to finalization

• Support month-end and quarter-end close activities.

• Apply customer payments accurately and timely in ERP systems.
• Research and resolve unapplied or unidentified cash.
