• Contact customers through inbound and outbound calls for collections, payment follow-ups, account reconciliation, and dispute resolution.

• Document customer interactions accurately in ERP, CRM systems.
• Maintain high customer satisfaction and service quality standards.

• Manage customer communications via email and ticketing platforms.
• Review customer accounts, collections reports, and aging schedules.
• Prepare operational reports and dashboards.
• Support process improvement and automation initiatives.
• Process Governance & Compliance
• Ensure adherence to client policies, SOX controls, and operational procedures.
• Maintain process documentation and standard operating procedures.
• Support audits and compliance reviews.
• Identify process risks and recommend mitigation actions.

BCom

jobs.title: Power Grid Consultant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Power Grid Consultant into our quickly evolving Infrastructure and Capital Projects team in Hungary!

We welcome both fresh graduates and experienced professionals.

What the Power Grid Consultant (Electrical Engineer) will do:
- Support Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and Distribution System Operators (DSOs) in planning the power grid of the future
- Work directly with clients as part of international consulting project teams
- Perform power system analyses (power flow, voltage, short‑circuit, N‑1, redispatch)
- Model and analyze national and regional electricity grids
- Contribute to grid stability, dynamics, and power quality studies
- Use advanced engineering and simulation tools to optimize grid operation
- Analyze energy market trends and support technology and business evaluations

What we are looking forward to
- You have completed a degree in electrical engineering or industrial engineering with a focus on electrical power engineering
- You have knowledge of the planning and operation of transmission and distribution networks
- You speak German (at least B2+, C1) and English (B1+) as well
- You are familiar with typical challenges related to transient stability of assets (e.g. HVDC systems, converters, electrolyzers, STATCOMs) and understand their relevance for grid operators and manufacturers
- You are interested in power system analysis software (e.g. NEPLAN, Integral, PowerFactory) and ideally have a confident command of MATLAB or Python
- You enjoy working on innovative topics and are willing to acquire new knowledge independently, and you bring the flexibility and mobility required in a consulting environment

What we offer:
- Cafeteria - Budget for benefits based on your choice

- Refer-a-Friend - get a bonus in the employee referral program

- Flexible working arrangements (Flex-work, Telework)

- Wide range of leading-edge training (including language courses)

- AYCM sports pass card

- Family oriented benefits

- Competitive compensation package, paid overtime, and insurance

- Company shares on discount price

- Employee assistance program (counseling by mental health therapist, legal or financial advice)

jobs.title: Consultant Banking Architect
jobs.description:
En Accenture Consulting acompañamos a las principales entidades financieras en sus procesos de transformación más estratégicos, combinando visión de negocio, innovación tecnológica y excelencia en la ejecución. Trabajarás en proyectos de alto impacto, en entornos internacionales y altamente regulados, colaborando estrechamente con clientes C‑level y equipos multidisciplinares para impulsar el cambio end‑to‑end.

Buscamos un Banking Architect para liderar análisis, diseño y entrega de arquitecturas end-to-end en programas de consultoría e implementación bancaria. Serás el referente técnico principal para clientes y equipos de delivery, combinando conocimiento profundo de banca con dominio de tecnologías modernas para impulsar transformaciones digitales en entidades financieras.
El puesto se desempeña en Madrid en un modelo de trabajo híbrido realizando algunos días desde tu casa y otros en la oficina donde podrás crear interesantes sinergias con el resto de tu equipo. Es imprescindible residir en España y tener permiso laboral en España.
Funciones a realizar:
- Liderar el análisis y diseño de arquitecturas objetivo (target-state) para core banking, canales digitales, pagos, tarjetas y CRM, asegurando consistencia funcional y técnica.

- Definir y guiar la evolución desde plataformas monolíticas hacia arquitecturas modulares, cloud-native y API-first (microservicios, event-driven, DDD), incluyendo criterios de desacoplamiento y estrategia de migración.

- Elaborar artefactos de arquitectura de alto nivel (HLD), diagramas de arquitectura, flujos e integración para comunicar soluciones de forma clara a equipos técnicos y stakeholders ejecutivos.

- Participar en actividades de preventa (propuestas, RFPs, solutioning, estimaciones) y recomendación de paquetes core banking y soluciones del ecosistema (por ejemplo Temenos, Mambu, Finacle, Oracle FLEXCUBE, nCino, Salesforce FSC).

Responsabilidades
- Actuar como principal referencia de arquitectura y asesorar al cliente en la definición de roadmaps tecnológicos y de solución, alineando objetivos de negocio, regulación y viabilidad técnica.

- Diseñar arquitecturas de integración para open banking y ecosistemas API, contemplando patrones de seguridad, versionado, gobernanza de APIs y observabilidad.

- Definir estrategias de integración y mensajería (REST/SOAP, Kafka, MQ, Apache Camel o equivalentes), garantizando resiliencia, trazabilidad y rendimiento.

- Asegurar buenas prácticas de DevSecOps y delivery continuo: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, contenerización (Docker) y orquestación (Kubernetes) en entornos regulados.

- Colaborar con equipos de datos para alinear data architecture y capacidades analíticas/BI (modelado, plataformas de datos, reporting), cuando aplique a casos de uso bancarios.

- Considerar marcos regulatorios relevantes (por ejemplo PSD2, Open Banking, DORA, Basel III, AML/KYC) en el diseño de la solución, incluyendo requisitos de seguridad, continuidad, auditoría y cumplimiento.

- Mentorización de arquitectos/as junior y promoción de estándares y calidad técnica en el equipo.

- Impulsar formas de trabajo Agile y escaladas (SAFe/Scrum) en entornos complejos y multi-país.

Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will help translate concepts into practice and support the successful realization of grid transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Power Grid consultant

Power Grid Planning & Data Management

You contribute to the planning and analysis of national and regional power grid models to support the development of future ‑ ready electricity networks. Your responsibilities include supporting grid planning and operational strategies, performing system assessments and scenario analyses, and working with complex grid and asset data. You support the analysis of power system dynamics and stability to ensure reliable and resilient grid operation. jobs.title: PML Functional consultant
jobs.description:
Do you want to help companies transform how they manage their products — from ideation through design, development and launch?
Do you have hands-on experience with PLM platforms and a strong grasp of product development processes? Are you energised by working closely with clients to design and deploy solutions that make a tangible difference to how products are created and managed?

Your job
As a PLM Functional Consultant within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice, you will support and lead PLM deployment and transformation projects at Belgian and international clients. You will work across industries including Consumer Goods, Retail, Industrial Equipment and Pharma & Life Sciences — contributing to projects that span process design, platform deployment and change management.
Examples of projects you can work on:
- PLM deployment: support the end-to-end deployment of a PLM platform at a consumer goods or manufacturing client — from requirements gathering and process design through configuration, testing and go-live

- BOM and product data management: help a client define and implement structured BOM processes, engineering change workflows and product data governance across their organisation

- PLM maturity assessment: conduct a PLM maturity assessment for a client, identify gaps in their current product data management approach and define a prioritised improvement roadmap

- Process design and optimisation: analyse current product development and engineering change processes, design improved future-state workflows and translate them into PLM system configurations

- User training and adoption: develop training content and support end-user adoption of new PLM processes and tools across engineering, product and commercial teams

In this role you will:
- Support requirements gathering workshops and process design sessions with client teams

- Analyse and map current product development and engineering processes

- Contribute to functional solution design, configuration and testing of PLM platforms

- Own user stories and functional specifications across one or more PLM workstreams

- Support data migration activities including data mapping, cleansing and validation

- Communicate PLM concepts clearly to both technical and business audiences

- Contribute to proposal development and internal knowledge sharing

- Work in international project teams, collaborating with Accenture's global Engineering and PLM network

Your team
Our consultants in Supply Chain & Engineering are changing businesses every day using deep industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and industry, we devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. With an eye for competitive advantage, sustainability, digital disruption, operating models and the future workforce, we take on the challenge of designing and implementing transformative business solutions, using the newest technology.
Our research-based advice and situational analyses enable our clients to act with speed and confidence. Whether we're investigating complex issues or identifying new opportunities, our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts.

Your background
- Master's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems or a related field

- 2 to 4 years of experience in PLM, product data management or engineering consulting roles

- Hands-on experience with at least one PLM platform (Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP PLM, PTC Windchill, or a consumer goods-focused PLM platform)

- Solid understanding of product lifecycle and engineering processes: BOM management, engineering change, data governance, lifecycle workflows

- Experience or strong interest in Consumer Goods or Retail industry is a plus — understanding of product ranging, specification management or recipe/formulation management is an asset

- Ability to analyse and map business processes and translate them into system requirements

- Exposure to ERP systems, master data management or data migration tools is a plus

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, client-first mindset

- Fluent in English, both spoken and written

- Fluent in French and/or Dutch, both spoken and written

- Ability to travel to client sites; a valid driving licence is strongly recommended

Nice to have
- Experience or strong interest in Consumer Goods or Retail industry — understanding of product ranging, specification management or recipe/formulation management

- Exposure to ERP systems, master data management or data migration tools

- Interest in AI or GenAI applications in product development or engineering contexts

- Experience across more than one manufacturing or product industry

Our offer
Within the Supply Chain & Engineering Practice of Accenture Belgium and Luxembourg, you will get the opportunity to work for leading customers on high-value projects. You will be able to build your skills and expertise by leveraging our state-of-the-art assets, methodologies, global network of experts and comprehensive training curriculum. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted in virtual classrooms, online or in collaboration with external parties. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable steppingstone to build a career.
Accenture is an incredible place to work — and keep learning. By joining us, you'll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we're very proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. jobs.title: IAM Security Consultant
jobs.description:
Accenture CyberSecurity
Accenture CyberSecurity helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond and recover across all aspects of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business and industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, end‑to‑end solutions tailored to our clients’ needs across their entire value chain, helping them build cyber resilience and grow with confidence.

Selected candidates will take part in IAM Security projects for global and leading companies across Europe, working in complex, international environments.

What You’ll Do
- Design, implement and support Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions aligned with business requirements and security policies

- Configure and customize IAM platforms such as SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, ForgeRock, Okta and Ping Identity

- Develop and maintain integrations between IAM tools and target systems (Active Directory, LDAP, SAP, databases, cloud platforms)

- Support IAM activities including role mining, policy definition, access certifications and access reviews

- Contribute to IAM architecture and strategy covering SSO, MFA, identity federation and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

- Participate in project planning, documentation, testing, and go‑live support within global delivery teams

- At least 5 years of hands‑on experience in IAM projects (scope adjusted according to seniority)

- Strong knowledge of IAM concepts: user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication and authorization, SSO, RBAC/ABAC, and identity federation

- Experience with one or more IAM platforms, including SailPoint IdentityNow / IdentityIQ, One Identity Manager, Saviynt, ForgeRock, Ping Identity or Okta

- Solid understanding of IAM-related protocols such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP, and SCIM

- Knowledge of directory services (Active Directory, Azure AD), databases, and web services (REST/SOAP)

- Fluency in English

Legal : Must own a valid work permit or EU/Schengen Space Nationality to legally work in Portugal.

What Will Set You Apart
- Experience with One Identity Manager (particularly for provisioning, workflows, and customization)

- Programming/scripting knowledge (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, SQL)

- Certifications in IAM or security domains (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CIAM, Azure AD, SailPoint, One Identity)

- Cloud IAM experience (e.g., Azure AD, AWS IAM, Google Cloud IAM)

- Familiarity with PAM tools (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust)

- Fluency in other European languages (e.g., French, German, Spanish)

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Lead and mentor a team of mobile security analysts in proactively identifying and flagging malicious code and security threats within Android applications.
- Oversee the analysis of emerging threats and ensure effective response to security incidents and escalations.

Professional & Technical Skills:
- A strong background in Application Security, Security Auditing, or a prior role focused specifically on Android malware analysis.

- Deep understanding of the Android OS, application lifecycle, and Dalvik bytecode (smali). Must have strong proficiency in reading source code in Java and Kotlin.
- Exposure to JavaScript, Flutter & Query languages such as SQL
- Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash).

In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa al cuore del cambiamento per trasformare interi settori di mercato. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.
All'interno del Reinvention Partner Digital Core aiutiamo i clienti a reinventare la loro digital foundation, inclusa la strategia e l'architettura tecnologica, i dati e l'AI, la modernizzazione e la gestione delle applicazioni, l'infrastruttura, i dati e il cloud.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive
Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, accompagnando le aziende leader durante la loro trasformazione digitale grazie a strategie all’avanguardia. In particolare, potrai:
- Guidare i nostri clienti in un percorso di innovazione IT, disegnando roadmap di trasformazione applicando le tecnologie più avanzate sul mercato.

- Analizzare il livello di maturità delle tecnologie del cliente, studiando i trend di mercato e il livello di adozione da parte dei diversi settori.

- Progettare architetture digitali, nuove applicazioni e architetture dati complesse, collaborando come Subject Matter Expert all'interno di progetti e team internazionali.

- Elaborare soluzioni basate su piattaforme moderne e rivoluzionarie (Cloud / DevSecOps, Open API, IoT, AI, Robotic Process Automation, architetture a microservizi e dati).

- Pianificare e coordinare le tue attività e quelle delle risorse più junior e/o di interi team a te affidati, seguendo la delivery di progetti di consulenza a lungo termine.

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione è previsto un livello di inquadramento B3 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico (C011). La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 36.907,87 € e 50.500 €.
#LI-MP #LI-EU

Se condividi la nostra passione per la consulenza e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
- Hai un'esperienza dai 2 ai 6 anni su progetti di consulenza rivolti a diversi settori di mercato e funzioni aziendali, oppure in grandi aziende internazionali, gestendo diversi interlocutori e lavorando in team.

- Conosci le architetture enterprise digitali (es: SOA, microservizi e API, event driven, dati), i framework di architettura (es. TOGAF, Zachman) e hai conoscenza di tool di modellazione e Enterprise Architecture Management (LeanIX, UML)

- Conosci piattaforme cloud (es: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) ed hai familiarità con database relazionali e NoSQL, DevOps, CI/CD e containerizzazione e le modalità di integrazione tra sistemi legacy e moderni

- Hai esperienza nel definire roadmap di trasformazione, valutare i rischi legati alle iniziative IT ed il loro allineamento agli obiettivi aziendali

- Hai una Laurea Triennale o superiore, e sai parlare fluentemente in italiano e inglese.

jobs.title: Security Consultant Resources
jobs.description:
As a Security Consultant in the Resources Security industry group , you will be responsible for overseeing security-related activities at one of our clients in areas such as retail, consumer goods, or life sciences.

You will bring together technical, business, and commercial expertise to help clients address their complex security challenges. Specifically, we are looking for candidates with broad experience in one or multiple Security domains , combined with commercial interest . In this role, you will support delivery teams to ensure projects are executed effectively and meet client expectations. You will work closely with clients, the client account team, and security domain experts to provide hands-on assistance in delivering security consulting projects. Additionally, you will contribute to building strong client relationships and assist in identifying opportunities for future collaboration. This role offers the chance to develop your expertise while working on impactful security projects.

Key Responsibilities:
- People : As part of the Accenture Security team, you will operate within the Products Security industry group, one of the five industry groups in the Netherlands. Clients are undergoing (security) transformations that change their business and way of working, and a strong understanding of these industries is essential.

- Processes : You will leverage your industry-specific knowledge to help clients define, implement, and run tailored security solutions, ensuring secure business and IT operations.

- Technology : You will have the opportunity to develop expertise in a wide range of innovative tools, technologies, and methodologies across all Security offerings.

- Data : Operating in a data-driven environment, you will utilize insights to deliver projects and identify new opportunities for clients.

With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning, and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Who We Are – Security
Joining our team means becoming part of a close-knit group of Security professionals who serve Accenture’s clients with the best and brightest insights into the latest Security trends. We are united by our core values to challenge our clients’ status quo and build relationships based on trust. Our shared goal is to keep our clients and the people they serve protected while building a cyber-resilient future together.
In practice, this means deploying cutting-edge security systems, using AI to analyze security risks, and developing defense strategies based on a combination of technology and user behavior. You will have the freedom to take a proactive and creative approach to find the best solutions for our clients’ specific security challenges.
We also prioritize maintaining a strong team identity and culture within the security group. Throughout the year, we organize various (social) events, including an annual ski trip, parties, BBQs, and more.

Here’s what you’ll need:
- A bachelor's or master's degree, preferably security or technology oriented.

- 3–5 years of work experience in Cyber Security

- Work experience within large organizations.

- Proven experience in consultancy projects.

- Interest in gaining commercial experience , with the ability to integrate security expertise into business strategies.

Bonus points if you are :
- A team player with strong analytical skills and the ability to understand and resolve complex problems.

- Fluent in English (required); fluency in Dutch is highly preferred.

Location: London

About Accenture:

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skills and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.

As a team:

In the UK, Accenture partners with leading Energy/Chemicals/Natural resources firms. As companies balance the traditional role of providing the world with secure, affordable energy with the transition to low-carbon solutions, they are rethinking their business and operational models. This includes optimising the management of upstream and downstream assets, integrating AI into operations, and driving sustainability in a cost-effective manner that positions them for future success. Accenture’s unique position, at the intersection of business and technology, means that our clients are turning to us for help with their most important business and technology challenges.

There will never be a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why people love it here. Here are just a few typical responsibilities:

- Working alongside our clients, supporting delivery of consulting engagements to address their biggest challenges.
- Driving lasting and distinctive outcomes/value in fields such as: - Value case and value management
- Operating model design and transformation
- Cost & productivity improvement
- Net zero transition
- Analytics and big data
- Technology & business transformation
- AI strategy/delivery
- Risk & Regulatory compliance

- Solving sophisticated/ambiguous business, change and technology problems, bringing analysis and structure to projects
- Developing and managing high performing multidisciplinary Consulting teams - leading by example, actively mentoring others and contributing to performance management activities
- Acting, and taking decisions with little management oversight
- Building, developing and sustaining trusted client relationships
- Driving/Supporting business development and sales.
- Supporting offering development within the Energy, Chemicals, Natural Resources Practice & playing a role in driving the growth agenda for clients
- Leading/Supporting the creation of thought leadership assets to help drive improved market presence in external forums
- Prioritising diversity & inclusion across teams

We are looking for experience in the following areas:

- 3-6+ Years experience in the energy industry, either through direct industry roles or within a consulting capacity
- Understanding and passion about Energy/CNR industry trends and business models
- Understanding of the Energy/CNR value chain (e.g. Upstream, Downstream, Integrated Gas, Mining)
- Familiarity with recognized consulting frameworks and techniques – for example research, quantitative/qualitative analysis, structured problem solving, design thinking, executive communication, project management
- Track record of building and sustaining relationships with clients
- An appreciation of how technology can contribute to solving clients’ business problems
- Experience operating as the bridge between business and technology
- Familiarity with some of the core technology platforms used in the industry
- Ability to multi-task and engage on different projects and activities concurrently in challenging and often ambiguous circumstances
- Presentation, oral and written communication skills

Set yourself apart:

- Proven success in co-creating in a team-oriented environment
- Proven track record of working creatively and analytically to solve complex problems
- Desire to work in a dynamic environment and constantly evolving industry
- Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills
- Specialised knowledge/experience in a particular area of the value chain – e.g. Subsurface/Wells; Production and Operations; Lubricants; Mobility retail; Mining; Refining; Chemicals; Manufacturing
- Strong Project management skills

What’s in it for you:

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jobs.description:
As a (Senior) Security Consulting Manager in the Resources Security industry group, you will be responsible for overseeing security-related activities at one of our clients in the following sectors: energy, chemicals and utilities.
You will bring together technical, business, and commercial expertise to help clients address their complex security challenges.
We are looking for people with a broad understanding in several security domains. This includes security of emerging technologies (e.g., AI) , security for Operational Technology (OT) , security operations (e.g., vulnerability management and detect & response) , cyber strategy and IAM combined with strong commercial acumen.

In this role, you will work with delivery teams to ensure existing projects are operating as expected, while also building relationships and developing new opportunities with clients. You will act as a bridge between the client, the client account team, and our group of experts in the security domain teams.

Key Responsibilities:
- People : As part of the Accenture Security team, you will operate within the Resources Security industry group, one of the five industry groups in the Netherlands. Clients are undergoing (security) transformations that change their business and way of working, and a strong understanding of these industries is essential.

- Processes : You will leverage your industry-specific knowledge to help clients define, implement, and run tailored security solutions, ensuring secure business and IT operations.

- Technology : You will have the opportunity to develop expertise in a wide range of innovative tools, technologies, and methodologies across all Security offerings.

- Data : Operating in a data-driven environment, you will utilize insights to deliver projects and identify new opportunities for clients.

With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning, and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Joining our team means becoming part of a close-knit group of Security professionals who serve Accenture’s clients with the best and brightest insights into the latest Security trends. We are united by our core values to challenge our clients’ status quo and build relationships based on trust. Our shared goal is to keep our clients and the people they serve protected while building a cyber-resilient future together.
In practice, this means deploying cutting-edge security systems, using AI to analyze security risks, and developing defense strategies based on a combination of technology and user behavior. You will have the freedom to take a proactive and creative approach to find the best solutions for our clients’ specific security challenges.
We also prioritize maintaining a strong team identity and culture within the security group. Throughout the year, we organize various (social) events, including an annual ski trip, parties, BBQs, and more.

Here’s what you’ll need:
- A Security or technology-oriented degree, either managerial or technical in nature (preferred).

jobs.description:
Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – Telecommunications
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients in telecom industry to realize exceptional business value from technology
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture
Level: Senior Manager
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 15+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformation strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to drive enterprise-wide IT transformation by integrating business strategy, architecture vision, execution governance, and measurable value realization. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to translate strategic ambition into architecture-enabled delivery and sustained business outcomes telecom OSS, BSS, networks and digital platforms.
The Practice – A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients in Telecommunication industry, driving end-to-end transformation initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:
Technology Strategy & Digital Reinvention: Define and implement business-aligned Technology, data, digital and Cloud strategies tailored to telecom companies, including pragmatic roadmaps for practical implementation Enterprise Architecture & Digital Core: Helping clients design, architect and scale their technology landscape, solving key business challenges by enabling architecture transformation and charting a journey from current state to their enterprise ‘North Star’ based on industry best practices and the next technology frontier Generative AI and Agentic AI-led Transformation: Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across the client's value chain – network operations, autonomous networks, customer care, service assurance, sales and marketing and enterprise services. Assessing organizational AI readiness, defining the data and technology foundation required to scale AI responsibly, designing target state architectures for reinvented, AI-enabled functions Application Portfolio Optimization: Assess and rationalize the client's application landscape to reduce complexity, eliminate redundancy and lower total cost of ownership, while aligning the portfolio to business priorities and target architecture Industry Specific Technology Consulting: Understand telecom specific client challenges ranging from vendor/product strategy to technical debt, process complexity, operating model inefficiencies and architecture modernization and help solve chronic business process challenges by deploying cutting edge technologies Technology Architecture: Help clients design, architect and scale their technology architectures to support new technology-driven growth Enterprise Growth & Innovation: Assist clients to build the required capabilities for growth and innovation, leveraging emerging technologies to sustain high performance in a rapidly evolving industry landscape

Role Overview​
We are looking for a strong Technology Strategy and Architecture Transformation leader with deep telecommunications expertise across OSS/BSS and Networks transformation, including autonomous networks. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership; shape strategic narratives; drive enterprise architecture discussions; and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps
This role operates at the intersection of strategy, enterprise architecture, and transformation execution—ensuring alignment between business priorities, technology investments, and realized outcomes. The successful candidate will be expected to:
​ The role requires strong telecom domain expertise, executive presence, deep consulting capability, and the ability to independently drive high-value client conversations in ambiguous and high-stakes environments
Key Responsibilities​
​Technology Strategy and Architecture
- Leverage your deep experience across technology strategy and enterprise architecture areas such as Digital & Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, AI/Agentic Architecture, Value case/business case formulation, Application Portfolio Optimization Strategy, Technical Debt, AI and Cloud Transformation
- Advise clients on platform strategy, architecture options, and build-versus-buy decisions across package solutions, ecosystem components, and cloud-native architectures
- Design future-state business capability models and target architecture for telecom transformation initiatives across key domains
- Have a strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities
- Develop technology solutions and value-adding propositions specific to the telecom industry, and take these to market
- Establish architecture governance, principles, standards, and minimal viable guardrails
- Create expert content and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions
- Demonstrate strong understanding of the Telecom industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership
- Identify high-value AI, GenAI and agentic use cases across network operations, care, fulfillment, assurance, commercial operations and enterprise functions
- Advise clients on key business and technology trends in telecom including AI-led operations, agentic architecture, autonomous networks, digital channels, monetization platforms, ecosystem partnerships and cloud-native modernization

Transformation and Execution Guidance
- Translate target architecture into multi‑year, phased transformation roadmap
- Lead complex modernization programs spanning legacy transformation, network modernization, platform simplification, API enablement, cloud migration, process redesign, and operating model evolution
- Support programs across OSS/BSS transformation, networks transformation, autonomous network enablement, platform simplification and operating model redesign
- Identify quick wins, foundational enablers, and long‑term modernization initiatives.
- Maintain architectural coherence across programs, workstreams, products, and implementation partners.
- Work with delivery, engineering, security, operations and business teams to connect strategy with implementation realities
- Partner with CIO/CTO leadership to evolve technology operating models.

Executive Advisory/Value Realization
- Lead CxO-level conversations on IT and network strategy, transformation priorities, sourcing choices, platform modernization, and enterprise architecture direction
- Establish transformation governance and value realization frameworks.
- Connect architecture and transformation decisions to business outcomes such as improved customer experience, faster product launch, lower cost-to-serve, reduced order fallout, improved assurance, and simplified IT landscapes
- Provide executive-level visibility into strategic alignment, risks, value delivery, and transformation progress
- Support strategic pursuits, client account development, and growth initiatives through differentiated advisory propositions and executive-level solution narratives

Core Skillsets & Tools​
Telecom Strategy and Domain Expertise
- Strong understanding of telecom business models, customer and network value chains, and business processes across lead-to-order, order-to-activate, trouble-to-resolve and usage-to-cash.
- Deep subject matter expertise of OSS/BSS domains including CRM, CPQ, product catalog, order management, billing, charging, mediation, fulfillment, assurance, inventory, provisioning and field service integration.
- Strong understanding of networks transformation, network operations, service orchestration, zero-touch operations and autonomous networks concepts.
- Ability to connect market and business trends with technology transformation priorities, operating model implications and value realization

Architecture, Platform and Technology Depth
- Strong experience in enterprise architecture, business architecture, platform architecture and transition architecture across telecom environments.
- Knowledge of key telecom platforms and vendors such as Amdocs, Netcracker, Salesforce Industries, Oracle, Ericsson, Nokia, ServiceNow and adjacent digital, integration and data platforms.
- Good understanding of telecom frameworks and standards such as TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open APIs and ODA; familiarity with enterprise architecture practices such as TOGAF is preferred.
- Strong understanding of API-led integration, microservices, cloud and hybrid cloud architectures, event-driven design, data platforms, observability and automation tooling.
- Practical understanding of hyperscaler capabilities and partner ecosystems across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, including their relevance to telecom transformation
- Practical understanding of AI, GenAI and agentic architecture concepts and their application to telecom business and operations use cases.
- Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the telecom value chain.
- Experience identifying use cases and target-state architectures for AI-enabled network operations, care, assurance, knowledge management and enterprise productivity

Consulting and Communication Skills
- Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, hypothesis-led analysis, benchmarking, assessment design, facilitation and executive storytelling.
- Ability to drive CxO-level conversations with credibility and clarity, influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across business and technology teams.
- Ability to independently lead client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling transformation narratives and shape opportunities
- Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits, and senior client relationship development

Read more about us.
- The rise of forerunners
- Recent Blogs

Your experience counts!
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus
- Prior experience in consulting, technology, or client-facing roles is a plus
- 15+ years of experience in consulting, technology strategy, enterprise architecture, telecom IT transformation or client-facing advisory roles.
- Experience working across telecom transformation initiatives spanning OSS/BSS, networks transformation, cloud, data, AI or platform modernization.
- Exposure to fixed, mobile, broadband, enterprise, or converged service provider environments will be advantageous
- Hands-on experience in at least 2 of our offerings: Enterprise Architecture, Technology ROI/Cost Take-out, Application Portfolio Optimization, Modern Architecture, Cloud Transformation, AI-led reinvention
- 4+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
- Understanding and application of leading concepts in Business Architecture, Application Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Security Architecture, Integration Architecture, Microservices architecture and SOA
- Practical use of Enterprise Architecture tools such as LeanIX, Troux, Mega, Alfabet, Archimate, etc.
- Experience in designing technology governance constructs based on established frameworks such as TOGAF and COBIT is preferred
- Strong facilitation capability with experience in workshops, design thinking sessions, leadership discussions and architecture governance forums.

What’s in it for you?
- An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

jobs.description:
Imaginez, transformez et impactez le monde   positivement : venez vivre au c œ ur du changement en tant que   membre actif et spécialisé dans les problématiques de sécurité de l’information.

A ce titre, n ous recherchons   Consultant Senior   Pentest   et Red Team pour intégrer nos équipes Cyber   Resilience ,   contribuer activement aux différentes missions en cours, et participer au développement de nos capacités sur cette ligne de services. Ce poste unique exige une combinaison de compétences pour mener des tests de pénétration sophistiqués et exécuter des opérations complètes de Red Team afin d'identifier et d'exploiter les vulnérabilités au sein de l'infrastructure informatique des clients, qu'elle soit sur site ou dans le cloud.

Vos missions :

•   Réalisation de tests de pénétration internes   : Effectuer des évaluations de sécurité approfondies sur les infrastructures informatiques (y compris le WIFI), qu'elles soient sur site ou dans le cloud.
•   Mise en place d'infrastructures Red Team :   Concevoir et gérer des infrastructures dédiées aux opérations de Red Team, incluant le contournement des solutions de sécurité telles que les antivirus et les EDR.
•   Simulation d'attaques Red Team et exploitation avancée d'Active Directory :   Planifier et exécuter des opérations de Red Team, tester la réactivité des équipes de sécurité et améliorer les mesures de défense. Utiliser des techniques d'attaque avancées pour identifier et exploiter les vulnérabilités d'Active Directory.
•   Analyse et remédiation des vulnérabilités :   Fournir des analyses détaillées des vulnérabilités découvertes et proposer des recommandations de remédiation concrètes et pragmatiques.
•   Veille technologique :   Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des dernières vulnérabilités, exploits et outils de   pentesting . Participer à des conférences et formations pour rester à la pointe du domaine.
• Formation et sensibilisation :   Contribuer aux programmes de formation pour améliorer la sensibilisation à la sécurité au sein de l'entreprise.

Expérience   recherché e  :

• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tests de pénétration/opérations Red Team,

• Vous êtes diplômé d'une formation Bac+5 ou supérieur, dans le domaine de la Cybersécurité.

• Vous maîtrisez des outils de   pentesting , des scripts (Python, Bash, etc.) et des systèmes d'exploitation (Windows, Linux).
• Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la réalisation de tests de pénétration internes (y compris le WIFI) et de simulations d'attaques dans des environnements cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) et sur des plateformes basées sur des conteneurs (Docker,   Kubernetes ).
• Vous disposez d'une capacité à concevoir, déployer et gérer des infrastructures complexes pour les opérations Red Team, incluant des serveurs de commande et contrôle, des outils de phishing et des   payloads   personnalisés.

• Techniques avancées de contournement des défenses : Expertise dans les méthodes de contournement des solutions de sécurité telles que les antivirus et les EDR (Endpoint   Detection   and   Response ). Capacité à développer et utiliser des   payloads   et des techniques "living off the land" ( LotL ) pour éviter la détection.
• Vous disposez d'expérience dans le développement de malware et maitrisez les langages tels que C, C++, C# ou PowerShell. Ou encore des   frameworks   tels que Cobalt Strike, Brute Ratel,   etc
• Maîtrise des techniques d'énumération réseau, d'escalade de privilèges et de mouvements latéraux.

• Langues :   la m aîtrise de l'anglais   est indispensable

Vous tirerez également votre épingle du jeu grâce aux éléments suivants :

• Certifications en sécurité de l'information telles que OSCE3, OSEP, CRTO, CRTL, OSCP, CRT (P/E) ou autres.
•   Qualification PASSI déjà obtenue

- Excellent sens de la communication   orale et écrite   et capacité à travailler en équipe.

- Forte curiosité, autonomie et proactivité.

jobs.title: Consultor Sênior de Segurança SAP e GRC
jobs.description:
Na Accenture, nossos profissionais de Segurança SAP e Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) ajudam organizações a proteger e transformar ambientes SAP complexos, promovendo crescimento dos negócios e conformidade regulatória.
Como Consultor de Segurança SAP e GRC , você atuará em projetos de transformação SAP, contribuindo para a definição e implementação de estratégias de segurança, governança de acessos e conformidade. Você terá contato direto com clientes e equipes multidisciplinares, apoiando a entrega de soluções seguras, escaláveis e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

Principais responsabilidades:
- Atuar em projetos de Segurança SAP e GRC envolvendo SAP S/4HANA, Fiori, SAP BTP e soluções SAP em nuvem.

- Projetar, implementar e otimizar conceitos de autorização SAP, incluindo roles, perfis e modelos de acesso.

- Atuar com SAP GRC Access Control, incluindo análise de Segregação de Funções (SoD), Access Risk Management, Emergency Access Management (Firefighter) e controles de mitigação.

- Trabalhar em parceria com stakeholders do cliente, gerentes de projeto, equipes de Cybersecurity, auditoria e áreas funcionais SAP.

- Apoiar a definição e implementação de estratégias de segurança e governança de acessos.

- Atuar em atividades de redesenho de roles, provisionamento de usuários, avaliações de compliance e remediação de auditorias.

- Apoiar e executar atividades de testes de segurança, incluindo Functional Unit Testing (FUT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT) e avaliações de prontidão para entrada em produção.

- Contribuir para o desenho de soluções e elaboração de propostas relacionadas à transformação em Segurança SAP.

- Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento de profissionais mais juniores da equipe.

- Participar de projetos de implementação, migração e transformação SAP, garantindo a qualidade e segurança das entregas.

Requisitos:

jobs.title: Thesis Internship Utilities - Strategy & Consulting - Marktgebaseerde vs. gereguleerde ontsluiting van flexibiliteit in het elektriciteitsnet
jobs.description:
Locatie : Amsterdam
Startdatum : september t/m november
Looptijd: circa 6 maanden, met mogelijkheid tot verlenging of verkorting in overleg

Introduction
De energietransitie en toenemende netcongestie vragen om effectieve manieren om flexibiliteit in het elektriciteitsnet te ontsluiten. In Nederland is een marktgebaseerde aanpak momenteel leidend, waarbij flexibiliteit wordt gestimuleerd via prijssignalen en marktmechanismen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de discussie over een meer gereguleerde aanpak, waarbij flexibiliteit (deels) wordt genormeerd via regels en gereguleerde tarieven. Als afstudeer stagiair bij Accenture onderzoek je hoe deze twee benaderingen zich tot elkaar verhouden en wat de meest effectieve aanpak is binnen de Nederlandse context. Je werkt aan een strategisch en actueel vraagstuk met directe relevantie voor netbeheerders, beleidsmakers en marktpartijen.

Tijdens je onderzoek ga je:
- De huidige marktgebaseerde mechanismen voor flexibiliteit in Nederland analyseren (zoals congestiemanagement en flexibiliteitsmarkten);
- Gereguleerde benaderingen en internationale best practices verkennen en vergelijken;
- De rol van netbeheerders, marktpartijen en toezichthouders in beide modellen analyseren;
- De effectiviteit van beide benaderingen evalueren op basis van criteria zoals efficiëntie, schaalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid;
- Een advies formuleren over de wenselijke inrichting van flexibiliteitsontsluiting in Nederland.

Mogelijke onderzoeksvragen kunnen zijn:
- Hoe effectief is de huidige marktgebaseerde aanpak in het ontsluiten van flexibiliteit bij toenemende netcongestie?
- Wat zijn de voor- en nadelen van een meer gereguleerde aanpak voor flexibiliteitsmanagement?
- Welke randvoorwaarden bepalen het succes van beide benaderingen?
- Hoe kan een hybride model eruitzien dat markt- en reguleringselementen combineert?
- Wat betekent de keuze voor een bepaalde aanpak voor verschillende stakeholders in het energiesysteem?
- De exacte onderzoeksvragen worden in overleg met de begeleiders en op basis van jouw interesses verder gedefinieerd.

Onderzoeksmethoden
- Zowel kwalitatieve als kwantitatieve onderzoeksmethoden zijn mogelijk, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur en de gekozen invalshoek. Denk aan literatuuronderzoek, interviews met experts, beleidsanalyse, data-analyse en/of modellering.
- De exacte onderzoeksvragen en methoden worden in overleg met de begeleiders en op basis van jouw interesses verder gedefinieerd.

Jouw team
Je werkt samen binnen een enthousiast team van Accenture Strategy & Consulting Utilities Nederland, waar je kunt rekenen op inhoudelijke begeleiding, samenwerking met experts van de Technology Strategy & Advisory en Data & AI teams, en toegang tot de brede kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van Accenture als organisatie.

Wie jij bent
- Je bent een masterstudent, bij voorkeur met een specialisatie gerelateerd aan de energiesector;
- Je hebt affiniteit met AI, organisatieontwerp en verandermanagement;
- Je beschikt over sterke conceptuele denkkracht en creativiteit;
- Je bent een teamspeler met uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden;
- Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

Wat wij jou bieden

- Werk flexibel, in een cultuur gebaseerd op vertrouwen

jobs.title: Business Analyst/Consultant – Public Services Institutions – German Speaker
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services.

As a member of the  Public Services  team , you will work   for central and local government institutions across Germany and   help   them   transform their operations and drive   future proof operations   by leveraging digital innovation, data, and advanced technologies.

During project work y ou will be supporting   institutions from   the following sub industries:

- Social Services   & Nonprofit

- Revenue ,   Tax   & Central Government

- Defense

- Public Safety , Borders & Law Enforcement

- Cities & Infrastructure

For more information about Public Services   work   please visit our website:   P ublic Services

THE WORK:

- Project Delivery : Deliver projects for   public sector   clients by working together with   medium to large size   teams. Responsibilities may include strategy,   business analysis , process design and change management .   Act as a bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring clear understanding of requirements and delivered solutions .   Facilitate workshops and discussions with stakeholders to gather requirements and   align on   solutions .   Ensure structured communication and effective stakeholder management throughout the project lifecycle .   Act as a bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring clear understanding of requirements and delivered solutions .

- Business Development : Support efforts of sales team to identify and win potential opportunities within the practice.

- Industry Experience : Provide industry expertise in at least one of the above sub-segments of the Public Service industry

jobs.description:
Job Title -  S&C GN  - Data Science Consultant
Team : Global Network – Data & AI
Practice : Health Analytics
Location: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad
Experience: 4-8 Years in Healthcare Analytics
Educational Qualification:
- Master’s degree in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related field with 3+ years of experience, OR
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related field with 4+ years of experience

We are an innovative Data Science team specializing in the Contact Center domain, dedicated to transforming customer interactions through data-driven intelligence. As part of the Marketing Analytics team, we focus on optimizing contact center operations by leveraging machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), generative ai, and advanced analytics.
Our work involves analyzing customer conversations, predicting user behavior, and enhancing self-service capabilities to reduce call transfers and improve satisfaction. We build conversational AI models, real-time recommendation systems, and predictive analytics solutions that drive meaningful business impact. By integrating AI-driven insights with marketing strategies, we enable proactive customer engagement, personalized experiences, and operational efficiencies across various touchpoints.
This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.
If you're passionate about applying data science to solve real-world customer experience challenges, this is the team for you!
Key Responsibilities
As a Data Science Consultant, you will:
- Develop and fine-tune Generative AI models to automate responses and improve customer interactions.
- Build and deploy ML models for intent classification, sentiment analysis, and predictive analytics.
- Apply NLP techniques (NER, summarization, embeddings) using frameworks like Hugging Face, LangChain, and OpenAI APIs.
- Optimize conversational AI workflows for real-time decision-making and enhanced self-service.
- Analyze large-scale customer interaction data to extract actionable insights.
- Work with unstructured data (text, audio, chat, emails) to build robust AI/ML pipelines.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, marketing) to integrate AI solutions.
- Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for scalable AI/ML development and deployment.

What you would do in this role
- Work with Managers to get Client's business requirements and deliver Analytics driven solution.
- Duties and Responsibilities: - Sr. Data Scientist is responsible for generating actionable recommendations well-supported by quantitative analysis to help our clients address their ongoing problems.
- Present analytic findings & opportunities for improvement to senior management and summarize key findings, and aid in the dissemination of metrics throughout the organization.
- Build knowledge base and disseminate information on applications of variety of analytical techniques.
- Develop statistical models and delivery of analytic offerings and solutions in health domain areas.

Required Skills
Technical Must-Haves
- Python programming
- Advanced data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy)
- SQL or PySpark
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning (Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
- NLP and NLP Frameworks (NER, summarization, embeddings, Hugging Face, LangChain)
- Generative AI (LLMs, Transformers, Diffusion Models)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Prompt Engineering
- Unstructured Data Handling (text, chat, emails)

Good to Have Skills
- LLM Optimization (fine-tuning, prompt engineering, efficient deployment)
- Experience with cloud-native AI/ML services (Azure ML, AWS Sagemaker, GCP Vertex AI)
- Customer segmentation and behavioral analysis
- Conversational AI optimization
- Large-scale data analysis
- Agentic AI (multi-agent orchestration, memory, autonomous workflows)
- Unstructured Data Handling (audio)

jobs.description:
Job Title : Financial Consultant (Independent Aftermarket – Dealer & Workshop Development)

Role overview:
Support the growth of the Independent Aftermarket (IAM) by improving dealer performance, strengthening relationships with independent repairers (IRs) and garage chains, and enhancing the adoption of digital ordering and workshop systems. The role is field‑driven and focuses on structured visits, assessments, capability development, and targeted commercial activation.

Key Responsibilities:
Dealer Visits & Performance Enhancement:
- Conduct standardized onsite visits with authorized dealers to review IAM parts performance, product portfolio depth, competitiveness, and sales execution.
- Identify improvement opportunities in processes, stock strategies, customer service, and adoption of digital ordering platforms.
- Provide structured feedback, capture visit outcomes, and define actionable next steps.

Dealer Assessments & Improvement Plans:
- Run comprehensive dealer assessments measuring operational quality, commercial maturity, and adherence to IAM principles.
- Perform audits, scorecards, and performance comparisons to identify strengths and gaps.
- Create clear improvement plans with KPIs, responsibilities, and timelines.

Dealer Coaching:
- Deliver targeted coaching programs designed to uplift dealer performance—especially new partners or dealers showing performance gaps.
- Train dealer staff on sales processes, product knowledge, pricing logic, and system usage.
- Provide structured follow‑up and progress reporting.

Individual Dealer Development Initiatives:
- Build customized development plans for selected focus dealers, covering customer segmentation, pricing strategy, potential analysis, ordering process optimization, and communication workflows.
- Establish monthly targets and track progress through structured reporting.

Customer Visits (IRs & Garage Chains):
- Conduct onsite visits to IRs and garage chains to promote product awareness, strengthen relationships, and expand parts sales.
- Provide hands‑on support for online ordering platforms and workshop systems.
- Document visit results and define improvement initiatives.

Customer Assessments & Action Plans:
- Evaluate the turnover potential and engagement level of IRs and garage chains.
- Identify commercial opportunities and develop improvement plans based on market need.
- Upload structured assessments and follow‑ups into the required systems.

Skills & Experience that are a + for the role:
- At least 5+ years in automotive aftermarket sales, field force, network development, or workshop consulting.
- Understanding of dealer operations, workshop processes, and B2B parts distribution.
- Strong skills in coaching, performance assessment, and relationship‑building.
- Ability to interpret KPIs, market data, and customer behavior patterns.
- Comfort working in structured, report‑driven environments.
- Strong communicator capable of influencing diverse stakeholders.
- Fluency in Portuguese + English (B2 min).

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at   www.accenture.com
